title: Artificial intelligence in esophageal cancer radiotherapy: a literature review.
zh_title: 人工智能在食管癌放疗中的应用：文献综述
summary: 检索并综述2020年以来AI在食管癌放疗流程各环节应用的原创研究。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Embase与Web of Science
覆盖放疗流程多个环节的AI应用
旨在提升效率并推动放疗个体化
reason: 文献综述，无新数据或系统定量合并，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of thoracic disease] Radiotherapy is a key component in the management of esophageal cancer (EC). Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative tool for optimizing radiotherapy workflows. Numerous AI-based tools are being developed to improve efficiency and facilitate the personalization of radiation oncology. This study aimed to provide an up-to-date review of the literature on recent advances in AI applications across the EC radiotherapy workflow. The PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases were searched to retrieve original English-language articles published from January 1, 2020 to May 26, 2026. The following search terms were used: "Esophageal neoplasms", "esophageal cancer", "oesophageal cancer" AND "artificial intelligence", "AI" AND "radiation oncology", "radiotherapy", "radiation", "chemoradiotherapy". The included studies covered different steps in the radiotherapy workflow; that is, initial treatment decision-making, treatment planning and preparation, treatment delivery, and post-treatment follow-up. A total of 105 studies covering the different stages of the radiotherapy workflow were included in the review. Most studies focused on initial treatment decision-making, primarily benefit-risk stratification through predictive modeling of treatment outcomes and treatment-related toxicities, followed by treatment planning and preparation, particularly automated segmentation and treatment planning. Conversely, few studies investigated AI applications in treatment plan approval and quality assurance, or treatment delivery. Notably, most of the included studies were retrospective, with substantial heterogeneity in study designs, methodologies, and reporting. AI demonstrates substantial potential to facilitate clinical decision-making while improving the efficiency and accuracy of radiotherapy workflows. Future research should prioritize multicenter prospective studies, standardized methodological and reporting frameworks, and explainable AI (XAI) to improve the reliability, transparency, and clinical translation of AI models.
zh_abstract: [Journal of thoracic disease] 放疗是食管癌（EC）管理的关键组成部分。人工智能（AI）已成为优化放疗工作流程的变革性工具。许多基于 AI 的工具正在开发中，以提高效率并促进放射肿瘤学的个性化。本研究旨在对 AI 应用在 EC 放疗工作流程中最新进展的文献提供最新综述。检索 PubMed、Embase 和 Web of Science 数据库，以获取 2020 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 5 月 26 日发表的原创英文文章。使用以下检索词：“Esophageal neoplasms”、“esophageal cancer”、“oesophageal cancer” AND “artificial intelligence”、“AI” AND “radiation oncology”、“radiotherapy”、“radiation”、“chemoradiotherapy”。纳入的研究涵盖放疗工作流程的不同步骤，即初始治疗决策、治疗计划与准备、治疗实施以及治疗后随访。本综述共纳入 105 项研究，涵盖放疗工作流程的不同阶段。大多数研究集中于初始治疗决策，主要是通过对治疗结局和治疗相关毒性进行预测建模来进行获益-风险分层，其次是治疗计划与准备，尤其是自动分割和治疗计划。相反，很少有研究探讨 AI 在治疗计划审批和质量保证或治疗实施中的应用。值得注意的是，大多数纳入研究为回顾性研究，在研究设计、方法和报告方面存在显著异质性。AI 在促进临床决策的同时提高放疗工作流程的效率和准确性方面展现出巨大潜力。未来研究应优先开展多中心前瞻性研究、标准化的方法和报告框架以及可解释人工智能（XAI），以提高 AI 模型的可靠性、透明性和临床转化。

title: Multimodal imaging and artificial intelligence for bone tumor diagnosis: Comparative performance and emerging technologies.
zh_title: 骨肿瘤诊断的多模态影像与人工智能：性能比较与新兴技术
summary: 综述比较影像学与AI/影像组学在骨肿瘤诊断、分期与疗效预测中的作用，强调参考标准稳定性是主要瓶颈。
key_points: 比较X线、CT、MRI、PET在骨肿瘤诊疗中的定位
AI与影像组学用于分类、分割、预后与反应预测
提出核心限制在于参考标准稳定性而非算法
reason: 叙述性综述，提出观点但无新数据，属增量档上限
abstract: [Journal of bone oncology] Multimodal imaging is central to the diagnosis, staging, and management of bone tumors. Radiography and computed tomography remain essential for initial assessment and cortical evaluation, magnetic resonance imaging provides superior soft tissue contrast and local staging accuracy, and positron emission tomography enhances detection of metastatic disease and treatment response. No single technique suffices across clinical scenarios. Advances in artificial intelligence and radiomics offer avenues to augment this framework, with demonstrated potential in lesion classification, segmentation, prognostication, and response prediction. This review advances a specific argument rather than surveying available technologies: that the principal constraint on artificial intelligence in musculoskeletal oncology is the stability of the reference standard rather than algorithmic capability. Ground truth in bone tumors is unstable on four grounds. Core needle biopsy samples a limited volume and may miss the highest-grade component: agreement between biopsy and resection grade in central chondrosarcoma falls from a weighted kappa of 0.63 in long bones to 0.12 in the pelvis. Expert interpretation is itself inconsistent, with interobserver kappa for grading cartilaginous tumors of 0.44 among musculoskeletal pathologists and 0.35 among radiologists. Molecular criteria have redefined entities within the past decade, so older datasets contain classes that no longer exist as defined. And histological classification does not reliably predict clinical behavior. Consequently, measurable accuracy has a ceiling set by the reference standard rather than the algorithm, and apparent failure on external validation may reflect label divergence between institutions rather than model deficiency. Evidence is graded throughout, and clinical readiness distinguished from technical performance. No system for primary bone tumor characterization has regulatory clearance in the United States or Europe, and formal appraisal of this literature confirms low methodological compliance and infrequent external validation. Progress will depend on multicenter validation and protocol harmonization, and, distinctively for this field, on composite reference standards, outcome-based endpoints, and explicit uncertainty modelling, since ground-truth instability can be mitigated but not eliminated.
zh_abstract: [Journal of bone oncology] 多模态影像对骨肿瘤的诊断、分期和管理至关重要。X线摄影和计算机断层扫描仍是初始评估和皮质评估的关键，磁共振成像提供更优的软组织对比度和局部分期准确性，正电子发射断层扫描增强转移性疾病和治疗反应的检测。没有单一技术足以应对所有临床情景。人工智能和放射组学的进展提供了扩展这一框架的途径，在病变分类、分割、预后预测和反应预测方面已显示出潜力。本综述提出一个具体论点，而非综述现有技术：在肌肉骨骼肿瘤学中，人工智能的主要限制是参考标准的稳定性，而不是算法能力。骨肿瘤中的真实标签因四个理由而不稳定。粗针活检取样体积有限，可能遗漏最高级别成分：在中央性软骨肉瘤中，活检与切除分级之间的一致性从长骨中的加权kappa 0.63降至骨盆中的0.12。专家解读本身也不一致，肌肉骨骼病理学家对软骨性肿瘤分级的观察者间kappa为0.44，放射科医生为0.35。分子标准在过去十年内重新定义了实体，因此较旧的数据集包含按当前定义已不存在的类别。并且组织学分类不能可靠预测临床行为。因此，可测量的准确性有一个由参考标准而非算法设定的上限，外部验证中表面上的失败可能反映机构间标签分歧而非模型缺陷。全文对证据进行分级，并将临床就绪度与技术性能区分开来。在美国或欧洲，尚无用于原发性骨肿瘤表征的系统获得监管许可，对该文献的正式评估证实方法学依从性低且外部验证不频繁。进展将取决于多中心验证和方案协调，并且该领域的独特之处在于，还取决于复合参考标准、基于结局的终点和明确的不确定性建模，因为真实标签不稳定性可以减轻但无法消除。

title: Methodological Adherence, Reporting Completeness, and Risk of Bias in AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews: A Matched Meta-Research Study
zh_title: AI辅助系统综述的方法学依从性与偏倚风险：匹配元研究
summary: medRxiv预印本以1:2匹配比较报告使用AI与未报告使用AI的健康系统综述，评估方法学依从性、报告完整性与偏倚风险。
key_points: 匹配维度含发表时间、临床领域、综述类型与是否含meta分析
比较方法学依从性、报告完整性与偏倚风险
并评估AI使用披露的透明度
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 元研究方法学预印本，关注证据质量但无模型性能或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to accelerate systematic reviews that inform clinical practice and policy. However, evidence on the methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias of completed AI-assisted reviews is limited. Objective: To compare methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias between published systematic reviews with reported AI assistance and matched reviews with no reported AI use, and to assess AI-use transparency. Methods: We conducted a matched-cohort meta-research study of English-language, peer-reviewed health systematic reviews. AI-assisted reviews published during 2023--2025 were matched 1:2 to reviews with no reported AI use using individualized MEDLINE searches targeting publication timing, clinical domain, review type, and meta-analysis status. When more than two eligible comparators were available, two were randomly selected. AI assistance was defined as reported use during searching, screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, evidence synthesis, or substantive drafting. Full texts and supplementary materials were examined to classify reported AI use. The primary outcome was a prespecified modified 13-item AMSTAR-2 methodological-adherence score (range 0 -- 13; noninferiority margin &-1 point). Secondary outcomes included PRISMA 2020 reporting completeness and ROBIS risk of bias; AI-use transparency was assessed descriptively. Adapted 13-item AMSTAR-2 confidence categories were summarized descriptively, while critical- and noncritical-domain adherence was examined in exploratory adjusted analyses. Multivariable regression models adjusted for journal impact tier, funding reporting, formal review-group affiliation, review-team size, and review-question type, using cluster-robust standard errors by matched set. Sensitivity analyses included matched-set fixed-effects models. The study was registered on the Open Science Framework (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q5JRW). Results: The cohort included 231 systematic reviews: 77 AI-assisted and 154 with no reported AI use. Mean 13-item AMSTAR-2 scores were 7.58 and 9.63, respectively. In multivariable-adjusted analyses, AI-assisted reviews scored 1.64 points lower (95% CI &-2.37 to &- 0.91); noninferiority was not demonstrated. PRISMA adherence was estimated to be 4.7 percentage points lower among AI-assisted reviews in primary adjusted analyses (95% CI &-8.9 to &-0.6) and 6.4 points lower in matched-set fixed-effects
zh_abstract: 【背景】人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于加速为临床实践和政策提供信息的系统综述。然而，关于已完成的 AI 辅助综述的方法学依从性、报告完整性和偏倚风险，证据有限。【目的】比较报告使用 AI 辅助的已发表系统综述与报告未使用 AI 的匹配系统综述在方法学依从性、报告完整性和偏倚风险方面的差异，并评估 AI 使用的透明度。【方法】我们开展了一项匹配队列的元研究，纳入英文、经同行评审的卫生领域系统综述。使用针对发表时间、临床领域、综述类型和荟萃分析状态的个体化 MEDLINE 检索，将 2023--2025 年发表的 AI 辅助综述按 1:2 与报告未使用 AI 的综述匹配。当有超过两名符合条件的对照可用时，随机选择两名。AI 辅助定义为报告在检索、筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、证据合成或实质性起草过程中使用 AI。检查全文和补充材料以对报告的 AI 使用进行分类。主要结局为预先设定的改良 13 条目 AMSTAR-2 方法学依从性评分（范围 0--13；非劣效性界值 &-1 分）。次要结局包括 PRISMA 2020 报告完整性和 ROBIS 偏倚风险；AI 使用透明度采用描述性评估。改良 13 条目 AMSTAR-2 置信度类别采用描述性总结，而关键域和非关键域依从性在探索性校正分析中检查。多变量回归模型校正期刊影响层级、资金报告、正式综述组隶属关系、综述团队规模和综述问题类型，并按匹配集使用聚类稳健标准误。敏感性分析包括匹配集固定效应模型。该研究已在 Open Science Framework 注册（DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q5JRW）。【结果】该队列包括 231 篇系统综述：77 篇 AI 辅助和 154 篇报告未使用 AI。13 条目 AMSTAR-2 平均评分分别为 7.58 和 9.63。在多变量校正分析中，AI 辅助综述评分低 1.64 分（95% CI &-2.37 至 &-0.91）；未证明非劣效性。在主要校正分析中，AI 辅助综述的 PRISMA 依从性估计低 4.7 个百分点（95% CI &-8.9 至 &-0.6），在匹配集固定效应中低 6.4 分

title: StableProt: Structure-Aware Deep Learning for Protein Thermostability (Tm) and Environmental Adaptation (OGT) Prediction
zh_title: StableProt：结构感知深度学习预测蛋白热稳定性与适应温度
summary: bioRxiv预印本提出StableProt，结合序列与Foldseek 3Di结构令牌，双头分别预测蛋白熔解温度Tm与生物最适生长温度OGT。
key_points: 基于冻结SaProt主干融合三维接触信息
分离预测头避免双任务梯度冲突
对嗜温数据下采样以缓解数据库偏倚
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 单任务蛋白质预测预印本，方法有小幅改进但缺乏外部基准细节，属增量档
abstract: Predicting protein melting temperature (Tm) and organismal optimal growth temperature (OGT) is essential for enzyme engineering, biocatalyst design, and metagenomic bioprospecting, yet computational prediction faces several fundamental bottlenecks: sequence-only representations miss tertiary packing; dual-task coupling induces destructive gradient conflict; natural database skew (>87% mesophiles) drives mesophilic collapse; and existing tools produce uncalibrated point predictions. To address these challenges, we present StableProt, a structure-aware framework that couples amino acid sequences with Foldseek 3Di structural tokens via a frozen SaProt backbone to capture 3D contacts. Disjoint heads condition thermodynamic stability on ecological context without gradient conflict, while targeted 14% mesophilic subsampling expands thermophile representation to eliminate mesophilic collapse. Calibrated ensemble modeling reduces calibration error to 1.92%, providing dependable 95% confidence intervals. Evaluating models across 10{degrees}C temperature intervals reveals severe baseline collapse at thermal extremes, whereas StableProt maintains robust accuracy across regimes. On ProThermDB and zero-shot FireProtDB, StableProt achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic accuracy (CRPS = 4.52{degrees}C and 8.71{degrees}C) while recovering 92.0% of hyperthermophiles ([≥]80{degrees}C), and in prospective validation, its calibrated intervals capture both enzyme stability (75.3% coverage) and host environmental growth temperatures (78.1% coverage). StableProt is freely accessible as an interactive web server at https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/.
zh_abstract: 预测蛋白质熔解温度（Tm）和生物体最适生长温度（OGT）对于酶工程、生物催化剂设计和宏基因组生物勘探至关重要，但计算预测面临若干根本性瓶颈：仅序列表征遗漏三级堆积；双任务耦合导致破坏性梯度冲突；自然数据库偏斜（>87% 为嗜温菌）驱动嗜温塌缩；现有工具产生未校准的点预测。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 StableProt，一个结构感知框架，通过冻结的 SaProt 主干将氨基酸序列与 Foldseek 3Di 结构 token 耦合，以捕获 3D 接触。不相交的头将热力学稳定性条件化于生态背景，而不产生梯度冲突；同时，有针对性的 14% 嗜温子采样扩大嗜热菌代表性，以消除嗜温塌缩。校准集成建模将校准误差降至 1.92%，提供可靠的 95% 置信区间。在 10°C 温度区间评估模型显示，基线在热极端处严重塌缩，而 StableProt 在各区间保持稳健准确性。在 ProThermDB 和零样本 FireProtDB 上，StableProt 达到最先进的概率准确性（CRPS = 4.52°C 和 8.71°C），同时回收 92.0% 的超嗜热菌（[≥]80°C）；在前瞻性验证中，其校准区间同时覆盖酶稳定性（75.3% 覆盖率）和宿主环境生长温度（78.1% 覆盖率）。StableProt 可作为交互式网络服务器免费访问：https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/。

title: Artificial intelligence in Saudi otolaryngology research: a scoping review of the current landscape, gaps, and future directions.
zh_title: 沙特耳鼻喉科 AI 研究范围综述
summary: 范围综述梳理2019年以来沙特耳鼻喉科 AI 研究主题与空白。
key_points: 遵循 PRISMA-ScR 检索五大来源
覆盖人工耳蜗、鼻颅底、头颈肿瘤等领域
指出研究主题分布与知识空白
reason: 范围综述属综述类，受最高6分限制，且无新数据，仅在增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in otolaryngology, but the extent and focus of AI research in Saudi Arabia remain unclear. This scoping review mapped the available evidence and identified key research themes and knowledge gaps. A scoping review was conducted following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and the Saudi Medical Journal archive were searched for studies published between January 2019 and April 2026. Eligible studies investigated AI applications or clinician perspectives within Saudi otolaryngology. The evidence was mapped across major otolaryngology domains, including cochlear implantation and hearing, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, head and neck oncology, surgical and other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea, AI education and implementation, and AI-assisted patient education. The searches identified 2,925 database records, four records from other sources and seven records from an updated search and expert suggestions; thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence covered AI awareness and education, large language model (LLM)-based patient education, cochlear implantation, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, and head and neck oncology; no eligible study addressed surgical or other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea. Clinicians were generally positive about AI, while clinical studies showed promising performance of AI models. LLM chatbots generally gave accurate postoperative advice, although, when validated tools were used, their responses were harder to read and less actionable than patient-education standards recommend. However, limited AI education, small or non-Saudi datasets, limited external validation, and implementation barriers remained important challenges. AI research in Saudi otolaryngology remains limited but is expanding across several clinical domains. Future research should prioritise Saudi-specific datasets, multicentre clinical validation, structured AI education, rigorous bilingual (Arabic and English) evaluation of LLM-generated patient information, and safe integration of AI into clinical practice in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] 人工智能（AI）在耳鼻咽喉科学中的应用日益增多，但沙特阿拉伯 AI 研究的范围和重点仍不明确。本范围综述梳理了现有证据，并识别了关键研究主题和知识空白。按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南开展了一项范围综述。检索 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、Google Scholar 和 Saudi Medical Journal 档案，纳入 2019 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月发表的研究。符合条件的研究调查了沙特耳鼻咽喉科学中的 AI 应用或临床医生观点。证据按耳鼻咽喉科学主要领域进行映射，包括人工耳蜗植入与听力、鼻科学与颅底外科、面部整形外科、喉科学与嗓音、头颈肿瘤学、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的外科及其他耳鼻咽喉科相关干预、AI 教育与实施，以及 AI 辅助患者教育。检索共识别 2,925 条数据库记录、4 条其他来源记录和 7 条来自更新检索及专家建议的记录；13 项研究符合纳入标准。证据涵盖 AI 意识与教育、基于大语言模型（LLM）的患者教育、人工耳蜗植入、鼻科学与颅底外科、面部整形外科、喉科学与嗓音以及头颈肿瘤学；没有符合条件的研究涉及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的外科或其他耳鼻咽喉科相关干预。临床医生对 AI 总体持积极态度，而临床研究显示 AI 模型具有良好性能。LLM 聊天机器人通常能给出准确的术后建议，不过，当使用经过验证的工具评估时，其回答比患者教育标准所建议的更难以阅读且可操作性更低。然而，AI 教育有限、数据集较小或非沙特数据集、外部验证有限以及实施障碍仍然是重要挑战。沙特耳鼻咽喉科学中的 AI 研究仍然有限，但正在多个临床领域扩展。未来研究应优先建立沙特特异性数据集、开展多中心临床验证、提供结构化 AI 教育、对 LLM 生成的患者信息进行严格的双语（阿拉伯语和英语）评估，并按照 Saudi Vision 2030 将 AI 安全整合到临床实践中。

title: An Anatomy-guided 3D Segmentation Pipeline for Prostate Surgical Phantoms from CT Scans
zh_title: 前列腺手术体模 CT 解剖引导三维分割
summary: 提出解剖引导的三维分割流程，用于 CT 中的前列腺手术体模。
key_points: 面向机器人前列腺手术体模的自动分割
用于运动规划与术后性能评估
reason: 预印本方法研究，针对体模小规模不一致数据，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Full autonomy has been a long-term goal in robotic surgery and a near-to-medium-term goal for prostatectomy. Due to the relatively closed structure of the procedure, its standard-of-care robotic/laparoscopic solutions, and procedure economics, prostate procedures are an optimal early target for surgical automation. Prototyping and testing of possible solutions is done in constructed laboratory phantoms, either synthetic tissues or animal phantoms. To enable measurement of perceptual and robotic motion error, phantoms undergo volumetric imaging; these images are critical to both a potential deployed automatic system, used in planning motion and treatment (cutting, ablation, suturing, etc.), as well as post-hoc assessment of system performance. Rapid iteration on these phantom models yields small, inconsistent datasets, while the current workflow for human annotation is often anatomically unreliable and prohibitively time-consuming, rendering deep learning unsuitable at reasonable scales. To address these limitations, we present an automated 3D segmentation pipeline that uses classical medical image-processing techniques to encode the known anatomy of the phantoms as explicit geometric and intensity priors, which requires no training corpus and is transferred to each new phantom revision without re-annotation. Across 57 scans spanning multiple phantom revisions, our pipeline recovers the capsule interior at 0.83 median Dice on 11 contrast-suppressed scans and detects all 32 annotated focal lesions without false positives, completing a full scan in 2-8 minutes on commodity CPU hardware versus 1-2 hours by hand.
zh_abstract: 完全自主一直是机器人手术的长期目标，也是前列腺切除术近中期目标。由于该手术相对闭合的结构、其标准治疗机器人/腹腔镜解决方案以及手术经济学，前列腺手术是手术自动化的最佳早期目标。可能解决方案的原型制作和测试在构建的实验室体模（phantom）中进行，这些体模要么是合成组织，要么是动物体模。为了能够测量感知和机器人运动误差，体模接受体积成像；这些图像对于潜在部署的自动系统（用于规划运动和治療，如切割、消融、缝合等）以及系统性能的事后评估都至关重要。对这些体模模型的快速迭代产生小型、不一致的数据集，而当前人工标注工作流程在解剖学上往往不可靠且耗时过长，使深度学习无法在合理规模上适用。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种自动化3D分割流程，该流程使用经典医学图像处理技术，将体模的已知解剖结构编码为显式几何和强度先验，无需训练语料库，并可迁移到每个新体模版本而无需重新标注。在跨越多个体模版本的57次扫描中，我们的流程在11次对比度抑制扫描上以0.83的中位Dice恢复胶囊内部，并检测到全部32个标注局灶性病变且无假阳性，在商用CPU硬件上2-8分钟完成一次完整扫描，而手工需1-2小时。

title: MotionBench-XAI: Benchmarking What Shapes Shapley Explanations in Spatiotemporal Machine Learning
zh_title: MotionBench-XAI：时空机器学习中 Shapley 解释的基准
summary: 构建含精确真值 Shapley 值的合成数据集与真实数据基准，考察时空数据中解释方法的设计选择影响。
key_points: 五个合成数据集含精确真值归因
纳入三个真实时空数据集
含帕金森严重度动作评估场景
reason: 方法学基准预印本，临床相关性间接，属增量档
abstract: Predicting outcomes from spatiotemporal data, such as assessing Parkinson's severity from human motion, often requires explainability in addition to accuracy. Practitioners need to know what drove the prediction, whether it be spatial (a body joint), temporal (a specific window), or both. Shapley values are attributions computed by treating input features as players in a cooperative game and measuring how the model output changes as coalitions of players are removed. Computing them involves choosing what counts as players, how absent players are imputed, and how the game is evaluated. How these choices affect explanation quality is poorly understood for spatiotemporal data, and real data carries no ground-truth attributions to check against. We present MotionBench-XAI, a benchmark built on i) five synthetic spatiotemporal datasets with exact ground-truth Shapley values, ii) three real datasets across clinical gait, electrocardiogram, and audio, iii) ten attribution methods across three player sets, and iv) three trained architectures. We show that grouping features into players, across time, space, or both, matters more than the choice of imputer. Generative imputers improve explanations only when their conditional models are accurate. On real data, the standard proxy metrics select contradictory best methods. We distill these findings into practical insights and provide an open-source pipeline.
zh_abstract: 从时空数据预测结局，例如根据人体运动评估帕金森病严重程度，通常不仅要求准确性，还要求可解释性。从业者需要知道是什么驱动了预测，无论是空间上的（某个身体关节）、时间上的（某个特定窗口），还是两者兼有。Shapley 值是通过将输入特征视为合作博弈中的参与者，并衡量当参与者联盟被移除时模型输出如何变化而计算出的归因。计算它们涉及选择什么算作参与者、如何对缺失参与者进行插补，以及如何评估该博弈。对于时空数据，这些选择如何影响解释质量仍知之甚少，而且真实数据没有可用来核对的真实归因。我们提出 MotionBench-XAI，一个基准，建立在 i) 五个具有精确真实 Shapley 值的合成时空数据集，ii) 跨临床步态、心电图和音频的三个真实数据集，iii) 跨三组参与者集合的十种归因方法，以及 iv) 三个已训练架构之上。我们表明，将特征分组为参与者——跨时间、空间或两者——比插补器的选择更重要。生成式插补器仅在其条件模型准确时才能改善解释。在真实数据上，标准代理指标会选择相互矛盾的最佳方法。我们将这些发现提炼为实用见解，并提供开源流程。

title: RapidMitDet: Boosting Computational Efficiency for Mitosis Detection via Magnification Alignment
zh_title: RapidMitDet：基于放大倍率对齐提升核分裂检测计算效率
summary: 提出由粗到细的核分裂检测框架，低倍筛候选、高倍确认，并用倍率对齐知识蒸馏缩小信息差。
key_points: 粗到细框架降低全切片吉像素级计算负担
倍率对齐知识蒸馏缓解低倍模型性能下降
面向病理核分裂指数评估的临床可用性
reason: 聚焦效率改进的预印本，缺少外部验证与临床结局证据
abstract: Automated mitosis detection is a critical research focus, enabling pathologists to rapidly assess mitotic indices for tumor malignancy evaluation. However, most of the existing detection approaches suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the giga-pixel image resolution of Whole-Slide Images (WSIs), which greatly hinders their clinical applicability. In this study, we propose RapidMitDet, a computational efficient mitosis detection approach. Our method employs a coarse-to-fine framework, first identifying mitotic candidates at lower magnification and then confirming them at higher magnification. In the coarse-detection stage, we introduce magnification-aligned knowledge distillation to reduce the information gap between magnification levels while minimizing the performance degradation in the lower magnification detection model. In the subsequent fine-classification stage, we propose adaptive triplet learning (ATL) to optimize infomative sample selection, thereby enhancing discrimination between mitotic and non-mitotic instances. Experimental results show that RapidMitDet achieves the optimal accuracy-efficiency balance at 20x magnification, improving computational speed by up to 5.62 times over the latest state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Due to its lightweight model design, RapidMitDet can also deliver efficient detection at higher magnification (40x) while achieving even higher detection performance. In WSI-level evaluations, our method shows strong agreement with pathologists' diagnoses (ICCs: 0.879 (40x), 0.822 (20x)) while maintaining superior efficiency, highlighting its potential for clinical application. Code is available at https://github.com/logincat/RapidMitDet
zh_abstract: 自动有丝分裂检测是一个关键研究重点，使病理学家能够快速评估有丝分裂指数以进行肿瘤恶性评估。然而，由于全切片图像（Whole-Slide Images, WSIs）的千兆像素图像分辨率，大多数现有检测方法存在显著的计算低效问题，这极大阻碍了其临床适用性。在本研究中，我们提出RapidMitDet，一种计算高效的有丝分裂检测方法。我们的方法采用由粗到细框架，首先在较低放大倍数下识别有丝分裂候选，然后在较高放大倍数下确认它们。在粗检测阶段，我们引入倍率对齐知识蒸馏，以减少放大倍数之间的信息差距，同时最小化较低放大倍数检测模型中的性能下降。在随后的细分类阶段，我们提出自适应三元组学习（adaptive triplet learning, ATL）以优化信息性样本选择，从而增强有丝分裂与非有丝分裂实例之间的区分。实验结果表明，RapidMitDet在20倍放大倍数下实现最佳准确率-效率平衡，相比最新最先进（SOTA）方法将计算速度提高最多5.62倍。由于其轻量级模型设计，RapidMitDet还可在更高放大倍数（40倍）下提供高效检测，同时实现更高的检测性能。在WSI水平评估中，我们的方法与病理学家诊断高度一致（ICC：0.879（40倍）、0.822（20倍）），同时保持卓越效率，突显其临床应用潜力。代码公开于 https://github.com/logincat/RapidMitDet

abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】对于抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性个体如何进行风湿科转诊分诊，目前尚无循证指导。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测哪些新发 ANA 阳性检测个体将发生系统性自身免疫病，并在一项为期 2 年的随机实用性研究中评估其对自身免疫病诊断时间的影响。【方法】该模型被整合到单一学术卫生系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有 ANA 阳性个体均按 1:1 随机分组，且分组独立于风险评分。在干预组中，高风险评分个体被邀请接受加快的风湿科评估。在对照组中，风险评分被计算但不据此采取措施。所有参与者均接受标准治疗，并可转诊至风湿科。每 6 个月进行病历审查，评估患者是否接受过风湿科评估以及是否获得自身免疫病诊断。主要结局为从 ANA 阳性检测至诊断的时间，采用 Cox 比例风险模型进行分析。在 ANA 阳性后 6 个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较研究组间被诊断为自身免疫病的比例。【结果】在 2385 名随机分组个体中，随机化后排除后，干预组 954 人和对照组 1006 人被纳入分析。干预组个体从 ANA 阳性日期起至自身免疫病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比，1.9；95% 置信区间，1.3 至 2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为 43 天，对照组为 138 天。在 ANA 阳性检测后 6 个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组 23% 和对照组 16% 被诊断为自身免疫病（P=0.07）。【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入临床预测模型的干预与显著更短的自身免疫病诊断时间相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: Deep learning-based detection and classification of airway nodules on CT for early medical intervention.
zh_title: 深度学习检测与分类CT气道结节
summary: 回顾性研究构建深度学习模型检测低剂量CT气道结节，并在四家医院独立外部测试。
key_points: 1043名受试者1107例低剂量CT，共1813个结节
907个近端结节用于训练，738个独立外部测试
作为第二阅片工具评估其临床效用
reason: 四院独立外部验证且样本可观，但为回顾性、无临床结局，属重要档下限
abstract: [Insights into imaging] Airway lesions are common CT findings in interval and post-screen lung cancers; however, airway nodules are frequently overlooked. Robust artificial intelligence (AI) tools for characterizing airway nodules remain limited. This study aimed to develop and evaluate deep learning-based models for the detection and classification of airway nodules on low-dose CT(LDCT) as a second-reading tool. 1813 segmental and more proximal airway nodules were retrospectively identified from 1107 LDCT of 1043 participants. A sphere-based center-points matching network, first used to establish a lung nodule detection model, was transferred to airway nodules and enhanced by incorporating coordinate and multiscale attention. The model was trained on 907 proximal airway nodules and independently tested on 738 proximal nodules across four hospitals. The clinical utility of the AI tool was evaluated through human-AI interaction. For nodule classification, a 3D SEResNeXt101-based model was trained, validated and tested using 286 airway nodules (121 benign, 165 malignant) with a 6:2:2 split and evaluated in an independent testing dataset. On the independent testing set, the detection model achieved a high sensitivity of 73.7%. Human-AI interaction demonstrated AI assistance significantly improved radiologists' performance, increasing sensitivity from 39.5% to 72.9% and F1-score from 49.4% to 77.2%, while reducing diagnosis time from 83.8 s to 61.8 s. The classification model showed high sensitivities of 82.1%, 71.4%, 94.3%, 72.7% and specificities of 62.7%, 73.9%, 73.9%, 87.5% across multicenter training, validation, testing and independent testing sets, respectively. This AI system significantly enhances the detection and classification of proximal airway nodules, guiding early medical intervention. Question Improved early detection and classification of airway nodules are critical for lung cancer mortality reduction, but AI-based CAD systems targeting airway nodules remain scarce. Findings The DL models for detection and classification of proximal airway nodules on chest CT were developed and assisted radiologists to achieve higher detection accuracy. Critical Relevance Statement The clinical applications of the proposed DL-based system for detecting and classifying proximal airway nodules on chest CT scans help radiologists reduce missed/delayed diagnoses and shorten diagnostic time as a second-reading tool, guiding medical intervention and improving clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 气道病变是间期肺癌和筛查后肺癌中常见的 CT 表现；然而，气道结节常被忽视。用于表征气道结节的稳健人工智能（AI）工具仍然有限。本研究旨在开发并评估基于深度学习的模型，用于在低剂量 CT（LDCT）上检测和分类气道结节，作为二次阅片工具。回顾性从 1043 名参与者的 1107 次 LDCT 中识别出 1813 个段级及更近端气道结节。一个基于球体的中心点匹配网络最初用于建立肺结节检测模型，随后被迁移至气道结节，并通过纳入坐标注意力和多尺度注意力进行增强。该模型在 907 个近端气道结节上训练，并在四家医院的 738 个近端结节上独立测试。通过人机交互评估了该 AI 工具的临床效用。对于结节分类，使用 286 个气道结节（121 个良性、165 个恶性）按 6:2:2 划分训练、验证和测试了一个基于 3D SEResNeXt101 的模型，并在独立测试数据集中进行评估。在独立测试集上，检测模型达到 73.7% 的高灵敏度。人机交互表明，AI 辅助显著提高了放射科医生的表现，将灵敏度从 39.5% 提高到 72.9%，F1 分数从 49.4% 提高到 77.2%，同时将诊断时间从 83.8 秒缩短至 61.8 秒。该分类模型在多中心训练、验证、测试和独立测试集上分别显示出 82.1%、71.4%、94.3%、72.7% 的高灵敏度和 62.7%、73.9%、73.9%、87.5% 的特异度。该系统显著增强近端气道结节的检测和分类，指导早期医疗干预。【问题】改善气道结节的早期检测和分类对于降低肺癌死亡率至关重要，但针对气道结节的基于 AI 的 CAD 系统仍然稀缺。【发现】开发了用于胸部 CT 上近端气道结节检测和分类的深度学习（DL）模型，并帮助放射科医生实现更高的检测准确率。【关键相关性声明】所提出的基于 DL 的系统在胸部 CT 扫描上检测和分类近端气道结节的临床应用，有助于放射科医生作为二次阅片工具减少漏诊/延迟诊断并缩短诊断时间，指导医疗干预并改善临床结局。

title: AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization for childhood brain tumors.
zh_title: AI模型MANTIS预测儿童脑肿瘤预后
summary: 基于2786例甲基化数据构建MANTIS，用神经网络预测儿童脑肿瘤生存与治疗效应。
key_points: MANTIS预测髓母细胞瘤与室管膜瘤10年生存
C-index最高0.80±0.07，优于临床指标
可识别约60%平均风险患者的治疗效应
reason: 同行评审，2786例大样本，预测临床结局，属重要档
abstract: [Nature genetics] Accurate prediction of patient outcomes remains a critical challenge in oncology, in particular for childhood brain tumors, in which treatment decisions need to carefully balance risk of tumor recurrence and death against severe therapy-induced sequelae. Here, we developed MANTIS (methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions), a precision artificial intelligence (AI) tool for medulloblastoma and ependymoma outcome prediction built on genome-wide DNA methylation array data from 2,786 patients. MANTIS generates individualized survival probabilities over a 10-year period and achieves concordance indices as high as 0.80 ± 0.07, significantly exceeding the predictive accuracy of current clinical indicators. Extending MANTIS to estimate individualized treatment effects identifies ~60% of patients with average-risk medulloblastoma without a significant survival disadvantage (P = 0.683) when treated with less intensive craniospinal irradiation doses, which is associated with improved neurocognitive outcomes. In conclusion, our study establishes a foundation for AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization in childhood brain tumors and offers a blueprint for similar initiatives in other cancer types.
zh_abstract: ［Nature genetics］准确预测患者结局仍是肿瘤学中的关键挑战，尤其是儿童脑肿瘤，其治疗决策需要仔细权衡肿瘤复发和死亡风险与严重治疗诱导的后遗症。在此，我们开发了MANTIS（methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions；甲基化谱分析和人工神经网络用于时间依赖性个体化生存预测），一种用于髓母细胞瘤和室管膜瘤结局预测的精准人工智能（AI）工具，基于2,786例患者全基因组DNA甲基化芯片数据构建。MANTIS生成10年期间的个体化生存概率，一致性指数高达0.80 ± 0.07，显著超过当前临床指标的预测准确性。将MANTIS扩展以估计个体化治疗效应，识别出约60%的平均风险髓母细胞瘤患者在接受较低强度颅脊髓照射剂量治疗时无显著生存劣势（P = 0.683），而较低强度颅脊髓照射剂量与神经认知结局改善相关。总之，我们的研究为儿童脑肿瘤基于AI的精准预后和治疗个体化奠定了基础，并为其他癌症类型的类似计划提供了蓝图。

title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography
zh_title: MambaSleepCVD：用多导睡眠图预测长期心血管结局
summary: 基于 Coupled Mamba 的多模态融合模型，在 SHHS 队列上用整夜多导睡眠图预测长期心血管风险。
key_points: 用 Coupled Mamba 融合跨模态与时序信息
比较任务专用单模态编码器与多模态自监督预训练
在 SHHS 数据集上验证，性能与基线相当或更优
reason: 新方法加公开队列验证，但为回顾性单一人群数据，无外部验证
abstract: Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability, we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we show that in the reference dataset chronological age strongly drives survival ranking; when provided as an explicit input, it can create a shortcut that obscures the contribution of PSG-derived physiology. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
zh_abstract: 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍是全球重大临床优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口学混杂因素后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于 Coupled Mamba 的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态和时间融合，捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态交互。借助这一能力，我们评估来自任务特定单模态编码器的专门化监督表征是否提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在睡眠心脏健康研究（SHHS）数据集上验证，我们的方法在完全监督、数据充足的情形下达到与当前最先进架构相当或更好的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就贡献了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们表明在参考数据集中，实际年龄强烈驱动生存排名；当作为显式输入提供时，它可能形成一条捷径，掩盖 PSG 衍生生理信息的贡献。最终，我们的发现表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督单模态专家为从睡眠记录中进行预后风险排序提供了一条灵活途径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查将需要独立外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

title: A Systematic Review of Bias, Validation, and Explainability in Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Dental Diagnostics.
zh_title: 牙科诊断AI的偏倚、验证与可解释性系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA并注册PROSPERO的系统综述，评估牙科多学科AI诊断的效能、方法学质量、偏倚风险、验证与可解释性。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA，PROSPERO注册CRD42025639340
检索PubMed、Embase、Scopus等至2025年12月
用QUADAS-2与RoB 2评估偏倚风险
reason: 多数据库PRISMA系统综述，聚焦偏倚与可解释性，综述上限档取6
abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To critically evaluate the current role of artificial intelligence (AI) in dental diagnosis across multiple dental disciplines, assessing diagnostic performance, methodological quality, risk of bias, validation, explainability, and clinical applicability. This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025639340). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, LILACS, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched up to December-2025. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Risk of bias in diagnostic accuracy studies was assessed using QUADAS-2-tool, evaluating the domains of patient selection, index test, reference standard, flow and timing whilst randomised studies were assessed using Cochrane RoB 2-tool. Reporting quality and transparency of AI-model development and validation were assessed using the selected items from TRIPOD-AI reporting guideline. Methodological quality and risk of bias in AI model development and evaluation were additionally assessed using PROBAST+AI. Ninety-six studies met the inclusion criteria, of which 90.6% were retrospective. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) were the most frequently used architecture (82.3%). Sixteen studies failed to specify the CNN architecture used. Reported diagnostic accuracy ranged from 81% to 99% across dental specialties, with high performance in implantology (92-99%), orthodontics (88-99%), endodontics (87-99%). Panoramic radiographs and cone-beam computed tomography were the most used imaging modalities. QUADAS-2 analysis indicated that high-risk of bias in 55.2% of studies and most lacked external validation, whilst Assessment using selected TRIPOD+AI items identified important gaps in reporting completeness and transparency, particularly in sample-size justification, missing-data handling, protocol availability, study registration, and data or code availability. AI demonstrates substantial technical capability to enhance diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, the predominance of retrospective designs, limited external validation, and methodological weaknesses constrain the strength of current evidence. The use of AI is potentially considered as a decision-support tool rather than replacement for clinical judgement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 严格评价人工智能（AI）在多个牙科专业牙科诊断中的当前作用，评估诊断性能、方法学质量、偏倚风险、验证、可解释性和临床适用性。本系统综述按照PRISMA指南进行，并在PROSPERO注册（CRD42025639340）。检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、LILACS、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Web of Science和ClinicalTrials.gov，截至2025年12月。两名评价者独立进行研究选择、数据提取和偏倚风险评估。诊断准确性研究中的偏倚风险使用QUADAS-2工具评估，评价患者选择、指标试验、参考标准、流程和时间领域；随机研究则使用Cochrane RoB 2工具评估。AI模型开发和验证的报告质量与透明度使用TRIPOD-AI报告指南中的选定条目评估。AI模型开发与评价的方法学质量和偏倚风险额外使用PROBAST+AI评估。96项研究符合纳入标准，其中90.6%为回顾性研究。卷积神经网络（CNN）是最常用的架构（82.3%）。16项研究未说明所使用的CNN架构。各牙科专业报告的诊断准确率范围为81%至99%，在口腔种植学（92-99%）、口腔正畸学（88-99%）、牙髓病学（87-99%）中表现较高。全景X线片和锥形束计算机断层扫描是最常用的成像方式。QUADAS-2分析表明55.2%的研究存在高偏倚风险，且大多数缺乏外部验证；而使用选定的TRIPOD+AI条目进行评估发现，在报告完整性和透明度方面存在重要缺口，尤其是在样本量论证、缺失数据处理、方案可获取性、研究注册以及数据或代码可获取性方面。AI在提高诊断准确性和效率方面展现出相当大的技术能力。然而，回顾性设计占主导、外部验证有限以及方法学弱点限制了当前证据的强度。AI的使用可能被视为一种决策支持工具，而非临床判断的替代。

title: Too good to be true? AI performance in CT-based urinary stone detection and classification: EAU endourology systematic review and diagnostic accuracy meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI在CT尿路结石检测中的诊断准确性meta分析
summary: 纳入14项研究做双变量随机效应合并，评估AI在CT尿路结石检测与分类的敏感度、特异度并做meta回归。
key_points: PROSPERO注册，检索至2026年3月
14项研究：5项检测、9项分类
用QUADAS-AI评估偏倚风险，提示性能或偏高
reason: 系统综述与meta分析、纳入14项研究结论明确，但为二手汇总证据
abstract: [World journal of urology] To evaluate pooled performance of artificial intelligence (AI) in computed tomography (CT)-based urinary stone detection and classification and identify methodological factors influencing results. This review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261319940). A systematic search of PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar was conducted up to March 15, 2026. Studies evaluating AI-based detection or classification of urolithiasis on CT with available validation/test cohort data (sensitivity/specificity or 2 × 2 tables) were included. A bivariate random-effects model generated pooled sensitivity, specificity, and hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves. Meta-regression explored moderators related to dataset composition and AI pipelines. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-AI. 14 studies (five detection-based, nine classification-based) were included. Overall pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.967 and 0.979 (AUC 0.987). Classification studies demonstrated higher pooled sensitivity (0.977) and specificity (0.990) compared with detection studies (0.935 and 0.919; AUC 0.945). Significant heterogeneity was observed and influenced by training sample size, class imbalance, presence of bladder stones or other pathologies, and architectural choices. Most studies had high risk of bias, lacked external validation, and frequently used slice-level or pre-selected datasets, potentially overestimating performance. Substantial methodological heterogeneity and high risk of bias limit clinical generalizability. Detection studies better reflect real-world workflows and show lower performance. Current evidence does not support routine clinical implementation without standardized reporting and robust external validation.
zh_abstract: [World journal of urology] 评估人工智能（AI）在基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的泌尿系结石检测和分类中的汇总性能，并识别影响结果的方法学因素。本综述已在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD420261319940）。对 PubMed、Cochrane Library 和 Google Scholar 进行了截至 2026 年 3 月 15 日的系统检索。纳入评估基于 CT 的尿路结石 AI 检测或分类且具有可用验证/测试队列数据（敏感性/特异性或 2 × 2 表）的研究。双变量随机效应模型生成汇总敏感性、特异性和分层汇总受试者工作特征（HSROC）曲线。Meta 回归探讨了与数据集组成和 AI 流程相关的调节因素。使用 QUADAS-AI 评估偏倚风险。纳入 14 项研究（五项基于检测，九项基于分类）。总体汇总敏感性和特异性分别为 0.967 和 0.979（AUC 0.987）。与检测研究（0.935 和 0.919；AUC 0.945）相比，分类研究显示更高的汇总敏感性（0.977）和特异性（0.990）。观察到显著异质性，并受训练样本量、类别不平衡、膀胱结石或其他病变的存在以及架构选择的影响。大多数研究具有高偏倚风险、缺乏外部验证，并经常使用切片级或预先选择的数据集，可能高估性能。显著的方法学异质性和高偏倚风险限制了临床可推广性。检测研究更好地反映真实世界工作流程，并显示较低性能。当前证据不支持在没有标准化报告和稳健外部验证的情况下进行常规临床实施。

title: Evaluation of large language models for guideline-based clinical questions in muscle-invasive and non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and upper tract urothelial carcinoma: a multidisciplinary Delphi study.
source: PubMed · Journal of comparative effectiveness research
zh_title: 大语言模型回答尿路上皮癌指南问题的Delphi评估
summary: 将2025 EAU指南输入Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT，各实体25题，由7–10人专家组两轮Delphi评分。
key_points: 覆盖NMIBC、MIBC与UTUC三类疾病
各模型一致同意率88%、100%、96%
以9分制评分，中位分≥7为达标
reason: 多模型对比加多学科专家评分，设计规范，但题量有限、无真实临床结局
abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] Aim: To assess expert panel agreement with responses from three large language models, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, to questions based on guidelines for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) and upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC). Materials & methods: The 2025 European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines were provided to Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1-mini. Figures and tables were converted into plain language text. Each model answered 25 questions per entity. Panels of 7-10 experts rated responses on a 9-point scale using a modified Delphi process with two rounds. Outcomes were consensus in agreement and median expert panel score ≥7. Results: For Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, respectively, consensus in agreement was achieved for 88%, 100% and 96% of NMIBC responses (p = 0.097); 92%, 100% and 96% of MIBC responses (p = 0.223); and 56%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses (p < 0.001). For UTUC, significantly fewer Claude responses achieved consensus in agreement than Gemini or ChatGPT responses. Across all questions, consensus in agreement was achieved for 59/75 Claude responses (78.7%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%), and 72/75 ChatGPT responses (96%) (p < 0.001). Median scores ≥7 were achieved for 88%, 100% and 100% of NMIBC responses; 96%, 100% and 100% of MIBC responses; and 68%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses. In UTUC, Claude had significantly fewer such responses than Gemini, but the difference from ChatGPT was not statistically significant. Overall, median scores ≥7 were achieved for 63/75 Claude responses (84%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%) and 74/75 ChatGPT responses (98.7%) (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Under the study conditions, large language model responses frequently achieved expert panel agreement, particularly for Gemini and ChatGPT, supporting the potential of these models for guideline interpretation. Further validation is required to establish clinical utility and safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] 【目的】评估专家小组对三种大型语言模型Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT针对非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）、肌层浸润性膀胱癌（MIBC）和上尿路尿路上皮癌（UTUC）指南问题所作回答的一致性。 【材料与方法】向Claude 3.5 Haiku、Gemini 2.5 Flash和GPT-4.1-mini提供2025年欧洲泌尿外科学会（EAU）指南。图和表被转换为通俗语言文本。每个模型对每种疾病实体回答25个问题。由7-10名专家组成的小组使用改良德尔菲法分两轮对回答按9分制评分。结局为一致性共识和专家小组评分中位数≥7。 【结果】对于Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT，分别有88%、100%和96%的NMIBC回答达成一致性共识（p = 0.097）；92%、100%和96%的MIBC回答达成一致性共识（p = 0.223）；56%、100%和96%的UTUC回答达成一致性共识（p < 0.001）。对于UTUC，Claude回答达成一致性共识的数量显著少于Gemini或ChatGPT回答。在所有问题中，Claude回答有59/75（78.7%）、Gemini回答有75/75（100%）、ChatGPT回答有72/75（96%）达成一致性共识（p < 0.001）。中位评分≥7的比例分别为：NMIBC回答88%、100%和100%；MIBC回答96%、100%和100%；UTUC回答68%、100%和96%。在UTUC中，Claude此类回答显著少于Gemini，但与ChatGPT的差异无统计学意义。总体而言，Claude回答有63/75（84%）、Gemini回答有75/75（100%）、ChatGPT回答有74/75（98.7%）达到中位评分≥7（p < 0.001）。 【结论】在本研究条件下，大型语言模型的回答经常获得专家小组一致性认可，尤其是Gemini和ChatGPT，支持这些模型用于指南解读的潜力。尚需进一步验证以确立临床效用和安全性。

title: Performance of intraoperative artificial intelligence-assisted label-free stimulated Raman histology in recurrent brain tumors.
zh_title: 术中AI辅助无标记拉曼组学用于复发脑肿瘤
summary: 双中心观察性研究显示，光纤激光刺激拉曼组学联合卷积神经网络可在术中快速检测与分型复发中枢神经系统肿瘤。
key_points: 双中心观察性研究，纳入143例患者共262幅SRH图像
CNN2行组织学分型，对照最终整合病理诊断
reason: 双中心外部对照验证，但样本143例且仅报告诊断准确性，属值得一看档
abstract: [Neuro-oncology advances] Therapy-induced tissue alterations complicate intraoperative diagnosis of recurrent central nervous system (CNS) tumors. We evaluated stimulated Raman histology (SRH) combined with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for rapid tumor detection and classification. In this bicentric observational study, fresh tissue from patients undergoing resection or stereotactic biopsy for suspected recurrent CNS tumors was imaged with fiber-laser-based SRH. CNN1 performed binary tumor/non-tumor prediction and CNN2 histotype classification. CNN1 was evaluated against blinded neuropathologist SRH consensus and CNN2 against the final integrated histopathological diagnosis. Of 382 acquired SRH images, 262 images from 143 patients were included. CNN1 achieved an AUC of 0.975 (95% CI, 0.95-1.00) for tumor detection. An exploratory cohort-derived tumor probability threshold of ≥59 increased specificity from 70.7% to 92.0% while maintaining 95.2% sensitivity and identifying 71.4% of radiation necrosis samples. Among 212 images in treatment subgroup analysis, CNN1 accuracy did not differ significantly across prior-treatment groups (overall 90.1%; P = .080). CNN2 accuracy declined from 61.8% after surgery alone to 39.0% after surgery, radiotherapy, and medical treatment (χ2 = 6.04, P = .049). Multimodal therapy was independently associated with lower odds of correct CNN2 prediction (adjusted OR, 0.10 [95% CI, 0.02-0.39]; P = .001 and 0.04 [95% CI, 0.01-0.20]; P < .001). 120/382 images (31.4%) were of insufficient diagnostic quality; application of the quality control threshold would have rejected 84/120 (70.0%). CNN1 maintained high tumor/non-tumor discrimination across treatment subgroups when image quality was sufficient, whereas CNN2 entity-classification performance declined with increasing treatment intensity. Reliable SRH-based diagnosis in recurrent tumors requires validated image-quality control measures and model adaptation to recurrent disease.
zh_abstract: [Neuro-oncology advances] 治疗诱导的组织改变使复发性中枢神经系统（CNS）肿瘤的术中诊断复杂化。我们评估了刺激拉曼组织学（SRH）联合卷积神经网络（CNN）用于快速肿瘤检测和分类。在这项双中心观察性研究中，对因疑似复发性CNS肿瘤接受切除或立体定向活检患者的新鲜组织，采用基于光纤激光的SRH进行成像。CNN1进行二分类的肿瘤/非肿瘤预测，CNN2进行组织学亚型分类。CNN1以盲法神经病理学家SRH共识为参照进行评估，CNN2以最终整合组织病理学诊断为参照进行评估。在获取的382幅SRH图像中，纳入来自143例患者的262幅图像。CNN1用于肿瘤检测的AUC为0.975（95% CI，0.95-1.00）。源自探索性队列的肿瘤概率阈值≥59将特异性从70.7%提高至92.0%，同时维持95.2%的敏感性，并识别出71.4%的放射性坏死样本。在治疗亚组分析中的212幅图像中，CNN1准确率在既往治疗组间无显著差异（总体90.1%；P = .080）。CNN2准确率从仅手术后的61.8%下降至手术、放疗和药物治疗后的39.0%（χ2 = 6.04，P = .049）。多模式治疗与CNN2正确预测的较低几率独立相关（校正OR，0.10 [95% CI，0.02-0.39]；P = .001，以及0.04 [95% CI，0.01-0.20]；P < .001）。120/382幅图像（31.4%）诊断质量不足；应用质量控制阈值本可拒绝84/120幅（70.0%）。当图像质量足够时，CNN1在各治疗亚组中维持较高的肿瘤/非肿瘤判别能力，而CNN2的实体分类性能随治疗强度增加而下降。复发性肿瘤中可靠的基于SRH的诊断需要经过验证的图像质量控制措施以及模型对复发性疾病的适配。

title: Unimodal imaging foundation models and vision-language models in MRI: A systematic review of emerging methods and clinical applications.
zh_title: MRI 单模态基础模型与视觉语言模型系统综述
summary: 系统综述 35 项研究，梳理 MRI 领域基础模型与视觉语言模型的方法、应用与落地障碍。
key_points: 纳入 35 项 MRI 基础模型与视觉语言模型研究
研究集中于神经影像，诊断分类最成熟
自动报告生成临床保真度不足
reason: 系统综述纳入 35 项研究、结论较清晰，但无原创数据，属综述上限档
abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] 医学影像中的人工智能正从任务特定算法转向可适配的基础模型（FMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于 MRI 仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要将跨多个序列的多参数、容积成像与临床背景相整合。本系统综述评估了 35 项关于 MRI 中单模态 FMs 和多模态 VLMs 的研究，总结新兴架构、下游应用及临床转化面临的挑战。当前研究集中在神经影像，诊断分类是最成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅性强，仍受限于临床保真度差。更广泛采用受到 MRI 采集异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限以及以安全性为重点的评估指标不足所阻碍。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更强的整合、稳健的评估框架以及改进的模型可解释性。

title: The surgeon in the loop: automation bias and human-AI interaction in robotic surgery.
zh_title: 机器人手术中外科医生对AI提示的自动化偏差
summary: 19名外科医生在腹腔镜胆囊切除视频截图上作切口规划，对照有无AI叠加，量化对错误AI建议的采纳率。
key_points: 两阶段对照实验，19名外科医生参与
测量加入AI提示后切口规划的改动程度
统计错误AI建议被接受的比例
reason: 人机交互安全问题有新意，但样本仅19人、为模拟场景
abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] Artificial intelligence systems for intraoperative surgical guidance are approaching clinical deployment, yet no study has quantified automation bias (defined as the tendency to over-rely on automated recommendations) in the context of surgical decision-making. As these systems enter operative workflows, the surgeon's ability to recognize and override incorrect AI guidance becomes a critical safety requirement. To measure the extent to which surgeons modify incision plans after exposure to AI-labeled visual guidance and to determine the rate at which incorrect AI suggestions are accepted. A two-phase controlled experiment was conducted among 19 surgeons (10 residents, 2 fellows, 7 attendings). Participants drew incision lines on 20 static frames from robotic cholecystectomy videos, first without guidance (Phase 01) and then with a mock AI overlay (Phase 02). Overlays were either correct (derived from expert consensus) or deliberately incorrect (shifted toward unsafe anatomy) at an approximately 70:30 ratio. No actual AI model was used. The primary outcome was mean perpendicular distance (MPD) between Phase 01 and Phase 02 lines. Secondary outcomes included AI-corridor adherence, over-reliance and under-reliance rates, behavioral accuracy, and confidence shift. Across 231 paired observations, MPD did not differ significantly between correct (75.5 pixels; SD, 33.4) and incorrect (71.1 pixels; SD, 31.7) overlay conditions (P = .35). Directional analysis revealed that surgeons accepted incorrect AI suggestions in 60.6% of incorrect-overlay frames (43/71), with a specificity for rejecting incorrect guidance of only 39.4% (28/71). Correct suggestions were accepted 76.9% of the time (123/160). Overall behavioral accuracy was 65.4%. Self-reported confidence increased significantly after AI exposure (Δ = + 0.65; P < .001). Surgeons accepted approximately 3 of every 5 incorrect AI recommendations. As intraoperative AI systems approach deployment, surgeon oversight cannot be assumed to neutralize algorithmic error; it must be empirically measured, deliberately designed for, and prospectively validated.
zh_abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] 用于术中手术引导的人工智能系统正接近临床部署，但尚无研究量化手术决策背景下的自动化偏差（automation bias，定义为过度依赖自动推荐建议的倾向）。随着这些系统进入手术工作流程，外科医生识别并推翻错误 AI 引导的能力成为关键安全要求。测量外科医生在接触 AI 标记的视觉引导后修改切口计划的程度，并确定错误 AI 建议被接受的比例。在 19 名外科医生（10 名住院医师、2 名专科培训医师、7 名主治医师）中开展了一项两阶段对照实验。参与者在来自机器人胆囊切除术视频的 20 张静态帧上绘制切口线，首先无引导（第 01 阶段），然后使用模拟 AI 叠加层（第 02 阶段）。叠加层要么正确（源自专家共识），要么故意错误（向不安全解剖结构偏移），比例约为 70:30。未使用实际 AI 模型。主要结局是第 01 阶段与第 02 阶段线条之间的平均垂直距离（MPD）。次要结局包括 AI 走廊依从性、过度依赖和依赖不足率、行为准确性和信心变化。在 231 对配对观察中，正确（75.5 像素；SD，33.4）与错误（71.1 像素；SD，31.7）叠加条件下的 MPD 无显著差异（P = .35）。方向性分析显示，外科医生在 60.6% 的错误叠加帧中接受了错误 AI 建议（43/71），拒绝错误引导的特异性仅为 39.4%（28/71）。正确建议的接受率为 76.9%（123/160）。总体行为准确性为 65.4%。接触 AI 后自我报告信心显著增加（Δ = + 0.65；P < .001）。外科医生接受了每 5 条错误 AI 推荐中的约 3 条。随着术中 AI 系统接近部署，不能假定外科医生监督能够抵消算法错误；必须对其进行实证测量、有意设计并前瞻性验证。

title: Application of topological deep learning in staging liver fibrosis based on hepatobiliary phase MR images.
zh_title: 拓扑深度学习用于肝胆期MRI肝纤维化分期
summary: 回顾性研究构建融合拓扑数据分析与EfficientViT的模型，用于肝胆期MRI无创肝纤维化分期。
key_points: 构建TopoEfficientViT模型
回顾性纳入2018至2025年慢性肝病患者
以无创方式替代肝活检分期
reason: 同行评审回顾性影像研究，方法有新意但验证范围有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Early-stage liver fibrosis is reversible; thus, accurate staging of liver fibrosis is of great importance.. Liver biopsy is the gold standard for the diagnosis of liver fibrosis; however, its invasive nature limits its clinical application. Accurate noninvasive staging of liver fibrosis remains challenging. Thus, there is an urgent need for a precise and reliable noninvasive diagnostic approach. A topological deep learning model combining topological data analysis and EfficientViT framework (TopoEfficientViT) was developed to effectively capture global contextual relationships in hepatobiliary phase MR images for assessment of staging liver fibrosis. Our retrospective study included patients with chronic liver diseases from June 2018 to July 2025, which was approved by our Institutional Review Board. Our data from a hospital site (Site A) in our institution were divided into a training set (n = 275) and a validation set (n = 75). The test set (n=65) was composed of data from a separate hospital site (Site B) in the same institution. A total of 415 patients (323 males, mean age 56.52±9.54 years; 92 females, mean age 58.86±9.68 years) were enrolled in the study. In the training set, the AUC and accuracy of TopoEfficientViT for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.942 and 0.906, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.957 and 0.891, respectively. In the validation set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.849 and 0.76, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.861and 0.813, respectively. In the test set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.829 and 0.769, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.791 and 0.785, respectively. The TopoEfficientViT model had high predictive performance for staging liver fibrosis by integrating multi-scale persistent homology topology with convolutional networks.
zh_abstract: ［Abdominal radiology (New York)］早期肝纤维化是可逆的；因此，准确分期肝纤维化非常重要。肝活检是诊断肝纤维化的金标准；然而，其侵入性限制了临床应用。准确无创分期肝纤维化仍具有挑战性。因此，迫切需要一种精确可靠的无创诊断方法。开发了一种结合拓扑数据分析与EfficientViT框架的拓扑深度学习模型（TopoEfficientViT），以有效捕捉肝胆期MR图像中的全局上下文关系，用于评估肝纤维化分期。我们的回顾性研究纳入2018年6月至2025年7月的慢性肝病患者，该研究经我们机构审查委员会批准。来自我们机构一个医院院区（Site A）的数据被分为训练集（n = 275）和验证集（n = 75）。测试集（n=65）由同一机构另一个医院院区（Site B）的数据组成。共纳入415例患者（323例男性，平均年龄56.52±9.54岁；92例女性，平均年龄58.86±9.68岁）。在训练集中，TopoEfficientViT对肝纤维化F1-2 vs. F3-4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.942和0.906；对肝纤维化F1-3 vs. F4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.957和0.891。在验证集中，对肝纤维化F1-2 vs. F3-4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.849和0.76；对肝纤维化F1-3 vs. F4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.861和0.813。在测试集中，对肝纤维化F1-2 vs. F3-4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.829和0.769；对肝纤维化F1-3 vs. F4分期的AUC和准确率分别为0.791和0.785。TopoEfficientViT模型通过整合多尺度持续同调拓扑与卷积网络，在肝纤维化分期方面具有较高预测性能。

title: Prompting Strategies for Readability Alignment Between User-Generated Ophthalmology Questions and Large Language Model Answers: Comparative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 提示策略对齐眼科问题与大模型回答可读性
summary: 基于400条用户眼科提问，比较多种大模型提示策略对回答可读性对齐、质量与计算成本的影响。
key_points: 400条YouTube公开眼科提问按3档可读性分层
比较多种大模型架构下的不同提示策略

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Accessible health communication is essential for effective patient education, yet most medical information remains written at a level above the general population's recommended reading level. Large language models (LLMs) can simplify complex medical information, but it remains unclear whether responses can be automatically adapted to match the linguistic complexity of user-generated questions seeking medical information. To evaluate whether the LLM-generated responses to user-generated ophthalmology questions align with their readability and to compare different prompting strategies for readability control across multiple LLM architectures, including their impact on response quality as well as computational cost and efficiency. A total of 400 user-generated ophthalmology questions collected from public YouTube comments were categorized into 3 readability tiers based on the Flesch Reading Ease Score. A controlled comparative evaluation of responses generated by 4 LLMs (GPT 5.2, Gemini 3, Claude Opus 4.5, and OSS-20b) was performed under 4 prompting conditions: Baseline (no readability control), Formula-Informed Readability Prompt, Semantic Readability Inference, and External Calculator-Guided Prompt. Agreement between question and response readability was assessed using quadratic-weighted Cohen kappa. Response quality was evaluated using BERTScore and LLM-as-a-judge assessments. Computational efficiency was evaluated through token usage, estimated cost per response, and latency. The external calculator-guided strategy produced the strongest alignment in readability across models, achieving the highest agreement (Gemini 3: κ=0.94; GPT 5.2: κ=0.90), while maintaining favorable computational efficiency. abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) remains essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease, while the focus has moved from stenosis to plaque burden. Current workflows either need manual adjustments that limit consistency and efficiency, or they lack segment-specific precision. This study evaluated the effectiveness and reliability of a fully automated deep learning-based plaque quantification method using CCTA. DVPlaque workflow, a fully automated deep learning model, was developed to quantify segment-specific plaque volume. A total of 271 CCTA scans were included. Plaque quantification was performed by the expert and DVPlaque model, respectively. Reliability was measured through interclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analysis and Bland-Altman plots. DVPlaque workflow cost less time than expert measurement (p 0.90, and per-segment ICCs were > 0.90 except for mid-LAD NCP (0.887). DVPlaque scheme was capable of quantifying plaque volume with excellent efficiency. The automated quantification of CP and NCP exhibited strong reliability even on a per-segment level, facilitating clinical application.

title: A paradigm shift toward explainable and federated intelligence for brain tumor MRI analysis.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Deep learning techniques in brain tumor analysis using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans have improved significantly, but their clinical deployment is limited by models with limited interpretability ('black-box' models) and data privacy limitations. This paper analyses recent literature and aims to explore the intersection of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Federated Learning (FL). Following the PRISMA protocol, a systematic search was conducted in Scopus on February 24, 2026, covering English-language journal articles and conference proceedings published from January 2020 to February 2026. The search initially identified 767 records, which were screened using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria for MRI-based brain tumor studies addressing deep learning, explainability, privacy, or Federated Learning, resulting in 147 initially retained studies for the final screening set. One study was subsequently identified as formally retracted and excluded from the final synthesis, resulting in 146 included studies. The review classifies the literature into five primary research themes in brain tumor analysis: explainability, deep learning frameworks, privacy-preserving learning, advanced architectures (Transformers and Mamba), and multimodal learning. The literature suggests a paradigm shift in brain tumor analysis toward model interpretability using XAI. However, there is a significant knowledge gap in privacy-preserving collaborative learning models. Advanced architectures are proposed to solve brain tumor problems, but there are still limitations in model generalization, computational costs, and clinical reliability.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 使用磁共振成像（MRI）扫描进行脑肿瘤分析的深度学习技术已显著改进，但其临床部署受到可解释性有限（“黑箱”模型）和数据隐私限制的制约。本文分析近期文献，旨在探讨可解释人工智能（XAI）与联邦学习（FL）的交叉领域。遵循 PRISMA 方案，于 2026 年 2 月 24 日在 Scopus 进行了系统检索，覆盖 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 2 月发表的英文期刊文章和会议论文。该检索初步识别 767 条记录，使用预定义纳入和排除标准筛选针对基于 MRI 的脑肿瘤研究、涉及深度学习、可解释性、隐私或联邦学习的研究，结果初步保留 147 项研究作为最终筛选集。随后一项研究被确认正式撤稿并从最终综合中排除，最终纳入 146 项研究。本综述将文献归类为脑肿瘤分析的五个主要研究主题：可解释性、深度学习框架、隐私保护学习、先进架构（Transformers 和 Mamba）以及多模态学习。文献提示脑肿瘤分析正朝向使用 XAI 的模型可解释性发生范式转变。然而，在隐私保护协作学习模型方面存在显著知识空白。先进架构被提出用于解决脑肿瘤问题，但在模型泛化、计算成本和临床可靠性方面仍存在局限。

abstract: [Molecular biology and evolution] During the evolution of protein sequences, amino acid substitutions follow broad patterns that are well established, such as those induced by the physico-chemical properties of residues or the position of sites along the sequence. While these deviations from random changes have been exploited for practical applications, such as to simulate protein evolution or to score protein alignments, they are too general to predict the precise evolution of individual protein sequences. To investigate whether protein sequences contain contextual information about their subsequent evolution beyond that captured by conventional substitution statistics and evolutionary conservation, we trained deep learning models based on an Evolutionary Scale Modelling (ESM2) encoder to predict the rate, the position and the nature of the amino-acid substitutions in the evolution of ancestral sequences and compared their performance to simpler and explainable heuristics. Our results show that predicting the rate of amino acid changes is achieved equally well by deep learning and by using evolutionary information in outgroup sequences. This suggests that the protein sequence does not contain information that significantly improves the predictions for this task. On the opposite, we show that deep learning models predict the position of these substitutions more accurately than statistics-based baselines. Predictions of the nature of substitutions largely outperform baselines, with over 37% accuracy overall. We observe that rapidly evolving sequences are harder to predict and substitutions preferentially occur between chemically similar amino acids. Interestingly, predictive information is predominantly contained within a local sequence context of 16 residues. These findings indicate that the nature of substitutions in protein evolution is partly governed by predictive rules that remain to be discovered through a more accurate modelling that could describe evolutionary trajectories based on sequence context alone.
zh_abstract: [Molecular biology and evolution] 在蛋白质序列的进化过程中，氨基酸替换遵循已被充分确立的广泛模式，例如由残基的物理化学性质或位点在序列中的位置所诱导的模式。尽管这些偏离随机变化的模式已被用于实际应用，例如模拟蛋白质进化或对蛋白质比对进行评分，但它们过于一般化，无法预测单个蛋白质序列的精确进化。为了研究蛋白质序列是否含有关于其后续进化的上下文信息——超出传统替换统计和进化保守性所捕获的信息——我们训练了基于进化尺度建模（Evolutionary Scale Modelling, ESM2）编码器的深度学习模型，以预测祖先序列进化中氨基酸替换的速率、位置和性质，并将其性能与更简单且可解释的启发式方法进行比较。我们的结果表明，预测氨基酸变化的速率，深度学习和使用外群序列中的进化信息可以达到同样好的效果。这表明蛋白质序列不包含能显著改善该任务预测的信息。相反，我们表明深度学习模型比基于统计的基线更准确地预测这些替换的位置。对替换性质的预测大大优于基线，总体准确率超过37%。我们观察到，快速进化的序列更难预测，并且替换优先发生在化学性质相似的氨基酸之间。有趣的是，预测信息主要包含在16个残基的局部序列上下文中。这些发现表明，蛋白质进化中替换的性质部分受尚待发现的预测规则支配，这些规则可通过更准确的建模来发现，而该建模或许能够仅基于序列上下文描述进化轨迹。

abstract: [iScience] Reliably estimating cerebral maturation in preterm newborns is crucial for early identification of atypical neurodevelopment. We developed a deep-learning framework using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to predict postmenstrual age (PMA) from spontaneous neural activity in EEG recordings of 165 healthy preterm infants (28-38 weeks PMA). The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.75 ± 0.60 weeks, with 73.9% of prediction errors within one week. To identify key neurophysiological drivers, we systematically manipulated signal components. Results showed that removing low-frequency activity ( 12 Hz) had minimal impact. Our results demonstrate that maturation signatures are primarily driven by slow-wave dynamics and their hierarchical coupling with faster oscillations, which are fundamental hallmarks of early neurodevelopment.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 可靠估计早产新生儿的脑成熟度对于早期识别非典型神经发育至关重要。我们开发了一个使用卷积神经网络（CNN）的深度学习框架，从165名健康早产婴儿（PMA 28–38周）的EEG记录中的自发神经活动预测经后年龄（postmenstrual age, PMA）。该模型达到平均绝对误差0.75 ± 0.60周，73.9%的预测误差在一周以内。为识别关键神经生理驱动因素，我们系统地操纵了信号成分。结果显示，去除低频活动（ 12 Hz）的影响极小。我们的结果表明，成熟特征主要由慢波动力学及其与更快振荡的层级耦合驱动，这些是早期神经发育的基本标志。

abstract: [Zeitschrift fur medizinische Physik] PET image quality degradation due to positron range effects in high-energy positron-emitting radionuclides such as Gallium-68 (68Ga) can be mitigated by applying positron range correction (PRC). Deep learning (DL) models have been shown to improve image quality by reducing image noise. This study aimed to evaluate a DL model for simultaneous denoising and 68Ga-specific PRC in clinical [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC PET scans. Three different U-Net-based DL models were trained to map reduced-count PET images reconstructed without PRC (25%, 33%, or 50% of acquired counts) to full-count PET images reconstructed with tissue-independent PRC (FC-PRC). The generated reduced-count-enhanced images (RCE-25%, RCE-33%, RCE-50%) were evaluated using the mean standardized uptake value (SUVmean) in liver and lung, noise levels in liver, and maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) of soft tissue lesions. Three experienced nuclear medicine physicians assessed the overall image quality (OIQ), overall diagnostic confidence (ODC), and lesion detectability (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy). Compared to FC-PRC, RCE-33% and RCE-50% exhibited similar noise, whereas RCE-25% showed substantial residual noise. CNR was reduced for RCE-33% (-5.6%, p=0.001) and RCE-25% (-8.0%, p 90%). The proposed DL-based approach achieved comparable noise and image quality down to 50% of counts. Although it did not outperform the reconstruction-based PRC, its benefit lies in simultaneous denoising and PRC in a single step.
zh_abstract: [Zeitschrift fur medizinische Physik] 对于高能正电子发射放射性核素如镓-68（68Ga），正电子射程效应导致的PET图像质量下降可通过应用正电子射程校正（PRC）来减轻。深度学习（DL）模型已被证明可通过降低图像噪声来改善图像质量。本研究旨在评估一种DL模型，在临床[68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC PET扫描中同时进行去噪和68Ga特异性PRC。训练了三种不同的基于U-Net的DL模型，将未进行PRC重建的减少计数PET图像（采集计数的25%、33%或50%）映射到使用组织非依赖性PRC重建的全计数PET图像（FC-PRC）。生成的减少计数增强图像（RCE-25%、RCE-33%、RCE-50%）通过肝脏和肺的平均标准化摄取值（SUVmean）、肝脏噪声水平，以及软组织病灶的最大标准化摄取值（SUVmax）和对比噪声比（CNR）进行评估。三名经验丰富的核医学医师评估了整体图像质量（OIQ）、整体诊断信心（ODC）和病灶可检测性（敏感性、特异性、准确性）。与FC-PRC相比，RCE-33%和RCE-50%表现出相似的噪声，而RCE-25%显示出大量残留噪声。RCE-33%（-5.6%，p=0.001）和RCE-25%（-8.0%，p 90%）的CNR降低。所提出的基于DL的方法在低至50%计数时实现了相当的噪声和图像质量。尽管它未优于基于重建的PRC，但其优势在于单步骤中同时去噪和PRC。

abstract: [Psychopharmacology bulletin] Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) lacks approved pharmacological treatments despite a high symptom burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to accelerate drug discovery and model therapeutic effects. This study will outline an AI-enabled framework for identifying and modelling a novel pharmacological agent for BPD, designed to meet five therapeutic goals: (1) reduce depression without increasing impulsivity and suicidality, (2) reduce suicidality without sedation, (3) limit side effects and weight gain, (4) reduce polypharmacy, and (5) provide combined antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic effects. Three AI-driven approaches will be piloted: (1) deep-learning-based compound generation, (2) natural-language-processing (NLP) evidence synthesis, and (3) predictive modelling of symptom trajectories. These methods will be used to design and characterise a hypothetical multimodal compound, BPD-AI-01, including its predicted 3D molecular structure and receptor binding profile. All analyses will use publicly available data and in silico simulations. AI-guided modelling will generate BPD-AI-01, a candidate molecule predicted to act as a partial agonist at 5-HT1A receptors, a modulator at NMDA-associated sites, and a weak antagonist at 5-HT2A/D2 receptors, with low affinity for histaminergic and muscarinic receptors. Its 3D structure will be optimised to balance CNS penetration with reduced metabolic burden. Simulated trajectories will suggest potential antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic-like effects without marked sedation or weight gain. AI-enabled pharmacological research may support the design of next-generation medications for BPD that address multiple symptom domains within a single molecule. Empirical validation will be required before any clinical application.
zh_abstract: ［Psychopharmacology bulletin］边缘型人格障碍（BPD）尽管症状负担高，仍缺乏获批的药物治疗。人工智能（AI）为加速药物发现和模拟治疗效应提供了新机会。本研究将概述一个AI赋能的框架，用于识别和建模一种针对BPD的新型药物，旨在满足五个治疗目标：（1）减轻抑郁而不增加冲动性和自杀倾向；（2）减少自杀倾向而不引起镇静；（3）限制副作用和体重增加；（4）减少多重用药；（5）提供抗抑郁、抗自杀、情绪稳定和抗精神病联合效应。将试点三种AI驱动方法：（1）基于深度学习的化合物生成；（2）自然语言处理（NLP）证据综合；（3）症状轨迹的预测建模。这些方法将用于设计和表征一种假设的多模式化合物BPD-AI-01，包括其预测的3D分子结构和受体结合谱。所有分析将使用公开可用数据和计算机模拟（in silico simulations）。AI引导的建模将生成BPD-AI-01，一种候选分子，预测其作为5-HT1A受体部分激动剂、NMDA相关位点调节剂以及5-HT2A/D2受体弱拮抗剂，并对组胺能受体和毒蕈碱受体具有低亲和力。其3D结构将被优化，以平衡中枢神经系统（CNS）穿透性与降低的代谢负担。模拟轨迹将提示潜在抗抑郁、抗自杀、情绪稳定和抗精神病样效应，且无明显镇静或体重增加。AI赋能的药理学研究可能支持设计下一代BPD药物，在单一分子中针对多个症状域。在任何临床应用之前将需要实证验证。

title: A Lightweight EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Detection Framework on an Edge-Computing Platform Toward Future Intelligent Digital Twin Systems.

summary: 提出含通道选择的轻量膨胀混合深度学习模型，在边缘计算平台实现基于EEG的阿尔茨海默病检测。

abstract: [Journal of integrative neuroscience] Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses slowly through several stages until the patient reaches full cognitive decline. The electroencephalography (EEG) alterations associated with AD often emerge before symptom onset, suggesting that accessible and repeated EEG-based assessment could facilitate earlier detection and longitudinal monitoring. However, this type of assessment requires an AD detection model operating on edge-computing platforms within the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). At present, many existing AD detection models rely on complex deep learning architectures with numerous parameters, which significantly limit their practicality for on-edge deployment. We propose an on-edge AD detection framework comprising a lightweight dilated hybrid deep learning (DHDL) model with a channel selection approach to reduce the computational and power demands on the evaluated edge-computing platform. A key architectural component is the inclusion of dual-granularity dilated temporal convolutions. This method expands the receptive field at two scales to capture both short- and long-term temporal features from EEG signals without increasing the number of parameters. Subsequently, several hybrid lightweight layers extract distinct temporal and spatial features and are integrated with attention mechanisms. Additionally, our channel selection approach first forms an initial subset of EEG channels guided by individual channel classification accuracy, and then iteratively refines the selected channels using hill-climbing optimization. Here, we evaluated our framework on two publicly available EEG datasets recorded for the same group of subjects (n = 48 subjects): a conventional closed-eye (CE) dataset and a more challenging open-eye (OE) dataset. Validation followed a subject-independent Leave-2-Subjects-Out (L2SO) cross-validation protocol. Real-time deployment was tested on an edge-computing platform. The proposed framework achieved 92.56% accuracy for the CE dataset and 75.15% accuracy for the OE dataset. Inference required 10.45 ms and 8.23 ms per segment for the CE and OE datasets, respectively, and consumed 9.69 mJ and 6.95 mJ of energy per segment, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework as a real-time, on-edge inference module for AD detection. Although a complete intelligent digital twin system is not implemented in this work, the proposed framework can serve as an inference component for future digital twin systems, su
zh_abstract: [Journal of integrative neuroscience] 阿尔茨海默病（AD）缓慢进展，经历多个阶段，直至患者达到完全认知衰退。与AD相关的脑电图（EEG）改变常在症状出现之前发生，提示可及且可重复的基于EEG的评估可能有助于更早发现和纵向监测。然而，此类评估需要一种在医疗物联网（IoMT）内边缘计算平台上运行的AD检测模型。目前，许多现有AD检测模型依赖参数众多的复杂深度学习架构，这显著限制了其在边缘部署的实用性。我们提出一种边缘端AD检测框架，包含轻量级空洞混合深度学习（DHDL）模型以及通道选择方法，以降低所评估边缘计算平台上的计算和功耗需求。一个关键架构组件是引入双粒度空洞时间卷积。该方法在两个尺度上扩大感受野，以从EEG信号中捕获短期和长期时间特征，而不增加参数数量。随后，若干混合轻量级层提取不同的时间和空间特征，并与注意力机制集成。此外，我们的通道选择方法首先根据单个通道分类准确率形成EEG通道的初始子集，然后使用爬山优化迭代细化所选通道。在此，我们在两个公开可用的EEG数据集上评估我们的框架，这些数据集记录自同一组受试者（n = 48名受试者）：常规闭眼（CE）数据集和更具挑战性的睁眼（OE）数据集。验证遵循受试者独立的留2名受试者交叉验证（L2SO）方案。在边缘计算平台上测试了实时部署。所提出的框架在CE数据集上达到92.56%的准确率，在OE数据集上达到75.15%的准确率。CE和OE数据集的推理分别需要每段10.45 ms和8.23 ms，并分别消耗每段9.69 mJ和6.95 mJ的能量。这些结果证明了所提出框架作为AD检测实时边缘推理模块的可行性。尽管本工作未实现完整的智能数字孪生系统，但所提出的框架可作为未来数字孪生系统的推理组件，su

abstract: [Frontiers in ophthalmology] Glaucoma is among the leading causes of blindness. It is important to detect glaucoma at early stages. Using structural and functional examinations to identify primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is critical. Computer-aided diagnosis of glaucoma requires multimodal data to identify an accurate and explainable model for early glaucoma diagnosis. In this study, 301 multimodal data points were collected from the ophthalmology department at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University. Data regarding fundus photography (FP), retinal nerve fiber layer thickness (RNFLt), intraocular pressure (IOP) values, visual field examination parameters and age were obtained. A powerful deep learning network was used to segment the optic nerve head obtained from the FPs. Machine learning classifiers (MLCs) were adopted to obtain the final classification results using 3 datasets: early glaucoma eyes, suspected glaucoma eyes, and healthy eyes; moreover, the diagnostic results of glaucoma specialists and general nonglaucoma ophthalmologists were collected. The overall area under the curve was 0.9858. The accuracy values of the deep learning- machine learning system, the glaucoma specialist group, the general ophthalmologist group were 0.9478, 0.9493, 0.8725, respectively. The algorithm delivers superior results in the early diagnosis of POAG. This study's hybrid deep learning-machine learning framework can effectively assist with clinical decision-making for early POAG.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in ophthalmology] 青光眼是主要致盲原因之一。早期发现青光眼很重要。利用结构和功能检查识别原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）至关重要。青光眼的计算机辅助诊断需要多模态数据，以建立准确且可解释的早期青光眼诊断模型。本研究从哈尔滨医科大学附属第二医院眼科收集了301个多模态数据点。获取了有关眼底摄影（FP）、视网膜神经纤维层厚度（RNFLt）、眼压（IOP）值、视野检查参数和年龄的数据。使用强大的深度学习网络对从FP中获得的视神经乳头进行分割。采用机器学习分类器（MLC）在3个数据集上获得最终分类结果：早期青光眼眼、疑似青光眼眼和健康眼；此外，还收集了青光眼专家和普通非青光眼专科眼科医师的诊断结果。总体曲线下面积为0.9858。深度学习-机器学习系统、青光眼专家组和普通眼科医师组的准确率分别为0.9478、0.9493、0.8725。该算法在POAG早期诊断中提供了优越的结果。本研究的混合深度学习-机器学习框架可有效辅助早期POAG的临床决策。

abstract: [International journal of nursing studies] Artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, models, and tools are increasingly used in healthcare to support clinical decision-making, administrative workflows, and patient care but key ethical concerns such as accountability, equity, and transparency exist which affect nursing and midwifery practice. However, this discourse often overlooks the relational, contextual, and embodied aspects of care. Our systematic review aimed to critically identify, appraise and synthesise the evidence on ethical dimensions of AI in nursing and midwifery to address these complex issues. We undertook a systematic review following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses checklist. We conducted a comprehensive search using key AI, ethics, nursing and midwifery terms across CINAHL, Embase, MEDLINE, The Philosopher's Index and PsycINFO in March 2025. We screened results on Covidence against eligibility criteria using independent reviewers and performed quality assessment. We extracted data and applied inductive thematic synthesis to identify key themes. Six themes emerged. First, preserving humanity emphasised care ethics in AI-mediated nursing and midwifery practice. Second, beyond technical reliability explored safety as an ethical and relational imperative examining premature deployment risks, misinformation as patient harm, and risk mitigation. Third, autonomy, authority and accountability focused on governance challenges and solutions including patient and professional autonomy. Fourth, beyond transparency examined privacy threats, trust-building, and the governance roles of nurses and midwives. Fifth, justice in development and deployment concentrated on algorithmic bias and equitable implementation. Sixth, workforce preparation and deployment centred on capacity gaps and training, critical thinking and ethical awareness, academic integrity, and implementation barriers. Our review offers timely and original insights of the ethical dimensions of AI in nursing and midwifery by capturing interconnected tensions between technological innovation and core professional values across relational care, patient safety, governance, information stewardship, equity and justice, and workforce preparedness. Clear recommendations include an urgent need for education to improve AI literacy, robust, inclusive and flexible AI governance, and the implementation of AI tools aligned with nurses and midwives' values and workflows. zh_abstract: [International journal of nursing studies] 人工智能（AI）技术、模型和工具越来越多地用于医疗保健，以支持临床决策、行政工作流程和患者照护，但存在问责、公平和透明度等关键伦理问题，影响护理和助产实践。然而，这一讨论往往忽视照护的关系性、情境性和具身性方面。我们的系统综述旨在严格识别、评价和综合关于AI在护理和助产中伦理维度的证据，以应对这些复杂问题。我们按照系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）清单进行了系统综述。我们于2025年3月使用AI、伦理、护理和助产的关键术语，在CINAHL、Embase、MEDLINE、The Philosopher's Index和PsycINFO中进行了全面检索。我们使用独立评价者在Covidence上根据纳入标准筛选结果，并进行质量评价。我们提取数据并应用归纳性主题综合以识别关键主题。共出现六个主题。第一，维护人性强调AI介导的护理和助产实践中的照护伦理。第二，超越技术可靠性探讨安全性作为伦理和关系层面的必要要求，考察过早部署风险、错误信息作为患者伤害以及风险缓解。第三，自主性、权威性和问责制聚焦于治理挑战和解决方案，包括患者和专业自主性。第四，超越透明度考察隐私威胁、信任建立以及护士和助产士的治理角色。第五，开发与部署中的公正集中于算法偏倚和公平实施。第六，劳动力准备和部署以能力差距和培训、批判性思维和伦理意识、学术诚信以及实施障碍为中心。我们的综述通过捕捉技术创新与核心专业价值之间在关系性照护、患者安全、治理、信息管理、公平与公正以及劳动力准备度方面的相互关联张力，提供了关于AI在护理和助产中伦理维度的及时且原创的见解。明确的建议包括迫切需要开展教育以提高AI素养、建立稳健、包容和灵活的AI治理，以及实施与护士和助产士价值观及工作流程一致的AI工具。此外，我们的综述倡导
