title: Artificial intelligence-enabled nanomedicine development: From rational design to manufacturing optimization.
source: PubMed · Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society
zh_title: AI赋能纳米药物研发：从理性设计到生产优化
summary: 综述梳理用于纳米材料设计、体内命运预测、诊疗影像分析与制剂生产优化的AI方法与建模流程，并讨论转化障碍。
key_points: 覆盖纳米材料理性设计与体内命运预测
涉及诊疗影像分析与制剂生产优化
指出数据与模型可靠性等转化障碍
reason: 属一般性综述，无原始数据或验证，信息量有限
abstract: [Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society] The translation of nanomedicines remains constrained by persistent bottlenecks, including complex design parameters, unpredictable in vivo behavior, and low diagnostic accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI), with its advanced data processing and learning algorithms, offers new solutions to these challenges by learning from heterogeneous data and supporting decision-making throughout nanomedicine development. This review summarizes the AI methods and modeling workflows relevant to nanomedicine and surveys their applications in rational nanomaterial design, prediction of in vivo fate and nano-bio interactions, theranostic imaging analysis, and formulation and manufacturing optimization. This review further discusses the main barriers that currently limit translation, which largely concern data, model reliability, and computational cost. Future progress will depend on better data resources, more generalizable and interpretable models, and closer integration of AI with experimental and mechanistic approaches. We believe that through these advances, AI-enabled nanomedicine will ultimately achieve more reliable and translatable outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Journal of controlled release : official journal of the Controlled Release Society] 纳米药物的转化仍受持续瓶颈制约，包括复杂的设计参数、不可预测的体内行为以及较低的诊断准确性。人工智能（AI）凭借其先进的数据处理和学习算法，通过从异质数据中学习并支持纳米药物开发全过程的决策，为这些挑战提供了新解决方案。本综述总结了与纳米药物相关的AI方法和建模工作流程，并综述了它们在合理纳米材料设计、体内命运与纳米-生物相互作用预测、诊疗成像分析以及制剂和制造优化中的应用。本综述进一步讨论了当前限制转化的主要障碍，主要涉及数据、模型可靠性和计算成本。未来进展将取决于更好的数据资源、更具泛化性和可解释性的模型，以及AI与实验和机制方法的更紧密结合。我们相信，通过这些进展，AI赋能的纳米药物最终将实现更可靠、更可转化的结果。

title: Artificial intelligence for vascular minimally invasive surgery: techniques, clinical integration, and challenges.
zh_title: 血管微创手术中的人工智能：技术、临床整合与挑战
summary: 综述纳入30项原始研究，梳理AI在血管微创手术的预测分析、决策支持、影像分析与机器人应用及落地挑战。
key_points: 分析30项原始研究：机器学习8项、深度学习9项
涵盖自然语言处理4项、机器人与强化学习9项
兼论临床转化、部署、监管与伦理问题
reason: 系统综述纳入30项研究、结论明确，但属综述，最高6分档内取5
abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Minimally invasive surgery (MIS), including endovascular and robot-assisted procedures, is widely used for vascular pathologies but remains limited by technical complexity, cognitive workload, and postoperative complications. Artificial Intelligence (AI) may help address these challenges through predictive analysis, decision support, image analysis, and automation. A structured Google Scholar search was conducted from February 21, 2025, to January 1, 2026, and updated through September 2026. Peer-reviewed studies applying AI to vascular MIS were included, with additional targeted searches addressing clinical translation, deployment, regulation, and ethical considerations. Thirty primary studies were analyzed, including eight on machine learning, nine on deep learning, four on natural language processing, and nine on robotics or reinforcement learning. Machine learning supported risk stratification and outcome prediction, deep learning enabled imaging and segmentation applications, natural language processing facilitated clinical information extraction, and robotic systems supported navigation and procedural assistance. AI demonstrates substantial potential across the vascular MIS pathway, but broader clinical adoption requires stronger validation, prospective multicenter studies, standardized reporting, health-economic evaluation, and careful consideration of regulatory, liability, and accessibility challenges.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine] 微创手术（MIS），包括血管内和机器人辅助手术，广泛用于血管病变，但仍受技术复杂性、认知负荷和术后并发症的限制。人工智能（AI）可通过预测分析、决策支持、图像分析和自动化帮助应对这些挑战。于2025年2月21日至2026年1月1日进行了结构化 Google Scholar 检索，并更新至2026年9月。纳入将 AI 应用于血管 MIS 的同行评审研究，并进行了补充性针对性检索，涉及临床转化、部署、监管和伦理考量。分析了30项原始研究，包括8项机器学习、9项深度学习、4项自然语言处理和9项机器人或强化学习研究。机器学习支持风险分层和结局预测，深度学习实现影像和分割应用，自然语言处理促进临床信息提取，机器人系统支持导航和操作辅助。AI 在血管 MIS 全流程中显示出巨大潜力，但更广泛的临床采用需要更强验证、前瞻性多中心研究、标准化报告、卫生经济学评估，以及审慎考虑监管、责任和可及性挑战。

title: Organotchi: an open-source tool for the automated segmentation, morphological characterization, and longitudinal tracking of organoids
zh_title: Organotchi：开源类器官自动分割与纵向形态追踪工具
summary: 预印本发布开源工具 Organotchi，可从明场图像自动分割神经类器官并做纵向形态定量与质控。
key_points: 整合自动分割与十项形态学特征量化
追踪囊性结构随时间变化并报告批次内/间差异
标记离群类器官与分割失败，代码开源
reason: 开源工具填补形态表征与质控空白，但属预印本、无外部验证与对照结果
abstract: Neural organoids are three-dimensional stem cell-derived models widely used to study brain development and model disease. Brightfield imaging offers a non-invasive readout of their growth and morphology, and recent advances have made automated organoid segmentation from such images increasingly attainable. Yet existing tools largely leave morphological characterization, quality assessment, and comparisons between conditions to manual or ad hoc analysis. Here we present Organotchi, an open-source tool that integrates automated segmentation with longitudinal morphological analysis of neural organoids. Organotchi quantifies ten morphological features, including area, perimeter, and eccentricity, and tracks cystic structures over time, reports variability within and between batches, and flags outlier organoids and segmentation failures, supporting objective organoid characterization and enhancing downstream analysis. As a proof of concept, we apply Organotchi to disease modelling, pharmacological perturbation, and protocol optimization in neural organoids. One use case assesses drug response in breast cancer spheroids, demonstrating its use beyond its development domain.
zh_abstract: 神经类器官是三维干细胞衍生模型，广泛用于研究脑发育和模拟疾病。明场成像可对其生长和形态提供非侵入性读出，而近期进展使从此类图像进行自动类器官分割日益可行。然而，现有工具在很大程度上将形态学表征、质量评估和条件间比较留给人工或临时分析。在此我们提出 Organotchi，一种开源工具，将自动分割与神经类器官的纵向形态学分析相结合。Organotchi 量化十种形态学特征，包括面积、周长和偏心率，并随时间追踪囊性结构，报告批次内和批次间变异性，并标记离群类器官和分割失败，支持客观的类器官表征并增强下游分析。作为概念验证，我们将 Organotchi 应用于神经类器官的疾病建模、药物扰动和方案优化。一个用例评估乳腺癌球状体中的药物反应，证明其用途超出其开发领域。

title: Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care
zh_title: 面向ICU运营模拟的患者世界模型
summary: 提出从纵向电子病历学习「患者世界模型」，在MIMIC-IV上训练并冻结，用于ICU运营与情景模拟。
key_points: 用神经网络从纵向EHR学习共享患者轨迹表征
在MIMIC-IV训练后冻结，支持跨情景模拟查询
与共享ICU日历耦合，模拟患者状态与照护需求
reason: 预印本新方法思路有新意，但仅MIMIC-IV单库，未见外部验证
abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.
zh_abstract: 设计医疗策略需要在实施前预判其临床和运营后果，这一任务通常依赖卫生系统仿真。此类仿真必须对患者状态如何演变并产生照护需求进行建模。然而，传统方法通常将紧凑的状态转移裁剪为针对单一政策问题，并忽略依赖历史的动态过程，因此当出现需要不同临床信息的新问题时，就需要重新定义状态和转移。我们提出使用神经网络从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中学习患者世界模型，以提供患者轨迹的共享临床表征，从而可服务于跨场景的仿真问题。以 ICU 运营为例，我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练模型，将其冻结，并通过场景特定映射将其可时间查询的预测与共享的 ICU 日历、资源和队列耦合，从而使一个模型在评估 ICU 床位容量、照护调度和 ICU 后转运能力的各项仿真中呈现入院需求、照护任务和出院建议。实验表明，我们的模型在总体占用率以及对容量和调度政策的定向响应方面与马尔可夫和半马尔可夫对照模型相匹配。它还能再现从回放观察轨迹中得到的政策收益。对于从不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，学习到的表征捕捉到 24 小时恢复差异（预测为 -6.4 个百分点，观察为 -6.7 个百分点），这是紧凑状态模型遗漏的对比，并会传播为不同的模拟照护需求、队列负担和床位使用。这些结果表明，患者动态的学习世界模型有潜力替代问题特定的状态模型，从而可通过重新配置场景来评估新的照护政策，而无需重建模型。

title: LeadWeaver: Topology-Aware Masked-Lead Modeling for Robust 12-Lead ECG Diagnosis
zh_title: LeadWeaver：面向缺失导联的12导联心电图诊断
summary: 预印本提出拓扑感知掩码导联建模，在PTB-XL及CPSC类设置下评估缺失或损坏导联的心电图诊断。
key_points: 各导联表示为时间token流
固定加学习的生理导联图耦合
采用掩码导联潜在补全而非波形合成
reason: 新方法预印本，公开数据集评估但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical electrocardiography is organized as a structured set of correlated leads, yet most neural ECG classifiers assume that all twelve leads are present, correctly ordered, and acquired under the same device conditions at training and deployment. We propose LeadWeaver, a topology-aware ECG representation model designed for diagnosis under missing, corrupted, or device-shifted leads. LeadWeaver represents each lead as a temporal token stream, couples leads through a fixed-plus-learned physiological lead graph, and performs masked-lead latent completion rather than waveform synthesis. A reliability router estimates which observed leads should dominate each diagnostic decision, while a consistency objective aligns complete-lead and incomplete-lead predictions. We evaluate the model on PTB-XL and CPSC-style settings using complete-input diagnosis, arbitrary missing-lead subsets, lead corruption, cross-dataset transfer, calibration, and selective prediction. The central hypothesis is that robust ECG diagnosis requires explicitly modeling both inter-lead topology and uncertainty about unavailable evidence, rather than treating missing channels as zero-valued inputs.
zh_abstract: 临床心电图被组织为一组结构化的相关导联，然而大多数神经 ECG 分类器假设十二个导联均存在、顺序正确，并且在训练和部署时处于相同设备条件下采集。我们提出 LeadWeaver，一种拓扑感知的 ECG 表征模型，设计用于在导联缺失、损坏或设备偏移情况下进行诊断。LeadWeaver 将每个导联表示为时间 token 流，通过固定的加可学习的生理导联图耦合导联，并执行掩蔽导联的潜在补全而非波形合成。可靠性路由器估计哪些观察导联应在每个诊断决策中占主导，而一致性目标对齐完整导联和不完整导联的预测。我们在 PTB-XL 和 CPSC 风格设置中评估该模型，使用完整输入诊断、任意缺失导联子集、导联损坏、跨数据集迁移、校准和选择性预测。核心假设是，稳健的 ECG 诊断需要显式建模导联间拓扑结构以及对不可用证据的不确定性，而不是将缺失通道视为零值输入。

title: OraRefer: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Photograph Fusion for Oral Cancer Screening with Guaranteed Patient-Level Sensitivity
zh_title: OraRefer口腔癌筛查患者级融合模型
summary: 预印本提出分割引导的多照片融合口腔癌筛查模型，以阈值保证患者级敏感度。
key_points: 在714名患者3000张照片上评估
先分割定位病灶再融合同一患者多张照片与危险因素
推理无需标注，按患者而非单张照片做转诊决策
reason: 方法有新意但仅单一大规模数据集、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Oral cancer and the oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMD) that can precede it are visible on the oral mucosa, which makes smartphone photographs a promising tool for screening. Deep learning models for this task classify individual photographs. However, screening refers patients, not photographs: a patient is usually photographed several times, and the referral decision must miss no more than a set share of patients with disease. We propose OraRefer, a patient-level screening model that reads each photograph with a segmentation-guided foundation model that conditions its class decision on the predicted lesion, combines all photographs of a patient with risk factors, and refers through a threshold with a finite-sample sensitivity guarantee. The model localizes the mouth itself, so inference needs no annotation. On 3000 photographs of 714 patients, patient-level fusion reaches an AUROC of 0.919 and outperforms attention-based multiple-instance learning. At a 90% sensitivity target, OraRefer detects 95% of patients with OPMD or cancer and misses 3 of 61 patients with cancer, at a specificity of 0.610. Because the threshold is calibrated without retraining, each clinic can set its own guaranteed operating point on a local calibration sample.
zh_abstract: 口腔癌及其可能先于其出现的口腔潜在恶性疾患（OPMD）在口腔黏膜上可见，这使智能手机照片成为有前景的筛查工具。用于此任务的深度学习模型对单张照片进行分类。然而，筛查转诊的是患者而非照片：一名患者通常会被拍摄多次，且转诊决策漏诊的患病患者比例不得超过设定比例。我们提出OraRefer，一种患者级筛查模型，其使用分割引导的基础模型读取每张照片，该模型以预测病灶为条件作出类别决策，将一名患者的所有照片与风险因素结合，并通过具有有限样本敏感性保证的阈值进行转诊。该模型自身定位口腔，因此推理无需标注。在714名患者的3000张照片上，患者级融合达到0.919的AUROC，并优于基于注意力的多实例学习。在90%敏感性目标下，OraRefer检出95%的OPMD或癌症患者，并在特异性为0.610时漏诊61例癌症患者中的3例。由于阈值无需重新训练即可校准，每家诊所可在本地校准样本上设定自身有保证的工作点。

title: Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Cancer Grade Prediction and Cross-Cancer Transfer Learning from Pathology Reports
zh_title: 层级时序Transformer预测病理报告肿瘤分级
summary: 预印本构建层级时序Transformer处理病理报告序列，用于肿瘤分级预测并测试跨癌种迁移。
key_points: 用BiomedBERT编码报告、按癌种条件化时序建模
TCGA 4786份报告14种癌型，留出3种做迁移
加入间隔感知时间编码HTT-IA
reason: 临床NLP方法有新颖性但为预印本、验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Language models for cancer reports usually read one document at a time and are tested on tumour types seen in training. Continuous-time sequence models address the first gap, but whether they use visit timing, not just order, is seldom tested. Methods: We developed the Hierarchical Temporal Transformer (HTT), which encodes reports with adapted BiomedBERT and reads the sequence with a cancer-type-conditioned temporal transformer. We evaluated it against best-possible AUROC ceilings on two synthetic benchmarks, one with the label stated in the text and one recoverable only from tumour sizes and visit intervals (ten seeds). Diagnostics led to an interval-aware time code (HTT-IA). On 4,786 TCGA pathology reports in 14 types, three types were withheld, and a text-only HTT was compared with a survival model. Results: On the phrase benchmark HTT reached AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012 against 0.913 +/- 0.007 for a last-report baseline (+0.018, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.050); dates cannot raise the ceiling there. On the growth benchmark the initial time code scored 0.790, equal to a no-time model (0.787), whereas HTT-IA reached 0.843 (+0.053, 0.026 to 0.082) against ceilings of 0.894 without and 0.979 with dates. On unseen tumour types HTT reached 0.925 +/- 0.007, equal to in-distribution performance and to a single-report baseline. Text-only macro C-index was 0.592 (CALM 0.626-0.652). Conclusion: Cross-type transfer is carried by the pre-trained encoder. Visit timing is used only when the data make it identifiable and the time code is on a clinical scale. Ceilings, order-only ablations and re-dating probes are inexpensive checks for such models.
zh_abstract: 【背景】用于癌症报告的语言模型通常一次只读取一份文档，并在训练中见过的肿瘤类型上接受测试。连续时间序列模型弥补了第一个缺口，但它们是否利用就诊时间而不仅是顺序，鲜有被检验。【方法】我们开发了分层时间Transformer（Hierarchical Temporal Transformer, HTT），它用适配的BiomedBERT编码报告，并用癌症类型条件化的时间Transformer读取序列。我们在两个合成基准上评估其相对于最佳可能AUROC上限的表现，一个基准的标签在文本中陈述，另一个只能从肿瘤大小和就诊间隔中恢复（十个随机种子）。诊断分析促成了一个间隔感知的时间编码（HTT-IA）。在14种类型的4,786份TCGA病理报告中，三种类型被留出，并将纯文本HTT与生存模型进行比较。【结果】在短语基准上，HTT达到AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012，而末次报告基线为0.913 +/- 0.007（+0.018，95% CI -0.009至+0.050）；在那里日期无法提高上限。在生长基准上，初始时间编码得分为0.790，与无时间模型（0.787）相同，而HTT-IA达到0.843（+0.053，0.026至0.082），对应的上限为无日期0.894和有日期0.979。在未见肿瘤类型上，HTT达到0.925 +/- 0.007，与分布内性能以及单报告基线相同。纯文本宏C-index为0.592（CALM 0.626-0.652）。【结论】跨类型迁移由预训练编码器承担。只有当数据使就诊时间可识别且时间编码处于临床尺度时，才会使用就诊时间。上限、仅顺序消融和重新标注日期探针是此类模型的廉价检查。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
zh_title: 异构生物医学知识图谱上的大模型多跳推理基准
summary: 预印本对GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen与BioGPT在五个知识图谱上做多层级查询评测，发现图谱接地可降低幻觉。
key_points: 覆盖DrugBank、NeuroSynth等五个知识图谱
通用模型多跳推理优于领域专用模型
查询越复杂性能下降，图谱接地降幻觉
reason: 预印本基准研究，方法有新意但无临床外部验证，属值得一看
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地用于生物医学和认知神经科学，但它们对异构知识图谱（KGs）进行可靠推理的能力仍不清楚。我们在五个KG（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map和GDPKG）上对五个LLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen和BioGPT）进行基准测试。我们引入一个多层级查询数据集，以评估在KG感知（图接地）和KG不可知条件下的推理深度和事实准确性。标注者间一致性达到实质性水平，Cohen's kappa为0.781（范围：0.753-0.807），Fleiss' kappa为0.77。结果表明，通用模型，尤其是GPT-5.1和Gemini 2.0 Pro，在多跳和高层次推理任务上通常优于领域特定模型，尽管性能随查询复杂度增加而下降。KG接地降低了所有评估模型的幻觉率。与我们的初始假设相反，在没有图接地的情况下，领域特定模型在专门任务上并不一致优于通用模型。这些发现凸显了将广泛的语言模型能力与结构化领域知识相结合的价值。我们根据任务复杂性和计算约束为选择LLM-KG集成策略提供实用指导，并讨论用于个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断和可解释AI的混合神经符号架构。

title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
zh_title: LLM辅助标签噪声校正用于脑电睡眠分期
summary: 提出在训练阶段用LLaMA 3.1结合脑电频谱特征与序列上下文筛除低置信度睡眠分期标注，再重训TinySleepNet。
key_points: 先用TinySleepNet输出逐epoch置信度
低置信度片段交LLaMA 3.1按AASM标准复核
仅用于训练阶段，不改变推理流程
reason: 预印本新方法，有基线与既有流程对比但证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期分类是临床睡眠医学中的一项关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域已显示出有希望的结果，但其性能从根本上受训练标签质量制约，这些标签由人类专家手动标注，且易受评分者间不一致和系统性标注错误影响。本文提出一种新颖的 LLM 辅助标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练期间运行，以在重新训练分类器之前识别并移除不可靠的睡眠分期标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练 TinySleepNet 以提取每个 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度分数，然后将低置信度 epoch 连同其 EEG 频谱特征和周围序列上下文提交给 LLaMA 3.1。LLM 根据 AASM 睡眠评分指南评估每个 epoch，并给出可靠（RELIABLE）或可疑（SUSPICIOUS）的判定。可疑 epoch 从训练集中移除，并在清洗后的数据上重新训练 TinySleepNet。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上使用20折交叉验证进行评估，我们的方法将总体准确率从81.8%提高到84.6%，Macro F1-score 从75.6%提高到77.4%，在 REM 检测方面提升尤为显著。至关重要的是，由于 LLM 仅在训练期间运行，轻量级 TinySleepNet 架构（130万参数）在推理时得以保留，使所提出的流程适用于实时、可穿戴睡眠监测应用。

title: Generative Models for Novel Enzymatic Reactions: How Far Do They Go?
zh_title: 生成模型预测新酶促反应的能力评估
summary: 研究检验结构条件生成模型能否仅由酶生成训练数据中未出现的完整生化反应，并与BLASTp、CLIPZyme、RxnPred比较。
key_points: 任务为由酶生成训练集中未见过的反应
现有方法在设计上无法输出未见反应
以精确回收而非指纹相似度作为更严格判据
reason: 预印本方法有新意并与既有方法对比，但缺乏外部验证
abstract: Enzyme function prediction is a long-standing problem in biology, and deep learning methods have recently become popular to improve performance on this task. While most of these models focus on classifying enzymes or mapping them to known reactions, predicting unknown biochemical reactions remains underexplored. Here we thoroughly examine an approach that generates reactions absent from the training data from the enzyme alone. Existing methods such as BLASTp or CLIPZyme cannot, by design, output reactions that are absent from their training data or were not supplied at inference. The closest prior model, RxnPred, reports high fingerprint-similarity scores on held-out enzymes, a less stringent criterion than exact recovery, but fails to recover the correct answer on unseen reactions. We present a structure-conditioned generative model that outputs a complete reaction, reactants and products, and evaluate it on EnzymeMap_x, a reaction-disjoint benchmark in which no test reaction appears in training, under exact, stereo-respecting scoring. On this benchmark, within 400 sampled candidates, the model generates the complete, correct reaction for 25.0% of the subset of test enzyme--reaction pairs whose reaction is a new combination of metabolites seen in training. Surprisingly, it also correctly generates a few reactions composed of metabolites it has not seen in training (1.6%), though their embeddings are present in the vocabulary. With a lower budget, re-ranking places the correct reaction first for 5.6% of pairs and in the top ten for 12.4%, when the reaction is assumed not to be already known (0.2% and 8.1% without that assumption) along with confidence scores. Assessed more leniently, the model produces at least one correct reaction known for the enzyme (usually memorised from training) for 71.2% of test pairs. Going further, without any retraining, a sequence-only model given the reactants as well as the enzyme produces the correct product set for 9.5% of pairs within five candidates, without re-ranking. We also present head-to-head comparisons on these tasks with BLASTp, DIAMOND, RxnPred and Horizyn. Structure conditioning improves fingerprint similarity on homology-stratified splits, but a matched sequence-only ablation at the best configuration finds no measurable effect on exact recovery. Data coverage and chemical initialisation of the vocabulary seem to matter more than encoder geometry.
zh_abstract: 酶功能预测是生物学中长期存在的问题，深度学习方法近来因能提升该任务性能而流行。虽然这些模型大多集中于对酶进行分类或将其映射到已知反应，但预测未知生化反应仍研究不足。在此我们全面考察一种仅根据酶生成训练数据中不存在的反应的方法。现有方法如 BLASTp 或 CLIPZyme 按设计无法输出其训练数据中不存在或推断时未提供的反应。最接近的先前模型 RxnPred 在留出酶上报告了高指纹相似性得分，这一标准不如精确恢复严格，但未能对未见反应恢复正确答案。我们提出一种结构条件生成模型，输出完整反应，即反应物和产物，并在 EnzymeMap_x 上评估它；EnzymeMap_x 是一个反应不相交基准，其中没有测试反应出现在训练中，采用精确、尊重立体化学的评分。在该基准上，在 400 个采样候选内，对于反应为训练中见过的代谢物新组合的测试酶-反应对子集，模型为其中 25.0% 生成完整且正确的反应。令人惊讶的是，它还能正确生成少数由训练中未见过代谢物组成的反应（1.6%），尽管这些代谢物的嵌入存在于词汇表中。在较低预算下，当假定反应尚未已知时，重排序将正确反应排在 5.6% 对子的第一位、12.4% 对子的前十位（若不采用该假设则为 0.2% 和 8.1%），并附带置信分数。以更宽松的方式评估，模型为 71.2% 的测试对子产生至少一个该酶已知的正确反应（通常是从训练中记忆的）。更进一步，在没有任何再训练的情况下，一个仅基于序列的模型在同时给定反应物和酶时，在五个候选内为 9.5% 的对子产生正确产物集合，且无需重排序。我们还展示了在这些任务上与 BLASTp、DIAMOND、RxnPred 和 Horizyn 的正面比较。结构条件化提高了同源性分层划分上的指纹相似性，但在最佳配置下匹配的仅序列消融未发现对精确恢复有可测量影响。数据覆盖度和词汇表的化学初始化似乎比编码器几何结构更重要。

title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
zh_title: USB Gym：闭环超声切面匹配测试平台
summary: 基于公开CT模拟超声，构建可替换模块的闭环探头导航测试平台，并用以比较20种已发表方法。
key_points: 由公开患者CT模拟超声图像
分割器、控制器、奖励三模块可替换
20种方法在6例留出患者的60个回合上比较
reason: 预印本基准平台，有方法对比但样本与验证规模有限，值得一看档。
abstract: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough. Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory. Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress). Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】我们的主要目标是超声引导：移动探头直到其图像与目标视图匹配。已发表的用于引导各组成部分的方法在各自独立的模拟器中评估。我们询问，将这些方法组合成一个引导系统后是否足够好。【方法】我们构建了 USB Gym，一个测试平台，其标准引擎根据公开患者 CT 模拟超声，并有一个网络从 CT 标签中提取器官纹理。其引导系统有三个可替换部分（槽位）：器官分割器、控制器和奖励；它接收了 20 种已发表方法，每种方法均在六名留出患者的相同 60 个回合上运行。在每个槽位中，只有当一种已发表方法在这些患者上可检测地更好时，才替换我们的方法。该组合与我们原始引导系统在 20 个新 CT 上较好的那个作为基准基线。一个姿态预言机读取仅在模拟中可用的精确探头姿态，设定参考。以下结果为探索性结果。【结果】在这些 CT 上，探头起始时平均距离目标视图 16.0 mm；姿态预言机将其带到 1.5 mm。在固定组合时已知的结果中，只有图像相似性奖励（SSIM）略好且可检测地更好，因此该组合是我们的引导系统加上该奖励。该组合是基准基线，最终达到 13.7 mm（为预言机进展的 16%）。【结论】将未经调优的已发表方法与我们的方法组合，并未引导探头接近目标视图；该任务仍研究不足。该测试平台接受新方法；尚无引导系统在硬件上测试。

title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
zh_title: 卵巢癌多组学合成数据的生物学导向评估框架
summary: 提出面向配对RNA表达与CNV合成数据的生物学导向、患者不重叠评估框架，并在DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列上应用。
key_points: 以真实训练集与留出数据一致性为参照
评估模态内保真度与RNA-CNV配对一致性
改造并比较三种多组学整合架构
reason: 预印本提出评估框架，属有新意但证据有限档，未经同行评审
abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
zh_abstract: 配对多组学癌症队列的组装成本高昂且难以共享，这促使合成队列成为一种补充资源。随着生成模型开发加速，我们将重点从提出又一种架构转向定义评估标准，以确定合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构。我们引入一个生物学信息指导且患者不重叠的框架，用于评估配对 RNA 表达与拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向 DECIDER 高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与留出数据之间的一致性为参考，评估模态特异性保真度以及 RNA 与 CNV 配对之间的连贯性，同时辅以训练数据接近度诊断。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对谱。在多项保真度和连贯性指标上领先的模型也表现出最强的训练数据接近度。该方案和案例研究为社区比较未来的多组学生成器提供了参考。

title: Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling
zh_title: 面向3D医学视觉语言建模的多模态分层专家混合
summary: 提出MedHiVE，用解剖尺度两级软专家混合与报告衍生的解剖级对比对齐建模3D扫描与报告。
key_points: 按解剖尺度组织两级软专家混合路由
视觉与文本token均参与分层路由
结合报告衍生的解剖级对比学习
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但未见外部验证或开源说明，值得一看档。
abstract: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.
zh_abstract: 医学3D扫描和报告本质上是层级化的，诊断线索集中在多个组织层级的特定解剖区域。然而，大多数医学视觉-语言模型忽略这种结构，未能聚焦于临床相关解剖。我们介绍MedHiVE，它将层级化视觉-语言软混合专家（SMoE）与对比学习相结合，以联合建模细粒度解剖结构和全局扫描上下文。据我们所知，MedHiVE是首个通过按解剖尺度组织的两级SMoE层级路由视觉和文本token的框架，并将其与用于3D医学影像的报告衍生的解剖层面对比对齐相结合。这取代了先前工作中静态池化特征的直接区域-文本对齐和仅视觉的层级路由，转而采用跨解剖尺度的动态、基于槽的跨模态信息流。MedHiVE通过两级可学习token路由机制运行，其中局部图像和文本特征首先通过局部SMoE路由，然后由全局SMoE融合为统一多模态表征。对比学习在统一空间中对齐解剖层面和全局视觉-语言表征。MedHiVE在25,000+例CT扫描上以解剖监督进行预训练，在6个数据集、3项任务（分割、分类和检测）上持续超越11种最先进方法，证明层级化建模的重要性。MedHiVE的代码见github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE。

title: ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders
zh_title: ProtoGestalt：用于罕见遗传病面部表型与诊断的可解释原型
summary: 提出基于原型的可解释框架，通过受限于面部区域的视觉特征做罕见遗传病筛查与综合征识别。
key_points: 预测可分解为局部、可加的原型证据
在多套对照数据集与不同患病率下评估区分能力
对训练中出现的综合征评估诊断性能
reason: 方法有新意且强调可解释性，但为预印本、缺外部临床验证
abstract: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.
zh_abstract: 罕见遗传病因其多样性和临床特征重叠而难以诊断。面部形态可提供诊断线索，但大多数诊断模型可解释性有限，且并非为支持对未诊断疾病进行广泛筛查而设计。我们提出ProtoGestalt，一个用于面部表型分析、罕见病筛查和综合征识别的可解释的基于原型的框架。该方法通过约束学习到的视觉特征以选择面部区域来扩展原型学习，使预测可通过局部化且可加的证据加以解释。我们在多个对照数据集和类别患病率值上评估ProtoGestalt区分综合征面容与未受累面容的能力。我们进一步评估其在训练期间观察到的综合征上的诊断性能。学习到的基于原型的表征在综合征图像与病例匹配的对照图像之间提供显著分离，并在对照比例增加时保持有用性能。该框架还展示出区分不同综合征的能力。尽管用于罕见病面部分类的专用模型已经存在且具有合理准确性，ProtoGestalt提供了一种可解释的替代方案，将预测与解剖学上有意义的面部区域联系起来，可能支持临床决策和表型-基因关联的发现。

title: AI-assisted Home-based Intervention for ADHD Children
zh_title: AI 辅助 ADHD 儿童家庭干预试验注册
summary: 台湾大学医院注册一项 120 例随机对照试验，评估在线日记平台对 ADHD 儿童情绪调节的训练效果。
key_points: 注册为干预性试验，计划入组 120 例
对照为常规心理咨询
尚无结果，处于招募状态
reason: 前瞻性注册但无结果数据，AI 成分描述有限，属增量信息。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: National Taiwan University Hospital; conditions: ADHD - Attention Deficit Disorder With Hyperactivity, ADHD - Combined Type, ADHD - Inattentive Type; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: RECRUITING] The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the effectiveness of online diary platforms for socio-emotional learning training in children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). The main questions it aims to answer are: Does the online diary platform training enhance children's emotion regulation and its connection to positive thinking? Does the online diary platform training provide an immediate, interactive, and effective emotion training tool during the wait for follow-up visits and treatment? Researchers will compare online diary platforms training to counselling to see if online diary platforms training enhance children's emotion regulation. Participants will use the MangaChat diary platform to log their daily moods and events, which the platform transforms into comic strips to offer an engaging visual story of their emotional experiences. Participants are requested to use the platform daily (or at least 3 times per week) for approximately 10 to 15 minutes per session over a 12-week period.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：National Taiwan University Hospital；疾病：ADHD - Attention Deficit Disorder With Hyperactivity、ADHD - Combined Type、ADHD - Inattentive Type；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；阶段：NA；入组人数：120；状态：RECRUITING] 本临床试验的目标是评估在线日记平台在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童社会情绪学习训练中的有效性。它旨在回答的主要问题是：在线日记平台训练是否增强儿童的情绪调节及其与积极思维的联系？在线日记平台训练是否在等待随访就诊和治疗期间提供即时、互动且有效的情绪训练工具？研究人员将比较在线日记平台训练与心理咨询，以了解在线日记平台训练是否增强儿童的情绪调节。参与者将使用 MangaChat 日记平台记录每日情绪和事件，该平台将其转化为连环漫画，以提供其情绪体验的引人入胜的视觉故事。参与者被要求每天使用该平台（或至少每周 3 次），每次约 10 至 15 分钟，持续 12 周。

title: Development and Validation of a Multimodal Deep Learning Model Using Peripheral Oxygen Saturation and Ballistocardiography Signals for Predicting Apnea-Hypopnea Index in Obstructive Sleep Apnea
zh_title: 血氧与心冲击图多模态模型预测睡眠呼吸暂停指数
summary: 登记一项100例前瞻性观察研究，用智能床垫采集血氧与心冲击图信号，训练多模态深度学习模型估计AHI。
key_points: 前瞻性观察设计，计划入组100例
输入为血氧饱和度与心冲击图信号
目标为无创估计呼吸暂停低通气指数
reason: 前瞻性设计加分，但仅注册、样本100例、无结果，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fu Jen Catholic University; conditions: Obstructive Sleep Apnea; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 100; status: RECRUITING] Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common sleep disorder associated with cardiovascular, metabolic, and neurocognitive complications. The standard diagnostic test for OSA is in-laboratory polysomnography (PSG), which can be costly, labor-intensive, and inconvenient for repeated or large-scale screening. Therefore, there is a need for a convenient and non-invasive method to help identify individuals who may be at risk for OSA. This prospective observational study aims to develop and clinically validate a multimodal deep learning model that integrates peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO₂) signals and ballistocardiography (BCG) data collected using a smart mattress system to estimate the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI). Adult participants undergoing routine overnight PSG for suspected OSA will be enrolled. During sleep, synchronized SpO₂ and BCG signals will be recorded non-invasively. The performance of the deep learning model will be evaluated by comparing the predicted AHI values with AHI values derived from PSG. This study seeks to evaluate whether this practical, non-invasive, and scalable approach may support early identification of OSA risk and improve access to sleep disorder assessment in both clinical and home-based settings.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：辅仁天主教大学；疾病：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停；类型：观察性；入组人数：100；状态：招募中] 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）是一种常见睡眠障碍，与心血管、代谢和神经认知并发症相关。OSA 的标准诊断检查是实验室多导睡眠图（PSG），但其费用高、劳动强度大，且不便于重复或大规模筛查。因此，需要一种便捷且无创的方法来帮助识别可能处于 OSA 风险中的个体。这项前瞻性观察性研究旨在开发并临床验证一种多模态深度学习模型，该模型整合通过智能床垫系统采集的外周血氧饱和度（SpO₂）信号和心冲击图（BCG）数据，以估算呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）。研究将纳入因疑似 OSA 接受常规整夜 PSG 的成年参与者。睡眠期间，将无创记录同步的 SpO₂ 和 BCG 信号。将通过比较预测 AHI 值与 PSG 得出的 AHI 值来评估深度学习模型的性能。本研究旨在评估这种实用、无创且可扩展的方法是否可支持 OSA 风险的早期识别，并改善临床和家庭环境中睡眠障碍评估的可及性。

title: Machine Learning in Smart Hydrogel 4D Printing: Advances, Challenges, and Translational Perspectives.
zh_title: 智能水凝胶4D打印中的机器学习综述
summary: 综述系统梳理机器学习、深度学习与生成模型在智能水凝胶4D打印配方、过程控制与结构优化中的作用。
key_points: 领域仍处转化早期
覆盖配方、实时过程控制与结构优化
讨论挑战与转化前景
reason: 综述类且偏材料制造，与临床AI关联有限，增量档。
abstract: [Annals of biomedical engineering] The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and smart hydrogel-based additive manufacturing offers new capabilities for fabricating adaptive structures, though the field remains in early stages of translation. Smart hydrogels, with their stimuli-responsive properties and biocompatibility, present opportunities in tissue engineering, drug delivery, and soft robotics. However, the complexity of their material behavior and the challenges of high-resolution four-dimensional (4D) printing demand advanced computational approaches to optimize design, processing, and performance. This review systematically examines the role of AI, encompassing machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and generative models, in addressing these challenges. We critically assess AI-driven strategies for hydrogel formulation, real-time process control, structural optimization, and biological outcome prediction, distinguishing between retrospectively fitted models and prospectively validated implementations. A key contribution of this review is the clear differentiation between AI-assisted 3D printing and genuine 4D printing, where constructs exhibit time-dependent shape change, actuation, or degradation in response to stimuli. We introduce AI applications in specific hydrogel printing domains, provide a comparative framework for distinguishing 3D from 4D systems, and critically evaluate quantitative claims with attention to dataset size, validation approaches, and reproducibility. Case studies highlight where AI enhances printability, resolution, and functional outcomes, while we also identify persistent limitations including data scarcity, model interpretability, and regulatory hurdles. A comparative analysis of AI-assisted versus traditional design-of-experiment strategies reveals that while AI offers advantages in high-dimensional spaces, traditional methods remain more accessible, interpretable, and reproducible for simpler systems. By synthesizing recent advancements with transparent methodology and practical guidance, this study provides a roadmap for future research at the intersection of AI and smart hydrogel additive manufacturing, advocating for interdisciplinary collaboration and standardized reporting to enable next-generation innovations.
zh_abstract: 【综述】人工智能（AI）与基于智能水凝胶的增材制造的融合为制造自适应结构提供了新能力，尽管该领域的转化仍处于早期阶段。智能水凝胶具有刺激响应特性和生物相容性，在组织工程、药物递送和软体机器人中提供了机遇。然而，其材料行为的复杂性以及高分辨率四维（4D）打印的挑战，要求采用先进的计算方法来优化设计、加工和性能。本综述系统考察AI——包括机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）和生成模型——在应对这些挑战中的作用。我们批判性评估AI驱动的水凝胶配方、实时过程控制、结构优化和生物学结果预测策略，并区分回顾性拟合模型与前瞻性验证实现。本综述的一个关键贡献是清晰区分AI辅助3D打印与真正的4D打印，后者中构建体响应刺激表现出时间依赖性形状变化、驱动或降解。我们介绍AI在特定水凝胶打印领域中的应用，提供区分3D与4D系统的比较框架，并批判性评估定量主张，关注数据集规模、验证方法和可重复性。案例研究强调AI在提高可打印性、分辨率和功能结果方面的作用，同时我们也指出持续存在的局限性，包括数据稀缺、模型可解释性和监管障碍。对AI辅助策略与传统实验设计策略的比较分析显示，尽管AI在高维空间中具有优势，传统方法对于更简单的系统仍然更易获得、更易解释且更可重复。通过以透明的方法学和实践指导综合近期进展，本研究为AI与智能水凝胶增材制造交叉领域的未来研究提供路线图，倡导跨学科合作和标准化报告以实现下一代创新。

title: Verifiable Agentic Science on Public Infrastructure.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: 公共基础设施上可验证的智能体化科研
summary: 预印本提出将自主编码智能体接入共享计算资源以留下可审计记录，并展示30个本地智能体在同一数据上分化为18种互不兼容流程。
key_points: 指出本地智能体操作缺乏可核查记录
把智能体接入公共基础设施形成可审计轨迹
报告30个无引导智能体产生18种不兼容流程
reason: 智能体可复现性问题有新意，但为未经同行评审的预印本、通用科学场景，证据有限
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Autonomous artificial intelligence agents are transforming the practice of science. Across every discipline, researchers are handing data analysis to coding agents that can design and execute complex studies from a single prompt. Yet this revolution carries a threat. When agents improvise in local environments, they leave no verifiable record, ultimately risking a wave of irreproducible science. Solving this crisis requires moving agentic science onto public infrastructure where every action leaves an examinable trail. Here we connect autonomous coding agents to shared computing resources, turning ephemeral prompts into auditable scientific records. After showing that 30 unguided local agents splinter into 18 incompatible pipelines on the same dataset, we conduct an agentic reproduction and discovery study on a large scale-reproducing a large, diverse array of studies with every workflow, history, and intermediate dataset publicly accessible. This complete provenance trail exposes unstated modeling choices, reference mismatches, and subsampled tutorial inputs in published studies, and establishes a new foundation where human scientists can understand, steer, and trust AI-driven discovery.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] 自主人工智能（AI）智能体正在改变科学实践。在每个学科中，研究人员正将数据分析交给编码智能体，这些智能体可以从单个提示设计并执行复杂研究。然而这场革命伴随威胁。当智能体在本地环境中即兴操作时，它们不留下可验证记录，最终可能造成一波不可复现的科学。解决这一危机需要将智能体驱动的科学转移到公共基础设施上，使每个动作都留下可检查的轨迹。在这里，我们将自主编码智能体连接到共享计算资源，把短暂的提示转化为可审计的科学记录。在展示30个未引导的本地智能体在同一数据集上分裂为18条不兼容流水线之后，我们开展了一项大规模的智能体复现与发现研究——复现大量多样化研究，且每个工作流程、历史记录和中间数据集均可公开访问。这一完整的来源追踪轨迹揭示了已发表研究中未明示的建模选择、参考不匹配和子采样教程输入，并建立了一个新基础，使人类科学家能够理解、引导并信任AI驱动的发现。

title: Wetter's Digital Twin: A Patient-Specific Framework for Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare.
source: PubMed · JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons
zh_title: Wetter数字孪生：面向AI与医疗的个体化框架
summary: 提出Wetter数字孪生概念，整合个人健康信息、AI与人群数据，构建患者动态虚拟模型以辅助手术准备。
key_points: 提出个体化动态患者数字孪生概念WDT
整合EHR、影像、生理监测与可穿戴数据
拟用于术前模拟干预、改善手术结局
reason: 概念性观点文章，无数据验证，属增量档
abstract: [JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons] The concept of ORReady began with a simple goal: to better prepare the patient, surgeon, operating team, and operating room (OR) environment to improve surgical outcomes. Advances in artificial intelligence, large datasets, electronic health records, imaging, physiological monitoring, wearable technologies, and predictive analytics now create an opportunity to take that concept considerably further. Digital twins, originally developed in engineering, use evolving virtual representations of physical systems to model performance and test possible interventions before they are applied. We propose Wetter's Digital Twin (WDT) as an individualized, dynamic model of the patient that integrates personal health information with artificial intelligence, medical knowledge, and relevant population data. Unlike the conventional medical record, which primarily documents what has occurred, WDT would help clinicians understand what may happen next and explore how different interventions might alter that course. In surgery, such a model could assist with preoperative optimization, procedure selection and planning, intraoperative decision support, and postoperative recovery. The concept, however, extends beyond surgery. The same longitudinal patient-specific model could contribute to prevention, diagnosis, medical treatment, chronic disease management, rehabilitation, and long-term health planning. WDT is proposed not as a replacement for physician judgment or patient participation, but as a means of making increasingly complex health information more useful to both. Important challenges involving data integration, validation, privacy, security, bias, regulation, and clinical responsibility remain. The transition from a medical record that primarily records the past toward a patient-specific model that can also evaluate possible futures may represent an important next step in healthcare.
zh_abstract: [JSLS : Journal of the Society of Laparoendoscopic Surgeons] ORReady的概念始于一个简单目标：更好地为患者、外科医生、手术团队和手术室（OR）环境做好准备，以改善手术结局。人工智能、大型数据集、电子健康记录、影像、生理监测、可穿戴技术和预测分析的进步，如今为将该概念大幅推进创造了机会。数字孪生最初在工程领域开发，使用物理系统的演进虚拟表示来建模性能，并在实施可能的干预措施之前进行测试。我们提出Wetter的数字孪生（Wetter's Digital Twin, WDT），作为患者的个体化、动态模型，将个人健康信息与人工智能、医学知识和相关人群数据整合。与传统病历主要记录已经发生的情况不同，WDT将帮助临床医生理解接下来可能发生什么，并探索不同干预措施可能如何改变该进程。在外科领域，此类模型可协助术前优化、术式选择和规划、术中决策支持以及术后康复。然而，该概念超越外科。相同的纵向患者特异性模型可有助于预防、诊断、医疗、慢性病管理、康复和长期健康规划。提出WDT并非作为医生判断或患者参与的替代，而是作为一种使日益复杂的健康信息对二者更有用的手段。涉及数据整合、验证、隐私、安全、偏倚、监管和临床责任的重要挑战仍然存在。从主要记录过去的病历，转向也可评估可能未来的患者特异性模型，可能代表医疗保健的重要下一步。

title: AI Identifies Clinically Relevant Asystole Among False Loop Recorder Alerts: From Data Overload to Diagnosis.
zh_title: AI在环形记录仪误报警中识别出临床相关心脏停搏
summary: 个案报告：77岁晕厥女性患者的植入式环形记录仪多次误报警，AI增强远程监测识别出真实停搏并促成起搏器植入。
key_points: 设备因R波感知不良产生多次假性停搏报警
AI远程监测识别出伴P波阻滞的真实停搏
仅有单例个案，缺乏系统性验证
reason: 单例病例报告，无对照与量化评估，属增量档
abstract: [JACC. Case reports] Implantable loop recorders (ILRs) are often implanted to investigate unexplained syncopal episodes. However, ILRs may produce false alerts due to undersensing or artifacts, thus requiring careful review of numerous device recordings, which makes it challenging to identify clinically significant events. We report a case of a 77-year-old woman with recurrent syncopal episodes, in whom a 7-second pause was detected by an ILR. Device interrogations showed multiple pause alerts that were identified as false events because of poor R sensing. However, the artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced remote monitoring identified a true pause with blocked P waves, leading the patient to receive a pacemaker implantation. This case highlights the clinical value of AI-assisted remote monitoring in identifying clinically relevant arrhythmias among numerous device alerts. Improved automated filtering of ILR data may reduce diagnostic delays and help clinicians prioritize clinically significant events. ILRs may generate numerous false alerts because of sensing abnormalities, complicating the identification of clinically relevant events in routine practice. AI-enhanced remote monitoring may improve diagnostic efficiency by identifying true arrhythmic events within large volumes of device-generated data and guiding timely management.
zh_abstract: [JACC. Case Reports] 植入式循环记录器（implantable loop recorders, ILRs）常被植入以查明不明原因晕厥发作。然而，ILRs可能因感知不足或伪差而产生假警报，因此需要仔细审阅大量设备记录，这使得识别具有临床意义的事件具有挑战性。我们报告一例77岁女性，反复出现晕厥发作，其ILR检测到7秒停搏。设备程控检查显示多次停搏警报，这些警报因R波感知不良而被判定为假事件。然而，人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）增强的远程监测识别出一次伴P波阻滞的真性停搏，使患者接受了起搏器植入。本病例凸显了AI辅助远程监测在大量设备警报中识别临床相关心律失常的临床价值。改进ILR数据的自动过滤可能减少诊断延迟，并帮助临床医生优先处理具有临床意义的事件。ILRs可能因感知异常产生大量假警报，使常规实践中识别临床相关事件复杂化。AI增强的远程监测可通过在大量设备生成数据中识别真性心律失常事件并指导及时管理，从而提高诊断效率。

title: ToxPipe: integrating AI into toxicoinformatics.
zh_title: ToxPipe：将大模型集成进毒理学信息学
summary: 开源模块化软件栈，集中接入多种大模型并提供工作流、监控与使用审计；作者称高级AI功能相对基线未见明显收益。
key_points: 基于LibreChat、LiteLLM、Langflow构建
支持本地/开源模型与日志审计
MCP、RAG、智能体未见明显增益
reason: 开源工具集成，作者自述高级功能无明确增益，增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in toxicology] ToxPipe is a modular, fully open-source software stack designed to accelerate toxicological data analysis and decision-making by integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities with workflow, monitoring, and user-interface services. ToxPipe leverages existing open-source technologies like LibreChat, LiteLLM, and Langflow to provide centralized and streamlined access to different LLMs for end users and developers and logging and auditing of LLM use for organizations. ToxPipe also allows for open-source/local model support. While the ToxPipe ecosystem also supports advanced AI functions such as MCP server integration, RAG and literature search, and agent creation, we did not observe clear benefits using these configurations relative to the GPT-5.5 baseline assertion coverage scores. ToxPipe is available as a series of Docker containers for rapid and reproducible deployment.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in toxicology] ToxPipe 是一个模块化、完全开源的软件栈，旨在通过将大语言模型（LLM）能力与工作流、监控和用户界面服务集成，加速毒理学数据分析与决策。ToxPipe 利用 LibreChat、LiteLLM 和 Langflow 等现有开源技术，为最终用户和开发者提供集中且简化的不同 LLM 访问，并为组织提供 LLM 使用的记录和审计。ToxPipe 还支持开源/本地模型。虽然 ToxPipe 生态系统也支持高级 AI 功能，如 MCP 服务器集成、检索增强生成（RAG）和文献检索以及智能体创建，但相对于 GPT-5.5 基线断言覆盖率得分，我们未观察到使用这些配置有明显获益。ToxPipe 以一系列 Docker 容器形式提供，便于快速且可重复地部署。

title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
zh_title: 医疗AI数学基础的系统综述
summary: 系统综述汇总2016年以来147项研究，梳理医疗AI所依赖的数学框架与方法学趋势。
key_points: 按PRISMA 2020检索三大数据库
653条记录中147项纳入分析
用VOSviewer做文献计量、AMSTAR-2评质量
reason: 综述类最高6分；主题宽泛、无具体模型或临床结果，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare relies on diverse mathematical frameworks, yet their contributions to model development, evaluation, interpretability, and clinical translation remain fragmented. This systematic review synthesized the classical and emerging mathematical foundations underpinning healthcare AI and examined major methodological and application trends. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, studies published between January 2016 and June 30, 2026, were identified through systematic searches of Scopus, Google Scholar, and PubMed/MEDLINE, with searches conducted using Harzing's Publish or Perish v8 where applicable. Bibliometric analysis was performed using VOSviewer, while methodological quality was assessed using an adapted JBI-based framework and AMSTAR-2 for systematic reviews. Of 653 records identified, 147 studies met the eligibility criteria. Non-mutually exclusive mathematical-domain coding identified linear algebra in 100/147 studies (68.0%), calculus and optimization in 91/147 (61.9%), and probability and statistics in 79/147 (53.7%), highlighting their roles in data representation, learning, optimization, inference, uncertainty quantification, and validation. A separate mutually exclusive classification of dominant methodological themes identified explainable and trustworthy AI in 24/147 studies (16.3%), statistics and learning theory in 23/147 (15.6%), probability and Bayesian methods in 23/147 (15.6%), calculus and optimization in 19/147 (12.9%), and linear algebra in 15/147 (10.2%). Radiology and medical imaging were the leading healthcare application (24.3%), while classification and diagnosis were the most frequent clinical task (17.1%). Overall, healthcare AI is supported by an interconnected mathematical ecosystem. Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence] 医疗保健中的人工智能（AI）依赖多种数学框架，但这些框架对模型开发、评估、可解释性和临床转化的贡献仍较为分散。本系统综述综合了支撑医疗保健AI的经典与新兴数学基础，并考察了主要方法学与应用趋势。遵循PRISMA 2020指南，通过系统检索Scopus、Google Scholar和PubMed/MEDLINE识别2016年1月至2026年6月30日期间发表的研究，并在适用时使用Harzing's Publish or Perish v8进行检索。使用VOSviewer进行文献计量分析，同时采用改编的基于JBI的框架评估方法学质量，并使用AMSTAR-2评估系统综述。在识别的653条记录中，147项研究符合纳入标准。非互斥的数学领域编码在100/147项研究（68.0%）中识别出线性代数，在91/147项（61.9%）中识别出微积分与优化，在79/147项（53.7%）中识别出概率与统计，突出其在数据表示、学习、优化、推断、不确定性量化和验证中的作用。另一项针对主导方法学主题的互斥分类在24/147项研究（16.3%）中识别出可解释与可信AI，在23/147项（15.6%）中识别出统计与学习理论，在23/147项（15.6%）中识别出概率与贝叶斯方法，在19/147项（12.9%）中识别出微积分与优化，在15/147项（10.2%）中识别出线性代数。放射学与医学影像是领先的医疗保健应用（24.3%），而分类与诊断是最常见的临床任务（17.1%）。总体而言，医疗保健AI由一个相互关联的数学生态系统支撑。包括图神经网络、Transformers和量子机器学习在内的新兴方法，需要更强外部验证、标准化基准测试和严格评估，以实现可靠的临床转化。

title: Beyond Artificial Intelligence: Vocation and the Sacred Relationship Between Physician and Patient.
zh_title: 天主教会伦理视角下的医学AI与医患关系
summary: 同行评审评论文章，依据天主教生命伦理文献讨论AI融入临床时应如何维护人的尊严与医师对患者的责任。
key_points: 以教会文献为框架讨论AI临床整合
强调医学是服务他人的志业而非信息获取
主张在保留医师责任前提下规范使用AI
reason: 伦理论述类评论，无数据与方法创新，观点档
abstract: [The Linacre quarterly] The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine should be discussed following Pope Leo XIV's recent encyclical on AI and the need to protect human dignity in this era of advancing technology. As a result of its efficiency and accessibility to people for medical advice, AI is already starting to change healthcare. These advances may improve patient care, but medicine is about more than access to information. Medicine is a vocation motivated by the compassionate service to others, and this must be defended. Using the teachings of Antiqua et Nova and Magnifica Humanitas as a guide, this commentary discusses how Catholic bioethics can contribute to the integration of AI in clinical practice. These ethical principles can direct the proper use of AI while still upholding physicians' responsibilities to their patients. Physicians must recognize each patient's dignity and needs, which go beyond the knowledge that any algorithm can offer. Furthermore, the recommendations that these AI systems provide are only as strong as the information available to them, emphasizing the continued importance of the physician's clinical judgment. As we continue to monitor the emergence and growth of AI, the Church serves as a reminder to us that AI should support physicians' clinical judgment while preserving the sacred relationship of trust between physician and patient.

title: pLM-bVAE: protein language model-enhanced binary representation improves quantum annealing-based protein sequence design
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型增强二值编码改进量子退火蛋白设计
summary: 预印本提出pLM-bVAE，将预训练蛋白语言模型表征引入二值变分自编码器，用于量子退火蛋白序列设计的编码与解码。

在三个公开蛋白数据集上做计算实验

abstract: Quantum annealing (QA) has been explored as an approach for protein design in vast combinatorial sequence spaces. Applying QA to protein sequence design requires amino acid sequences to be encoded as binary vectors, and optimized vectors to be decoded back into amino acid sequences. Thus, both the quality of binary encoding and sequence reconstruction accuracy are important for effective QA-based optimization. Binary variational autoencoder (bVAE) has been used to map protein sequences to binary representations in QA-based protein sequence design. However, bVAE was originally developed for natural language modeling, and its suitability for proteins has not been systematically evaluated. Here, we present pLM-bVAE, which incorporates protein representations derived from a pretrained protein language model (pLM) into the original bVAE model. In computational experiments on three public protein variant datasets, pLM-bVAE showed higher sequence reconstruction accuracy and binary encoding performance than bVAE. Moreover, we incorporated pLM-bVAE into a QA-based protein sequence design framework. Across all three datasets, pLM-bVAE generated more high-scoring sequences with greater sequence dissimilarity from the training and validation data than bVAE. Our results demonstrate that pLM-bVAE provides an effective binary representation for improving QA-based protein sequence design. Availability The source code used in this manuscript is available at https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE.
zh_abstract: 量子退火（QA）已被探索作为在庞大组合序列空间中进行蛋白质设计的一种方法。将 QA 应用于蛋白质序列设计需要将氨基酸序列编码为二进制向量，并将优化后的向量解码回氨基酸序列。因此，二进制编码的质量和序列重建准确性对于有效的基于 QA 的优化都很重要。二进制变分自编码器（bVAE）已被用于在基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计中将蛋白质序列映射为二进制表示。然而，bVAE 最初是为自然语言建模开发的，其用于蛋白质的适用性尚未被系统评估。在此，我们提出 pLM-bVAE，它将从预训练蛋白质语言模型（pLM）获得的蛋白质表示整合到原始 bVAE 模型中。在三个公共蛋白质变体数据集上的计算实验中，pLM-bVAE 显示出比 bVAE 更高的序列重建准确性和二进制编码性能。此外，我们将 pLM-bVAE 纳入基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计框架。在所有三个数据集上，与 bVAE 相比，pLM-bVAE 生成了更多高分序列，且这些序列与训练和验证数据的序列差异性更大。我们的结果表明，pLM-bVAE 提供了一种有效的二进制表示，用于改进基于 QA 的蛋白质序列设计。可用性 本手稿使用的源代码可在 https://github.com/hueda8/pLM-bVAE 获取。

title: Bioprocess Modeling Made Easy With Hybrax
zh_title: Hybrax：生物过程混合建模开源框架
summary: 开源Python框架Hybrax整合生物过程数据格式与端到端训练流程，用于机理与混合模型建模。
key_points: 面向常微分方程内嵌神经网络的混合模型
提供统一数据格式与可定制训练流水线
旨在改善文献模型与数据的可复现性
reason: 预印本开源工具，属工程性改进，未报告验证结果，增量档。
abstract: Hybrid models that embed neural networks in ordinary differential equations are increasingly popular in bioprocess modeling, but they are challenging to set up. Much of the effort goes into the code around the model: wet-lab data must be imported and pre-processed, feeds and sampling must be accounted for in the balance equations, and a training loop with cross-validation must be set up. Researchers usually write this code from scratch for each project. In addition, no widely adopted format for bioprocess data exists, and datasets are mostly published in bespoke spreadsheets or not at all. As a result, models and datasets from the literature are difficult to reproduce, reuse, or compare.We present Hybrax, an open-source Python framework that addresses these problems. It combines a flexible format for bioprocess data with a customizable end-to-end training pipeline for mechanistic and hybrid models. Hybrax derives the transport terms in the process dynamics automatically and provides the utilities needed for training, so that researchers can focus on developing the model itself. It also facilitates model sharing and reproducibility: each training checkpoint contains the model parameters, code, configuration, and training data required to run the model or retrain it from scratch. We demonstrate Hybrax by re-implementing two models from the literature, one trained on real-world E. coli data and one on synthetic HEK293 data, with performance comparable to the original models. Hybrax is available at https://github.com/hybrax/hybrax.
zh_abstract: 将神经网络嵌入常微分方程的混合模型在生物过程建模中越来越受欢迎，但它们难以搭建。大部分工作花在模型周边的代码上：必须导入并预处理湿实验室数据，必须在平衡方程中考虑补料和采样，并且必须建立带交叉验证的训练循环。研究人员通常为每个项目从头编写这些代码。此外，生物过程数据尚无广泛采用的格式，数据集大多以定制的电子表格发布，或者根本不发布。因此，来自文献的模型和数据集难以复现、复用或比较。我们提出 Hybrax，一个解决这些问题的开源 Python 框架。它将灵活的生物过程数据格式与可定制的端到端训练流程相结合，适用于机理模型和混合模型。Hybrax 自动推导过程动力学中的传输项，并提供训练所需的实用工具，使研究人员能够专注于开发模型本身。它还促进模型共享和可复现性：每个训练检查点包含运行模型或从头重新训练所需的模型参数、代码、配置和训练数据。我们通过重新实现文献中的两个模型来演示 Hybrax，一个在真实世界大肠杆菌（E. coli）数据上训练，一个在合成 HEK293 数据上训练，性能与原始模型相当。Hybrax 可在 https://github.com/hybrax/hybrax 获取。

title: Transformer-Based Trajectory Prescription for sEMG-Optimizing Robot-Mediated Rehabilitation
zh_title: Transformer轨迹处方优化机器人康复中的sEMG
summary: 提出可个性化Transformer编码器-解码器模型，将表面肌电激活映射为康复机器人的接触力轨迹，并用流匹配生成轨迹分布。
key_points: 以优化神经肌肉激活为目标而非仅运动学
用RoPE位置嵌入构建用户特异潜表征
以流匹配输出轨迹分布
reason: 预印本方法探索，无临床结局与外部验证，增量偏中
abstract: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. The model uses a transformer encoder-decoder leveraging rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to generate a latent representation of trajectory-relevant and user-specific neuromotor factors, and augments trajectory prediction with flow matching to produce a distribution over plausible prescriptions biased toward the training distribution. Using data from 16 healthy participants completing 15 isometric trajectory tracking tasks, we evaluate generalization across held-out tasks and users, as well as the feasibility of user-specific fine-tuning within a therapy-session timescale. The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions. An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task. These results provide a proof of concept for data-driven, activation-targeted trajectory prescription in robot-mediated rehabilitation and establish a foundation for future validation in clinical populations. Data and code have been open-sourced as part of the OpenRobotRehab project on SimTK.
zh_abstract: 机器人介导的康复有潜力提供高强度、个体化治疗，但现有系统（其结局并未持续改善）通常规定运动学轨迹，而非明确靶向被认为支持恢复的神经运动激活。为弥补这一空白，并最终实现以激活优化为目标的康复机器人行为，我们提出一种可个性化的基于 transformer 的模型，将个体肌肉激活（通过表面肌电测量）映射到与末端执行器康复机器人交互时规定的接触力轨迹。该模型使用采用旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的 transformer 编码器-解码器，生成与轨迹相关且用户特异的神经运动因素的潜在表示，并通过流匹配增强轨迹预测，以产生偏向训练分布的合理处方分布。使用 16 名健康参与者完成 15 项等长轨迹跟踪任务的数据，我们评估了在留出任务和用户上的泛化能力，以及在治疗会话时间尺度内进行用户特异性微调的可行性。该模型在留出任务和用户上实现平均轨迹预测误差 <8%，具有实际上瞬时的确定性推理和亚秒级轨迹分布采样。在实时康复任务中对该模型的初步测试表明，平均而言，参与者在整个任务中累计仅 15% 的误差即达到目标神经运动激活。这些结果为机器人介导康复中数据驱动、以激活为靶点的轨迹处方提供了概念验证，并为未来在临床人群中的验证奠定了基础。数据和代码已在 SimTK 上作为 OpenRobotRehab 项目的一部分开源。

title: Interpretable Multimodal MRI-Clinical Fusion for Functional Outcome Prediction After Acute Ischemic Stroke
zh_title: 可解释多模态MRI-临床融合预测急性缺血性卒中功能结局
summary: 在66例缺血性卒中患者中比较MRI各模态与临床变量融合的预后模型，FLAIR-临床融合交叉验证AUC最高。
key_points: 样本仅66例，采用八折分层分组交叉验证
仅临床模型AUC约0.90，MRI单独模型约0.67-0.73
FLAIR与临床融合平均AUC约0.948
reason: 小样本单中心预印本，仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.
zh_abstract: 本研究评估第1天多模态MRI对预测急性缺血性卒中（AIS）后3个月功能结局的附加预后价值。分析了66例具有ADC、DWI、FLAIR和临床数据的AIS患者。从每种MRI模态提取三维预训练ResNet嵌入，使用折隔离主成分分析降维，并与结构化临床变量和ADC衍生病变生物标志物相结合。使用八折分层分组交叉验证在MRI模态组合上评估线性支持向量机。仅临床建模取得较强性能（AUC = 0.899 ± 0.151），而仅MRI模型显示有限区分度（AUC ≈ 0.67–0.73）。在多模态配置中，FLAIR-临床融合取得最高平均交叉验证性能（AUC = 0.948 ± 0.061），其次是ADC-临床融合（AUC = 0.941 ± 0.094）。完整ADC-DWI-FLAIR融合并未始终优于单模态临床融合。特征重要性分析确定年龄、NIHSS亚评分、ADC病变负荷和学习到的FLAIR表征为关键贡献因素，而定性FLAIR激活图显示在病变样区域出现响应。这些发现表明，紧凑的第1天FLAIR和ADC表征提供超出临床变量的互补预后信息，并支持AIS中可解释、数据高效的结果预测。

title: GTAFL: Addressing Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning in Medical Image
zh_title: GTAFL：面向医学图像测试分布未知的长尾联邦学习
summary: 提出测试分布未知场景下的长尾联邦学习任务与GTAFL框架，以应对医疗数据本地与全局长尾分布。
key_points: 定义“测试无关长尾联邦学习”新任务
现有方法假设测试分布均匀，实际易失效
面向隐私保护的去中心化医学图像训练
reason: 方法类预印本，未给出具体临床数据集与外部验证结果
abstract: In healthcare, protecting patient privacy is crucial due to the sensitivity of medical data and its extensive accessibility. Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized and privacy-preserving training paradigm, making it an ideal solution for healthcare applications. A critical challenge in healthcare is that real-world medical data often exhibits long-tailed distributions in local and global views. Existing methods addressing long-tailed FL problem typically assume that the model will be evaluated on uniform test data distribution. However, practical test data in healthcare systems is often agnostic and unpredictable, leading to potential model failures in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel task termed Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and propose GTAFL, a comprehensive framework to address this challenge. During the training stage, GTAFL employs adaptive re-sampling, expert classifier retraining, and self-supervised learning to correct biased classifiers and distorted feature spaces caused by long-tailed training distributions. During the inference stage, an ensemble mechanism combines retrained expert classifiers to handle test data with unknown distributions. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10 and two medical datasets manifest that our framework outperforms other state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL
zh_abstract: 在医疗保健中，由于医疗数据的敏感性及其广泛可及性，保护患者隐私至关重要。联邦学习（federated learning, FL）提供了一种去中心化且保护隐私的训练范式，使其成为医疗保健应用的理想解决方案。医疗保健中的一个关键挑战是，真实世界医疗数据在局部和全局视图中常呈现长尾分布。解决长尾FL问题的现有方法通常假设模型将在均匀测试数据分布上评估。然而，医疗保健系统中的实际测试数据往往不可知且不可预测，导致模型在真实世界场景中可能失败。本文引入一个称为测试不可知长尾联邦学习（Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning）的新任务，并提出GTAFL，一个应对该挑战的综合框架。在训练阶段，GTAFL采用自适应重采样、专家分类器重训练和自监督学习，以纠正由长尾训练分布导致的有偏分类器和扭曲特征空间。在推理阶段，集成机制组合重训练的专家分类器，以处理分布未知的测试数据。在CIFAR10和两个医学数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的框架优于其他最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL获取。

title: Collaborative generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography
zh_title: 通用-专用AI协同实现脑CT工作清单安全降级
summary: 多中心回顾性外部验证（n=2001）显示，通用CLIP模型与商用检测器协同可安全降级非增强脑CT检查。
key_points: 多中心外部验证2001例急诊与创伤队列
单用商用检测器漏检31例显著异常
协同系统在预设阈值下召回全部异常
reason: 同行评审+多中心外部验证且评估工作流降级效果，符合外部验证加分档，但为回顾性设计。
abstract: Safe deprioritization of non-contrast brain computed tomography (NCCT) demands high sensitivity and negative predictive value (NPV) across common and uncommon findings requiring clinical attention. Here, we present a collaborative safety net integrating BrainCT-CLIP, a generalist foundation model via contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP), with commercial detectors. Every examination remained in the reporting workflow, deprioritized only when no model returned a positive result. In a retrospective multicenter external validation of consecutive emergency and trauma cohorts ( n = 2001), standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized, including 16 target-disease false negatives and 15 outside their indications. In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20). These findings support generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization under radiologist oversight, with high sensitivity for intracranial findings requiring clinical attention.
zh_abstract: 对非增强脑计算机断层扫描（non-contrast brain computed tomography, NCCT）进行安全降低优先级，要求在需要临床关注的常见和不常见发现中具有高敏感性和阴性预测值（negative predictive value, NPV）。在此，我们提出一个协作式安全网，将 BrainCT-CLIP（一种通过对比语言-图像预训练（contrastive language-image pre-training, CLIP）构建的通用基础模型）与商业检测器整合。每项检查均保留在报告工作流程中，仅当没有任何模型返回阳性结果时才降低优先级。在一项针对连续急诊和创伤队列（n = 2001）的回顾性多中心外部验证中，独立商业检测器使324项显著检查中的31项被降低优先级，包括16项目标疾病假阴性和15项超出其适应证。相比之下，协作系统在开发队列中预先设定的阈值下找回了所有显著检查，达到100%敏感性和NPV，同时对18%的检查降低了优先级（368/2001；95% CI，17–20）。这些发现支持在放射科医生监督下使用通才-专科人工智能进行安全的工作列表降低优先级，并对需要临床关注的颅内发现具有高敏感性。

title: AI-driven multi-horizon risk stratification for heart failure hospitalization in UA with HFpEF: a Chinese multi-center cohort study
zh_title: AI驱动的不稳定心绞痛合并HFpEF心衰住院多时间跨度风险分层
summary: 中国多中心回顾性队列纳入4367例不稳定心绞痛合并HFpEF患者，构建12/24/36个月心衰住院风险模型并完成外部验证。
key_points: 多中心回顾性队列，纳入4367例UA合并HFpEF患者
LASSO、SVM-RFE与Boruta联合筛选预测变量
训练12种机器学习模型做多时间跨度风险预测
最优模型外部验证AUC约0.836–0.839
reason: 多中心样本4367例并完成外部验证，属重要档；回顾性设计未再上调
abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) complicated by unstable angina (UA) represents a major challenge in chronic disease management with high risk of recurrent heart failure hospitalization (HFH), and despite the availability of multicenter real-world data, AI-driven tools for multi-horizon risk assessment remain limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort enrolled 4367 patients with UA and HFpEF, and an ensemble feature selection pipeline integrating LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta identified robust predictors, followed by training of twelve machine learning algorithms to estimate HFH risk at 12-, 24- and 36-month horizons with external validation. The optimal time-specific models (ET, GBDT and LightGBM) achieved strong discrimination in the training cohort with AUCs of 0.818, 0.834 and 0.863, and maintained performance in external validation with AUCs of 0.839, 0.836 and 0.851, respectively, while SHAP analysis highlighted diabetes mellitus, TyG-BMI and NT-proBNP as the most influential predictors. We developed and externally validated a multi-time-point machine learning framework for HFH risk stratification in UA and HFpEF, which showed acceptable calibration and potential clinical utility on decision-curve analysis. Further prospective and real-world validation across diverse populations and healthcare systems is needed to confirm clinical effectiveness and support translation into routine practice.
zh_abstract: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）合并不稳定型心绞痛（UA）是慢性病管理中的重大挑战，其复发性心力衰竭住院（HFH）风险高；尽管已有多个中心的真实世界数据，用于多时间跨度风险评估的人工智能驱动工具仍然有限。这项多中心回顾性队列纳入了 4367 例 UA 和 HFpEF 患者，整合 LASSO、SVM-RFE 和 Boruta 的集成特征选择流程识别出稳健预测因子，随后训练 12 种机器学习算法以估计 12、24 和 36 个月时间跨度的 HFH 风险，并进行外部验证。最佳时间特异性模型（ET、GBDT 和 LightGBM）在训练队列中实现了较强的区分能力，AUC 分别为 0.818、0.834 和 0.863，并在外部验证中保持性能，AUC 分别为 0.839、0.836 和 0.851；同时 SHAP 分析突出显示糖尿病、TyG-BMI 和 NT-proBNP 是最有影响力的预测因子。我们开发并外部验证了一个用于 UA 和 HFpEF 的 HFH 风险分层的多时间点机器学习框架，该框架在决策曲线分析中显示出可接受的校准度和潜在临床效用。仍需在不同人群和医疗系统中进行进一步的前瞻性和真实世界验证，以确认临床有效性并支持转化为常规实践。

title: External validation of an image-only ultrasound model for delivery-date prediction in four Chilean public hospitals
zh_title: 仅图像超声预测分娩日期模型在智利四院外部验证
summary: 在智利四家公立医院外部验证仅图像超声预测分娩日期模型，2550例孕妇，误差优于常规但重定标后增益不足一天。
key_points: 四院外部验证2550例孕妇
平均绝对误差6.9天 vs 常规11.6天
重定标对照下增益不足1天
reason: 四院外部验证、2550例，属重要档；但增益有限未上调至8
abstract: Pregnancy dating fails the women who need it most: those who reach care without a first-trimester scan. We externally validated a commercial image-only ultrasound deep-learning model for delivery-date prediction, applied unmodified to 64,235 frames from 3788 examinations of 2550 pregnancies (34% migrant) at four Chilean public hospitals. Mean absolute error was 6.9 days versus 11.6 for the conventional due date, yet most of this gain reflected a shorter local gestation and fell below one day against recentred comparators. Fixed-term comparators assign every pregnancy the same gestational age at birth and therefore cannot rank who will deliver early, at any level of point accuracy: accuracy metrics are blind to the ranking on which management turns whenever the outcome distribution is concentrated, as in term-dominated cohorts. In a prespecified landmark analysis the model’s separate image-only risk score discriminated preterm birth with an area under the curve of 0.86, against 0.52 for gestational age alone; outside the landmark restriction it exceeded a clinical baseline of coded diagnoses plus same-examination biometry by 0.09, although it was miscalibrated. Error and calibration were also assessed by maternal nationality. These classification analyses are exploratory, and no woman was managed with the model; they identify what a prospective study should test.
zh_abstract: 妊娠孕龄推算辜负了最需要它的女性：那些在未进行早孕期超声检查的情况下接受照护的女性。我们在智利四家公立医院对一种仅使用图像的商用超声深度学习模型进行了外部验证，用于预测分娩日期，并将该模型未经修改地应用于来自 2,550 次妊娠的 3,788 次检查的 64,235 帧图像（34% 为移民）。平均绝对误差为 6.9 天，而传统预产期为 11.6 天，然而这一增益的大部分反映的是当地更短的妊娠时长，并且相对于重新定中心的对照，差异降至不足一天。固定足月对照将每次妊娠在出生时赋予相同的孕龄，因此在任何点准确度水平上都无法对谁会早产进行排序：当结局分布集中时（如足月占主导的队列），准确度指标对管理决策所依赖的排序是盲的。在一项预设的地标分析中，该模型单独的仅图像风险评分区分早产，曲线下面积为 0.86，而单独孕龄为 0.52；在地标限制之外，它比由编码诊断加同次检查生物测量构成的临床基线高出 0.09，尽管其校准不佳。还按母亲国籍评估了误差和校准。这些分类分析是探索性的，没有女性使用该模型进行管理；它们确定了前瞻性研究应检验什么。

title: Physical Limits to AI Substitution across Physician Specialties — Implications for the Physician Workforce
zh_title: 各专科 AI 替代的物理极限与医生人力影响
summary: 基于 2023 年 Medicare Part B 约 450 亿美元、56 个专科 58.9 万名医生的申报数据，分析需要实体接触的工作占比及其对 AI 替代上限的影响。
key_points: 按是否需实体接触对申报服务分类
皮肤科、骨科等操作类专科受替代保护较强
非评估管理工作中物理性占比随培训年限上升
reason: 大样本医保索赔数据分析，提出替代上限框架；属描述性分析，非临床结局验证。
abstract: AbstractAI can already interpret medical images, draft diagnostic assessments, and converse with patients - fueling predictions that it will replace physicians. Yet software cannot physically examine, biopsy, or operate on a patient, so the share of a specialty's work that requires in-person physical interaction sets a ceiling on how much of it AI alone could replace. Analyzing 2023 Medicare Part B claims - nearly US$45 billion in payments to 589,648 physicians across 56 specialties - we classify each billed service by whether it requires physical contact, setting aside evaluation and management (E&M) visits. The share of non-E&M work that is physical, and thus protected at present from AI substitution, varies widely across specialties and increases in the length of postgraduate training: Procedural fields such as dermatology and orthopedic surgery are largely shielded. Only about one fifth of all payments go to non-E&M services with no physical barrier to AI substitution. Physicians, however, concentrate in E&M-heavy specialties - family and internal medicine - where physical protection, as we measure it, is low. The fields most accessible as career paths and most needed to relieve primary care shortages thus face the greatest uncertainty, because AI could impact their work as either a substitute or a complement - an outcome shaped as much by how AI is designed, deployed, and reimbursed as by the technology itself.
zh_abstract: 摘要 AI 已经能够解读医学图像、起草诊断评估并与患者交谈——这助长了其将取代医生的预测。然而，软件无法对患者进行体格检查、活检或手术，因此一个专科中需要面对面身体接触的工作所占比例，为 AI 单独可替代的比例设定了上限。我们分析 2023 年 Medicare Part B 索赔——向 56 个专科的 589,648 名医生支付的近 450 亿美元——按每项计费服务是否需要身体接触进行分类，并将评估与管理（E&M）就诊排除在外。非 E&M 工作中属于身体性、因而目前不受 AI 替代保护的工作占比，在不同专科间差异很大，并随毕业后培训年限增加而上升：皮肤科和骨科手术等操作性领域在很大程度上受到保护。所有支付中只有约五分之一流向没有身体接触障碍、可被 AI 替代的非 E&M 服务。然而，医生集中在 E&M 占比较高的专科——家庭医学和内科——在这些专科中，按我们的衡量，身体保护程度较低。因此，作为职业路径最容易进入、且最需要用来缓解初级保健短缺的领域面临最大不确定性，因为 AI 可能以替代或补充的方式影响它们的工作——这一结果既取决于 AI 的设计、部署和报销方式，也取决于技术本身。

title: Opposing microbiome-mediated axes link modifiable lifestyles to health and chronic diseases
zh_title: 肠道菌群介导的两条对立轴关联生活方式与疾病
summary: 基于6803名日本成人宏基因组数据，构建的菌群预测评分在13个独立队列中验证，识别出关联生活方式与15种疾病的两条对立轴。
key_points: 日本4D队列6803名成人粪便宏基因组分析
菌群预测评分在13个独立地理队列中验证
健康轴富集膳食成分代谢，疾病轴富集口腔来源菌
生活方式因素与15种疾病通过菌群轴关联
reason: 大队列加13队列外部验证，但AI方法非研究重点，证据方向偏流行病学
abstract: Fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort and microbiome-based prediction scores validated across 13 independent and geographically diverse cohorts revealed two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases. Analyses disentangling the role of the gut microbiome in linking lifestyle factors to health outcomes remain limited. Here, using fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort, we identified two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases. A health-associated axis enriched in microbial metabolism of dietary components was linked to plant-based, soy and dairy intake. In contrast, a disease-associated axis, enriched in oral-derived bacteria and pathobionts, was linked to refined carbohydrates and sedentary behavior. Starter culture microorganisms used to ferment foods did not show statistically significant mediation of the observed health effects. Alcohol was associated with both health- and disease-oriented mediation patterns involving microbial host-glycan utilization. Microbiome-defined health- and disease-oriented mediator axes were supported by fecal short-chain fatty acids and plasma cytokines from >1,700 individuals, revealing butyrate-associated anti-inflammatory and pro-inflammatory host profiles, respectively. Microbiome-based prediction (MADE) scores captured lifestyle–microbiome–disease mediation patterns and distinguished individual diseases across 13 independent external cohorts from the United States, China, Sweden, Russia and Australia. We identify the gut microbiome as a key mediator linking lifestyle to health and disease, providing a framework for microbiome-based assessment to guide lifestyle interventions for health promotion and disease prevention.
zh_abstract: 来自日本 4D 队列 6,803 名成人的粪便鸟枪法宏基因组学，以及在美国、中国、瑞典、俄罗斯和澳大利亚的 13 个独立且地理多样的队列中得到验证的基于微生物组的预测评分，揭示了将生活方式与健康和 15 种疾病联系起来的两个相反的微生物组介导轴。旨在厘清肠道微生物组在将生活方式因素与健康结局相联系中的作用的研究仍然有限。在此，我们利用来自日本 4D 队列 6,803 名成人的粪便鸟枪法宏基因组学，识别出两个相反的微生物组介导轴，将生活方式与健康和 15 种疾病联系起来。一个健康相关轴富集于膳食成分的微生物代谢，与植物性食物、大豆和乳制品摄入相关。相反，一个疾病相关轴富集口腔来源细菌和致病共生菌（pathobionts），与精制碳水化合物和久坐行为相关。用于发酵食物的发酵剂微生物未显示出对所观察健康效应的统计学显著中介作用。酒精与涉及微生物宿主聚糖利用的、既面向健康又面向疾病的中介模式均相关。由微生物组定义的健康导向和疾病导向中介轴得到来自 >1,700 名个体的粪便短链脂肪酸和血浆细胞因子的支持，分别揭示与丁酸相关的抗炎和促炎宿主特征。基于微生物组的预测（MADE）评分捕捉了生活方式–微生物组–疾病的中介模式，并在来自美国、中国、瑞典、俄罗斯和澳大利亚的 13 个独立外部队列中区分了各个疾病。我们将肠道微生物组确定为连接生活方式与健康和疾病的关键中介，为基于微生物组的评估提供了一个框架，以指导促进健康和预防疾病的生活方式干预。

title: Vibe Coding versus Clinical Reality
zh_title: 「氛围编程」与临床现实的落差
summary: NEJM AI 评论文章：AI 降低了医疗软件原型开发门槛，但要让产品安全合规地进入临床，仍离不开工程师、安全专家与监管专业能力。
key_points: 有心脏病介入医生借助 AI 工具开发患者支持应用并获奖
非工程背景的领域专家也能用 AI 将问题转化为可运行软件
从演示原型到合规临床产品仍需工程、安全与监管投入
文章提及欧盟 MDR、FDA 指南与 GDPR 隐私要求
reason: 观点评论类文章，按规则最高 6 分；仅作概念与监管讨论，无数据验证。
abstract: AbstractIn February 2026, a full-time interventional cardiologist placed third in a global coding competition with a postvisit patient support application called postvisit.ai. Many top participants had no formal engineering background but were domain experts who could describe a problem precisely enough for AI tools to translate it into working software. This process has been called "vibe coding." We discuss what it means and whether it has any relevance to clinical reality. Although AI tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building a prototype, turning a working demo into a safe, regulated product ready for clinical use still very much requires engineers, security specialists, and regulatory expertise. The EU Medical Device Regulation, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration guidance on AI in healthcare, and the privacy requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act all demand professional teams and rigorous processes that no amount of vibe coding can replace. None of this should discourage physicians from building. The natural next step is for them to move from consulting on software design to actively shaping the tools that they use, creating a new generation of physician-builders.
zh_abstract: 摘要 2026年2月，一位全职介入心脏病学家凭借一款名为 postvisit.ai 的诊后患者支持应用，在一场全球编程比赛中获得第三名。许多顶尖参赛者没有正规工程背景，但他们是领域专家，能够足够精确地描述问题，使 AI 工具将其转化为可运行的软件。这一过程被称为“vibe coding”。我们讨论其含义以及它是否与临床现实相关。尽管 AI 工具已大幅降低构建原型的门槛，但将可运行的演示转化为安全、受监管、可供临床使用的产品，仍然非常需要工程师、安全专家和监管专业知识。欧盟《医疗器械法规》（EU Medical Device Regulation）、美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）关于医疗保健中人工智能的指南，以及《通用数据保护条例》（General Data Protection Regulation）和《健康保险流通与责任法案》（Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act）的隐私要求，都要求专业团队和严格流程，而这些是再多 vibe coding 也无法替代的。这不应使医生不敢动手构建。自然的下一步是让他们从软件设计咨询转向积极塑造自己使用的工具，从而创造新一代“医生-构建者”。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Review of Research Studies and Clinical Evidence.
zh_title: 胆囊癌人工智能研究综述
