abstract: [Brain and behavior] This study aimed to develop an interpretable ClinicalBERT-based framework for mental health monitoring using structured clinical data. Because the Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring dataset contains structured patient attributes rather than free-text clinical narratives, a structured-to-text transformation module was used to convert the records into contextual descriptions suitable for ClinicalBERT. The proposed model was compared with Random Forest, XGBoost, Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT), TabTransformer, and a Deep Neural Network, and to strengthen the experimental comparison, contemporary tabular transformer models, including SAINT and FT-Transformer, were also evaluated. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Cross-validation, confidence interval analysis, statistical significance testing, and ablation experiments were conducted to examine the reliability of the results. SHAP and LIME were used to explain global feature contributions and individual predictions. ClinicalBERT achieved an accuracy of 90.2%, a precision of 90.5%, a recall of 90.4%, and an F1-score of 90.6%, outperforming all comparison models. The additional validation analyses supported the stability of the results. SHAP and LIME further identified the patient attributes that contributed most strongly to the model's predictions. The findings indicate that structured clinical records can be transformed into contextual representations for transformer-based mental health monitoring. The framework combines predictive performance with interpretable output, although its evaluation is currently limited to a single dataset. Further validation using multi-institutional and prospective data is required.
zh_abstract: 【脑与行为】本研究旨在开发一个基于 ClinicalBERT 的可解释框架，用于使用结构化临床数据进行心理健康监测。由于心理健康诊断与治疗监测数据集（Mental Health Diagnosis and Treatment Monitoring dataset）包含结构化患者属性而非自由文本临床叙述，因此使用结构化到文本转换模块将记录转换为适合 ClinicalBERT 的上下文描述。将所提出的模型与随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost、来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers, BERT）、TabTransformer 和深度神经网络（Deep Neural Network）进行比较，并且为加强实验比较，还评估了当代表格 Transformer 模型，包括 SAINT 和 FT-Transformer。使用准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数评估模型性能。进行了交叉验证、置信区间分析、统计显著性检验和消融实验，以检查结果的可靠性。使用 SHAP 和 LIME 解释全局特征贡献和个体预测。ClinicalBERT 达到 90.2% 的准确率、90.5% 的精确率、90.4% 的召回率和 90.6% 的 F1 分数，优于所有比较模型。额外的验证分析支持结果的稳定性。SHAP 和 LIME 进一步识别出对模型预测贡献最强的患者属性。研究结果表明，结构化临床记录可以转换为基于 Transformer 的心理健康监测的上下文表示。该框架将预测性能与可解释输出相结合，尽管其评估目前仅限于单一数据集。需要使用多机构和前瞻性数据进行进一步验证。

title: Can large language models improve the quality and efficiency of health policy surveillance?
zh_title: 大模型能否提升卫生政策监测质量与效率
summary: 评论文章讨论大模型在卫生政策监测各环节的潜在用途，以及需要应对的挑战。
key_points: 政策监测含界定范围、收集与编码法律数据
LLM有望提升监测效率与质量
文章同时列出尚待解决的潜在挑战
reason: 评论文章，无实证数据与新方法，属增量档
abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Legal epidemiology is a growing field wherein researchers examine the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Policy surveillance is a key part of the legal epidemiology process and leads to the creation of a legal dataset for econometric analyses. Policy surveillance includes conceptualizing the research scope, collecting legal data, and coding data to answer legal questions. Historically, policy surveillance has been slow and time-consuming, limiting timely information about the effects of health policies on health outcomes. Researchers are exploring the role of artificial intelligence using large language models (LLMs) to increase the efficiency and quality of the policy surveillance process. In this commentary, we describe potential uses of LLMs by researchers conducting policy surveillance as well as potential challenges that will need to be addressed before LLMs are widely used in the process. We also suggest areas for future research while emphasizing the need for development of guidelines for LLM use in policy surveillance.
zh_abstract: [Health affairs scholar] 法律流行病学是一个不断发展的领域，研究人员在其中考察卫生政策对健康结局的影响。政策监测是法律流行病学过程的关键部分，并促成为计量经济学分析创建法律数据集。政策监测包括构思研究范围、收集法律数据以及对数据编码以回答法律问题。历史上，政策监测一直缓慢且耗时，限制了对卫生政策影响健康结局的及时信息。研究人员正在探索使用大型语言模型（large language models，LLMs）的人工智能在提高政策监测过程效率和质量方面的作用。在本评论中，我们描述了开展政策监测的研究人员对 LLMs 的潜在用途，以及在 LLMs 广泛用于该过程之前需要解决的潜在挑战。我们还提出了未来研究领域，同时强调需要制定 LLMs 在政策监测中使用指南。

title: Generative artificial intelligence use and interpersonal educational interaction among nursing students: self-regulated learning as a statistical mediator.
zh_title: 护理学生生成式AI使用与教育互动关系
summary: 对1020名护理学生的横断面调查显示，生成式AI互动、教育互动与自主学习两两显著正相关，自主学习起统计中介作用。
key_points: 单所医科大学1020名护理学生问卷
三变量均呈显著正相关（P<0.01）
自主学习为统计中介，非因果结论
reason: 单中心横断面问卷，无对照与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is reshaping health sciences education. For nursing students, educational interaction (EI), self-regulated learning (SRL), and GAI interaction are all particularly important. However, these relationships and their processes remain underexplored. A total of 1020 nursing students were recruited from one medical university in Hunan Province in China. The Demographics Questionnaire, the Chinese version of Student-GAI interaction scale, the Educational Interaction Scale, and the Self-regulated Learning Questionnaire were administered. SPSS 22.0 and AMOS 24.0 software were used to analyze the data. The mean scores of student-GAI interaction (SGI) and EI were 14.80 ± 2.27 and 70.90 ± 8.15, respectively. Significant positive relationships were found among all three variables (all P < 0.01). Both SGI (β = 0.256) and SRL (β = 0.520) positively were associated with EI (both P < 0.001). Furthermore, SGI showed a significant direct association with EI, with a direct effect value of 0.92 (P < 0.001). SRL statistically mediated the association between SGI and EI, with a significant indirect effect value of 0.44. The mediating effect represented 32.35% of the total effect (P < 0.001). Dimension-specific analyses revealed that the mediating effect was strongest for student-teacher interaction (45.41%) and student-content interaction (41.54%). SGI is positively associated with EI among nursing students, both directly and indirectly through SRL. Educational strategies that encourage effective GAI use and strengthen SRL may be associated with enhanced EI in nursing education.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in psychology] 生成式人工智能（generative artificial intelligence, GAI）正在重塑健康科学教育。对护理学生而言，教育互动（educational interaction, EI）、自我调节学习（self-regulated learning, SRL）和GAI互动都尤为重要。然而，这些关系及其过程仍未被充分探讨。从中国湖南省一所医科大学招募了1020名护理学生。施测了人口学问卷、中文版学生-GAI互动量表、教育互动量表和自我调节学习问卷。使用SPSS 22.0和AMOS 24.0软件分析数据。学生-GAI互动（student-GAI interaction, SGI）和EI的平均得分分别为14.80 ± 2.27和70.90 ± 8.15。三个变量之间均发现显著正相关（均P < 0.01）。SGI（β = 0.256）和SRL（β = 0.520）均与EI呈正相关（均P < 0.001）。此外，SGI与EI表现出显著直接关联，直接效应值为0.92（P < 0.001）。SRL在SGI与EI的关联中起统计学中介作用，间接效应值显著为0.44。中介效应占总效应的32.35%（P < 0.001）。维度特异性分析显示，中介效应在学生-教师互动（45.41%）和学生-内容互动（41.54%）中最强。在护理学生中，SGI与EI呈正相关，既存在直接关联，也通过SRL间接关联。鼓励有效使用GAI并加强SRL的教育策略可能与护理教育中EI的提升相关。

title: Green AI for Telehealth.
zh_title: 远程医疗中的绿色AI：架构与治理议题
summary: 同行评审观点文章，讨论加拿大远程医疗中 AI 与物联网-雾-云架构的资源与环境代价。
key_points: 梳理远程监护、虚拟就诊、患者门户现状
提出绿色AI概念与资源感知架构思路
强调采购、基础设施、公平与评估维度
reason: 述评类文章，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Healthcare management forum] Telehealth is increasingly supported by connected devices, remote monitoring, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and distributed computing. These tools can extend access and support more responsive care, but their computational and environmental demands are rarely considered alongside clinical and organizational needs. We describe the current Canadian telehealth landscape, including remote care management, virtual visits, patient portals, and remote monitoring, and identify opportunities and gaps for AI integration. We then define Green AI in healthcare and explain how an IoT-fog-cloud architecture can support resource-aware telehealth. For health leaders, Green AI is not only an engineering issue. It affects procurement, infrastructure planning, workforce capacity, clinical workflow, environmental responsibility, and equity. Evaluation should consider clinical performance, resource use, organizational fit, and sustainability. Responsible AI-enabled telehealth requires more than technical performance. A Green AI perspective can help health organizations improve computational efficiency while maintaining patient safety, usable workflows, resilience, and equitable access.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare management forum] 远程医疗正日益得到联网设备、远程监测、人工智能（AI）和分布式计算的支持。这些工具可以扩大可及性并支持更具响应性的护理，但其计算和环境需求很少与临床和组织需求一并考虑。我们描述了当前加拿大远程医疗格局，包括远程护理管理、虚拟就诊、患者门户和远程监测，并识别了 AI 整合的机会和差距。然后，我们定义了医疗保健中的绿色 AI（Green AI），并解释了物联网-雾-云（IoT-fog-cloud）架构如何支持资源感知的远程医疗。对于医疗领导者而言，绿色 AI 不仅是工程问题。它影响采购、基础设施规划、劳动力能力、临床工作流程、环境责任和公平性。评估应考虑临床性能、资源使用、组织适配性和可持续性。负责任的 AI 赋能远程医疗需要的不仅是技术性能。绿色 AI 视角可以帮助医疗组织提高计算效率，同时维持患者安全、可用工作流程、韧性和公平可及。

title: Figure format and the accuracy of AI-assisted reconstruction of Kaplan-Meier survival data
zh_title: 图片格式对AI重建Kaplan-Meier生存数据准确性的影响
summary: 预印本比较矢量PDF与位图PNG输入下，语言模型重建Kaplan-Meier个体生存数据的误差差异。
key_points: 生成64组双臂模拟数据集
同一模型分别在矢量PDF与300dpi PNG下重建
以曲线误差与限制性平均生存时间误差比较
reason: 预印本方法学研究，模拟数据规模有限，结论偏工具性，属增量档
abstract: Reconstructing participant-level data from published Kaplan-Meier curves supports meta-analysis and other secondary survival analyses when original trial records are unavailable. Researchers may use original PDF figures or screenshots, which can look alike but retain different information. We assessed how converting vector figures to images affects reconstruction by a language model that can inspect files and execute code. We generated 64 independent two-arm datasets across four scenarios combining 100 or 1,000 participants per arm with proportional or crossing hazards. Each figure was supplied as a native vector PDF and a matched 300-dpi PNG to Opus 5.5 through Claude Code under the same instructions. Outcomes compared reconstructed records with the original observed records: time-averaged absolute curve error through 24 months, error in the between-group restricted mean survival time difference, and error in the Cox log-hazard ratio. Native PDFs had lower curve error in all 64 completed pairs, including replacements for incomplete runs. Mean errors were 0.000029 and 0.1047 percentage points for PDF and PNG, respectively; the paired difference was -0.1047 (95% confidence interval, -0.1194 to -0.0909). PNG errors in the restricted mean survival time difference and log-hazard ratio were small: mean absolute errors were 0.0084 months and 0.0027. Lower resolution and compression increased curve errors; embedding unchanged pixels in a PDF did not restore vector accuracy. Some PNG runs exceeded the instructed revision limit, so results describe the implemented workflow rather than performance under a strictly enforced limit. Preserving vector information improved reconstruction fidelity in this workflow, but the observed differences do not establish clinically consequential changes in treatment estimates. Validation against reported survival summaries and event counts remains necessary. Generalization to published clinical figures and other model workflows requires further evaluation.
zh_abstract: 当原始试验记录不可获得时，从已发表的Kaplan-Meier曲线重建参与者水平数据可支持荟萃分析和其他二次生存分析。研究人员可能使用原始PDF图或截图，它们看起来相似但保留的信息不同。我们评估了将矢量图转换为图像如何影响由一个可检查文件并执行代码的语言模型所进行的重建。我们在四种情景下生成了64个独立双臂数据集，这些情景组合了每臂100或1,000名参与者与比例风险或交叉风险。每张图均以原生矢量PDF和匹配的300-dpi PNG形式，在相同指令下通过Claude Code提供给Opus 5.5。结局将重建记录与原始观察记录进行比较：24个月内时间平均绝对曲线误差、组间限制性平均生存时间差异的误差，以及Cox对数风险比的误差。原生PDF在所有64个完成的配对中均具有更低的曲线误差，包括对未完成运行的替换。PDF和PNG的平均误差分别为0.000029和0.1047个百分点；配对差异为-0.1047（95%置信区间，-0.1194至-0.0909）。PNG在限制性平均生存时间差异和对数风险比方面的误差较小：平均绝对误差分别为0.0084个月和0.0027。较低分辨率和压缩增加了曲线误差；在PDF中嵌入未改变的像素并未恢复矢量准确性。一些PNG运行超出了指令规定的修订上限，因此结果描述的是实际实施的工作流程，而非在严格强制上限下的性能。在该工作流程中，保留矢量信息提高了重建保真度，但观察到的差异并不能确定治疗估计发生了具有临床意义的变化。仍有必要针对已报告的生存汇总和事件计数进行验证。推广到已发表的临床图和其他模型工作流程仍需进一步评估。

title: The Dangerous Illusion of the “Two-Week AI Expert”: A Call to Action Against Superficial Medical Education
zh_title: 批评“两周速成AI专家”式医学教育
summary: 观点文章批评医学教育以短期培训速成AI专家，呼吁在仍有条件时教授算法基础与审慎判断。
key_points: 批评两周速成AI专家的做法
强调必须教授算法基础与审视能力
警告未经审视算法可致诊断错误
reason: 观点评论，非研究，属一般性行业讨论，给4分
abstract: If we choose the quick fix, let us be honest about the consequences: when an unexamined algorithm leads to a fatal diagnostic error, the blame will not lie with the black box. It will lie with us, because we were too reckless to teach the fundamentals when we still had the chance. The post The Dangerous Illusion of the “Two-Week AI Expert”: A Call to Action Against Superficial Medical Education appeared first on MedCity News .
zh_abstract: 如果我们选择权宜之计，那就让我们坦诚面对后果：当一个未经审视的算法导致致命的诊断错误时，责任不会在那个黑箱身上。责任将落在我们身上，因为我们当初还有机会教授基础知识时却过于鲁莽。文章《“两周AI专家”的危险幻觉：呼吁反对肤浅的医学教育》首先发表于 MedCity News。

title: What Patients Say They Can't Access: Mining Cancer Screening Barriers from Online Communities
zh_title: 从在线社区挖掘癌症筛查障碍
summary: 预印本分析六个 Reddit 社区逾5.6万帖，对576条美国帖子编码归纳筛查障碍。
key_points: 数据为六个癌种 Reddit 社区超5.6万帖
流程含关键词过滤、分诊、开放编码
归纳结构性、信息性与心理社会性障碍
reason: 定性文本挖掘预印本，无模型对照评估，属增量偏上
abstract: Cancer screening disparities persist across the U.S., yet the patient-reported barriers driving low uptake remain poorly characterized at scale. While clinical surveys capture structured responses, they miss the organic, unsolicited discourse where patients candidly describe real-world obstacles. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale analysis of over 56,000 posts across six cancer-specific Reddit communities to surface barriers to cancer screening among U.S. patients. We apply a pipeline combining keyword filtering, barrier triage, open coding, and codebook synthesis to systematically extract and categorize patient-reported barriers from 576 U.S.-located posts. Our qualitative analysis reveals recurring structural, informational, and psychosocial barriers that vary meaningfully by cancer type and community context. These findings lay the groundwork for future work aimed at proactively identifying and addressing barriers at scale - spanning a broader range of cancer types and populations - and informing the design of targeted interventions, navigator programs, and health system policies that translate patient-reported obstacles into actionable solutions.
zh_abstract: 美国各地的癌症筛查差异持续存在，但导致低参与率的患者报告障碍在大规模层面仍缺乏充分刻画。虽然临床调查捕获结构化回答，却遗漏了患者坦诚描述现实世界障碍的自发、非征询式讨论。在本文中，我们对六个特定癌症的 Reddit 社区中超过 56,000 条帖子进行了大规模分析，以揭示美国患者癌症筛查的障碍。我们应用了一个结合关键词过滤、障碍分诊、开放式编码和编码簿综合的流程，从 576 条位于美国的帖子中系统提取并归类患者报告的障碍。我们的定性分析揭示了反复出现的结构性、信息性和心理社会障碍，这些障碍因癌症类型和社区背景而存在有意义的差异。这些发现为未来工作奠定了基础，旨在主动大规模识别和解决障碍——涵盖更广泛的癌症类型和人群——并为设计有针对性的干预措施、导航员项目和卫生系统政策提供信息，从而将患者报告的障碍转化为可操作的解决方案。

title: Leveraging deep generative modelling at the agent level in discrete-event simulations
zh_title: 离散事件仿真中智能体级深度生成建模
summary: arXiv预印本用条件表格GAN替代多疾病仿真中道路伤害模块，运行时间缩短86.6%。
key_points: 在Thanzi La Onse多疾病智能体仿真中验证
以条件表格GAN替换道路伤害子模型
仿真运行时间提升86.6%（自助法95%区间）
reason: 预印本方法学改进，面向卫生政策仿真，证据有限
abstract: Emulators are often invoked to facilitate parameter inference in computationally intensive agent-based simulations (ABSs). Most approaches, however, require a large sample of pre-existing outputs on which such emulators can be trained. For computationally intensive simulations, this sample can be prohibitively expensive to generate. We propose a new approach to leverage emulators at the agent level in event-based ABSs to reduce the computational requirements of the simulation itself. We demonstrate this in a computationally intensive ``multi-disease'' ABS, Thanzi La Onse, which self-consistently simulates a wide range of medical conditions in a population. By applying conditional tabular generative adversarial networks to replace the modelling of one of the simulated causes of ill health, road traffic injuries (RTIs), we are able to improve its simulation run-time by 86.6% (95% bootstrap confidence interval [85.2, 88.1]), while recovering the evolution of cause-specific mean disability adjusted life years with a 13% error, despite the low assumed incidence of fatal RTIs (~2%). Crucially, we do so while retaining the full ABS framework, and correctly recovering multi-disease dynamics. This represents a crucial step towards enabling full-model emulators for very computationally intensive simulations, and making large ABS amenable to rigorous parameter inference and a full understanding of parameter sensitivity.
zh_abstract: 仿真器（Emulators）常被用于促进计算密集的基于智能体仿真（ABSs）中的参数推断。然而，大多数方法需要大量预先存在的输出样本，以便在此类仿真器上进行训练。对于计算密集的仿真，生成该样本可能成本高昂到难以承受。我们提出一种新方法，在事件型 ABS 中于智能体层面利用仿真器，以降低仿真本身的计算需求。我们在一个计算密集的“多疾病”ABS——Thanzi La Onse 中展示了这一点；该模型自洽地模拟人群中广泛的医疗状况。通过应用条件表格生成对抗网络来替代对其中一种被模拟的健康不良原因——道路交通伤害（RTIs）——的建模，我们能够将其仿真运行时间改善 86.6%（95% bootstrap 置信区间 [85.2, 88.1]），同时以 13% 的误差恢复特定病因平均伤残调整生命年的演变，尽管假定致死性 RTIs 的发生率较低（约 2%）。关键在于，我们在做到这一点的同时保留了完整的 ABS 框架，并正确恢复了多疾病动态。这代表着朝着为计算密集度极高的仿真实现全模型仿真器、并使大型 ABS 能够进行严格参数推断和全面理解参数敏感性迈出的关键一步。

title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
zh_title: TACT-KV：医学视觉语言模型三维KV缓存压缩
summary: 预印本提出免校准的三轴离散余弦变换KV缓存压缩方法，压缩3D医学影像视觉语言模型的内存占用。
key_points: 针对3D医学影像视觉语言模型的KV缓存内存瓶颈
沿三个解剖轴施加可分离三维离散余弦变换
按层以逆注水分配频域比特预算
reason: 纯效率优化的预印本方法，条目未见临床验证或对比结果
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.
zh_abstract: 应用于3D医学扫描的视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）面临结构性内存墙。单个CT或MRI体数据会产生数万个视觉token，而由此产生的键值（KV）缓存会随批次和上下文二者线性扩展。现有KV压缩方法基于缓存的特征或token统计量进行操作，或应用一维和二维变换，从而使缓存中的三轴空间结构未被利用。我们提出TACT-KV（Tri-Axis Cosine Transform，三轴余弦变换），这是一种无需校准的KV压缩方法，利用3D扫描全部三个解剖轴方向上视觉KV状态中的强空间相关性。这种相关性在频域变换下使KV缓存能量集中。TACT-KV对KV缓存应用可分离三维离散余弦变换，通过反向注水在频率bin之间分配每层比特预算（为高能量分量分配更多比特），并用固定标量码本对每个bin进行量化。我们推导出一个闭式关系：自适应比特分配带来的失真降低主要由变换后缓存的频谱集中度主导。在六个医学VLM和两个3D CT基准上，TACT-KV在我们主要比较的十二个模型与数据集配对中的十一个上取得了最低的1比特预测翻转率。同样的优势在四个于视频任务上评估的通用VLM上得到重现，表明利用三轴结构的收益可推广到医学影像之外。在同等高带宽内存（HBM）下，TACT-KV将单GPU上的解码批次大小最多扩大至8×。

title: A Frame-Level View and Image-Quality Annotation Tool for Fetal Echocardiography: Comparison with Spreadsheet Annotation
zh_title: 胎儿超声心动图逐帧视图与质量标注工具
summary: 开发逐帧心脏切面与图像质量标注工具CAT，并与表格标注对比，随机交叉试验纳入6名医学生。
key_points: 表格标注1746个文件中6.2%存在重大录入错误
CAT每段视频标注视图段数为3.6 vs 1.5
6名医学生随机交叉各标两项正常研究
reason: 小样本工具对比研究，仅内部评测，属增量档
abstract: Objective: To develop the Cardiologist Annotation Tool (CAT) for frame-level cardiac view and image-quality annotation in fetal echocardiography and compare it with spreadsheet-based annotation. Methods: CAT provides cine playback, frame navigation, and keyboard-based labeling without manual frame-range entry. Experts annotated 25 studies using both methods, and spreadsheet annotations were audited for predefined data-entry errors. In a randomized crossover study, six medical students annotated two normal studies, one with each method, against an expert reference. Results: Among 1,746 spreadsheet-annotated files, 6.2% contained major or critical data-entry errors, more frequently in congenital heart disease than normal studies (10.9% vs 3.4%). CAT yielded more annotated view segments per clip (3.6 vs 1.5). Rates of labeled and correctly labeled frames per minute were 1.77 and 1.68 times those with spreadsheets, respectively (both P = 0.031), with gains in all six students. No detectable difference in view-label accuracy was observed. Conclusion: CAT eliminates manual frame-range entry and enables finer-grained, structured annotation of fetal echocardiography, providing a practical approach to preparing datasets for AI research.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发心脏科医师标注工具（Cardiologist Annotation Tool，CAT），用于胎儿超声心动图中心脏切面和图像质量的帧级标注，并将其与基于电子表格的标注进行比较。【方法】CAT 提供电影回放、帧导航和基于键盘的标记，无需手动输入帧范围。专家使用两种方法对 25 项研究进行标注，并针对预定义的数据录入错误对电子表格标注进行审计。在一项随机交叉研究中，六名医学生针对专家参考标准对两项正常研究进行标注，每种方法各标注一项。【结果】在 1,746 个经电子表格标注的文件中，6.2% 含有重大或严重数据录入错误，先天性心脏病研究中的发生率高于正常研究（10.9% vs 3.4%）。CAT 每个片段产生的已标注切面段更多（3.6 vs 1.5）。每分钟标注帧率和正确标注帧率分别为使用电子表格时的 1.77 倍和 1.68 倍（两者 P = 0.031），且六名学生均有所提高。未观察到切面标签准确率存在可检测差异。【结论】CAT 消除了手动帧范围输入，能够对胎儿超声心动图进行更细粒度的结构化标注，为准备 AI 研究数据集提供了一种实用方法。

title: Task-Aware Bitrate Thresholds for Codec-Robust Ultrasound Segmentation
zh_title: 面向任务码率阈值的压缩鲁棒超声分割
summary: 评估H.264、HEVC、AV1三种编解码器在前列腺超声分割上的任务感知压缩性能，给出保持分割精度的最低码率。
key_points: 以Dice与HD95而非感知保真度作为选择编解码器的依据
在相同SSIM水平下对齐各编解码器工作点以公平比较
报告均值与第5百分位Dice以暴露最坏情况退化；场景为远程超声与机器人手术
reason: 场景具体但问题较窄、仅预印本且无临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Remote robot surgery and tele-ultrasound increasingly rely on real-time streaming under strict bandwidth constraints, making lossy compression unavoidable. Since the receiving end of these clinical pipelines is increasingly a machine rather than a human observer, codec selection must be guided by downstream task accuracy rather than perceptual fidelity. We evaluate three widely deployed codecs, H.264/AVC, HEVC, and AV1, on prostate ultrasound segmentation, reporting task-aware compression performance with region overlap (Dice) and boundary accuracy (HD95) as the quality metrics. To compare codecs fairly, we match their operating points at a common perceptual-quality (SSIM) level. We establish, per codec, the lowest bitrate that preserves acceptable segmentation accuracy, reporting the 5th-percentile Dice alongside the mean to expose worst-case degradation. All three codecs preserve segmentation quality (mean Dice $\geq$ 0.84) down to approximately 0.07-0.20 bits per voxel (bpv). Below this point, AV1's accuracy declines gradually, while H.264's drops sharply. As a result, H.264 needs 82% more bitrate than AV1 to reach the same region-overlap accuracy (Dice), and 104.7% more to reach the same boundary accuracy (HD95).
zh_abstract: 远程机器人手术和远程超声越来越依赖严格带宽限制下的实时流传输，这使得有损压缩不可避免。由于这些临床流程的接收端越来越多是机器而非人类观察者，编解码器的选择必须以下游任务准确率为导向，而不是以感知保真度为导向。我们在前列腺超声分割上评估三种广泛部署的编解码器：H.264/AVC、HEVC 和 AV1，并以区域重叠度（Dice）和边界准确率（HD95）作为质量指标，报告任务感知的压缩性能。为公平比较各编解码器，我们在共同感知质量（SSIM）水平上匹配其工作点。我们针对每种编解码器确定能够保持可接受分割准确率的最低比特率，并报告第 5 百分位 Dice 及均值，以揭示最坏情况下的退化。三种编解码器在低至约 0.07-0.20 比特/体素（bpv）时均能保持分割质量（平均 Dice $\geq$ 0.84）。低于该点后，AV1 的准确率逐渐下降，而 H.264 的准确率急剧下降。因此，为达到相同的区域重叠准确率（Dice），H.264 所需比特率比 AV1 高 82%；为达到相同的边界准确率（HD95），H.264 所需比特率比 AV1 高 104.7%。

title: PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
zh_title: PINR-ESI：物理信息自监督隐式神经表示的EEG扩展源成像
summary: 预印本提出无需配对源标签或仿真监督预训练的物理信息自监督隐式神经表示框架，用于EEG源空间重建。
key_points: 以导联场矩阵约束网络，使预测EEG与实测EEG一致
将皮层电流密度建模为坐标条件化的连续场，并用经典逆解做热启动
patch积分投影把连续场映射为离散源系数用于前向建模；证据主要来自仿真
reason: 方法有新意但验证以仿真为主、无外部临床验证，属增量档
abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.
zh_abstract: EEG 扩展源成像旨在定位活跃皮层区域并表征其空间范围，然而监督式逆网络通常依赖合成的 EEG-源配对，且可能对合成到真实的失配敏感。我们提出一种物理信息自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架，用于无需配对源标签或基于仿真的监督预训练的空间源重建。导联场矩阵编码源到传感器的容积传导模型，并通过预测 EEG 与实测 EEG 之间的一致性约束 INR。皮层电流密度被建模为连续的坐标条件场。经典逆估计提供热初始化以及对源活动的空间约束，而分块集成投影将场映射为离散源系数以进行前向建模。在不同噪声水平、源数量和源范围下的仿真显示，该方法在识别活跃皮层区域方面具有最明显优势，尤其是对多个源和较大源。使用癫痫患者真实 EEG 记录和颅内刺激实验进行的定量与定性评估进一步支持了该框架用于源成像的可行性。这些发现表明，物理信息自监督 INR 在扩展源成像方面具有潜力。

summary: 瑞金医院注册400例前瞻与回顾结合的观察性研究，用EUS图像和临床特征区分胰腺囊性病变。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreatic Mucinous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Serous Cystic Neoplasm, Pancreatic Pseudocyst; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 400; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs), serous cystic neoplasms (SCNs), and pancreatic pseudocysts (PPCs) often exhibit overlapping imaging features on endoscopic ultrasound (EUS). However, these conditions require different clinical management strategies. Accurate differentiation is therefore important for appropriate treatment planning. This study aims to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI) model that integrates EUS images and clinical features to differentiate MCNs, SCNs, and PPCs. The study is designed as an ambispective observational diagnostic study consisting of retrospective model development, prospective temporal validation, and a reader study involving EUS physicians. Approximately 400 adult patients with confirmed MCN, SCN, or PPC will be included. Retrospective clinical data and EUS images will be used for model development and internal validation. After model development is completed, newly diagnosed patients will be prospectively enrolled to independently evaluate the diagnostic performance of the model. The primary outcome is the patient-level macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (macro-AUROC) for three-class classification in the prospective validation cohort. Secondary outcomes include diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, calibration, clinical net benefit, and the performance of EUS physicians with and without AI assistance. This study is expected to provide evidence for the potential clinical value of AI-assisted differentiation of pancreatic cystic lesions. No additional invasive procedures or study-specific treatments will be performed.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：瑞金医院；疾病：胰腺黏液性囊性肿瘤、胰腺浆液性囊性肿瘤、胰腺假性囊肿；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组：400；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 胰腺黏液性囊性肿瘤（MCNs）、浆液性囊性肿瘤（SCNs）和胰腺假性囊肿（PPCs）在内镜超声（EUS）上常表现出重叠的影像学特征。然而，这些疾病需要不同的临床管理策略。因此，准确鉴别对于制定适当的治疗计划很重要。本研究旨在开发并验证一种人工智能（AI）模型，该模型整合EUS图像和临床特征以鉴别MCNs、SCNs和PPCs。研究设计为双向观察性诊断研究，包括回顾性模型开发、前瞻性时间验证以及涉及EUS医师的阅片者研究。将纳入约400例确诊MCN、SCN或PPC的成年患者。回顾性临床数据和EUS图像将用于模型开发和内部验证。模型开发完成后，将前瞻性入组新诊断患者，以独立评估模型的诊断性能。主要结局是前瞻性验证队列中三分类的患者水平宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（macro-AUROC）。次要结局包括诊断准确性、敏感性、特异性、校准、临床净获益，以及EUS医师在有无AI辅助时的表现。本研究预期为AI辅助鉴别胰腺囊性病变的潜在临床价值提供证据。不会进行额外的侵入性操作或研究特异性治疗。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Dina ahmed; conditions: Dental Crowding; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 155; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] The purpose of this study is to evaluate how accurately and quickly artificial intelligence (AI) can separate individual teeth from digital dental scans of adults with dental crowding. The study will compare AI-based tooth segmentation with manual segmentation performed by experienced orthodontists. Digital dental scans from adult patients with moderate to severe dental crowding will be analyzed. The scans will be processed using two orthodontic software programs, Archform 2.6.4.1 and Blue Sky Plan V5, which use AI to automatically identify and separate individual teeth. The same scans will also be manually segmented by experienced orthodontists. The study will compare the results from the different methods by assessing whether the teeth are correctly identified and separated, the accuracy of tooth measurements, the types of segmentation errors, and the time required to complete the segmentation. The study aims to determine whether AI-based segmentation can provide accurate results while reducing the time required for digital orthodontic analysis. The findings may help improve the efficiency of digital orthodontic diagnosis and treatment planning, particularly for adults with crowded teeth.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Dina ahmed；疾病：牙列拥挤（Dental Crowding）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：155；状态：ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] 本研究旨在评估人工智能（AI）从牙列拥挤成人的数字化牙科扫描中分离单个牙齿的准确性和速度。研究将比较基于 AI 的牙齿分割与经验丰富的正畸医生进行的手动分割。将分析中度至重度牙列拥挤成年患者的数字化牙科扫描。这些扫描将使用两个正畸软件程序 Archform 2.6.4.1 和 Blue Sky Plan V5 进行处理，这两个程序使用 AI 自动识别并分离单个牙齿。相同的扫描也将由经验丰富的正畸医生手动分割。研究将通过评估牙齿是否被正确识别和分离、牙齿测量的准确性、分割错误类型以及完成分割所需时间，来比较不同方法的结果。本研究旨在确定基于 AI 的分割是否能够在减少数字化正畸分析所需时间的同时提供准确结果。研究结果可能有助于提高数字化正畸诊断和治疗计划的效率，特别是对于牙列拥挤的成人。

abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis explains the histological pattern of injury seen through light microscopy in kidney biopsy specimens and is the end result of different injuries to podocytes. The clinical classification of patients by FSGS lesion is challenging because of a broad spectrum of etiologies, limited understanding of pathophysiology, and poor correlation among histopathology, treatment response, and clinical outcomes. Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis is a problematic process to detect lesions, with low and late analysis of the absence of initial symptoms, and a challenging position of specific markers. However, Histopathological and genomic Data in Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) are significantly used in multiple research applications, but they face several limitations that restrict the efficiency of experimental analysis. This review systematically analyzed recent enhancements in biopsy-based analysis and deep learning models for FSGS, with specific emphasis on different mechanisms. Moreover, this review analyzed different strategies, namely kidney transplantation, pathogenesis to therapeutic approaches, transformer-based architectures, glomerular segmentation methodologies, multitasking strategy classification, and gene expression analysis for FSGS. This review analysis includes 121 research papers, which are selected and analyzed for glomerular segmentation, gene expression, clinical outcomes, lesion classification, and disease recurrence prediction. Based on the recent research frameworks, it explicitly states the performance analysis, benefits, as well as challenges of FSGS. The article presents details of a new dataset and future directions for improving the majority of nephropathology diagnoses previously available through the use of integrated approaches that utilize both histopathology and genomics, enhancing future research direction in FSGS.
zh_abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] 局灶节段性肾小球硬化（focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, FSGS）解释了肾活检标本中经光学显微镜观察到的组织学损伤模式，并且是足细胞受到不同损伤后的最终结果。根据FSGS病变对患者进行临床分类具有挑战性，原因包括病因谱广泛、对病理生理学的理解有限，以及组织病理学、治疗反应和临床结局之间相关性较差。局灶节段性肾小球硬化是一个检测病变存在问题的过程，由于缺乏初期症状，其分析率低且分析较晚，并且特异性标志物处于具有挑战性的位置。然而，局灶节段性肾小球硬化（FSGS）中的组织病理学和基因组学数据被大量用于多种研究应用，但它们面临若干限制，制约了实验分析的效率。本综述系统分析了基于活检的分析和用于FSGS的深度学习模型的最新进展，特别强调不同机制。此外，本综述分析了不同策略，即肾移植、从发病机制到治疗方法、基于Transformer的架构、肾小球分割方法、多任务策略分类以及FSGS的基因表达分析。本综述分析纳入121篇研究论文，这些论文被选择并分析用于肾小球分割、基因表达、临床结局、病变分类和疾病复发预测。基于近期研究框架，本文明确阐述了FSGS的性能分析、优势以及挑战。本文详细介绍了一个新数据集，并提出了未来方向，以改进此前通过同时利用组织病理学和基因组学的整合方法所能获得的多数肾脏病理诊断，从而增强FSGS的未来研究方向。

title: Vibrational spectroscopy and artificial intelligence for dynamic phenotypic characterization of antimicrobial resistance.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
zh_title: 振动光谱结合AI用于耐药表型快速表征
summary: 同行评审综述，讨论振动光谱结合机器学习用于细菌分类与耐药表型快速预测的潜力与现有局限。
key_points: 振动光谱提供无标记生化指纹用于细菌分型

常规药敏试验周转时间长、生理分辨率有限
reason: 综述性文章，无具体数据或验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] The rapid emergence of antimicrobial resistance has created an urgent need for diagnostic technologies capable of rapidly identifying resistant phenotypes and informing precision antimicrobial therapy. Conventional antimicrobial susceptibility testing methods remain clinically reliable; however, they are limited by relatively long turnaround times and restricted physiological resolution. In recent years, vibrational spectroscopy techniques have emerged as promising platforms for rapid phenotypic microbiology because they generate label-free biochemical fingerprints associated with proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and membrane biomolecules. When integrated with machine learning and artificial intelligence, these technologies could provide highly sensitive tools for rapid bacterial classification, resistance prediction, and monitoring of dynamic physiological adaptation during antibiotic exposure. This review discusses the integration of chemometrics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms with spectroscopic datasets, emphasizing both predictive performance and biological interpretability. It is highly useful for bacterial identification, biochemical characterization, and resistance profiling across multiple microbial species. Major controversies regarding genotype-versus-phenotype diagnostics, reproducibility, standardization, and AI explainability are also examined. Finally, we highlight current research gaps and future directions, including single-cell spectroscopy, multimodal phenotyping, explainable AI frameworks, and approaches in systems microbiology. Taken together, the available evidence indicates that integrating vibrational spectroscopy with artificial intelligence could substantially reshape future antimicrobial resistance diagnostics and mechanistic microbiology.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] 抗菌药物耐药性的迅速出现，催生了对能够快速识别耐药表型并为精准抗菌治疗提供信息的诊断技术的迫切需求。传统抗菌药物敏感性试验方法在临床上仍然可靠；然而，它们受到相对较长的周转时间和有限的生理学分辨率的限制。近年来，振动光谱技术已成为快速表型微生物学的有前景平台，因为它们可产生与蛋白质、脂质、核酸、碳水化合物和膜生物分子相关的无标记生化指纹。当与机器学习和人工智能整合时，这些技术可提供高度敏感的工具，用于快速细菌分类、耐药性预测以及监测抗生素暴露期间的动态生理适应。本综述讨论了化学计量学、机器学习和深度学习算法与光谱数据集的整合，强调预测性能和生物学可解释性。它对于跨多种微生物物种的细菌鉴定、生化表征和耐药谱分析非常有用。本文还审视了关于基因型与表型诊断、可重复性、标准化和AI可解释性的主要争议。最后，我们强调了当前研究空白和未来方向，包括单细胞光谱学、多模态表型分析、可解释AI框架以及系统微生物学方法。综上所述，现有证据表明，将振动光谱与人工智能整合可能显著重塑未来的抗菌药物耐药性诊断和机制微生物学。

key_points: 两队列合计179例，样本量小

reason: 预印本、单中心小样本、无外部验证与临床结局影响，属增量档
abstract: Predicting the progression of COVID-19 in hospitalised patients was an important challenge during the pandemic, particularly when healthcare resources were limited. This study investigates the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to predict three clinical outcomes: death, admission to the intensive care unit (ICU), and clinical status (improvement or worsening). The study uses two patient datasets: an Algerian cohort of 80 patients from the Internal Medicine Department of the University Hospital Centre of Constantine, collected between July and August 2020, and a French cohort of 99 patients collected between March and May 2020. Five ML classifiers were evaluated: logistic regression (LR), k-nearest neighbours (KNN), classification and regression trees (CART), Naive Bayes (NB), and support vector machines (SVM). Their performance was examined in combination with three feature-selection methods: analysis of variance (ANOVA), mutual information (MI), and recursive feature elimination (RFE). The results were also compared with multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using one to five hidden layers. Model evaluation included 30 repetitions of five-fold cross-validation on the training data, followed by evaluation on a separate hold-out test set. The results showed that selecting 20 features generally provided better cross-validated accuracy than selecting 30 features or using the full feature set. The best-performing classifier-feature-selection combination varied across the six dataset-outcome tasks. LR combined with RFE was selected for three tasks, LR combined with ANOVA for one task, and CART combined with ANOVA for two tasks. The selected ML models achieved test-set accuracies ranging from 0.47 to 0.95 and higher accuracy than the average MLP results in five of the six tasks. These findings suggest that ML methods can be useful for exploring clinical outcomes in hospitalised COVID-19 patients. However, the small sample sizes and limitations of the available data mean that the results should be interpreted with caution. Further evaluation using larger and independent patient datasets is needed before these models can be considered for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 预测住院COVID-19患者的疾病进展是大流行期间的一项重要挑战，尤其是在医疗资源有限时。本研究探讨使用机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型预测三项临床结局：死亡、入住重症监护病房（ICU）以及临床状态（改善或恶化）。研究使用两个患者数据集：一个阿尔及利亚队列，来自君士坦丁大学医院中心内科的80名患者，收集于2020年7月至8月；以及一个法国队列，99名患者，收集于2020年3月至5月。评估了五种ML分类器：逻辑回归（LR）、k近邻（KNN）、分类与回归树（CART）、朴素贝叶斯（NB）和支持向量机（SVM）。将其性能与三种特征选择方法结合进行检查：方差分析（ANOVA）、互信息（MI）和递归特征消除（RFE）。结果还与使用1至5个隐藏层的多层感知机（MLP）模型进行比较。模型评估包括在训练数据上进行30次重复的五折交叉验证，随后在单独的留出测试集上评估。结果显示，选择20个特征通常比选择30个特征或使用完整特征集提供更好的交叉验证准确率。表现最佳的分类器-特征选择组合在六项数据集-结局任务中各不相同。LR联合RFE被选用于三项任务，LR联合ANOVA用于一项任务，CART联合ANOVA用于两项任务。所选ML模型在测试集上的准确率范围为0.47至0.95，并且在六项任务中的五项中准确率高于MLP的平均结果。这些发现表明，ML方法可用于探索住院COVID-19患者的临床结局。然而，样本量小和可用数据的局限性意味着应谨慎解释结果。在将这些模型考虑用于临床之前，需要使用更大且独立的患者数据集进行进一步评估。

key_points: 组合手工特征与CNN特征

abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. Code: https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection
zh_abstract: 医学影像学的最新创新显著改善了脑肿瘤识别，超越了传统诊断方法，后者存在分辨率低、辐射暴露和对比度有限的问题。磁共振成像（MRI）因其高分辨率、无创的特性，在精确和准确的肿瘤表征中至关重要。本研究探讨多种特征表示方案的协同作用，如局部二值模式（LBP）、Gabor滤波器、离散小波变换、快速傅里叶变换、卷积神经网络（CNN）和灰度游程长度矩阵，以及五种学习算法，即：k近邻、随机森林、支持向量分类器（SVC）、概率神经网络（PNN）和CNN。实证结果表明，LBP与SVC和CNN结合获得了高特异性和准确性，使其成为基于MRI的肿瘤诊断的一种有前景的方法。为进一步研究LBP的贡献，使用卡方和p值检验的统计分析来确认LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别的显著影响。此外，SHAP分析用于识别分类中最重要的特征。在小数据集中，CNN获得了97.8%的准确率，而SVC产生了98.06%的准确率。在随后的分析中，还使用了一个大型基准数据集来评估学习算法的性能，以研究所提出模型的泛化能力。CNN达到了最高的98.9%准确率，其次是SVC的96.7%。这些结果突显了CNN在自动化、高精度肿瘤诊断中的有效性。代码：https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection

abstract: [JAMA network open] Although external validation of machine learning (ML)-based delirium risk models is a key stage in the model development pipeline, few published reports exist. Moreover, ML-based delirium risk models commonly degrade in performance during external validation. To examine the performance of a fusion multimodal with natural language processing (NLP) delirium risk stratification model in live clinical practice with cross-hospital external validation. This quality improvement study evaluated live clinical deployment of the model among patients 60 years or older who were admitted to non-intensive care units at Mount Sinai Hospital (MSH), with external validation performed at Mount Sinai Morningside Hospital (MSM), from December 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. Primary outcomes were performance of the risk stratification model, assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and monthly delirium detection rates. A 2 × 2 confusion matrix was created, and the 4 cells were used to calculate model performance metrics and compare associated diagnostic yield between premodel deployment and active model deployment periods. The overall sample included 33 095 admissions to non-intensive care units at MSM and MSH (mean [SD] age, 74.86 (9.22) years; 15 601 women [47.1%], 17 271 men [52.2%]). A total of 9020 MSM inpatient admissions were assigned a delirium risk score by the risk stratification model during live clinical operations and were compared to 21 186 MSH inpatient admissions that were assigned a risk score by the same model. Age at admission significantly differed between patients at MSM and MSH (MSM: median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years vs MSH: 72.62 [66.64-79.65] years; P < .001). Patients from MSM and MSH also significantly differed by sex, race and ethnicity, surgical vs medical primary diagnosis, length of stay, and dementia prevalence rate. Among 11 909 MSM patients, patients in the pre-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 78.00 [71.00-85.00] years) were significantly older than those in the post-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years) (P < .001). The AUROC of the model was 0.91 (95% CI, 0.90-0.92) for MSM and 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.94) for MSH. The positive predictive value of the model was 25.9% for MSM and 19.4% for MSH. For MSM, the mean monthly delirium detection rate significantly increased from 9.23% (95% CI, 8.07%-10.38%) to 19.59% (95% CI, 17.32%-21.85%) after model deployment (P < .001). abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.
zh_abstract: [JAMA network open] 生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人越来越多地用于支持孕产妇健康，但随机对照证据有限。评估获取生成式AI孕产妇健康聊天机器人是否改善了12个月孕产妇健康结局。这项两组随机临床试验于2023年10月至2024年12月纳入400名参与者，12个月随访于2025年12月完成。参与者通过线上方式在美国49个州和哥伦比亚特区招募。符合条件的参与者为说英语、年龄14岁或以上、怀孕或正在养育小于6个月婴儿，并自我认同为种族和/或族裔少数群体成员。参与者按1:1随机分配接受该聊天机器人访问权，或接受由每月儿童书籍构成的主动对照。主要结局为12个月时使用广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7（Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7）和患者健康问卷-9（Patient Health Questionnaire-9）测量的焦虑和抑郁症状。次要结局包括急诊就诊、妊娠相关并发症、产后保健检查、有效避孕使用和睡眠时长。在400名随机参与者中，平均（SD）年龄为32.6（5.1）岁；200名（50%）在入组时正在养育婴儿；10名（2%）自我认同为美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民，80名（20%）为亚裔，188名（47%）为黑人或非裔美国人，57名（14%）为多种族，65名（16%）为西班牙裔或拉丁裔。AI聊天机器人与焦虑评分（调整后平均差，0.10；95% CI，-0.77至0.96）或抑郁评分（调整后平均差，-0.23；95% CI，-1.05至0.59）的差异无关，也与急诊就诊、产后保健、避孕使用或睡眠时长无关。在入组时怀孕的参与者中，该聊天机器人在12个月次要终点分析中与更多自我报告的妊娠相关并发症相关，但在纵向分析中不相关。在探索性组内分析中，较高的聊天机器人参与度与更长的睡眠时长和更高的焦虑评分相关。在这项针对种族和族裔少数群体孕妇和产后个体的随机临床试验中，与主动对照相比，获取生成式人工智能孕产妇健康聊天机器人未改善12个月时的孕产妇焦虑或抑郁。次要和探索性发现应谨慎解读。ClinicalTrials.gov 标识符：NCT06053515。

title: Cross-paradigm audit of large language model judges for clinical text evaluation
zh_title: 临床文本评估中大模型裁判的跨范式审计
summary: 在四个德语临床数据集上，审计六款开放权重模型作为裁判与专家评分的一致性及失败模式。
key_points: 四个德语临床数据集、三种评估范式
无任何配置在各范式下均可靠
替代专家组改变57.2%评分类别
reason: 方法学审计有新意但非临床结局验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用汇总的一致性指标，掩盖了具有临床相关性的失效模式。本研究以专家评判者为参照，审计了六个开放权重模型在四个德语临床数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖报告和护理记录摘要、出院摘要生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因标准和语料而异，且没有任何配置在所有范式中均被证明可靠。所有评判者均表现出位置偏倚和身份偏倚。用LLM作为评判者替代专家小组后，57.2%的逐点类别发生偏移，41.7%的成对胜者被调换，10.2%的临床错误被漏检，并通过高估“简洁”和“准确”标准而颠倒了临床优先次序。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM作为评判者并非专家的安全替代品，部署阈值应遵循针对临床情境中LLM作为评判者的决策影响分析。

title: A multimodal tool-augmented agent for evidence-based clinical decision support in longitudinal AMD follow-up
zh_title: AMD随访多模态工具增强临床决策智能体
summary: 研究开发AMDagent，整合定量影像分析与指南检索，为AMD纵向随访提供有证据归属的结构化决策支持。
key_points: 面向年龄相关性黄斑变性纵向随访
整合纵向视网膜影像定量分析
结合指南检索生成可审计决策支持
reason: 新方法系统，摘要未提外部验证，值得一看
abstract: Clinical management of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires longitudinal decisions on disease activity, treatment response, and anti-VEGF injection intervals. These decisions depend on integrating multimodal retinal imaging findings across visits, yet manual synthesis is time-consuming and may omit relevant information, limiting transparency and consistency in follow-up planning. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored to summarize longitudinal AMD information, but existing approaches may lack explicit quantitative grounding and evidence attribution, reducing their auditability in clinical decision support. To address these limitations, we developed AMDagent, an evidence-grounded clinical agent that integrates quantitative imaging analysis with guideline retrieval to generate structured, clinician-facing decision-support outputs. The system links longitudinal imaging findings to actionable management considerations while preserving traceable evidence sources. In a 20-case proof-of-concept evaluation of curated longitudinal AMD cases, AMDagent was rated clinically appropriate in 92.0% of predefined decision-support units under expert adjudication. In addition, 83.3% of audited major clinical claims were explicitly grounded in tool-derived quantitative measurements and/or retrieved guideline evidence, enabling clinician verification. These preliminary findings suggest that evidence-grounded, clinician-facing agents may support more transparent and auditable longitudinal AMD decision support, although larger prospective multi-center studies are needed to assess generalizability and clinical utility.
zh_abstract: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的临床管理需要对疾病活动性、治疗反应和抗VEGF注射间隔作出纵向决策。这些决策依赖于整合跨访视的多模态视网膜影像发现，但人工综合耗时，且可能遗漏相关信息，从而限制随访计划的透明性和一致性。大语言模型（LLMs）已被探索用于总结纵向AMD信息，但现有方法可能缺乏明确的定量依据和证据归属，从而降低其在临床决策支持中的可审计性。为解决这些局限，我们开发了 AMDagent，这是一种以证据为基础的临床智能体，将定量影像分析与指南检索相结合，以生成结构化的、面向临床医生的决策支持输出。该系统将纵向影像发现与可执行的管理考量联系起来，同时保留可追溯的证据来源。在针对精选纵向AMD病例的20例概念验证评估中，在专家裁定下，AMDagent 在预定义决策支持单元中有92.0%被评为临床适当。此外，在经审计的主要临床主张中，83.3%明确基于工具得出的定量测量和/或检索到的指南证据，从而使临床医生能够核验。这些初步发现表明，以证据为基础、面向临床医生的智能体可能支持更透明、更可审计的纵向AMD决策支持，但仍需要更大规模的前瞻性多中心研究来评估其可推广性和临床实用性。

title: A multi-guideline clinical agent for vascular surgery: architecture, implementation, and benchmark evaluation.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 面向血管外科的多指南临床智能体
summary: 基于14部ESVS指南构建指南锁定式临床智能体，用55个病例情景做自动化基准评测。
key_points: 整合14部ESVS指南约1100页全文
指南路由与上下文门控抑制幻觉
55个情景、双盲LLM评判共330次评分
reason: 同行评审、架构有新意且有基准对比，但仅小样本情景评测、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.
zh_abstract: [《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》] 欧洲血管外科学会（ESVS）发布的临床实践指南（CPGs）篇幅约 1100 页，在诊疗现场同时进行交叉查阅并不现实。未加约束的大语言模型（LLMs）存在幻觉风险，这促使研究者采用锁定于指南语料的设计。我们介绍一个覆盖 ESVS 全部 14 部 CPG 语料的上下文感知临床代理的架构与开发过程。该系统在已验证的单指南 GraphRAG 原型基础上进行了扩展，加入了由 LLM 驱动的指南路由器（Guideline Router）、内嵌的上下文闸门（Context Gate；当缺少决策关键参数时不进行检索）、双通道检索，以及在强制引用模板下由 GPT-5 进行综合。一项自动化基准在 55 个情景案例（vignettes）上评估最终系统，由 2 名盲法 LLM 评审员评阅 3 轮（共 330 次判定），并对每一条被标记的论断由临床医生裁定。系统始终限定在其锁定的语料库范围内，拒绝了所有超出范围的查询，指南路由召回率达到 98.4%。对于表述不充分的查询，上下文闸门的特异度（specificity）为 91.9%、灵敏度（sensitivity）为 78.6%，且全部 259 条被引用的推荐意见均可在锁定语料库内核实。在敏感筛查定义下，自动评审员在 18.2% 的条目中标记出缺乏支持的论断；经 2 名血管外科医生裁定，7.3% 的条目含有具有临床后果的错误，但无一例被评定为可能造成伤害。完整答案的临床可接受性未予评分，留待前瞻性专家评估。这些结果支持用于血管外科的多指南上下文感知临床代理的可行性；引用可追溯性与锁定语料的来源溯源有助于未来的可审计性。

title: Artificial intelligence for the detection of large vessel occlusion stroke and workflow optimization: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI检测大血管闭塞卒中及流程优化Meta分析
summary: Meta分析13项观察性研究，评估AI辅助大血管闭塞卒中检测对流程与结局的影响。
key_points: 纳入13项观察性研究，采用随机效应模型
关注溶栓率、穿刺时间、再灌注与90天功能独立
AI实施与流程及治疗指标改善相关
reason: 系统综述/Meta分析纳入13项研究并报告流程与临床结局，属重要档
abstract: [Journal of neurosurgical sciences] To evaluate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) tools on workflow efficiency, treatment times, and clinical outcomes in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke. We included observational studies that assessed the implementation of AI-based tools in the management of patients with suspected or confirmed LVO stroke. Eligible studies reported workflow, treatment, safety, or functional outcomes. Data were extracted on thrombolysis rates, CTA-to-arterial puncture time, door-to-puncture time, endovascular treatment (EVT) access, reperfusion success, symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (sICH), mortality, and functional independence (mRS 0-2) at 90 days. Random-effects models were applied to calculate pooled mean differences (MD) or risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Thirteen studies were included. AI implementation significantly reduced workflow delays: CTA-to-puncture time decreased by -40.20 minutes (95% CI -66.41 to -13.99; P<0.01) and door-to-puncture time by -23.17 minutes (95% CI -38.71 to -7.63; P<0.01). Thrombolysis administration showed no difference (RR 0.79; 95% CI 0.57-1.09; P=0.15). Similarly, no significant effects were observed for EVT access (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.66-1.44; P=0.89), reperfusion success (RR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00-1.12; P=0.06), sICH (RR 0.63; 95% CI 0.30-1.35; P=0.23), or mortality (RR 0.72; 95% CI 0.38-1.37; P=0.32). However, AI-based workflows significantly improved functional independence at 90 days (RR 1.55; 95% CI 1.12-2.15; P=0.008). AI tools significantly improve treatment times and functional independence in acute LVO stroke without increasing adverse events.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neurosurgical sciences] 旨在评估人工智能（AI）工具对大血管闭塞（LVO）卒中患者工作流程效率、治疗时间和临床结局的影响。我们纳入了评估在疑似或确诊LVO卒中患者管理中应用基于AI工具的观察性研究。符合条件的研究报告了工作流程、治疗、安全性或功能结局。提取的数据包括溶栓率、CTA至动脉穿刺时间、入院至穿刺时间、血管内治疗（EVT）可及性、再灌注成功、症状性颅内出血（sICH）、死亡率和90天功能独立（mRS 0-2）。采用随机效应模型计算合并均数差（MD）或风险比（RR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。共纳入13项研究。实施AI显著减少了工作流程延迟：CTA至穿刺时间缩短-40.20分钟（95% CI -66.41至-13.99；P<0.01），入院至穿刺时间缩短-23.17分钟（95% CI -38.71至-7.63；P<0.01）。溶栓实施无差异（RR 0.79；95% CI 0.57-1.09；P=0.15）。同样，在EVT可及性（RR 0.97；95% CI 0.66-1.44；P=0.89）、再灌注成功（RR 1.06；95% CI 1.00-1.12；P=0.06）、sICH（RR 0.63；95% CI 0.30-1.35；P=0.23）或死亡率（RR 0.72；95% CI 0.38-1.37；P=0.32）方面未观察到显著影响。然而，基于AI的工作流程显著改善了90天功能独立（RR 1.55；95% CI 1.12-2.15；P=0.008）。AI工具显著改善了急性LVO卒中的治疗时间和功能独立，且未增加不良事件。

title: All-Atom Structure Tokenizer: AtomLM-9b for Biomolecular Structure Prediction
zh_title: AtomLM-9b：全原子结构分词与结构预测
summary: 预印本发布全原子结构分词器并训练9B自回归模型AtomLM-9b，作者称其蛋白结构预测性能可与AlphaFold 3相比。
key_points: 化学单元压缩为8192个共享结构token
CASP14/CASP15全原子lDDT为0.832和0.835
基于Qwen3.5-9B，从分子序列与连接关系预测结构token
reason: 大规模结构语言模型并在CASP、FoldBench基准上与AF3比较，方法新颖，但为未经同行评审的预印本
abstract: We develop an All-atom Structure Tokenizer that compresses biomolecular geometry into discrete structural tokens and achieves high-accuracy all-atom reconstruction. A hierarchical geometric encoder and finite scalar quantization map chemical units to a shared vocabulary of 8,192 tokens, while a joint coordinate de-tokenizer reconstructs backbone, side-chain, nucleic-acid, and ligand heavy atoms. The tokenizer achieves all-atom lDDT scores of 0.832 and 0.835 on CASP14 and CASP15, respectively. Building on this tokenizer, we train AtomLM-9b, an autoregressive language model based on Qwen3.5-9B that predicts structural tokens from molecular identities and connectivity and decodes them into complete atomic structures. We demonstrate, for the first time, protein structure prediction performance comparable to AlphaFold 3 with an all-atom-tokenizer-based structural language model: on the FoldBench protein-protein task, AtomLM-9b achieves a success rate of 75.01%, compared with the published AlphaFold 3 result of 72.93%. These results establish discrete all-atom tokenization as an effective interface between high-fidelity atomic reconstruction and language-model-based structure prediction.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了全原子结构分词器（All-atom Structure Tokenizer），可将生物分子几何结构压缩为离散结构标记，并实现高精度全原子重建。分层几何编码器和有限标量量化将化学单元映射到包含8,192个标记的共享词表，而联合坐标去分词器重建主链、侧链、核酸和配体重原子。该分词器在CASP14和CASP15上的全原子lDDT分数分别为0.832和0.835。基于该分词器，我们训练了AtomLM-9b，这是一种基于Qwen3.5-9B的自回归语言模型，可从分子身份和连接性预测结构标记，并将其解码为完整原子结构。我们首次展示了使用基于全原子分词器的结构语言模型获得与AlphaFold 3相当的蛋白质结构预测性能：在FoldBench蛋白质-蛋白质任务上，AtomLM-9b的成功率为75.01%，而已发表的AlphaFold 3结果为72.93%。这些结果确立了离散全原子分词作为高保真原子重建与基于语言模型的结构预测之间的有效接口。
