abstract: [Southern medical journal] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used increasingly to support clinical care and documentation in health care, including patient rehabilitation. AI is used to increase efficiency, facilitate information transfer, and improve accuracy and consistency in assessment and treatment of medical conditions. AI can assist clinicians in correlating symptoms, tracking patient progress, and recommending evidence-based treatment protocols. This article first provides perspectives on the role of AI in managing lateral epicondylosis. It then embarks on a preliminary study that compares expert opinions with AI recommendations for evaluation and treatment and provides insight into how patient expectations are influenced by AI searches in comparison to clinician recommendations. Although AI offers the potential of valuable support, clinicians remain responsible for final decisions to ensure optimal patient outcomes. The role of AI continues to evolve in clinical practice. It holds promise for advancing standards in the nonoperative management of lateral epicondylosis with the caveat that clinicians-human beings-have the ultimate responsibility and accountability for appropriate application and decision making to thoughtfully care for patients and improve treatment outcomes.
zh_abstract: [《南方医学杂志》（Southern medical journal）] 人工智能（AI）越来越多地用于支持医疗保健中的临床诊疗和文书记录，包括患者康复。AI被用于提高效率、促进信息传递，并提高对医疗状况评估和治疗的准确性和一致性。AI可协助临床医生关联症状、追踪患者进展并推荐循证治疗方案。本文首先提供关于AI在管理肱骨外上髁炎中作用的观点。随后开展一项初步研究，比较专家意见与AI在评估和治疗方面的建议，并深入探讨与临床医生建议相比，AI搜索如何影响患者期望。尽管AI提供了有价值的支持潜力，临床医生仍负责最终决策以确保最佳患者结局。AI在临床实践中的作用持续演变。它有望推进肱骨外上髁炎非手术治疗的标准，但需注意：临床医生——人类——对适当应用和决策负有最终责任和问责，以深思熟虑地照护患者并改善治疗结局。

title: Enhancing medical image segmentation with HCE-Net: A heterogeneous feature collaborative extraction network.
zh_title: HCE-Net：异构特征协同提取的医学图像分割网络
summary: 提出双路径异构编码网络HCE-Net，用正交融合模块结合Sobel边缘先验，提升医学图像分割精度。
key_points: 采用双路径异构编码，并行提取互补特征
正交融合模块结合Sobel边缘先验与多尺度卷积
论文称可改善上下文建模与轮廓分割精度
reason: 方法类回顾性研究，未见外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [PloS one] Medical image segmentation occupies a pivotal role in clinical diagnosis and therapeutic planning. Conventional segmentation techniques struggle to accommodate the intricate representational attributes of medical images, while prevailing deep learning segmentation models predominantly adopt homogeneous single encoders and linear feature fusion paradigms, thereby exhibiting inherent limitations in contextual modeling, fine-grained feature excavation, and contour segmentation accuracy. To address such dilemmas, this paper proposes a Heterogeneous Collaborative Feature Extraction Network (HCE-Net). Establishing a dual-path heterogeneous encoding architecture, this network excavates complementary feature representations in a parallel manner. An Orthogonal Fusion Module (OFM) is elaborately devised to integrate Sobel edge priors with multi-scale convolutions, enabling the precise capture of edge and contour characteristics. A Diversified Receptive Field Module (DFM) is constructed to consolidate multi-scale detail manifestations and preserve global contextual cues. Furthermore, Adaptive Aggregation Connection (AAC) is embedded within skip connection branches to supplant conventional simplistic concatenation, efficaciously mitigating the technical bottleneck of heterogeneous feature fusion. Comparative experiments conducted on three publicly accessible medical datasets, encompassing dental radiographs, pulmonary CT scans, and retinal vascular images, demonstrate that HCE-Net substantially elevates segmentation accuracy, enhances boundary integrity, and ameliorates the general robustness of the model. It manifests distinguished application prospects across diverse medical image segmentation scenarios.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 医学图像分割在临床诊断和治疗规划中占据关键地位。传统分割技术难以适应医学图像复杂的表征属性，而主流深度学习分割模型大多采用同质单一编码器和线性特征融合范式，因而在上下文建模、细粒度特征挖掘和轮廓分割准确性方面表现出固有局限。为解决这些困境，本文提出一种异质协同特征提取网络（HCE-Net）。该网络建立双路径异质编码架构，以并行方式挖掘互补的特征表示。精心设计正交融合模块（OFM），将Sobel边缘先验与多尺度卷积相整合，从而能够精确捕获边缘和轮廓特征。构建多样化感受野模块（DFM），以整合多尺度细节表现并保留全局上下文线索。此外，在跳跃连接分支中嵌入自适应聚合连接（AAC），以取代传统简单拼接，有效缓解异质特征融合的技术瓶颈。在三个公开可访问的医学数据集（涵盖牙科X线片、肺部CT扫描和视网膜血管图像）上进行的对比实验表明，HCE-Net 显著提升分割准确性、增强边界完整性并改善模型的整体稳健性。它在多种医学图像分割场景中展现出突出的应用前景。

title: Mammography datasets and artificial intelligence for breast cancer detection: challenges, bias, and future directions.
zh_title: 乳腺钼靶数据集与AI检测的挑战与偏倚综述
summary: 该综述从数据角度系统比较公开乳腺钼靶数据集的特征，分析其对AI模型开发、性能与临床泛化能力的影响。
key_points: 聚焦公开钼靶数据集特征与数据偏倚
讨论数据对临床泛化性的影响
提出未来方向，未报告原始实验
reason: 同行评审综述，主题有信息量，但无新实验，综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Breast cancer is still one of the main causes of death in women from cancer worldwide, and early detection is crucial. Mammography is the primary imaging modality for breast cancer screening and recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly enhanced automated breast cancer detection. This review takes a data-centered approach, examining key characteristics of public datasets, the contributions of mammography data to AI for breast cancer detection, and the implications for clinical generalizability. This review, however, takes a data-centered approach, critically analyzing characteristics of publicly available mammography datasets, and the role of mammography data to the development, performance and clinical generalization of AI models for the detection of breast cancer. The datasets are compared on the following aspects: dataset size, quality of the annotations, imaging modality, clinical metadata, dataset accessibility and demographic diversity. Analysis reveals that the quality, diversity and representativeness of the data used are critical for the performance and generalizability of AI models, ranging from the traditional machine learning era to the current era of deep learning, transformer-based systems, multimodal learning, explainable AI and privacy-preserving learning. The results show that, apart from the development of AI model architectures, it is a necessity to have standardized, diverse and clinically representative datasets to make further progress in AI-assisted mammography. The review emphasizes the importance of establishing a comprehensive benchmark dataset for mammography that is large and diverse to enhance reproducibility, to fairly evaluate models, and to develop strong, clinically viable AI systems for breast cancer detection.
zh_abstract: ［Frontiers in artificial intelligence］乳腺癌仍是全球女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，早期发现至关重要。乳腺X线摄影（mammography）是乳腺癌筛查的主要影像学方法，人工智能（AI）的最新进展显著增强了自动化乳腺癌检测。本综述采取以数据为中心的方法，考察公开数据集的关键特征、乳腺X线摄影数据对乳腺癌检测AI的贡献，以及对临床可推广性的启示。然而，本综述采取以数据为中心的方法，批判性分析公开可用乳腺X线摄影数据集的特征，以及乳腺X线摄影数据对乳腺癌检测AI模型的开发、性能和临床推广的作用。这些数据集在以下方面进行比较：数据集规模、标注质量、成像方式、临床元数据、数据集可及性和人口学多样性。分析表明，所用数据的质量、多样性和代表性对AI模型的性能和可推广性至关重要，从传统机器学习时代到当前的深度学习、基于Transformer的系统、多模态学习、可解释AI和隐私保护学习时代均是如此。结果显示，除了AI模型架构的发展外，拥有标准化、多样化且具有临床代表性的数据集对于在AI辅助乳腺X线摄影方面取得进一步进展是必要的。本综述强调建立大型且多样化的乳腺X线摄影综合基准数据集的重要性，以提高可重复性、公平评估模型，并开发用于乳腺癌检测的稳健、临床可行的AI系统。

title: Cross-cancer knowledge transfer for lymph node metastasis prediction: Applicability of an axillary lymph node-based deep learning model
zh_title: 跨癌种知识迁移预测淋巴结转移：腋窝淋巴结模型适用性
summary: 预印本用523例乳腺癌患者1128个腋窝淋巴结CT训练DenseNet-121集成模型，并在256张外部CT图像上检验跨解剖部位泛化。
key_points: 基于固定裁剪与可调方形裁剪的集成建模
训练集来自乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结CT数据
外部集为256张不同原发癌的淋巴结CT图像
reason: 有外部数据集验证，但样本量有限且为预印本回顾性设计
abstract: Evaluation of lymph node (LN) metastasis is critical for cancer staging and treatment planning. Since radiologic hallmarks of metastatic LNs are shared across primary cancers, a computed tomography (CT)-based deep learning (DL) classifier developed from one anatomy may transfer to others. This study built a DenseNet-121 ensemble model using clinical-implication-applied preprocessing and evaluated its cross-anatomical generalizability to LNs from diverse primary cancers. A DenseNet-121 ensemble model combining fixed-size cropping (FSC) and adjustable square cropping (ASC) was trained from ImageNet initialization on an axillary lymph node (ALN) dataset (n = 1,128 from 523 breast cancer patients). The model utilized clinical-implication-applied perinodal cropping with bicubic filtering and standardized resizing. To test cross-anatomical generalizability, an external dataset of 256 CT images across four anatomical regions was evaluated: cervical, mediastinal, upper-abdominal, and lower-abdominal LNs. Perinodal free margins were systematically varied from 10% to 40% to optimize the balance between context preservation and surround interference. Bicubic filtering and standardized resizing yielded the highest internal performance on the original ALN dataset (FSC-ASC ensemble area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.958, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.920-0.987 at 40% margin). The model demonstrated site-dependent, above-chance generalizability across all external regions. Cervical LNs achieved the highest performance at a 40% margin (AUROC 0.939, 95% CI 0.875-0.989). Mediastinal LNs peaked at a 10% margin (AUROC 0.796, 95% CI 0.672-0.903), with wider margins degrading performance due to adjacent structural interference. Upper-abdominal and lower-abdominal LNs reached optimal performance at a 30% margin (AUROC 0.814 for upper; AUROC 0.917 for lower). A single ALN-trained DL model can accurately predict LN metastasis across cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal stations through site-specific perinodal margin tuning. These findings support the feasibility of cross-cancer knowledge transfer and the clinical utility of generalizable backbones for pan-cancer nodal assessment.
zh_abstract: 淋巴结（LN）转移的评估对癌症分期和治疗计划至关重要。由于转移性 LN 的影像学特征在原发癌症之间共享，基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的深度学习（DL）分类器从一个解剖部位开发后可能迁移到其他部位。本研究使用应用临床意义导向的预处理构建了一个 DenseNet-121 集成模型，并评估其对不同原发癌症 LN 的跨解剖部位泛化能力。一个结合固定尺寸裁剪（FSC）和可调方形裁剪（ASC）的 DenseNet-121 集成模型，以 ImageNet 初始化在腋窝淋巴结（ALN）数据集（n = 1,128，来自 523 例乳腺癌患者）上训练。该模型采用了应用临床意义的淋巴结周围裁剪、双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸。为测试跨解剖部位泛化能力，评估了一个包含四个解剖区域共 256 张 CT 图像的外部数据集：颈部、纵隔、上腹部和下腹部 LN。淋巴结周围自由边距从 10% 系统变化到 40%，以优化上下文保留与周围干扰之间的平衡。双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸在原始 ALN 数据集上产生最高内部性能（在 40% 边距时，FSC-ASC 集成受试者工作特征曲线下面积 [AUROC] 0.958，95% 置信区间 [CI] 0.920-0.987）。该模型在所有外部区域均表现出部位依赖且高于随机水平的泛化能力。颈部 LN 在 40% 边距时达到最高性能（AUROC 0.939，95% CI 0.875-0.989）。纵隔 LN 在 10% 边距时达到峰值（AUROC 0.796，95% CI 0.672-0.903），更宽的边距因邻近结构干扰而降低性能。上腹部和下腹部 LN 在 30% 边距时达到最佳性能（上腹部 AUROC 0.814；下腹部 AUROC 0.917）。一个仅在 ALN 上训练的 DL 模型可通过部位特异性淋巴结周围边距调整，准确预测颈部、纵隔和腹部站点的 LN 转移。这些发现支持跨癌症知识迁移的可行性，以及可泛化骨干模型用于泛癌淋巴结评估的临床效用。

title: Evaluating uncertainty for detecting performance loss and guiding deferral after model transfer between hospital systems
zh_title: 医院间模型迁移后用不确定性检测性能损失并指导转人工
summary: 预印本在MIMIC-IV训练三个死亡预测网络并在eICU-CRD评估，发现熵与互信息不能可靠提示迁移后性能下降，但可辅助转人工。
key_points: 迁移后AUROC由0.86-0.87降至0.76-0.77且校准变差
熵与互信息下降，未能可靠指示性能损失
按熵转出最高20%后剩余错误率降至6.3-8.0%
reason: 跨机构外部评估且结论有警示价值，但为预印本、阴性结果为主
abstract: Clinical prediction models often perform worse after transfer between hospital systems, but deterioration becomes apparent only once outcomes are known. We investigated whether uncertainty measures available at prediction time warn of performance loss and can help identify individual predictions requiring review. Three neural network architectures were trained on MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality prediction and evaluated on eICU-CRD. Measures included predictive entropy, mutual information from Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, and representation density. After transfer, AUROC fell from 0.86-0.87 to 0.76-0.77 and calibration worsened, while entropy and mutual information were lower. None of the measures reliably indicated the reduced performance. Deferring the 20% with the highest entropy reduced the remaining error rate from 17.5-20.1% to 6.3-8.0%; the deferred patients included 91-99% of false alarms but only 2-7% of missed deaths, which carried low uncertainty. Uncertainty therefore supported selective review but failed to reveal performance loss.
zh_abstract: 临床预测模型在医院系统之间迁移后往往表现更差，但性能下降只有在结局已知后才变得明显。我们研究了预测时可获得的不确定性度量是否能预警性能损失，并帮助识别需要复核的个体预测。三种神经网络架构在 MIMIC-IV 上训练用于院内死亡预测，并在 eICU-CRD 上评估。度量包括预测熵、来自蒙特卡洛 dropout 和深度集成的互信息，以及表示密度。迁移后，AUROC 从 0.86-0.87 降至 0.76-0.77，校准恶化，而熵和互信息更低。没有任何度量能可靠指示性能下降。推迟熵最高的 20% 后，剩余错误率从 17.5-20.1% 降至 6.3-8.0%；被推迟的患者包括 91-99% 的假警报，但仅包括 2-7% 的漏报死亡，而这些漏报死亡的不确定性较低。因此，不确定性支持选择性复核，但未能揭示性能损失。

title: Disentangling Context-Specific Alzheimer's Disease Progression Signatures through an Explainable AI Framework
zh_title: 可解释AI解析阿尔茨海默病进展特征
summary: ADVISE可解释深度生成框架从人前额叶单核RNA测序中分离Braak分期相关转录信号，识别共享与情境特异分子程序（预印本）。
key_points: 以分离潜表征剥离背景生物变异对分期的掩盖
在整体、性别与细胞类型层面比较AD进展特征
提示突触传递与HSF1相关蛋白稳态应激等汇聚程序
reason: 方法有新意且用大规模单核测序数据，但为预印本、缺乏独立验证
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression involves stage-dependent transcriptional changes that are often masked by dominant cellular and biological variation. Here, we present ADVISE (Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings), an interpretable deep generative framework designed to disentangle Braak stage-associated transcriptional signals from background biological variation through separate latent representations. Using explainable AI, ADVISE prioritizes genes and pathways contributing to the disease-specific representation. Applying ADVISE to large-scale single-nucleus RNA sequencing data from the human prefrontal cortex, we identify shared and context-specific signatures of AD progression across global, sex-specific, and cell-type-specific analyses, revealing convergent molecular programs involving synaptic transmission, HSF1-associated proteostatic stress responses, and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance. Notably, ADVISE prioritizes ROBO2 as a progression-associated candidate in excitatory neurons. Experimental validation using CRISPR activation in hiPSC-derived excitatory neurons demonstrates that ROBO2 activation reduces the phosphorylated Tau-to-total Tau ratio. ADVISE thus reveals context-dependent molecular signatures of AD progression and bridges human single-cell discoveries with experimental validation of candidate regulators of AD pathology.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）进展涉及阶段依赖性的转录变化，这些变化常被占主导的细胞和生物学变异所掩盖。在此，我们提出ADVISE（Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings），一个可解释的深度生成框架，旨在通过分离的潜在表征将Braak分期相关的转录信号与背景生物学变异解耦。利用可解释AI，ADVISE优先识别对疾病特异性表征有贡献的基因和通路。将ADVISE应用于来自人类前额叶皮层的大规模单核RNA测序数据，我们在全局、性别特异性和细胞类型特异性分析中识别出AD进展的共享和情境特异性特征，揭示了涉及突触传递、HSF1相关蛋白质稳态应激反应以及SLIT/ROBO轴突导向的趋同分子程序。值得注意的是，ADVISE将ROBO2优先列为兴奋性神经元中与进展相关的候选基因。使用CRISPR激活在hiPSC来源的兴奋性神经元中进行的实验验证表明，ROBO2激活降低了磷酸化Tau与总Tau的比值。因此，ADVISE揭示了AD进展的情境依赖性分子特征，并将人类单细胞发现与AD病理候选调控因子的实验验证连接起来。

title: XAMPGen: An Interpretable SI Pipeline For Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery
zh_title: XAMPGen：可解释抗菌肽发现生成管线
summary: 在已知抗菌肽上微调ProGen生成新序列，并用可解释方法验证生成模型、定位编码关键功能信息的层。
key_points: 以生成式方法产出具目标性质的新型抗菌肽序列
用探针分类器与回归器识别关键功能层
自注意力分析用于解释生成模型并获取生物学线索
reason: 生成+可解释的方法有新意，但为预印本、缺少湿实验验证与外部对照，属值得一看档
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are short peptides with a broad spectrum of activity against bacterial pathogens, representing a promising avenue for combating the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. This study focuses on two main components: 1) generating novel AMPs with desired properties using generative SI (GenSI) and 2) utilizing explainable SI (XSI) methods to validate the GenSI model and derive biological insights. In this work, we fine-tuned ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, on known AMPs to generate novel peptide sequences with strong antimicrobial properties. To advance the interpretability and reliability of the generative model, we applied Explainable SI (XSI) techniques. Specifically, we used a probing classifier and a regressor to identify cornerstone layers that encode functionally critical information. Self-attention analysis within these layers revealed residue level interdependencies and patterns underlying antimicrobial functions, which we validated against well-characterized AMPs from the literature. Overall, these methods provide mechanistic insight into the model's decision-making process, offering a principled basis for trusting the sequences it generates rather than treating the model as a black box. Candidate sequences were filtered based on predicted Minimum Inhibitory Concentration (MIC) along with human insights into the structural activities of the AMPs in bacterial membranes, and a final set of peptides was selected for experimental testing. Biological assays for determining MIC confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated and tested peptides, with fluorescence and circular dichroism measurements providing structural insight. With our XSI approach, we are able to reveal correlations between amino acid sequence patterns and binding properties of these sequences to bacterial membrane mimics, that directly correlate with biological activities in cell-based assays. This builds confidence in that the learned amino acid interdependencies as applied to AMPs carries physico-chemical meaning and is relevant for discoveries of novel AMPs with therapeutic potential. This work demonstrates that interpretable generative language models can serve as effective and transparent tools for rational AMP discovery.
zh_abstract: 抗菌肽（antimicrobial peptides, AMPs）是对细菌病原体具有广谱活性的短肽，为应对日益严重的抗生素耐药性威胁提供了有前景的途径。本研究聚焦两个主要部分：1）使用生成式 SI（GenSI）生成具有所需特性的新型 AMPs；2）利用可解释 SI（XSI）方法验证 GenSI 模型并获得生物学见解。在本工作中，我们对已知 AMPs 微调了 ProGen——一种仅解码器（decoder-only）蛋白质语言模型——以生成具有强抗菌特性的新型肽序列。为提升生成模型的可解释性和可靠性，我们应用了可解释 SI（XSI）技术。具体而言，我们使用探针分类器（probing classifier）和回归器（regressor）来识别编码功能关键信息的基石层（cornerstone layers）。这些层内的自注意力分析揭示了残基水平的相互依赖关系以及抗菌功能背后的模式，我们对照文献中充分表征的 AMPs 进行了验证。总体而言，这些方法提供了对模型决策过程的机制性洞察，为信任其生成的序列提供了有原则的基础，而不是将模型视为黑箱。候选序列根据预测的最低抑菌浓度（Minimum Inhibitory Concentration, MIC）以及关于 AMPs 在细菌膜中结构活性的人类见解进行过滤，并最终选择一组肽用于实验测试。用于测定 MIC 的生物学实验证实所有生成并测试的肽均具有抗菌活性，荧光和圆二色性测量提供了结构洞察。借助我们的 XSI 方法，我们能够揭示氨基酸序列模式与这些序列对细菌膜模拟物结合特性之间的相关性，而这些结合特性与基于细胞的实验中的生物活性直接相关。这增强了对以下判断的信心：应用于 AMPs 的学习到的氨基酸相互依赖关系具有物理化学意义，并与发现具有治疗潜力的新型 AMPs 相关。本工作证明，可解释的生成式语言模型可作为理性 AMP 发现的有效且透明的工具。

title: Flexible Intensities Matter: A Comprehensive Re-evaluation of Hawkes Processes and Neural Temporal Point Processes
zh_title: Hawkes过程与神经时序点过程在医疗数据上的再评估
summary: 预印本在五个基准及UK Biobank、MIMIC-IV两个大规模医疗任务上重新比较不同灵活度的Hawkes过程与神经时序点过程。
key_points: 更灵活的Hawkes过程缩小既往性能差距
额外引入两个大规模医疗事件序列任务
任务形式为自回归下一事件预测
reason: 方法学再评估预印本，用大规模医疗数据但无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are the canonical framework for event sequence data, with applications spanning seismology, social media, and electronic health records. Recently, neural TPPs have been reported to substantially outperform classical TPPs, such as Hawkes processes, but these comparisons pitted flexible neural models against Hawkes processes in their most restricted form, and did not consider large-scale medical data. Here, we revisit this comparison through a systematic evaluation of Poisson and Hawkes processes of increasing flexibility against neural TPPs, on five established benchmark datasets and on two large-scale medical evaluation tasks derived from UK Biobank disease histories and MIMIC-IV ICU records, under autoregressive next-event prediction. First, the previously reported gap between Hawkes processes and neural TPPs largely disappears once Hawkes processes are equipped with flexible, learnable baselines and kernels. Second, the flexibility of the intensity parametrization also limits prior neural TPPs: a Transformer with a spline-based intensity head outperforms previous intensity-based neural TPPs and is on par with the intensity-free model. Decomposing the log-likelihood into a time term $\log p(t)$ and a type term $\log p(d \mid t)$, we find that this flexibility advantage lies almost entirely in the time density: more flexibility does not improve the type term. On these benchmarks, the gains of neural TPPs thus lie mostly in modeling when events occur, not which. Third, our results underscore the value of complex datasets for evaluating TPPs: only on the MIMIC-IV ICU records do neural TPPs retain an advantage in the type term. Our results inform both future method development and model choice. We release our framework, TorchPP, as an open-source package with consistent implementations of classical and neural TPPs.
zh_abstract: 时间点过程（Temporal point processes, TPPs）是事件序列数据的经典框架，应用遍及地震学、社交媒体和电子健康记录。近期有报告称，神经 TPP 显著优于 Hawkes 过程等经典 TPP，但这些比较是将灵活的神经模型与处于最受限形式的 Hawkes 过程相对比，且未考虑大规模医学数据。在此，我们在五个既有基准数据集以及两个源自 UK Biobank 疾病史和 MIMIC-IV ICU 记录的大规模医学评估任务上，于自回归下一事件预测下，通过系统评估灵活性递增的 Poisson 和 Hawkes 过程与神经 TPP 的对比，重新审视这一比较。第一，一旦 Hawkes 过程配备灵活、可学习的基线和核函数，先前报道的 Hawkes 过程与神经 TPP 之间的差距在很大程度上消失。第二，强度参数化的灵活性也限制了先前的神经 TPP：带有基于样条的强度头（spline-based intensity head）的 Transformer 优于先前基于强度的神经 TPP，并与无强度模型（intensity-free model）相当。将对数似然分解为时间项 log p(t) 和类型项 log p(d | t)，我们发现这种灵活性优势几乎完全在于时间密度：更高的灵活性并未改善类型项。因此，在这些基准上，神经 TPP 的增益主要在于建模事件何时发生，而非何种事件发生。第三，我们的结果凸显了复杂数据集对评估 TPP 的价值：只有在 MIMIC-IV ICU 记录上，神经 TPP 才在类型项上保持优势。我们的结果为未来方法开发和模型选择提供依据。我们以开源包形式发布我们的框架 TorchPP，其中包含经典 TPP 和神经 TPP 的一致实现。

title: C-WFDM: A ControlNet-Guided Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Completion
zh_title: ControlNet引导小波融合扩散模型补全脑MRI
summary: arXiv 预印本提出 C-WFDM，用 ControlNet 引导的小波融合扩散模型补全多模态脑 MRI 缺失对比。
key_points: 针对 T1w/T2w/FLAIR/T1Gd 模态不均衡缺失
指出按完整病例随机遮蔽的基准与真实缺失模式不符
方法基于小波融合与扩散生成
reason: 有新方法的问题设定，但为预印本且摘要未显示外部验证
abstract: Multimodal brain MRI provides complementary anatomical, tissue, and pathological information to support downstream artificial intelligence (AI) applications. However, modality availability is uneven across public and pooled neuroimaging datasets: T1-weighted (T1w) MRI is widely represented, T2-weighted (T2w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) MRI are less consistently available, and gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted (T1Gd) MRI is relatively scarce. Pooled datasets therefore contain participants with different combinations of acquired MRI contrasts, reflecting variation in the study designs, acquisition protocols, and clinical or research objectives of the contributing studies. Many missing-modality benchmarks simulate incomplete MRI by withholding contrasts from complete four-modality cases, which may not represent the observed availability patterns in pooled datasets. To address this gap, we introduce C-WFDM, a ControlNet extension of our Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model (WFDM), for subject-specific missing-modality completion. C-WFDM is built on an earlier BrainScape snapshot comprising 157 public MRI datasets and 45,880 preprocessed scans. The pretrained WFDM backbone retains target-modality and metadata conditioning, while target-specific ControlNet adapters use MRI contrasts from the same participant to guide synthesis. C-WFDM synthesizes T2w from T1w, FLAIR from T1w and T2w, and T1Gd from T1w, T2w, and FLAIR. Acquired conditioning contrasts are used when available, and generated intermediate contrasts are used only when required. We compare C-WFDM with ALDM, cWDM, and Pix2Pix using paired structural similarity index (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and mean absolute error (MAE). In the BrainScape completion experiment, C-WFDM achieves the best T2w and FLAIR results among the evaluated models, with SSIM values of 0.9232 and 0.8904, respectively.
zh_abstract: 多模态脑 MRI 提供互补的解剖、组织和病理信息，以支持下游人工智能（AI）应用。然而，公开和汇总神经影像数据集中的模态可用性并不均衡：T1 加权（T1w）MRI 广泛存在，T2 加权（T2w）和液体衰减反转恢复（FLAIR）MRI 的可用性较不一致，而钆增强 T1 加权（T1Gd）MRI 相对稀缺。因此，汇总数据集包含具有不同已采集 MRI 对比组合的参与者，这反映了贡献研究在研究设计、采集方案以及临床或研究目标上的差异。许多缺失模态基准通过从完整的四模态病例中扣留对比来模拟不完整 MRI，这可能无法代表汇总数据集中观察到的可用性模式。为填补这一空白，我们提出 C-WFDM，它是对我们的 Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model（WFDM）的 ControlNet 扩展，用于受试者特定的缺失模态补全。C-WFDM 建立在较早的 BrainScape 快照之上，该快照包含 157 个公开 MRI 数据集和 45,880 次预处理扫描。预训练的 WFDM 主干保留目标模态和元数据条件化，而目标特定的 ControlNet 适配器使用同一参与者的 MRI 对比来指导合成。C-WFDM 从 T1w 合成 T2w，从 T1w 和 T2w 合成 FLAIR，并从 T1w、T2w 和 FLAIR 合成 T1Gd。已采集的条件对比在可用时使用，生成的中间对比仅在需要时使用。我们使用配对结构相似性指数（SSIM）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）和平均绝对误差（MAE）将 C-WFDM 与 ALDM、cWDM 和 Pix2Pix 进行比较。在 BrainScape 补全实验中，C-WFDM 在受评估模型中取得最佳的 T2w 和 FLAIR 结果，SSIM 值分别为 0.9232 和 0.8904。

title: MicrobeRT: A Framework and Suite of Fine-tuned Language Models for Genomic Sequences
zh_title: MicrobeRT：宏基因组序列语言模型套件
summary: bioRxiv 预印本发布基于三个基因组语言模型微调的 MicrobeRT，用于宏基因组读段分类。
key_points: 任务含物种鉴定、耐药基因检测、致病性评估
基于 Nucleotide Transformer、DNABERT 等预训练模型
面向传染病监测的宏基因组分析流程
reason: 开源式模型套件预印本，摘要未见大规模外部评测细节
abstract: Accurate and reproducible metagenomic analysis is essential for effective infectious disease surveillance. Targeted diagnostics such as culturing, antigen assays, and multiplex PCR panels identify only predefined organisms and can fail to identify atypical or novel infections. Shotgun metagenomics offers hypothesis-free detection, but adoption is limited by workflow complexity, dependence on mutable reference databases, and high computational cost. To combat these challenges, we introduce MicrobeRT, an integrated suite of genomic language models fine-tuned to classify metagenomic sequencing reads across three tasks: (i) species level taxonomic identification, (ii) antibiotic resistance gene detection, and (iii) pathogenicity assessment. The framework builds on three pre-trained genomic language models - Nucleotide Transformer (Dalla-Torre et al 2025), DNABERT (Ji et al 2021, Zhou et al 2024), and HyenaDNA (Nguyen et al 2024) - leveraging their large-scale genomic pre-training, adaptability to downstream tasks, and, in the case of HyenaDNA, ability to capture long-range sequence dependencies. The models are fine-tuned on large, curated datasets spanning microbial, viral, fungal, and human genomes, including more than 500,000 genomes and 250,000 antibiotic resistance gene sequences. To evaluate the performance of our fine-tuned genomic language models across classification tasks, we developed a benchmarking framework that compares MicrobeRT against state-of-the-art (SOTA) bioinformatics tools. Across both simulated and empirical datasets, the models achieve strong performance while reducing computational overhead. MicrobeRT is released as open-source software, enabling further fine-tuning and reproducible integration of alternative models and classifiers. We also demonstrate seamless, drop-in integration by incorporating our fine-tuned taxonomic classification models as an optional add-on within the open-source TaxTriage pipeline (Merritt et al 2026). MicrobeRT demonstrates the feasibility of three clinically relevant multi-label analyses, offering a practical path to scalable, reproducible metagenomic diagnostics and enabling broader deployment of AI/ML-enhanced infectious disease testing.
zh_abstract: 准确且可重复的宏基因组分析对于有效的传染病监测至关重要。培养、抗原检测和多重PCR panel等靶向诊断仅能识别预先设定的微生物，可能无法识别非典型或新型感染。鸟枪法宏基因组学提供无假设的检测，但其应用受到工作流程复杂性、对可变参考数据库的依赖以及高计算成本的限制。为应对这些挑战，我们推出 MicrobeRT，这是一套经过微调的基因组语言模型集成套件，用于对宏基因组测序读段进行三类任务分类：(i) 物种水平分类学鉴定，(ii) 抗生素耐药基因检测，(iii) 致病性评估。该框架基于三个预训练基因组语言模型——Nucleotide Transformer (Dalla-Torre et al 2025)、DNABERT (Ji et al 2021, Zhou et al 2024) 和 HyenaDNA (Nguyen et al 2024)——利用其大规模基因组预训练、对下游任务的可适应性，以及 HyenaDNA 捕获长程序列依赖性的能力。这些模型在涵盖微生物、病毒、真菌和人类基因组的大型精选数据集上微调，包括超过500,000个基因组和250,000条抗生素耐药基因序列。为评估我们微调后的基因组语言模型在各分类任务上的性能，我们开发了一个基准测试框架，将 MicrobeRT 与最先进（SOTA）生物信息学工具进行比较。在模拟和实证数据集上，这些模型均取得强劲性能，同时降低计算开销。MicrobeRT 作为开源软件发布，支持进一步微调以及替代模型和分类器的可重复整合。我们还通过将微调后的分类学分类模型作为可选插件纳入开源 TaxTriage 流程 (Merritt et al 2026)，展示了无缝的即插即用整合。MicrobeRT 证明了三种临床相关的多标签分析的可行性，为可扩展、可重复的宏基因组诊断提供了实用路径，并使 AI/ML 增强的传染病检测能够更广泛部署。

title: Omics-scale decoding of protein N-glycosylation using protein language model embeddings
zh_title: 用蛋白语言模型嵌入实现蛋白质组尺度N-糖基化解码
summary: 利用蛋白语言模型嵌入做零样本N-糖基化位点预测，MaskNGly性能接近有监督预测器。
key_points: 无需下游监督训练，借助共进化分析解码嵌入
计算高效，可做蛋白质组尺度糖基化刻画
发现经典N-X-S/T基序的糖基化倾向随上下文变化
reason: 零样本新方法并称可比SOTA，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) learn rich sequence semantics from vast volume of protein sequences, yet the information encoded in their high-dimensional embeddings remains largely a black box, posing an interpretability challenge. Here we show that semantic features learned by pLMs can be decoded to reveal biologically meaningful signals using coevolutionary analysis without downstream supervised-training. Building on this insight, we developed MaskNGly, a zero-shot framework that identifies protein N-glycosylation sites directly from PLM-embeddings while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art supervised predictors. MaskNGly is computationally efficient and intrinsically transferable, enabling omics-scale characterization of protein glycosylation landscape. Applied across proteomes, it reveals that canonical N-X-S/T motifs gain higher glycosylation propensities with increasing organismal complexity and that glycosylation preferentially occurs at structured, solvent-exposed regions. Mutations altering high-scoring motifs are more frequently disease-associated. The framework also captures signatures of glycosylation-mediated protein allostery. These results establish an interpretable and scalable route to study glycobiology from pLM-embeddings.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, pLMs）从海量蛋白质序列中学习丰富的序列语义，但其高维嵌入所编码的信息在很大程度上仍是一个黑箱，构成可解释性挑战。在此，我们表明，pLMs 学到的语义特征可通过共进化分析解码，从而在无需下游监督训练的情况下揭示具有生物学意义的信号。基于这一见解，我们开发了 MaskNGly，一个零样本框架，可直接从 PLM 嵌入中识别蛋白质 N-糖基化位点，同时实现与最先进监督预测器相当的性能。MaskNGly 计算高效且本质可迁移，能够对蛋白质糖基化图景进行组学规模表征。应用于蛋白质组时，它揭示经典 N-X-S/T 基序随生物体复杂性增加而获得更高的糖基化倾向，并且糖基化优先发生在结构化、溶剂暴露区域。改变高评分基序的突变更频繁地与疾病相关。该框架还捕获糖基化介导的蛋白质变构特征。这些结果建立了一条从 pLM 嵌入研究糖生物学的可解释且可扩展路径。

title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
zh_title: 自然图像扩散模型迁移至医学影像生成
summary: 预印本分析自然图像扩散模型迁移至医学影像生成的效果与机制。
key_points: 自然图像初始化使像素空间gFID相对改善21–34%
潜空间改善约14%，分词器提供先验
增益与下游病理分类及影像组学特征一致
reason: 预印本方法分析有新意，有基线对比但临床证据有限
abstract: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit
zh_abstract: 从自然图像进行迁移学习在监督式医学图像分析中是标准做法，并越来越多地用于自监督医学图像分析，但其在生成建模中的作用，尤其是在扩散去噪器中的作用，仍未得到充分探索。医学扩散模型通常从头训练去噪器，未对自然图像迁移进行系统评估。我们在潜空间和像素两种范式、模型规模（131M–952M）以及两个放射学数据集（RadImageNet、BraTS）上对此进行分析，并追问迁移的哪些方面支持生成。我们发现：i）自然图像初始化持续改善生成，在像素空间中相对gFID改善21–34%，而在潜空间中为14%，其中分词器提供了大部分先验。gFID的改善与下游病理分类和影像组学特征FD相呼应，二者均是临床保真度的代理指标。ii）获益反映的是空间结构而非语义：语义探测不能预测生成质量，而一种适配去噪器内部表征的空间结构指标以|r|=0.85追踪gFID，表明空间组织是预训练得以体现的一个通道。iii）混合域去噪器训练显示，自然图像和医学图像在直至后期模块之前具有相似的逐层表示，并且将自然图像混入医学训练可提高保真度。iv）迁移获益与自然图像初始化相关，优于域内医学预训练和若干重新初始化方案。总体而言，在我们的设置中，自然图像去噪器正向迁移至医学去噪器。代码见 https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

title: CoRTeC: A Differentially Private Release for Synthetic Tabular Data, Decodable by Any Generator
zh_title: CoRTeC：可被任意生成器解码的差分隐私合成表格数据
summary: 提出CoRTeC方法，以差分隐私方式一次性发布带噪计数文件，供任意方反复生成合成表格数据而不额外消耗隐私预算。
key_points: 面向医院病历等无法共享数据的合成数据发布
隐私预算一次性花在可人工核查的带噪计数文件上
计数可转为合成行，无额外隐私代价
采用最大熵解码器生成数据
reason: 预印本新方法有思路新意，但无医疗数据实证与外部评估，属值得一看档
abstract: The records that could train the most useful models, such as a hospital's patient files, are often the ones an institution cannot share. We propose CoRTeC, a method that releases synthetic versions of such records under differential privacy. Differential privacy places a proven limit on what the synthetic data can reveal about any person, and in particular on membership inference. CoRTeC spends the privacy budget once, on a small file of noisy counts designed for training a classifier. For each group of records, the file gives the group's size, its balance of outcomes, a histogram of every column for each outcome and the outcome rate in each of several non-overlapping cells. A reviewer can check every number before the file leaves the institution. Anyone can then turn the counts into synthetic rows, as often as they like and at no further privacy cost. A maximum-entropy decoder can do this without any language model, and so can each of the five frozen language models we tested. None of them ever sees a real record. A selection step then matches the rows to the released counts. Decoded without a language model, the automatically configured release at $\varepsilon = 2$ trains classifiers to within 0.02 AUC of a real sample of the same size on the Adult dataset, across three data splits. On NHANES and bank marketing, without the selection step, it stays within 0.05 AUC. On Adult, with a fixed cohort rule, the release carries the outcome rates a deployment names more closely than a real sample does, at some cost in accuracy on pairs of columns. Four controls show that most of the utility comes from the release and the selection step, and that a language model adds what it knows from the column names. No private row ever reaches a model, and no row CoRTeC generates copies a real one. The strongest membership attack stays far below the bound the budget allows.
zh_abstract: 能够训练出最有价值模型的记录，例如医院的病人档案，往往正是机构无法共享的记录。我们提出CoRTeC，一种在差分隐私（differential privacy）下发布此类记录合成版本的方法。差分隐私为合成数据可能泄露任何个人的信息设定了经证明的限制，尤其是对成员推断（membership inference）的限制。CoRTeC将隐私预算一次性花费在一个小型的含噪计数文件上，该文件专为训练分类器而设计。对于每一组记录，该文件给出该组的大小、其结局的平衡情况、针对每种结局的每一列直方图，以及若干互不重叠单元格中各自的结局率。审查者可以在文件离开机构之前核对其中的每一个数字。随后任何人都可以把这些计数转换成合成行，次数不限，且无需再付出额外的隐私代价。最大熵解码器可以在没有任何语言模型的情况下完成这一转换，我们测试的五个冻结语言模型中的每一个也都能做到。它们中没有任何一个曾见过真实记录。随后通过一个选择步骤将行与已发布的计数相匹配。在不使用语言模型解码的情况下，在Adult数据集上、跨三个数据划分，自动配置的ε = 2发布版本所训练的分类器与同规模真实样本的AUC差距在0.02以内。在NHANES和bank marketing上，若不进行选择步骤，其差距保持在0.05 AUC以内。在Adult上，采用固定队列规则时，该发布版本所携带的部署方所指定结局率的贴近程度高于真实样本，代价是在列对（pairs of columns）上的准确性有所损失。四项对照表明，大部分效用来自该发布版本和选择步骤，而语言模型则补充了它从列名中所获知的信息。没有任何私有行进入模型，CoRTeC生成的任何行都不是对真实行的复制。最强的成员推断攻击远低于预算所允许的界限。

title: PathoS2VD: From 2D Histopathology to Pseudo Z-Stack Representations
zh_title: PathoS2VD：从2D病理切片生成伪Z轴堆叠表示
summary: 提出生成式框架，用图像到视频潜在扩散模型从单张2D病理图像合成伪Z轴堆叠，以补足缺失的z轴形态信息。
key_points: 从病理z-stack数据学习z轴形态先验
以图像到视频潜在扩散模型由单张切片生成多层
目标是替代成本较高的三维容积成像
面向常规单平面病理切片的表示增强
reason: 预印本新方法有明确新意，但缺乏下游任务与外部验证证据
abstract: For decades, diagnostic pathology has relied on thin two-dimensional (2D) tissue sections, despite biological tissues exhibiting inherently three-dimensional (3D) morphological organization. Because a single section captures only one focal plane, important morphological cues along the z-axis are inevitably discarded, limiting tissue representation for both human interpretation and computational analysis. In this work, we propose a generative framework that learns z-axis morphological priors from pathology z-stack data, offering a cost-effective alternative to dedicated volumetric imaging, and transfers this knowledge to conventional single-plane histopathology. Specifically, an image-to-video (I2V) latent diffusion model (LDM) is trained to synthesize a pseudo z-stack from a single 2D image, capturing plausible morphological variations across adjacent focal planes rather than reconstructing physical tissue volumes. To enable deployment on large-scale clinical datasets without native z-stack acquisition, we further introduce a prior-preserving mixture fine-tuning strategy that adapts the model to new domains while retaining the learned z-axis morphological prior. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the synthesized pseudo z-stacks exhibit realistic cross-plane morphological continuity and consistently improve downstream prostate cancer classification compared with conventional 2D representations. Our results suggest that learning transferable z-axis priors from limited z-stack data provides a practical way to enrich routine pathology images with complementary morphological information. Code: https://github.com/QuIIL/PathoS2VD.
zh_abstract: 数十年来，诊断病理学一直依赖薄层二维（2D）组织切片，尽管生物组织本身具有三维（3D）形态学组织结构。由于单张切片仅能捕获一个焦平面，沿z轴的重要形态学线索不可避免地丢失，限制了组织在人工判读和计算分析中的表征。在本工作中，我们提出一个生成式框架，从病理z-stack数据中学习z轴形态学先验，为专用体积成像提供一种成本效益高的替代方案，并将该知识迁移到常规单平面组织病理学。具体而言，训练一个图像到视频（I2V）潜在扩散模型（LDM），从单张2D图像合成伪z-stack，捕获相邻焦平面之间合理的形态学变化，而非重建物理组织体积。为使其能够在没有原生z-stack采集的大规模临床数据集上部署，我们进一步引入一种保留先验的混合微调策略，在保留已学得的z轴形态学先验的同时使模型适应新领域。大量实验表明，合成的伪z-stack表现出逼真的跨平面形态学连续性，并且与传统2D表征相比，持续改善下游前列腺癌分类。我们的结果提示，从有限的z-stack数据中学习可迁移的z轴先验，为用互补的形态学信息丰富常规病理图像提供了一条实用途径。代码：https://github.com/QuIIL/PathoS2VD。

title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
zh_title: 虚拟试验智能体框架VTHarness
summary: 提出智能体框架VTHarness，协调虚拟试验方案在多临床数据模式下的可执行转化，并发布VTBenchmark。
key_points: 智能体按流程阶段选择可复用技能
显式契约保持跨阶段决策一致
在三个合成环境验证并发布VTBenchmark
reason: 预印本，合成环境验证，新框架与基准但缺真实数据外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matching the references in 95.1% of workflows after requirement clarification, compared with 60.4% using retrieval from the same procedural corpus. Procedural skills improved source recovery across three language models and increased source overlap with analyst code in 13 Mayo Clinic cases. Site-specific adaptation enabled reference-matched cohort execution across eight MIMIC-IV tasks. Within the Mayo Clinic Virtual Trials Program, the framework supported investigator review of cohort construction and endpoint analysis. These findings support coordinating procedural guidance with workflow decisions to improve virtual-trial implementation across complex clinical schemas.
zh_abstract: 虚拟试验使用常规收集的临床数据来评估治疗策略，但将研究方案转化为可执行分析需要确定临床概念和研究要求应如何在可用数据中表示，并在整个工作流程中一致地应用。这些决策取决于本地数据表示和操作惯例，并可能涉及来源选择、患者和就诊身份、链接以及时间解释。在此，我们介绍VirtualTrialHarness（VTHarness），一个智能体框架，它通过为每个工作流程阶段选择可复用的流程性技能来协调虚拟试验的操作化，并使用显式契约来在各阶段维持一致的研究决策。我们还介绍VTBenchmark，用于评估来源选择和队列构建。在三个复杂合成环境中，VTHarness在需求澄清后于95.1%的工作流程中成功产生所有必需的、与参考匹配的队列输出，而使用从同一流程语料库检索的方法为60.4%。流程性技能在三个语言模型中改善了来源恢复，并在13个Mayo Clinic病例中增加了与分析人员代码的来源重叠。站点特异性适配使八个MIMIC-IV任务中能够执行与参考匹配的队列。在Mayo Clinic虚拟试验项目中，该框架支持研究者对队列构建和终点分析的审查。这些发现支持将流程性指导与工作流程决策协调起来，以改善跨复杂临床模式的虚拟试验实施。

title: Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI
zh_title: 临床预测AI中基于AUC的公平性指标
summary: 系统梳理八种基于AUC的临床预测模型公平性指标，分析其估计目标及AUC不可折叠性带来的解释问题。
key_points: AUC不可折叠，亚组与总体值不可直接比较
考察八种AUC公平性指标的估计目标
将指标与总体AUC的组内/组间分解关联
reason: 预印本方法学梳理，聚焦AUC公平性指标解释，无实证外部验证，值得一看。
abstract: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.
zh_abstract: 针对二分类结局的临床预测模型的公平性评估，通常涉及比较不同亚组间受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC，或c统计量）的公平性指标。然而，AUC已被证明是一种不可折叠的指标，这意味着其亚组特异值和总体值并不像通常隐含假设的那样可以直接比较。这引发了关于应如何使用和解释现有基于AUC的公平性指标的重要问题。我们考察了文献中提出的八种基于AUC的公平性指标，包括：组内AUC均等性；跨组AUC（xAUC）均等性；与总体AUC的差距；公平缩放AUC；基于最小值的指标；$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$；$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$；以及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$或$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$均等性。我们刻画了其估计目标，将其与总体AUC的分解（分解为组内和跨组分量）相联系，并对其进行了批判性评价。随后，我们基于EuroSCORE II（一种用于院内死亡的临床预测模型）进行模拟，以说明它们的行为。我们建议报告一个AUC矩阵，其中包含总体AUC及所有组内和跨组AUC分量，并同时报告人群特征。当需要公平性指标时，我们建议报告组内AUC均等性，跨组AUC均等性可提供补充信息，但由于其可能与校准存在冲突，需要谨慎对待。涉及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$和$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$的指标有其价值，可将组内和跨组AUC汇总为单一数值，但其解释并不简单，应谨慎使用。与总体AUC的差距、公平缩放AUC和基于最小值的指标比较了不应比较的量，且如何操作化尚不明确，因此不适合其目的，通常不推荐使用。

title: When can multi-fragment 2D/3D registration be trusted? Calibrated certification and uncertainty-driven view planning for pelvic fracture fluoroscopy
zh_title: 骨盆骨折透视多碎片2D/3D配准的可信度认证与视角规划
summary: 在60例骨盆骨折CT模拟透视上，提出配准全碎片并给出校准误差界、据此决定停止或规划下一视角的闭环。
key_points: 每帧配准所有碎片，用校准协方差给出误差界并标记可疑碎片
95%界覆盖83%未标记碎片；第二视角起14%误差超5mm
新增视角引起的碎片位移最能区分失败（探索性，AUC 0.94）
reason: 方法有新意但仅基于模拟透视、60例留出CT，属证据有限的预印本方法档
abstract: Registering a segmented CT to fluoroscopy can locate every fracture fragment but can guide surgery only when trusted. After each shot, our closed loop registers all fragments, bounds their errors with a calibrated sandwich covariance, flags implausible or ambiguous ones, and stops or plans the next view. On simulated fluoroscopy of 60 held-out fracture CTs with realistic image uncertainty, 95% bounds covered 83% of unflagged fragments and 91% of those within 5mm, but from the second view on 14% failed by over 5mm, a third with bounds of at most 2mm. A fragment's shift when a view was added separated tightly bounded failures best (exploratory; AUC 0.94, bound 0.81). Requiring that the newest view moved no fragment beyond its bound, preferred post hoc, lowered false stops at 2mm from 23% to 6% overall, with 345 instead of 362 correct ones but more trajectories uncertified; delaying the stop did not, and other signals at equal acceptance left 10-15% false. With a segmentation error shared by all views (median Dice 0.89), 21% of this rule's stops were false against 10% without it (15 cases; exploratory). Minimax planning certified sooner than the clinical protocol without the check (4.20 versus 4.72 shots, Holm p <0.001), but no criterion reached the pre-specified endpoint, a true 2mm error, significantly sooner, even in the true basin. On real fluoroscopy of five intact pelves no 2mm certificate was false. Trust takes evidence across views, not only a calibrated local bound.
zh_abstract: 将分割后的 CT 配准到透视图像可以定位每个骨折碎片，但只有在可信时才能指导手术。每次拍摄后，我们的闭环配准所有碎片，用校准的三明治协方差限定其误差，标记不可信或模糊的碎片，并停止或规划下一个视角。在具有真实图像不确定性的 60 个留出骨折 CT 的模拟透视中，95% 界限覆盖了 83% 的未标记碎片，以及 5 mm 以内未标记碎片的 91%，但从第二个视角起，14% 的失败超过 5 mm，其中三分之一界限至多为 2 mm。添加视角时碎片的位移最能区分紧密界限的失败（探索性；AUC 0.94，界限 0.81）。要求最新视角未使任何碎片移动超出其界限（事后偏好）将 2 mm 处的错误停止总体上从 23% 降至 6%，正确停止为 345 次而非 362 次，但更多轨迹未获认证；延迟停止没有产生该效果，其他信号在相同接受率下仍留下 10–15% 的错误。在所有视角共享分割误差（Dice 中位数 0.89）时，该规则的停止中有 21% 为错误，而无该规则时为 10%（15 例；探索性）。极小极大规划比未进行该检查的临床方案更快获得认证（4.20 对 4.72 次拍摄，Holm p <0.001），但没有任何标准能显著更早达到预设终点，即真实 2 mm 误差，即使在真实盆地中也是如此。在五个完整骨盆的真实透视图像上，没有 2 mm 认证是错误的。信任需要跨视角的证据，而不仅是校准的局部界限。

title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
zh_title: 将通用视觉语言模型用作临床神经诊断的脑电基础模型
summary: 提出通用视觉语言模型无需大规模脑电预训练，即可通过视觉化方式解读脑电信号用于神经诊断。
key_points: 传统脑电自动化依赖任务特定的监督标注模型
主张视觉语言模型可近似模拟医生目视判读脑电
在未做大规模脑电预训练情况下考察其少样本与微调能力
reason: 思路有新意但属论证性预印本，条目未给出外部验证或临床结局证据
abstract: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.
zh_abstract: 历史上，自动化脑电图（EEG）系统是通过在特意标注的数据上训练的特定任务监督模型实现的。较新的建模范式依赖于通过在未标注的EEG信号上进行大规模领域特定预训练，为多个模态特定任务创建统一表示，即“基础模型”。这种统一表示的质量直接取决于模态特定数据集的可获得性。同时，通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）展现出广泛的少样本学习能力，以及对不同视觉和语言任务良好的微调适应性。VLMs能否以视觉方式学习读取和解释EEG，在一定程度上模拟人类临床医生检查EEG模式的方式？在本工作中，我们论证它们可以：我们表明，未经大规模EEG预训练的通用VLMs在一组临床神经诊断任务中表现具有竞争力，在少样本学习设置下比专家基础模型更好地适应不同任务，并且在模态特定模型未能表现出随模型扩展而提升时，随模型规模扩展表现出更好的性能。

title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
zh_title: 混合偏斜下的联邦迁移医学影像分类
summary: 预印本提出PAFP个性化联邦迁移框架，应对多中心医学影像混合偏斜。
key_points: 提出基于预训练骨干的PAFP联邦迁移框架
用客户端特征对齐模块应对混合偏斜
面向隐私约束下的多中心医学影像分类
reason: 预印本提出个性化联邦迁移方法，证据限于实验未外部验证
abstract: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP.
zh_abstract: 医学影像中的深度学习受到数据稀缺以及隐私法规的制约，这些法规使跨机构集中患者数据变得不切实际。联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）通过将数据保留在本地来应对这些制约，但其分布式特性使训练暴露于强烈的统计异质性。多中心医学数据尤其受到影响，表现出一种混合偏斜，结合了跨中心的特征、标签、概念和数量偏移。个性化FL通过为每个客户端定制模型来缓解异质性，但大多数方法假设从头训练，鉴于医学特征相对于可用数据的高维性，这并不现实。我们提出个性化对齐器联邦预训练（Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained, PAFP）框架，这是一种基于预训练骨干网络的个性化FL方法。PAFP在微调模块之前插入客户端特定的特征对齐（Feature Alignment）模块，以将隐藏特征分布重新对齐到服务器聚合的目标。在FedISIC基准上，PAFP获得最高的未加权平衡准确率，同时相对于最强基线将客户端间性能方差降低约六倍，从而同时实现准确性和跨客户端公平性。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP

title: Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework
zh_title: 量子机器学习在六个临床数据集上的等效性检验基准
summary: 预印本：在六个公开临床数据集上配对比较量子与经典模型，量子模型未显著优于经典模型，并提出报告框架。
key_points: 量子核SVM与变分量子分类器对比五种经典模型
六个公开数据集、相同输入、25次交叉验证划分
量子模型未显著优于任何经典对照
reason: 公开数据集的配对基准与等效性检验，有新意但证据限于预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the best classical model on NHANES 2017-18 (-0.076). A classically trivial product-state kernel performed as well as the entangling kernel. With depolarizing noise (p = 0.01) and 1,024 shots per kernel entry, QSVM AUROC decreased by 0.054 (95% CI: 0.036 to 0.071). Untuned bandwidth produced near-chance AUROC (0.48-0.59). Conclusions: Correctly configured quantum classifiers approached but did not exceed tuned classical models. Finite-shot estimation, rather than gate noise, was their main practical cost, while configuration errors could reverse conclusions. QML-Health-READY defines reporting requirements for credible claims.
zh_abstract: 【背景】量子机器学习（QML）被宣传用于临床预测，但其与经典模型的比较很少采用配对设计或进行等效性检验。【方法】我们在六个公开临床数据集上，比较了量子核支持向量机（QSVM；4个量子比特，调优带宽）和变分量子分类器（VQC）与五种调优的经典模型。所有模型均使用相同的四组分输入和25次交叉验证划分。配对AUROC差异采用校正重采样t检验、Holm校正等价检验（边界：±0.02和±0.05）以及随机效应合并进行评估。还进行了消融、噪声、有限采样次数和实现故障分析。我们提出了QML-Health-READY，一个八领域报告框架。【结果】两种量子模型均未显著优于任何经典对照模型。跨数据集合并后，QSVM与核匹配的径向基函数（RBF）SVM相差-0.006 AUROC（95% CI：-0.017至+0.004），在±0.02的等效边界内等效。VQC与最佳经典模型相差-0.007（95% CI：-0.019至+0.004）。在六个数据集中的四个中，QSVM在±0.05范围内与RBF SVM等效，但在NHANES 2017-18上显著劣于最佳经典模型（-0.076）。一个经典上平凡的乘积态核与纠缠核表现相同。在去极化噪声（p=0.01）和每个核条目1,024次采样下，QSVM的AUROC下降0.054（95% CI：0.036至0.071）。未调优带宽产生接近随机水平的AUROC（0.48-0.59）。【结论】正确配置的量子分类器接近但未超过调优的经典模型。有限采样次数估计而非门噪声是其主要的实际代价，而配置错误可能逆转结论。QML-Health-READY定义了可信声明的报告要求。

zh_title: AI-EGGIM系统多中心前瞻性验证登记

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; conditions: Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 540; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) is a precancerous condition associated with an increased risk of gastric cancer. The endoscopic grading of gastric intestinal metaplasia (EGGIM) score evaluates the extent of GIM across five standard gastric regions. The investigators developed a real-time artificial intelligence-assisted EGGIM (AI-EGGIM) system that automatically assigns an intestinal metaplasia grade to each region and calculates a total EGGIM score. This prospective multi-center validation study will consecutively enroll patients undergoing upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. The AI-EGGIM system will generate real-time grades for the five standard gastric regions. Regardless of endoscopic appearance or AI output, every patient will undergo five mapping biopsies, with one biopsy obtained from each standard region. Histopathological operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia (OLGIM) staging will serve as the reference standard. The primary objective is to estimate the performance of an AI-EGGIM score ≥ 5 for identifying patients at high risk of gastric cancer.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：山东大学齐鲁医院；疾病：胃黏膜肠上皮化生；类型：观察性；入组人数：540；状态：尚未开始招募] 胃黏膜肠上皮化生（GIM）是一种与胃癌风险升高相关的癌前病变。胃黏膜肠上皮化生内镜分级（EGGIM）评分评估 GIM 在五个标准胃区内的范围。研究者开发了实时人工智能辅助 EGGIM（AI-EGGIM）系统，可自动为每个区域判定肠上皮化生分级并计算 EGGIM 总评分。本前瞻性多中心验证研究将连续入组接受上消化道内镜检查的患者。AI-EGGIM 系统将生成五个标准胃区的实时分级。无论内镜表现或 AI 输出如何，每位患者都将接受五点定位活检，每个标准区域取一处活检。胃黏膜肠上皮化生的病理 operative link（OLGIM）分期将作为参考标准。主要目的是评估 AI-EGGIM 评分 ≥ 5 用于识别胃癌高风险患者的性能。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Valvular Heart Disease: A Bibliometric and Knowledge-Mapping Analysis Revealing a Three-Phase Evolution Toward Integrated Clinical Intelligence.
source: PubMed · British journal of hospital medicine (London, England : 2005)
zh_title: AI在瓣膜性心脏病研究的文献计量分析
summary: 对1991—2025年3291篇AI与瓣膜性心脏病文献做文献计量与知识图谱分析，归纳三阶段演化。
key_points: 检索Web of Science，共识别3291篇文献
用CiteSpace分析关键词网络、合作与共被引
结论提出三阶段演化并指向整合型临床智能
reason: 文献计量与知识图谱分析，不产生新方法或新证据，属增量档
abstract: [British journal of hospital medicine (London, England : 2005)] The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in valvular heart disease (VHD) has advanced significantly in recent years. However, a systematic evaluation of this field's historical development, knowledge structure, and global research patterns has yet to be conducted. This paper aims to outline the global evolution of AI research in VHD utilizing bibliometric and knowledge-mapping methods. Publications related to AI and VHD from 1991 to 2025 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection database to investigate research progress. CiteSpace software was employed for bibliometric and knowledge mapping analyses, assessing indicators such as publication trends, keyword networks, collaboration patterns, co-citation relationships, and emerging topics. A total of 3291 pieces of literature were identified. Research productivity remained low until the year before 2004, followed by steady growth and a sharp increase after 2015, culminating in 461 articles by the end of 2025. Network analysis revealed three sequential stages: image-assisted applications, prediction modeling, and recent advancements in deep-learning-based integrated systems. The United States accounted for the largest research volume, while England and Germany served as core nodes in the international cooperation network. Co-citation analysis identified significant clinical guidelines and pioneering interventional studies as key intellectual pillars in this domain. Over the past 35 years, significant progress has been achieved, transitioning from computer systems used solely for image analysis to more integrated clinical applications. Currently, deep learning techniques are increasingly prevalent, accompanied by a focus on multimodal data integration and a stronger linkage between computational methods and clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [《英国医院医学杂志（伦敦，2005 年版）》] 近年来，人工智能（AI）在瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）中的应用已取得显著进展。然而，尚缺乏对该领域历史发展、知识结构和全球研究格局的系统性评价。本文旨在运用文献计量学与知识图谱方法，勾勒 AI 在 VHD 研究中的全球演进脉络。从 Web of Science 核心合集数据库检索 1991 年至 2025 年 AI 与 VHD 相关文献，以考察研究进展。采用 CiteSpace 软件进行文献计量与知识图谱分析，评估发文趋势、关键词网络、合作模式、共被引关系和新兴主题等指标。共识别出 3291 篇文献。在 2004 年之前，研究产出始终较低，随后稳步增长，2015 年后急剧上升，到 2025 年底达到 461 篇。网络分析揭示了三个相继阶段：影像辅助应用、预测建模，以及近期基于深度学习的集成系统的进展。美国的研究量最大，而英格兰和德国是国际合作网络中的核心节点。共被引分析将重要临床指南和开创性介入研究识别为该领域的关键知识支柱。过去 35 年间取得了显著进展，从仅用于图像分析的计算机系统，过渡到更为整合的临床应用。目前，深度学习技术日益普及，同时伴随对多模态数据整合的关注，以及计算方法与临床决策之间更紧密的联系。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Peking University Cancer Hospital & Institute; conditions: Lung Neoplasms; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 150; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] This study will evaluate whether a generative artificial intelligence (AI)-based rehabilitation support system can help older adults with lung cancer recover after lung surgery. Eligible participants aged 65 years or older who are scheduled for video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) will be randomly assigned to receive either personalized perioperative rehabilitation guidance through the AI-based system or usual rehabilitation guidance. The system will provide guidance on exercise, nutrition, and psychological well-being before surgery and during recovery, and participants may report symptoms for follow-up guidance. The study will compare lung function and quality of life between the groups. It will also assess exercise tolerance, emergency department visits, hospital readmissions, and events related to use of the system.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：北京大学肿瘤医院暨北京大学肿瘤研究所；疾病：肺肿瘤（Lung Neoplasms）；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；阶段：NA；入组人数：150；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] 本研究将评估基于生成式人工智能（AI）的康复支持系统能否帮助肺癌老年患者在肺手术后康复。符合条件、年龄65岁及以上且计划接受电视辅助胸腔镜手术（VATS）的参与者将被随机分配接受通过基于AI的系统提供的个性化围手术期康复指导或常规康复指导。该系统将在手术前和康复期间提供运动、营养和心理健康方面的指导，参与者可报告症状以获得后续指导。研究将比较两组之间的肺功能和生活质量。研究还将评估运动耐量、急诊就诊、再入院以及与使用该系统相关的事件。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Fondation Net-Care.ch; conditions: Hypertension, Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2, Obesity; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1600; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The SOFIA study evaluates a web-based health application for people living with one or more chronic conditions. The study aims to find out whether the SOFIA application is useful, easy to use, and used over time by participants. The SOFIA application offers tools to support the day-to-day management of health: lifestyle challenges, health data entry and personal tracking (e.g., blood pressure, weight), medication tracking for people using pochettes-doses (pharmacy-prepared unit-dose packets), and an AI conversational assistant providing general health information. The application does not make diagnoses, give personalized medical advice, or recommend treatment. It complements usual medical care but does not replace it. The study first enrolls people with hypertension, then, subject to ethics committee approval, people with type 2 diabetes and obesity. Participation takes place entirely online, through the SOFIA application, accessible from a web browser (smartphone, tablet, or computer). There are no in-person visits. Participants use the application freely, at their own pace, until the end of the study. Short questionnaires (most take 1 to 3 minutes) are offered in the application during the study, and a final questionnaire (about 20 minutes) at the end.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Fondation Net-Care.ch；疾病：高血压、2型糖尿病、肥胖；类型：干预性；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：1600；状态：尚未开始招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] SOFIA研究评估一款面向患有一种或多种慢性疾病人群的基于网络的健康应用程序。该研究旨在了解SOFIA应用程序是否有用、易于使用，以及是否会被参与者长期使用。SOFIA应用程序提供支持日常健康管理的工具：生活方式挑战、健康数据录入和个人追踪（如血压、体重）、为使用pochettes-doses（药房配制的单位剂量包装）者提供用药追踪，以及提供一般健康信息的人工智能对话助手。该应用程序不进行诊断、不提供个性化医疗建议，也不推荐治疗。它补充常规医疗照护，但不替代常规医疗照护。该研究首先入组高血压患者，随后在获得伦理委员会批准的前提下，入组2型糖尿病和肥胖患者。参与完全在线进行，通过SOFIA应用程序完成，可通过网页浏览器（智能手机、平板电脑或计算机）访问。无面对面访视。参与者在研究结束前可按自己的节奏自由使用该应用程序。研究期间会在应用程序中提供简短问卷（多数耗时1至3分钟），研究结束时提供最终问卷（约20分钟）。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Obstetricians, and Midwives in Non-Stress Test Interpretation

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Bilecik Seyh Edebali Universitesi; conditions: Non-Stress Test Interpretation, Fetal Well-Being Assessment; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 300; status: RECRUITING] This prospective observational study aims to evaluate and compare the interpretation of antenatal non-stress tests (NSTs) by three artificial intelligence models, three obstetricians, and three midwives. A total of 300 NST recordings obtained during routine antenatal care will be collected and prepared in PDF format. The recordings will be distributed to the evaluators, who will independently assess NST reactivity and recommend appropriate clinical management within two weeks. Two perinatologists will independently evaluate the NST recordings to establish the reference standard. In cases of disagreement, a third perinatologist will be consulted to determine the final reference assessment. The study will compare the diagnostic performance, agreement with the reference standard, and inter-rater agreement among artificial intelligence models, obstetricians, and midwives.

title: A Primer on Radiomics for the Practicing Orthopaedic Surgeon.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews

key_points: 介绍AI在骨科中的应用范畴
