abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is permeating many aspects of daily life. Medicine, and specifically orthopaedic surgery, is being influenced by the rapid growth and success of AI in serving as an adjunct to medical expertise. AI includes many nested subfields and applications such as computer vision, language models, and predictive analytics. Using standard machine learning methods, clinical decision support tools are being developed for clinicians to provide evidence-based, individualized care. Some models predict clinical and functional outcomes after a procedure, whereas others may incorporate administrative metrics to predict factors, such as length of stay, return to the emergency department, and complications. The application of AI to medical imaging focuses on the extraction of a large amount of quantitative data in the form of predefined features from clinical images that humans cannot perceive, a field known as radiomics. There has been recent interest, particularly in oncology, to apply radiomics to aid in diagnosis and prognostication of outcomes. Given the robust growth of radiomics literature, and the anticipated application in orthopaedic surgery, the purpose of this review article is to educate the orthopaedic surgery community on the practical importance and the basics of radiomics.
zh_abstract: [《美国骨科医师学会杂志。全球研究与评论》] 人工智能（AI）正在渗透日常生活的许多方面。医学，特别是骨科手术，正受到AI在作为医学专业知识辅助手段方面快速发展和成功的影响。AI包括许多嵌套的子领域和应用，例如计算机视觉、语言模型和预测分析。利用标准机器学习方法，正在为临床医生开发临床决策支持工具，以提供循证、个体化照护。一些模型预测操作后的临床和功能结局，而另一些模型可能纳入管理指标以预测住院时长、重返急诊科和并发症等因素。AI在医学影像中的应用侧重于从临床图像中提取大量以预定义特征形式存在的、人类无法感知的定量数据，这一领域被称为放射组学。近期尤其肿瘤学领域有兴趣应用放射组学来辅助诊断和预后判断。鉴于放射组学文献的强劲增长及其在骨科手术中的预期应用，本综述文章的目的是让骨科手术界了解放射组学的实际重要性和基础知识。

title: Automation and artificial intelligence in the clinical microbiology laboratory.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
zh_title: 临床微生物实验室自动化与AI综述
summary: 综述梳理临床微生物实验室自动化与AI证据的成熟度分布及落地含义。
key_points: 自动化平台在观察性/多中心研究中缩短培养周转
收益幅度受标本类型与流程配置影响
自动判读与药敏对常见标本与人工标准一致性高
reason: 综述按成熟度梳理证据且无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Clinical microbiology laboratories face persistent pressure to shorten turnaround times, reduce manual workloads, and standardize diagnostic workflows. Total laboratory automation (TLA) and artificial intelligence (AI) are complementary responses to these demands. In this review, we examine how the evidence base for automation and AI in clinical microbiology is distributed along a maturity gradient and what this distribution implies for the next phase of implementation. Available evidence indicates that automated platforms shorten culture turnaround times and reduce manual workload in observational and multi-center studies, although the scale of benefit depends on specimen type and workflow configuration. Automated reading, identification, and susceptibility testing systems showed high concordance with manual standards for common specimen types, with error rates below commonly cited acceptability thresholds. Evidence for AI performance in plate reading and resistance prediction is abundant; however, most models remain in an assistive phase without prospective validation. Randomized trials of rapid testing and automation rarely demonstrate overall clinical superiority, and patient-oriented benefits remain limited and inconsistent. Guidelines provide directional support, whereas interoperability, quality control, and regulatory frameworks are still under development. The priority of the field is not additional single-center performance validation. The next phase requires multi-center prospective verification, interpretability, standardization, and comparative evidence with clinical outcomes as endpoints. AI-assisted evidence tools may accelerate evidence generation, although their utility remains preliminary.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] 临床微生物实验室面临持续压力，需缩短周转时间、减少人工工作量并标准化诊断工作流程。全实验室自动化（total laboratory automation, TLA）与人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）是对这些需求的互补性应对。在本综述中，我们考察临床微生物学中自动化与AI的证据基础如何沿成熟度梯度分布，以及这种分布对下一阶段实施意味着什么。现有证据表明，自动化平台在观察性研究和多中心研究中缩短培养周转时间并减少人工工作量，尽管获益规模取决于标本类型和工作流程配置。自动判读、鉴定和药敏试验系统在常见标本类型上与人工标准显示出高度一致性，错误率低于通常引用的可接受阈值。AI在平板判读和耐药性预测中的性能证据丰富；然而，大多数模型仍处于辅助阶段，尚未经过前瞻性验证。快速检测和自动化的随机试验很少证明总体临床优效性，以患者为导向的获益仍然有限且不一致。指南提供方向性支持，而互操作性、质量控制和监管框架仍在发展中。该领域的优先事项不是更多单中心性能验证。下一阶段需要多中心前瞻性验证、可解释性、标准化，以及以临床结局为终点的比较性证据。AI辅助证据工具可能加速证据生成，尽管其效用仍处于初步阶段。

title: Rho: A Purpose-Driven Workspace for Human-AI Collaborative Analysis
zh_title: Rho：面向科研目的的人机协作分析工作区
summary: bioRxiv预印本介绍Rho，一个按当前科学问题组织材料与判断依据的人机协作分析环境，并作为智能体的延续上下文。
key_points: 将分析判断所需材料组织为共享状态
同时作为研究者阅读界面与智能体上下文
以设计描述为主，未报告量化评测
reason: 工具设计类预印本，缺乏定量对比与评测，属增量档
abstract: Agent-assisted bioinformatics has moved the bottleneck from computing a result to judging it: whether a comparison answers the intended question, on which unit of replication, at which version of the input, and what would change the conclusion. These judgments need materials that are usually scattered across conversations, notebooks, figures, run logs and notes, while the agent's context is a transcript rather than the structure the researcher is actually reading. We present Rho, a human--AI collaborative analysis environment that organizes materials by the current scientific purpose: it selects or obtains the materials a judgment needs, declares the relations they serve, composes operable views, and makes this organization a shared state that is at once the researcher's reading interface and the agent's continuation context. We present the design in three parts: a method object---the operations that form a round-trip, the kinds of state that must stay distinct, and the protocol invariants that make each distinction checkable; a three-layer architecture that separates capability providers from the application that composes them; and five illustrative analyses on public data. In a bulk RNA-seq case the recomputed counts differed from the published counts and the interface kept the computation, the choices and the discrepancy available for inspection; a single-nucleus case makes sample-level replication visible behind a cell-level comparison. Under one configuration these analyses show how the design behaves in practice; we present the work as a design contribution rather than an evaluation, and usability, comparative benefit and the scientific validity of individual analyses remain to be evaluated.
zh_abstract: 智能体辅助的生物信息学已将瓶颈从计算结果转移到判断结果：一次比较是否回答了预期问题、在哪个重复单元上、基于哪个版本的输入，以及什么会改变结论。这些判断所需材料通常分散在对话、笔记本、图、运行日志和笔记中，而智能体的上下文是记录文本，而非研究者实际阅读的结构。我们提出 Rho，一种人类–AI 协作分析环境，它按当前科学目的组织材料：选择或获取判断所需材料，声明这些材料所服务的关系，组合可操作视图，并使这种组织成为共享状态，该状态同时是研究者的阅读界面和智能体的延续上下文。我们分三部分呈现设计：一个方法对象——构成往返的操作、必须保持区分的状态种类，以及使每种区分可检查的协议不变量；一个三层架构，将能力提供者与组合它们的应用分离；以及五个基于公开数据的示例性分析。在一个 bulk RNA-seq 案例中，重新计算的计数与已发表计数不同，界面将计算、选择及差异保留以供检查；一个单核案例使细胞水平比较背后的样本水平重复变得可见。在一种配置下，这些分析展示了该设计在实践中如何表现；我们将其作为设计贡献而非评估来呈现，可用性、比较优势以及各分析的科学有效性仍有待评估。

title: 3D Banff Glomerulitis Scoring for Kidney Transplant Pathology: Feasibility Study for Volumetric Quantification
zh_title: 肾移植病理3D Banff肾小球炎评分可行性研究
summary: 可行性研究提出三维Banff病变评分框架，对齐连续切片、跨深度重建肾小球身份并整合三维炎细胞计数。
key_points: 针对单切片「最严重切片」规则的切片间不稳定性
提出兼容、容积、去重容积三种评分策略
以肾小球炎g-score为示例指标在多切片活检上试验
reason: 预印本可行性研究，样本与验证信息有限，属增量档
abstract: Quantifying glomerular inflammation in kidney-transplant biopsies is traditionally performed on single whole-slide sections using the Banff "most-severe section" rule, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of lesion distribution. This 2D based assessment might lead to instability when inflammation varies across slices. This paper reports a feasibility study examining the technical feasibility and clinical relevance of extending Banff scoring into three dimensions. To this end, we propose a 3D Banff lesion-scoring framework that aligns serial sections, reconstructs glomerular identities across depth, and integrates inflammatory-cell counts in 3D under three scoring strategies: Compatible, Volumetric, and Deduplicated Volumetric. In the experiments, glomerulitis (g-scores) was used as an example Banff metric and applied to multi-section renal allograft biopsies. Our findings indicate that 3D Banff g-scores are more consistent across sections and, under the semi-automatic setting, the Volumetric strategy correlates more strongly with clinical biomarkers than traditional 2D scores. These results show that 3D volumetric quantification offers promising added value, underscoring the potential benefit of 3D-aware Banff scoring for kidney transplant pathology.
zh_abstract: 在肾移植活检中量化肾小球炎症传统上是在单个全切片上使用Banff“最严重切片”规则进行，尽管病变分布本质上具有三维性质。当炎症在不同切片间变化时，这种基于2D的评估可能导致不稳定性。本文报告了一项可行性研究，考察将Banff评分扩展到三维的技术可行性和临床相关性。为此，我们提出一个3D Banff病变评分框架，该框架对齐连续切片、在深度上重建肾小球身份，并在三种评分策略下整合3D炎症细胞计数：兼容性（Compatible）、体积性（Volumetric）和去重体积性（Deduplicated Volumetric）。实验中，以肾小球炎（g评分）作为示例Banff指标，并应用于多切片同种异体肾移植活检。我们的发现表明，3D Banff g评分在切片间更一致，并且半自动设置下，Volumetric策略与临床生物标志物的相关性比传统2D评分更强。这些结果表明，3D体积量化提供了有前景的附加价值，强调了3D感知Banff评分对肾移植病理学的潜在益处。

title: Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa
zh_title: 豪萨语医学语音识别仅文本域自适应
summary: 预印本：在固定声学模型上用浅融合与密度比重打分，将豪萨语医学语音词错率由29.56%降至约23.3%。
key_points: 仅用文本语料做解码期语言模型融合
250段录音、10名说话者、豪萨语医学提示
两种方法词错率降至23.55%与23.33%
reason: 小样本单语种预印本，方法常规，属增量档
abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p < 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM's additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that lightweight, text-only language-model fusion can improve Hausa medical ASR without additional domain-specific speech collection.
zh_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统常难以处理专业医学词汇，尤其在领域特定语音数据稀缺的低资源语言中。我们使用固定的 MMS-1B-FL102 声学模型和两种解码时语言模型融合方法——浅融合（Shallow Fusion, SF）和密度比方法（Density Ratio Approach, DRA）——研究豪萨语医学 ASR 的纯文本领域自适应。一个在 19,421 条豪萨语健康句子上训练的 4-gram KenLM 作为医学目标模型，而一个 75,372 句的通用领域模型为 DRA 提供源先验。评估使用来自尼日利亚北部六个州的 10 名说话人的 25 条经医生审核提示的 250 条录音。在提示不相交的五折交叉验证下，SF 和 DRA 将 WER 分别从 29.56% 降至 23.55% 和 23.33%。两者均显著优于贪心解码（p < 0.001），而二者差异不显著（p = 0.423）。然而，仅使用通用 LM 的 SF 达到 23.96% WER，表明医学 LM 相对于通用 LM 的额外提升有限。融合下医学术语错误率也有所改善，但并未确立独特的医学领域优势。这些发现表明，轻量级、纯文本的语言模型融合可以在无需额外收集领域特定语音的情况下改善豪萨语医学 ASR。

title: Mitigating Spurious Invariance in Contrastive Learning: A Probabilistic Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Medical Image Analysis
zh_title: 概率化自监督学习缓解医学图像伪不变性
summary: 预印本：将对比学习特征编码为概率分布以减轻医学图像增强导致的伪不变性，并统一多种自监督框架。
key_points: 指出对比学习不变性在医学图像中可能虚假
用概率分布嵌入替代固定向量
统一框架声称优于现有自监督方法
reason: 有新意的方法类预印本，但缺少外部验证与细节，属增量偏上
abstract: Owing to the prohibitive cost of manual annotation for enormous medical images, self-supervised learning (SSL) has gained substantial attention and shown promise in various medical imaging tasks. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has emerged as a prominent one, encouraging models to encode semantic information that remains invariant between different augmented views. However, this invariance can be spurious for medical images, as subtle but critical medical features can be suppressed during augmentations. In this paper, we mitigate this issue by encoding the learned feature embeddings as probability distributions rather than fixed vectors, thus capturing a richer and more nuanced spectrum of information. Furthermore, we propose a unified probabilistic framework that seamlessly integrates multiple SSL approaches. Our method achieves superior performance over the state-of-the-art SSL methods on various downstream tasks across multiple datasets, including medical image segmentation and classification. We further validate the method through additional analyses of robustness to stronger augmentations, label efficiency under limited fine-tuning labels, and computational trade-offs. The code is released at https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL.
zh_abstract: 由于对海量医学图像进行人工标注的成本高得难以承受，自监督学习（SSL）受到广泛关注，并在多种医学影像任务中展现出前景。在 SSL 方法中，对比学习已成为一种突出的方法，它鼓励模型编码在不同增强视图之间保持不变的语义信息。然而，对于医学图像，这种不变性可能是虚假的，因为细微但关键的医学特征可能在增强过程中被抑制。本文通过将学习到的特征嵌入编码为概率分布而非固定向量来缓解该问题，从而捕获更丰富、更细致的信息谱。此外，我们提出一个统一概率框架，无缝集成多种 SSL 方法。我们的方法在多个数据集的多种下游任务上优于最先进的 SSL 方法，包括医学图像分割和分类。我们进一步通过额外分析验证该方法，包括对更强增强的鲁棒性、有限微调标签下的标签效率以及计算权衡。代码发布于 https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL。

title: High-Resolution Quantitative MRI Using Contrast-Domain Multiscale Energy (MuSE) Regularization
zh_title: 对比域多尺度能量正则的高分辨定量MRI重建
summary: 将扩散模型先验施加于合成对比图像，从不足5分钟扫描重建0.5mm各向同性定量MRI。
key_points: 体素体积较临床协议小约八倍
先验作用于合成对比图像，独立于时间基与序列
多尺度能量模型仅在CelebA人脸灰度图上训练
reason: 重建方法有新颖性，但条目未见临床任务评估或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Quantitative MRI methods can offer tissue parameter maps (e.g. T1) that are comparable across scanners, sessions and subjects, together with multiple contrast-weighted images from a single scan. However, most data are acquired at 1 mm, which limits their use in neurodegenerative diseases that affect fine brain structures. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first diffusion-model-based reconstruction for quantitative MRI at 0.5 mm isotropic resolution from scans of less than 5 minutes, which has eightfold smaller voxel volume than clinical protocols. The key idea is to apply the prior to the synthesized contrast images rather than to the subspace coefficients. The prior is then independent of the temporal basis and the sequence, which improves generalization and allows a 2-D multiscale energy (MuSE) model trained on grayscale CelebA face images to be used without any MRI training data. The explicit energy makes reconstruction MAP estimation by a step-size-free majorize-minimize algorithm that regularizes a rotating subset of contrasts along different axes, which makes 3-D multi-contrast reconstruction tractable. For 3-D radial MPnRAGE at 7 T in 4.3 min, MuSE reduced the phantom NRMSE from 0.133 (CG-SENSE) and 0.091 (L1-wavelet) to 0.074 and the WM T1 interquartile range from 117 and 47 ms to 38 ms, and it was demonstrated in vivo at 7 T.
zh_abstract: 定量MRI方法可提供跨扫描仪、会话和被试可比较的组织参数图（例如T1），并可一次扫描获得多幅对比加权图像。然而，大多数数据以1 mm采集，这限制了其在影响精细脑结构的神经退行性疾病中的应用。我们提出据我们所知首个基于扩散模型的定量MRI重建，可在小于5分钟的扫描中实现0.5 mm各向同性分辨率，其体素体积比临床协议小八倍。关键思想是将先验应用于合成对比图像，而不是应用于子空间系数。这样先验便独立于时间基和序列，从而改善泛化能力，并允许使用在灰度CelebA人脸图像上训练的二维多尺度能量（MuSE）模型，而无需任何MRI训练数据。显式能量通过无步长的majorize-minimize算法使重建成为MAP估计，该算法对不同轴上的旋转对比子集进行正则化，从而使三维多对比重建变得可行。对于7 T、4.3 min的三维径向MPnRAGE，MuSE将体模NRMSE从0.133（CG-SENSE）和0.091（L1-wavelet）降至0.074，并将白质（WM）T1四分位距从117和47 ms降至38 ms，并在7 T下进行了在体验证。

title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
zh_title: 扩散插件先验的自监督超声视频复原
summary: UltraDiff以冻结扩散模型为插件先验，无需配对数据即可联合超分与去斑超声视频。
key_points: 通过优化采样器潜在种子求解范围约束MAP
由瑞利尺度族模型推导散斑感知数据保真项
无需配对高分辨数据，也无需重新训练网络
reason: 无配对数据的复原方法较实用，但条目未见下游任务或外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 超声视频受限于硬件约束的空间分辨率和依赖信号的斑点噪声，而用于监督式恢复的配对低分辨率与高分辨率采集数据很少可获得。我们旨在无需配对训练数据或网络再训练的情况下，对超声视频联合进行超分辨和去斑点。我们提出 UltraDiff，它使用冻结的预训练扩散模型（DM）作为插件式先验，并在范围约束的最大后验公式下，通过优化 DM 采样器的潜在种子来恢复每一帧。我们从瑞利尺度族模型推导出一个斑点感知的数据保真项，并刻画其相对残差与方差自适应加权特性。我们进一步引入一种稳定化的保真项，在其未截断形式下，对于正观测值，该保真项在对数强度上具有下界且严格凸。全变分正则项补充 DM 先验，时间种子更新利用前一帧优化后的种子对每一帧进行热启动。在具有模拟斑点噪声和加性噪声的 EchoNet-LVH 视频上，使用自然图像先验的 UltraDiff 相比最强基线将 PSNR 提高 1.24 dB，而超声相关先验进一步提高该指标。在真实临床超声心动图视频上，相对于最强基线 DUP，UltraDiff 将零样本射血分数（EF）预测的平均绝对误差从 7.31 降至 6.37 个 EF 点。将斑点感知保真项与冻结扩散先验相结合，可实现无需真值的超声视频恢复，并有利于下游测量。UltraDiff 既不需要配对数据，也不需要再训练，且不绑定于特定的扩散检查点。与本研究相关的代码将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
zh_title: Dual-VaDE：双域混合先验的可解释解剖原型学习
summary: 提出耦合空间解剖与傅里叶频谱的双域高斯混合先验生成框架，从无标注医学图像学习可解释原型。
key_points: 以双域混合先验显式耦合空间解剖与保相频谱表示
推导闭式变分下界，用交替EM端到端优化
在OASIS-3脑MRI上原型更锐利且更合理
reason: 方法类预印本，仅单数据集脑MRI结果、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).
zh_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出Dual-VaDE，一种无监督生成框架，用于从无标注医学图像中学习可解释的解剖原型。与先前依赖单一空间潜码的变分方法相比——这类方法常将全局几何与局部纹理纠缠在一起，且无法捕捉其跨域依赖——Dual-VaDE引入双域高斯混合先验，显式地将空间解剖与保相傅里叶频谱表示耦合起来。我们推导出一个精确的闭式变分下界，将该联合先验融合到解码器中，并通过交替EM公式端到端优化整个网络，避免启发式两阶段聚类，同时确保更优的训练稳定性和鲁棒性。在OASIS-3脑MRI上评估，Dual-VaDE生成显著更清晰、更合理的原型，实现更优的聚类分离，相比仅空间基线最高提升94%，在随机种子间表现出显著降低的方差，并产生可忽略的推理开销（每幅图像0.28 ms）。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will develop and test an artificial intelligence (AI) model that estimates the risk of type 2 diabetes among senior (third- and fourth-year) nursing students at the Faculty of Nursing, Alexandria University, Egypt. Type 2 diabetes is common in Egypt, and many cases are not diagnosed. Daily habits such as diet, physical activity, and body weight play a major role in who develops it. Nursing students will become health care providers who teach patients about healthy living, so it is important to find those who may be at risk early. About 200 students will take part. Each student will complete a questionnaire about personal information and the Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile II, which measures health habits such as nutrition, physical activity, stress management, and health responsibility. The researcher will measure height, weight, waist size, and blood pressure. Each student's diabetes risk will be scored using the Arabic version of the Australian Type 2 Diabetes Risk Assessment Tool (AUSDRISK), which classifies risk as low, moderate, or high. These data will be used to build a machine learning model that predicts each student's diabetes risk level from lifestyle and body measurement factors, and shows which factors influenced the prediction most. Students will then try the model and rate how useful and easy to use it is. No treatment or intervention will be given. The study aims to support early identification of students at risk and to provide a model that nursing education programs and community health nurses could use in preventive health efforts.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：亚历山大大学（Alexandria University）；疾病：2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：200；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本研究将开发并测试一个人工智能（AI）模型，用于估计埃及亚历山大大学护理学院高年级（三年级和四年级）护理学生中2型糖尿病的风险。2型糖尿病在埃及很常见，且许多病例未被诊断。饮食、体力活动和体重等日常习惯在谁会发生该病方面起主要作用。护理学生将成为向患者传授健康生活知识的医疗服务提供者，因此尽早发现可能处于风险中的人很重要。约200名学生将参与。每名学生将完成一份关于个人信息的问卷和健康促进生活方式量表II（Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile II），该量表测量营养、体力活动、压力管理和健康责任等健康习惯。研究者将测量身高、体重、腰围和血压。每名学生的糖尿病风险将使用澳大利亚2型糖尿病风险评估工具（Australian Type 2 Diabetes Risk Assessment Tool, AUSDRISK）的阿拉伯语版本进行评分，该工具将风险分为低、中、高。这些数据将用于构建机器学习模型，该模型根据生活方式和身体测量因素预测每名学生的糖尿病风险等级，并显示哪些因素对预测影响最大。随后学生将试用该模型，并评价其有用性和易用性。不会给予任何治疗或干预。本研究旨在支持早期识别处于风险中的学生，并提供一个护理教育项目和社区健康护士可在预防性健康工作中使用的模型。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital; conditions: Medical Education, Generative AI; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 90; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this study is to develop and evaluate an intelligent system based on generative artificial intelligence (AI) for assessing clinical thinking and decision-making abilities in medical students. Participants will complete clinical case-based tasks designed to assess their clinical reasoning and decision-making abilities. zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital；状况：医学教育、生成式人工智能；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；阶段：NA；入组人数：90；状态：COMPLETED】本研究的目标是开发并评估一种基于生成式人工智能（AI）的智能系统，用于评估医学生的临床思维和决策能力。研究将检验基于 AI 的评估系统能否对医学生在临床情景中的表现提供可靠且有效的评估。参与者将完成基于临床病例的任务，这些任务旨在评估其临床推理和决策能力。其回答将使用基于 AI 的系统进行评估，并与使用既有评估方法和/或专家评分所作评估进行比较。本研究结果可能有助于确定生成式 AI 能否作为评估医学教育中临床思维和决策技能的实用工具。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Touro University, California; conditions: Stress (Psychology), Resilience, Psychological, Anxiety, Depressive Symptoms, Well-being; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 43; status: COMPLETED] Medical students often experience high levels of stress, anxiety, and poor sleep, especially during their first year and around exams. This study looked at whether adding hands-on osteopathic manipulative treatment (OMT) to a wellness program built around a wearable ring and an artificial intelligence (AI) health coaching app could help first-year medical students. Forty-three first-year osteopathic medical students at one college took part. Each student was randomly assigned, by chance rather than by choice, to one of three groups for 23 weeks: a wearable ring alone; a wearable ring plus an AI health coaching app; or a wearable ring, the AI health coaching app, and seven OMT sessions given about every three weeks by osteopathic physicians. All students wore the ring daily. The ring recorded information such as sleep, heart rate, and heart rate variability, which is a measure of how the nervous system responds to stress. Students also completed questionnaires about resilience and about symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress at three points: before the semester, in the middle, and at the end. Students answered additional surveys about their experience two months and seven months after the study ended. This was a small pilot study. Its main purpose was to find out whether a program like this can be carried out successfully and to gather the information needed to plan a larger study, rather than to determine whether OMT works. No harmful effects were reported.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：加利福尼亚州 Touro University；疾病/状况：压力（心理学）、心理韧性、焦虑、抑郁症状、幸福感；类型：干预性；阶段：NA；入组人数：43；状态：已完成] 医学生常经历高水平压力、焦虑和睡眠不佳，尤其在第一学年和考试前后。本研究考察在围绕可穿戴戒指和人工智能（AI）健康指导应用构建的健康项目中加入动手的整骨手法治疗（osteopathic manipulative treatment, OMT）是否能帮助一年级医学生。一所学院的43名一年级整骨医学生参与。每名学生通过随机分配（凭偶然而非选择）进入三组之一，持续23周：仅可穿戴戒指；可穿戴戒指加AI健康指导应用；或可穿戴戒指、AI健康指导应用以及由整骨医师大约每三周一次给予的七次OMT。所有学生每天佩戴戒指。戒指记录睡眠、心率和心率变异性等信息，其中心率变异性是衡量神经系统如何应对压力的一项指标。学生还在三个时间点完成关于心理韧性以及抑郁、焦虑和压力症状的问卷：学期前、学期中和学期末。研究结束两个月和七个月后，学生回答了关于其体验的额外调查。这是一项小型试点研究。其主要目的是了解此类项目能否成功实施，并收集规划更大规模研究所需的信息，而非确定OMT是否有效。未报告有害影响。

title: Artificial intelligence-empowered 4D bioprinting for craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction: a comprehensive review.

reason: 综述类，AI为其中一个组成部分，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Craniomaxillofacial subunit transplantation represents one of the most technically demanding reconstructive strategies for repairing anatomical subunit defects involving the cranium, mandible, maxilla, orbital cavity and nose. Conventional reconstructive approaches are hindered by inherent limitations in personalized anatomical matching, dynamic tissue adaptability, and long-term therapeutic efficacy. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and four-dimensional (4D) bioprinting has revolutionized craniomaxillofacial reconstructive surgery. This review summarizes state-of-the-art advances in AI-enabled 4D bioprinting for craniomaxillofacial subunit repair, covering core application scenarios including bone defect regeneration, facial soft tissue and cutaneous organ reconstruction, peripheral neural regeneration, and vascularized composite tissue fabrication. We elaborate the synergistic potential of AI and 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction, and dissect critical bottlenecks including inadequate material performance, low precision of shape deformation programming, and limited clinical translatability of existing AI models. This work provides valuable insights for further translational research of AI-integrated 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction.
zh_abstract: 【Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology】颅颌面子单元移植是修复涉及颅骨、下颌骨、上颌骨、眶腔和鼻的解剖子单元缺损时技术上要求最高的重建策略之一。传统重建方法受制于个性化解剖匹配、动态组织适应性以及长期治疗效果方面的固有局限。人工智能（AI）与四维（4D）生物打印的整合已使颅颌面重建外科发生革命性变化。本综述总结了AI赋能的4D生物打印用于颅颌面子单元修复的最新进展，涵盖骨缺损再生、面部软组织与皮肤器官重建、周围神经再生以及血管化复合组织构建等核心应用场景。我们阐述了AI与4D生物打印在颅颌面子单元重建中的协同潜力，并剖析了关键瓶颈，包括材料性能不足、形状变形编程精度低以及现有AI模型临床可转化性有限。本工作为AI整合的4D生物打印在颅颌面子单元重建中的进一步转化研究提供了有价值的见解。

summary: 预印本：在Kermany公开SD-OCT数据集上评估EfficientNet-B0至B7的四分类性能与效率权衡。
key_points: 八个ImageNet预训练变体，224×224固定分辨率

reason: 单数据集回顾性比较，只报告准确率差异，属增量档
abstract: Background/Objectives: CNNs perform well in retinal disease classification from spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT), but whether EfficientNet's natural-image scaling hierarchy transfers to medical-image transfer learning at fixed resolution remains unclear. This study evaluates EfficientNet-B0-B7 for four-class SD-OCT classification and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Methods: Eight ImageNet-pretrained variants (4.05-64.10M instantiated backbone parameters) were evaluated at 224x224 on the Kermany dataset. Grayscale images were replicated to RGB and processed using model-embedded preprocessing and augmentation. Training comprised frozen-backbone head training followed by partial fine-tuning. Metrics covered classification, discrimination, efficiency, and visual analyses. Results: Test accuracy varied non-monotonically from 95.93% (B0) to 96.95% (B1); B7 achieved 96.73%. B1 had the highest accuracy and Drusen F1 (0.8780), while B7 had Drusen F1 of 0.8720 and the highest Drusen recall (0.9177). Drusen had the lowest F1 across all variants and contributed 82.2% of the summed squared deviation in class-specific F1; class ranking remained Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen. The OCT accuracy ranking differed from the reported ImageNet hierarchy, where B7 ranked first. The accuracy-to-parameter ratio fell from 19.82 to 1.48 percentage points per million total parameters. The final train-test gap had a weak, non-significant association with test accuracy (r = 0.26, p = 0.53). Conclusions: Larger EfficientNet variants did not consistently improve SD-OCT classification. B1 achieved the highest accuracy and Drusen F1, whereas B7 showed a secondary accuracy recovery at greater model size and CPU latency, indicating task and protocol dependent scaling effects. As cross-partition duplicates have not been independently audited, results are conditional on the supplied split.
zh_abstract: 【背景/目的】卷积神经网络（CNN）在基于频域光学相干断层扫描（SD-OCT）的视网膜疾病分类中表现良好，但EfficientNet的自然图像缩放层级能否在固定分辨率下迁移到医学图像迁移学习仍不清楚。本研究评估EfficientNet-B0至B7用于四分类SD-OCT分类及准确率-效率权衡。【方法】在Kermany数据集上以224×224评估了八个ImageNet预训练变体（4.05-64.10M实例化骨干参数）。灰度图像被复制为RGB，并使用模型内置的预处理和增强进行处理。训练包括冻结骨干的头部训练，随后进行部分微调。指标涵盖分类、区分度、效率和视觉分析。【结果】测试准确率非单调变化，从95.93%（B0）到96.95%（B1）；B7达到96.73%。B1具有最高准确率和玻璃膜疣F1（0.8780），而B7的玻璃膜疣F1为0.8720，并具有最高的玻璃膜疣召回率（0.9177）。玻璃膜疣在所有变体中F1最低，并在类别特异F1的平方偏差总和中占82.2%；类别排序仍为Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen。OCT准确率排序与所报道的ImageNet层级不同，后者中B7排名第一。准确率与参数比从每百万总参数19.82个百分点降至1.48个百分点。最终训练-测试差距与测试准确率呈弱且不显著的关联（r=0.26，p=0.53）。【结论】更大的EfficientNet变体并未持续改善SD-OCT分类。B1取得了最高准确率和玻璃膜疣F1，而B7在更大模型规模和CPU延迟下表现出二次准确率回升，表明缩放效应取决于任务和方案。由于跨划分重复尚未经独立审计，结果以所提供的数据划分为条件。

title: RETBind: a patient-level multimodal foundation model for unified cross-modal retinal representation learning
zh_title: RETBind：患者级多模态视网膜基础模型
summary: 提出统一编码器的患者级多模态视网膜基础模型，用配对OCT与超广角眼底图做跨模态预训练。

abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, offering a practical path to patient-level diagnostic support. Foundation models further extend this potential by learning generalizable representations from large-scale unlabeled data, alleviating the burden of extensive manual annotation. However, existing ophthalmic foundation models largely rely on single-modality or modality-specific encoders, failing to capture patient-level cross-modal correspondence in real-world multimodal clinical workflows. To address these gaps, we propose RETBind, a patient-level multimodal foundation model with a unified encoder that explicitly learns cross-modal correspondence from paired clinical imaging using patient-level paired optical coherence tomography (OCT) and ultra-widefield (UWF) fundus imaging. This patient-level paired pretraining strategy enables the model to learn unified cross-modal representations of complementary information, improv-ing performance and robustness beyond single-modality approaches. Across nine benchmark datasets spanning ocular disease classification and segmentation tasks, RETBind achieved consistent improvements, particularly enhancing AUPR in clinically relevant imbalanced settings. Exploratory analyses further examined the potential of RETBind for systemic disease prediction from retinal imaging, collectively highlighting its ability to learn unified cross-modal representations within a single shared encoder, enabling direct interaction between modalities and supporting transfer across diverse retinal imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能 (AI) 在广泛的眼科任务中具有相当大的前景，为患者层面的诊断支持提供了实用路径。基础模型通过学习来自大规模未标注数据的可泛化表示进一步扩展这一潜力，减轻大量人工标注的负担。然而，现有眼科基础模型主要依赖单模态或模态特异性编码器，未能捕捉真实世界多模态临床工作流中的患者层面跨模态对应关系。为解决这些差距，我们提出 RETBind，一种患者层面多模态基础模型，具有统一编码器，利用患者层面配对的 optical coherence tomography (OCT) 和超广角 (UWF) 眼底成像，从配对临床影像中显式学习跨模态对应关系。这种患者层面配对预训练策略使模型能够学习互补信息的统一跨模态表示，相比单模态方法提升性能和稳健性。在涵盖眼病分类和分割任务的九个基准数据集上，RETBind 取得了一致改善，尤其在临床相关的失衡设置中提高 AUPR。探索性分析进一步检验了 RETBind 从视网膜成像预测系统性疾病的能力，共同突出其在一个共享编码器内学习统一跨模态表示的能力，使模态之间能够直接交互，并支持跨多种视网膜成像任务的迁移。

title: Emerging applications of machine learning and AI for predictive modeling in precision medicine
zh_title: 编辑述评：精准医学AI需先融合领域知识
summary: npj Digital Medicine编辑述评汇总31篇论文，主张精准医学AI须在训练前整合结构性领域知识，并转向机制可解释、人机协同与公平部署。
key_points: 汇总31篇论文，强调训练前融入领域知识
提出三类转变：机制可解释、人机协同、公平可及
定位从技术新奇走向可信的临床基础科学
reason: 编辑述评属综述观点类，上限6分；提出领域知识整合框架，信息量中等
abstract: Pure data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) is insufficient for clinical adoption. This editorial summarizes 31 papers showing that precision medicine requires integrating structural domain knowledge before model training. We identify three necessary transitions: anchoring algorithms in biological laws for mechanistic interpretability; designing collaborative, human-centered clinical interfaces; and scaling equitable, population-level interventions. These shifts advance medical AI from technical novelty toward trustworthy, clinically grounded, and ethically deployed foundational science.
zh_abstract: 纯数据驱动的人工智能（AI）不足以用于临床采纳。这篇社论总结了31篇论文，表明精准医学需要在模型训练之前整合结构化的领域知识。我们确定了三项必要的转变：将算法锚定于生物学规律以实现机制可解释性；设计协作式、以人为中心的临床界面；以及扩展公平的、人群层面的干预措施。这些转变推动医学AI从技术新奇性走向值得信赖、具有临床基础且合乎伦理部署的基础科学。

title: The TEMPO program and the future of digital mental health regulation in the US
zh_title: TEMPO项目与美国数字心理健康监管前景
summary: 评论文章分析FDA-CMS的TEMPO试点如何在未经上市前授权下为AI数字心理健康设备开辟监管中间地带。
key_points: TEMPO允许以质量管理体系替代即刻上市前许可
被视为真实世界数据监管沙盒
或重塑美国数字健康监管路径
reason: 监管沙盒的述评，有信息量但为观点文章，上限6分
abstract: The high burden of traditional FDA clearance drives many novel, AI-enabled mental health devices into unregulated consumer markets. The new FDA-CMS TEMPO pilot program establishes a vital regulatory middle ground, allowing companies to commercialize using a Quality Management System without immediate premarket authorization. This commentary explores how TEMPO serves as a sandbox for real-world data, offering a blueprint to reshape the future of US digital health regulation.
zh_abstract: 传统FDA许可的高负担促使许多新型、AI赋能的心理健康设备进入不受监管的消费市场。新的FDA-CMS TEMPO试点项目建立了一个至关重要的监管中间地带，允许公司在无需立即获得上市前授权（premarket authorization）的情况下，使用质量管理系统（Quality Management System）进行商业化。本评论探讨了TEMPO如何作为真实世界数据的沙盒，为重塑美国数字健康监管的未来提供蓝图。

title: Reducing radiographic retake rates with ultra-low dose pre-shots using deep learning-based noise reduction: A prospective clinical study.
zh_title: 深度学习降噪超低剂量预拍降低X线重拍率
summary: 前瞻性临床研究评估深度学习降噪支持的超低剂量预拍能否降低腕关节X线摄影的重拍率。
key_points: 体模实验将管电流时间积由2.8降至0.5 mAs
15名技师用5级置信度量表判定成像条件
开展前瞻性临床研究观察重拍率变化
reason: 前瞻性临床设计并报告工作流结局，但为单中心、样本量未明
abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] The pre-shot technique is an effective approach to lower retake radiography rates; however, it is limited by increased patient radiation exposure. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an ultra-low-dose pre-shot enabled by deep learning-based noise reduction (Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine: AiCE) on reducing retake rates in wrist radiography. A CXDI-810C (Canon Medical Systems) was used as the X-ray detector. Phantom images simulating lateral wrist pre-shots with and without AiCE were acquired under fixed imaging conditions using an additional 1.0 mm copper filter. The tube current-time product was reduced from 2.8 mAs to 0.5 mAs. Fifteen radiological technologists determined the optimal imaging condition using a five-point confidence scale, with scores below three considered insufficient for retake decision-making. A prospective clinical evaluation was then conducted, comparing retake rates between a non-pre-shot group (n = 542) and a pre-shot group (n = 325). The entrance surface air kerma (Ka,e) was estimated from phantom measurements. Without AiCE, no imaging condition met the threshold required for retake decision-making. Conversely, with AiCE, a tube current-time product of 1.6 mAs achieved acceptable image quality (3.29 ± 0.47), with all evaluators assigning scores ≥3; therefore, it was selected as the optimal condition. In the clinical evaluation, the retake rate markedly decreased from 14.38% to 0.61%. The pre-shot Ka,e was 0.11 ± 0.03 μGy, corresponding to only 0.15% of the standard lateral wrist radiography dose. AiCE-enabled ultra-low-dose pre-shot imaging dramatically reduced retake rates while requiring minimal additional radiation dose. The ultra-low-dose pre-shot using AiCE represents a highly effective strategy to minimize retake imaging with negligible dose penalty, offering substantial potential for dose optimization and improved workflow efficiency in clinical radiography.
zh_abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] 预拍摄（pre-shot）技术是降低X线摄影重拍率的有效方法；然而，它受到患者辐射暴露增加的局限。本研究旨在评估由基于深度学习的降噪（Advanced Intelligent Clear-IQ Engine：AiCE）实现的超低剂量预拍摄对降低腕关节X线摄影重拍率的影响。使用CXDI-810C（Canon Medical Systems）作为X射线探测器。在固定成像条件下，使用额外的1.0 mm铜滤过片，采集模拟腕关节侧位预拍摄的体模图像，分别有和无AiCE。管电流-时间乘积从2.8 mAs降至0.5 mAs。15名放射技师使用五点置信度量表确定最佳成像条件，低于3分被认为不足以进行重拍决策。随后进行了一项前瞻性临床评估，比较非预拍摄组（n = 542）和预拍摄组（n = 325）之间的重拍率。入射表面空气比释动能（Ka,e）由体模测量估算。无AiCE时，没有成像条件达到重拍决策所需的阈值。相反，有AiCE时，管电流-时间乘积为1.6 mAs达到可接受的图像质量（3.29 ± 0.47），所有评估者评分≥3；因此，它被选为最佳条件。在临床评估中，重拍率从14.38%显著降至0.61%。预拍摄的Ka,e为0.11 ± 0.03 μGy，仅相当于标准腕关节侧位X线摄影剂量的0.15%。AiCE实现的超低剂量预拍摄成像大幅降低了重拍率，同时仅需极少的额外辐射剂量。使用AiCE的超低剂量预拍摄代表了一种高效策略，可在剂量代价可忽略的情况下最大限度减少重拍成像，为临床X线摄影中的剂量优化和工作流程效率提升提供了巨大潜力。

title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model.
zh_title: 大模型心理治疗建议可被静默操纵
summary: 同行评审研究显示，对开放权重大模型施加推理时激活引导，可在不告知用户的情况下改变其抑郁症治疗推荐。
key_points: 12个抑郁建议场景，30档引导幅度
可静默偏移治疗推荐且不披露
仅测试单一开放权重模型
reason: 小样本单模型实验，但揭示LLM心理健康安全风险，属值得一看档
abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地为患者和临床医生的心理健康决策提供信息。推理时激活引导（activation steering）可以在不改变权重或提示词、且不向用户披露的情况下，使模型在目标维度上的行为发生偏移，从而使治疗建议可因商业或意识形态原因被悄然改变。【目的】确定方向性激活引导是否能改变一个开放权重LLM的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、场所与参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将方向性激活引导应用于一个开放权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），该模型对12个抑郁症建议场景作出回应（4个偏向药物治疗、4个偏向回避、4个中性）；这些回应在从-1.5到+1.5、以0.1为增量的30个振幅下生成，另加一个未引导基线。【暴露】一个单一的引导方向，将抗抑郁药物治疗与自我指导方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂）相对照；该方向由16个配对训练提示词构建，并施加于每个Transformer块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示词保持不变。【主要结局与指标】药物和四个自我照护类别被涉及的程度（由经人工验证的LLM评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按0至3分评分）、药物与自我照护之间的平衡，以及临床医生转介；使用以场景为随机截距的混合效应模型估计每单位振幅的变化。【结果】在372次生成中，引导使药物与自我照护之间的平衡产生分级、剂量依赖性的偏移，该平衡每单位振幅下降0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39至-0.25；P < .001）；药物涉及程度下降，自我照护涉及程度上升。对于未说明治疗偏好的场景，偏移最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54至-0.34；P < .001）。372份回应中有322份（87%）出现临床医生转介，且不随引导振幅变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这个提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重LLM中，推理时激活引导在不改变权重、提示词结构或安全性输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，且在未表达治疗偏好的用户中效应最大。这些发现表明，随着此类模型为临床决策提供信息，需要建立LLM披露标准和独立审计。

title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
zh_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract：出院小结结构化数据集
summary: 预印本发布从30万份MIMIC-IV出院小结抽取16个章节的大规模结构化数据集，结合规则解析与大模型生成。
key_points: 覆盖300,720份出院小结的16个章节
规则解析与大模型schema引导混合流程
补足MIMIC缺少的病史与用药信息
reason: 大规模公开可获取的临床NLP数据集，但为预印本
abstract: MIMIC is one of the most widely used public hospital datasets for machine learning on electronic health records, yet clinically important information, such as past medical history, allergies, and diagnostic findings, remains confined to free-text discharge summaries. Studies requiring this information must therefore build their own extraction pipelines, duplicating substantial effort across projects. We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables. MNE adds information that has no structured MIMIC counterpart and enriches related tables with broader coverage and greater clinical detail, including 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions. Validation by medical doctors confirms extraction accuracy above 92% across sections. Using MNE, we construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents, demonstrating how reusable structured representations of clinical narratives reduce data curation effort.
zh_abstract: MIMIC 是用于电子健康记录机器学习的最广泛使用的公共医院数据集之一，然而临床重要信息，如既往病史、过敏和诊断发现，仍局限于自由文本出院小结。因此，需要这些信息的研究必须建立自己的提取流程，在项目间重复大量工作。我们发布 MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE)，一个大规模数据集，采用混合提取流程，结合确定性解析与 schema 引导的大语言模型生成，将 300,720 份出院小结中的 16 个部分转换为结构化表格。MNE 增加了 MIMIC 中没有结构化对应信息的信息，并以更广覆盖和更细临床细节丰富相关表格，包括多 10 倍的患者病史条目，以及覆盖两倍以上入院次数的用药史。医生验证确认各部分提取准确率超过 92%。使用 MNE，我们为 LLM 智能体构建临床决策基准，展示临床叙事的可复用结构化表示如何减少数据整理工作。

title: CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E
zh_title: CellPlex：从H&E预测单细胞空间蛋白组的基准
summary: 构建覆盖7个队列、717个样本、约4480万细胞与149种蛋白的基准，评测从H&E推断单细胞空间蛋白组的方法。
key_points: 7个队列覆盖结直肠癌、乳腺癌、骨髓与胶质瘤
同切片H&E与多重免疫荧光，共717样本
统一流水线生成逐细胞标注以比较模型
reason: 多队列大规模基准且公开可比，属重要档；预印本上限8分
abstract: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.
zh_abstract: 空间蛋白质组学可测量组织切片中每个细胞的数十种蛋白质，但其成本使其局限于小型研究队列，而苏木精-伊红（H&E）切片几乎每位患者都有。从H&E推断单细胞空间蛋白质组学将使其分析进入常规病理学，越来越多的虚拟染色模型正在追求这一目标。每个模型都在各自队列、检测panel和像素级指标上评估，已发布模型向新队列的迁移效果差，从而留下应基于哪种方法以及H&E可揭示哪些蛋白质的问题。我们提出CellPlex，一个在细胞水平提出该任务的基准：七个队列具有同一切片的H&E和多路免疫荧光，涵盖结直肠癌和乳腺癌到淋巴结转移、骨髓和胶质瘤，包含717个样本、4480万个细胞和149种蛋白质，并通过同一流程处理为按细胞的目标。病理基础模型（PFMs）采用同一细胞水平方案进行适配，专业模型在匹配预算下进行微调，所有模型均在相同细胞上评分。适配后的PFMs在每个队列上都是最准确的模型，即使专业模型经过微调仍落后于它们，但在未训练过的队列上其准确率保留不到一半。可预测哪些蛋白质取决于组织，而不是取决于为这些蛋白质测量了多少细胞。通过固定用于评判预测的细胞、目标和数据划分，CellPlex为从常规H&E推断高成本分子测量设定了共同标准，并展示了H&E可在多大程度上替代空间蛋白质组学。我们将发布数据、数据划分、评估代码和基线，作为开发和比较未来病理基础模型与虚拟染色方法的测试平台。

title: Development, validation and AI chatbot evaluation of the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool.
zh_title: 青少年心理健康AI回复评估工具AMHART
summary: 开发并经临床医生审定的AMHART量表，结合大模型评估器审计四款主流聊天机器人的多轮回复。
key_points: 七维度量表经医生审定信效度
构建三模型LLM评估器与人工比对
测评ChatGPT、Claude等四款机器人
reason: 同行评审评估工具与多模型对比，但非临床结局研究，属值得一看档
abstract: [Nature. Mental health] Many adolescents seek mental health advice from general-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots, despite limited evaluations against youth-relevant clinical standards. We developed the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool (AMHART), a clinician-informed instrument for auditing the presence of guideline-informed response content across seven domains, and applied it to four major AI chatbots. Candidate items were reviewed by clinicians for their evidence base, objectivity, and clinical importance, yielding a subset with strong content validity and inter-rater reliability. We then configured a three-model large language model evaluator ensemble, assessed its agreement with human reference labels, and scored multi-turn conversations in which adolescent personas (varying by sex, diagnosis, and symptom severity) engaged with ChatGPT-5, ChatGPT-4, Claude-4.5, and Gemini-2.5. AMHART scores indicated greater coverage of applicable criteria for anxiety than depression and for moderate than severe presentations. Findings suggest AMHART offers a reliable, clinician-informed benchmark for evaluating chatbot responses to adolescent anxiety and depression disclosures.
zh_abstract: [Nature. abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] To synthesize the performance and methodological characteristics of fully automated deep learning algorithms for shoulder magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) segmentation. This systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 statement. CENTRAL, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore were searched from inception through July 17, 2026. The protocol specified fully automated deep learning-based pixel-wise segmentation of shoulder MRI, an expert-derived MRI-space reference standard, and quantitative segmentation metrics. Two reviewers independently screened records; unresolved disagreements were adjudicated by a senior reviewer. Overlapping datasets were linked during synthesis. Of 354 identified records, 169 duplicates were removed, 185 records were screened, and 53 full-text reports were assessed. Thirty-five reports were included (31 journal articles and 4 full conference papers; 2018-2026). U-Net-based encoder-decoder architectures predominated, with additional region-based, transformer, adversarial, and autoencoder approaches. Dice similarity coefficients ranged from approximately 0.81-0.99 for osseous targets, 0.71-0.99 for shoulder muscles, and 0.58-0.94 for tendon or tear regions; intersection-over-union values for tear or surgical-planning regions ranged from 0.45-0.83. MRI protocols and validation designs were heterogeneous, and most reports described retrospective single-center investigations. Five reports used independent external test sets; several others included multicenter images. Overlapping cohorts precluded a valid pooled participant count. Deep learning achieved high accuracy for shoulder bones and rotator-cuff muscles in selected datasets, whereas tear-region performance was more variable. Multicenter patient-level validation and standardized annotation and reporting are needed before routine clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine] 旨在综合肩部磁共振成像（MRI）全自动深度学习分割算法的性能和方法学特征。本系统综述遵循系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）2020 声明。检索了 CENTRAL、PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science 和 IEEE Xplore，检索时间从建库至 2026 年 7 月 17 日。方案规定纳入肩部 MRI 的全自动基于深度学习的逐像素分割、专家得出的 MRI 空间参考标准以及定量分割指标。两名综述作者独立筛选记录；未解决的分歧由一名资深综述作者裁定。在综合过程中对重叠数据集进行了关联。在 354 条识别记录中，去除 169 条重复记录，筛选 185 条记录，并评估 53 份全文报告。最终纳入 35 份报告（31 篇期刊文章和 4 篇完整会议论文；2018-2026 年）。基于 U-Net 的编码器-解码器架构占主导，另有基于区域、Transformer、对抗和自编码器等方法。Dice 相似系数范围约为：骨性目标 0.81-0.99，肩部肌肉 0.71-0.99，肌腱或撕裂区域 0.58-0.94；撕裂或手术规划区域的交并比值为 0.45-0.83。MRI 方案和验证设计存在异质性，大多数报告描述的是回顾性单中心研究。5 份报告使用了独立外部测试集；另有若干份纳入了多中心图像。重叠队列使得无法进行有效的合并参与者计数。在选定数据集中，深度学习对肩部骨骼和肩袖肌肉取得了高准确率，而撕裂区域的性能变化更大。在常规临床部署之前，需要多中心患者水平验证以及标准化标注和报告。

abstract: [Journal of nursing management] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming health care through advanced technologies that support clinical practice, education, workforce management, and decision making. As healthcare systems face growing challenges related to workforce shortages, increasing service demands, and rapid digital transformation, there is a need to understand how AI can contribute to the development of a future-ready nursing workforce equipped with the competencies required for modern healthcare environments. This systematic review aimed to examine the role of AI in developing a future-ready nursing workforce and to synthesize current evidence regarding its applications, benefits, challenges, and implications for workforce preparedness. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and was registered in PROSPERO. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and IEEE Xplore were searched for studies published between January 2015 and February 2026. Eligible primary studies examined an identifiable AI technology or an AI-specific construct in nursing education, clinical practice, workforce development, competency development, workforce planning, or professional preparedness. Methodological quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool, and findings were synthesized narratively. A total of 38 primary empirical studies satisfied the AI-specific eligibility criteria. The evidence was concentrated in cross-sectional (n = 15) and qualitative (n = 11) designs, with fewer development/prototype (n = 6), mixed methods (n = 3), randomized or quasi-experimental (n = 2), and methodological (n = 1) studies. AI-supported education, clinical decision support, workforce forecasting, and competency development showed promising benefits, but much of the evidence was based on perceptions, simulations, prototypes, or single-site evaluations rather than long-term implementation. Recurrent barriers included limited AI literacy, ethical and privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, infrastructure constraints, workflow integration, and organizational readiness. AI has promising, but still uneven, potential to support a future-ready nursing workforce. Current evidence supports cautious and staged integration rather than uncritical scale-up. Standardized AI and digital competency frameworks, human oversight, governance, infrastructure readiness, and prospective evaluation of effectiveness, equity, and cost are needed before widespread deployment. abstract: [Neurosurgical focus] The 2021 WHO CNS tumor classification marked a fundamental shift in neuro-oncology: molecular markers rather than histological appearance now define glioma diagnosis and guide treatment. Yet, in clinical practice the molecular information that matters most to a surgeon-IDH status, 1p/19q codeletion, and methylation class-typically arrives days to weeks after the operation it was meant to inform. Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to close that gap. Over the past several years, a growing body of work has demonstrated that AI models can extract diagnostically relevant molecular and histological information from data sources available in the operating room, in real time, at the point of surgical decision-making. In this review, the authors provide a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art intraoperative AI models available to neurosurgeons during brain tumor resections. They examine AI-augmented approaches to established intraoperative techniques, such as cryosection and fluorescence-guided surgery, before turning to novel technologies including nanopore sequencing and stimulated Raman histology (SRH). The authors conclude by discussing barriers to widespread clinical adoption and what lies ahead for this field. For cryosection, models such as LGNet and the Cryosection Histopathology Assessment and Review Machine (CHARM) have demonstrated strong performance on intraoperative discrimination of primary CNS lymphoma and molecular subtyping of glioma, respectively, with CHARM achieving areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.88-0.93 across glioma subtypes. In fluorescence-guided surgery, hyperspectral imaging combined with machine learning has enabled classification of tumor type, grade, and IDH mutation based on the 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) signal with up to 93% accuracy, extracting molecular information from a modality already present in the operating room. For nanopore-based methylation classification, ensemble models such as Rapid Nanopore Brain Intraoperative Classification (ROBIN) have achieved 90% concordance with the final diagnosis prospectively in under 2 hours. In SRH, foundation models for infiltration detection now outperform FLAIR, contrast enhancement, and 5-ALA fluorescence in identifying tumor margins, while molecular classification models have achieved over 90% glioma subtype accuracy in multi-institutional cohorts. abstract: Background. Estrogen receptor (ER), progesterone receptor (PR) and HER2 status guide systemic treatment in breast cancer. Multimodal models are rarely benchmarked against key biomarker molecular baselines or evaluated for cross-cohort calibration. We assessed incremental value, dependence on label-proximal HER2 transcripts, and transport of discrimination and calibration. Methods. A model combining whole-slide images, transcriptomes, age and stage was developed in TCGA-BRCA (1051 patients; ER/PR/HER2 analysis sets: 1001/998/1006) and evaluated in CPTAC-BRCA (120 patients; 118/113/95). CPTAC had been observed during earlier development and included 13 HER2-positive cases. Analyses included paired model comparisons, transcript removal, alternative loss functions and recalibration. Internal discrimination used pooled out-of-fold predictions; external discrimination used fold-mean estimates, with ensemble calibration reported separately. Internal calibration and macro-AUC uncertainty were interpreted as exploratory. Results. Internal AUCs were 0.943 for ER, 0.901 for PR, and 0.860 for HER2; external AUCs were 0.952, 0.937, and 0.918, respectively. External macro-AUC was 0.936 for the multimodal model and 0.957 for logistic regression using ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2 (difference -0.021). Removal of the extended 29-transcript 17q12-q21 region changed HER2 AUC by -0.035 [-0.058 to -0.013] (95% CI) internally and by -0.042 [-0.089 to -0.007] externally relative to the baseline multimodal model. For external 15-model ensemble predictions, recalibrated HER2 expected calibration error (ECE) was 0.236, exceeding the ECE reference ceiling of 0.125, while calibration-in-the-large was -1.657 [-2.373 to -1.023] (profile-likelihood 95% CI), indicating systematic overprediction. ER and PR also showed overprediction. In paired fold-mean comparisons, HER2 ECE and Brier score favoured the three-transcript model (ESR1, PGR, and ERBB2). Conclusions. A multimodal deep-learning model achieved high discrimination across cohorts but did not demonstrate clear incremental value over a parsimonious three-transcript baseline, while cross-cohort calibration remained a substantial challenge. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating incremental value, calibration, and clinical utility alongside discrimination when assessing AI-based prediction models for medical use.
zh_abstract: 【背景】雌激素受体（ER）、孕激素受体（PR）和HER2状态指导乳腺癌的全身治疗。多模态模型很少与关键生物标志物分子基线进行基准比较，也很少评估跨队列校准。我们评估了增量价值、对标签邻近HER2转录本的依赖性，以及判别力和校准的可迁移性。【方法】在TCGA-BRCA（1051例患者；ER/PR/HER2分析集：1001/998/1006）中开发了一个结合全切片图像、转录组、年龄和分期的模型，并在CPTAC-BRCA（120例患者；118/113/95）中进行评估。CPTAC在此前开发过程中已被观察过，并包括13例HER2阳性病例。分析包括配对模型比较、转录本移除、替代损失函数和重新校准。内部判别力采用合并的折外预测；外部判别力采用折均值估计，集成校准另行报告。内部校准和宏平均AUC（macro-AUC）的不确定性被解释为探索性。【结果】内部AUC分别为ER 0.943、PR 0.901和HER2 0.860；外部AUC分别为0.952、0.937和0.918。外部宏平均AUC在多模态模型中为0.936，在使用ESR1、PGR和ERBB2的逻辑回归中为0.957（差异-0.021）。移除扩展的29个转录本17q12-q21区域后，相对于基线多模态模型，HER2 AUC在内部变化-0.035 [-0.058至-0.013]（95% CI），在外部变化-0.042 [-0.089至-0.007]。对于外部15个模型集成预测，重新校准后的HER2期望校准误差（ECE）为0.236，超过ECE参考上限0.125，而整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为-1.657 [-2.373至-1.023]（轮廓似然95% CI），表明存在系统性过度预测。ER和PR也显示过度预测。在配对折均值比较中，HER2 ECE和Brier评分支持三转录本模型（ESR1、PGR和ERBB2）。【结论】多模态深度学习模型在各队列中实现了高判别力，但相较于简约的三转录本基线未显示出明确的增量价值，而跨队列校准仍是一个重大挑战。这些发现强调了在评估用于医疗用途的基于人工智能（AI）的预测模型时，除判别力外还应评估增量价值、校准和临床效用。

title: AI-based structural modelling and pathogenic variant mapping across the human protein interactome
