title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis
zh_title: MATS：可控可反思的多智能体肿瘤合成框架
summary: 预印本提出多智能体框架，实现文本可控、跨器官的肿瘤图像合成并闭环校验生成质量。
key_points: 刻画目标疾病的形态学属性分布
两阶段扩散生成肿瘤掩膜与纹理
闭环反思机制校验合成质量
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，缺少外部验证与临床结局
abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真的肿瘤有助于解决临床AI的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有的基于扩散的方法缺乏细粒度属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式代表性不足的认知。我们提出MATS，一个用于文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何形状和外观的细粒度属性空间上刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划：扩增代表性不足的亚型，同时保持常见亚型占主导。然后，它定位目标器官，提出解剖学上有效的放置位置，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜和渲染纹理，二者分别以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在整个合成过程的三个检查点验证属性对齐，并在检测到错位时提供针对性反馈以指导重新生成。仅在单源胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤数据集上训练，MATS在域内以及跨LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上均持续改善下游分割，而大多数先前的生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练。

title: Segment Anything Pancreas: A Unified MRI Segmentation Model for Pancreatic Cancer Radiotherapy
zh_title: Segment Anything Pancreas：胰腺癌放疗统一MRI分割模型
summary: 预印本提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，用共享MedNeXt编码器多任务头统一分割胰腺、亚区、肿瘤与危及器官。
key_points: 共享编码器加三输出头实现多任务分割
标注感知损失支持部分标注数据训练
在142例PANTHER患者上三折交叉验证
reason: 方法有新意的预印本，仅内部交叉验证、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Limited tumor annotations and incomplete labels across MRI datasets hinder unified segmentation of pancreatic tumors and organs at risk (OARs) for MRI-guided radiotherapy. Purpose: We propose Pancreas-MedNeXt, a unified model that segments the whole pancreas, its subregions, tumors, and surrounding OARs from one MRI volume. Methods: The model uses a shared MedNeXt encoder-decoder with supervised whole-pancreas and subregion pretraining, followed by multitask fine-tuning. Three output heads predict the pancreatic subregions, tumor, and OARs (stomach, duodenum, kidneys). An annotation-aware loss allows training on partially labeled data without treating unannotated structures as background. Pancreas and tumor were evaluated by three-fold cross-validation on 142 PANTHER patients (92 diagnostic, 50 MR-Linac), subregions and OARs on Cyst-X and AMOS test sets, and pancreas and OARs on 33 external T1-weighted TotalSegmentator scans. Comparisons with nnU-Net, MedNeXt, VISTA3D, and Swin UNETR used the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with paired bootstrap 95% CIs. Results: Pancreas-MedNeXt achieved the highest mean pancreas and tumor DSC on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI. Tumor DSC was 58.41% and 42.55%, exceeding task-specific MedNeXt by 4.94 (95% CI: 0.28-9.45) and 5.89 (95% CI: 2.37-9.72) percentage points, respectively. Whole-pancreas DSC was 85.73% and 70.66%. Pretraining improved head, body, and tail DSC by 2.01, 3.00, and 3.78 percentage points over training from scratch. It also achieved the highest DSC for the pancreas, duodenum, and right kidney on AMOS, and for all five organs on external MRI, exceeding the next-best method by 4.92-8.85 percentage points.Conclusion: A single Pancreas-MedNeXt model segments tumors, pancreatic subregions, and OARs on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI, which could streamline contouring for pancreatic cancer radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】MRI数据集中肿瘤标注有限且标签不完整，阻碍了MRI引导放疗中胰腺肿瘤和危及器官（OAR）的统一分割。【目的】我们提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，一种统一模型，可从单个MRI体积中分割全胰腺、其亚区、肿瘤及周围OAR。【方法】该模型使用共享的MedNeXt编码器-解码器，先进行有监督的全胰腺和亚区预训练，随后进行多任务微调。三个输出头分别预测胰腺亚区、肿瘤和OAR（胃、十二指肠、肾脏）。标注感知损失允许在部分标注数据上训练，而不会将未标注结构视为背景。胰腺和肿瘤在142例PANTHER患者（92例诊断性MRI，50例MR-Linac）上通过三折交叉验证评估，亚区和OAR在Cyst-X和AMOS测试集上评估，胰腺和OAR在33例外部T1加权TotalSegmentator扫描上评估。与nnU-Net、MedNeXt、VISTA3D和Swin UNETR的比较使用Dice相似系数（DSC）及配对bootstrap 95% CI。【结果】Pancreas-MedNeXt在诊断性和MR-Linac MRI上取得最高的平均胰腺和肿瘤DSC。肿瘤DSC分别为58.41%和42.55%，分别超过任务特异性MedNeXt 4.94（95% CI：0.28-9.45）和5.89（95% CI：2.37-9.72）个百分点。全胰腺DSC分别为85.73%和70.66%。与从头训练相比，预训练使头、体、尾DSC分别提高2.01、3.00和3.78个百分点。它还在AMOS上取得胰腺、十二指肠和右肾的最高DSC，并在外部MRI上取得全部五个器官的最高DSC，超过次优方法4.92-8.85个百分点。【结论】单一Pancreas-MedNeXt模型可在诊断性和MR-Linac MRI上分割肿瘤、胰腺亚区和OAR，有望简化胰腺癌放疗的勾画流程。

title: CAMEL: Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning for Ultra-Lightweight Retinal Foundation Models
zh_title: CAMEL：超轻量视网膜基础模型的跨架构掩码学习
summary: 预印本提出跨架构掩码嵌入学习方法CAMEL，旨在降低视网膜基础模型的计算开销以适配临床硬件约束。
key_points: 针对RETFound等模型算力开销过大的问题
采用跨架构掩码嵌入学习构建轻量模型
面向硬件受限场景的筛查部署需求
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Recent progress in deep learning has substantially advanced automated grading of ophthalmologic pathologies, supported by large annotated datasets and improved representation learning. However, a significant gap remains between state-of-the-art performance and clinical scalability. In particular, foundation models have reshaped image-based medical screening and diagnosis. These large-scale architectures trained on extensive datasets learn rich, generalizable feature representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In ophthalmology, RETFound, one of the most relevant foundation models for retinal images, performs strongly across classification, segmentation, and risk prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, foundation models are often computationally prohibitive, hindering their deployment in real-world clinical environments where hardware constraints and latency are critical. To bridge this gap, we introduce CAMEL (Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning), a novel cross-architecture distillation framework that uses an asymmetric masking strategy during embedding learning to effectively transfer knowledge from massive teacher foundation models to compact, lightweight student models. Our experimental evaluation across four datasets shows that CAMEL preserves accuracy while drastically reducing computational complexity, enabling lightweight yet highly accurate models suitable for resource-limited clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展在大型标注数据集和改进的表征学习支持下，显著推进了眼科病变的自动分级。然而，最先进性能与临床可扩展性之间仍存在显著差距。特别是，基础模型重塑了基于图像的医学筛查和诊断。这些在广泛数据集上训练的大规模架构学习到丰富、可泛化的特征表征，可适配广泛的下游任务。在眼科中，RETFound 是最相关的视网膜图像基础模型之一，在分类、分割和风险预测任务中表现强劲。尽管有效，基础模型通常计算成本过高，阻碍了其在硬件约束和延迟至关重要的真实临床环境中的部署。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 CAMEL（Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning），一种新颖的跨架构蒸馏框架，在嵌入学习期间使用非对称掩蔽策略，有效将知识从大型教师基础模型迁移到紧凑、轻量的学生模型。我们在四个数据集上的实验评估表明，CAMEL 在保持准确性的同时大幅降低计算复杂度，使轻量且高度准确的模型适用于资源有限的临床环境。

title: Sparse Autoencoders for Expert-Assisted Interpretation of Histopathology Foundation Model Embeddings
zh_title: 稀疏自编码器解析病理基础模型嵌入
summary: 用稀疏自编码器将病理基础模型嵌入分解为稀疏潜在特征，供病理专家辅助解读。
key_points: 在NCT-CRC嵌入上训练两种SAE变体
以CONCH为主，UNI2-h作稳健性验证
从重建保真度、稀疏性与标签富集等评估
reason: 有新意的可解释性预印本，对比有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Histopathology foundation models learn rich embedding representations, but their internal structure remains difficult to inspect. Concept-level interpretability is particularly relevant in computational pathology because pathologists reason through recurring morphological and tissue-level patterns, including tissue architecture, cellular morphology, staining variation, and artifacts. In this work, we investigate whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can decompose embeddings from histopathology foundation models into sparse latent features suitable for expert-assisted interpretation. We train vanilla and Batch-TopK SAE variants on NCT-CRC embeddings, using CONCH as the primary foundation model and UNI2-h as an additional robustness evaluation, and characterize the resulting latent features through reconstruction fidelity, sparsity, coherence, label enrichment, and downstream class-signal preservation. The learned sparse representations preserve most downstream tissue-class information, and their latent features retrieve more coherent and label-concentrated patch groups than raw embedding dimensions or PCA components. Discussions with pathology experts further motivated a WSI-level latent visualization workflow that places feature activations into larger tissue context. Overall, the additional UNI2-h evaluation suggests that the observed behavior is not specific to CONCH, supporting the use of sparse autoencoders for expert-assisted analysis of histopathology foundation-model embeddings, while emphasizing that latent features should be treated as candidate concepts requiring pathological assessment rather than automatically validated histopathological concepts.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学基础模型学习丰富的嵌入表示，但其内部结构仍难以检查。概念层面的可解释性在计算病理学中尤其相关，因为病理学家通过反复出现的形态学和组织层面模式进行推理，包括组织结构、细胞形态、染色变异和伪影。在这项工作中，我们研究稀疏自编码器（SAEs）能否将组织病理学基础模型的嵌入分解为适合专家辅助解释的稀疏潜在特征。我们在 NCT-CRC 嵌入上训练普通（vanilla）和 Batch-TopK SAE 变体，以 CONCH 作为主要基础模型，并以 UNI2-h 作为额外的稳健性评估，通过重建保真度、稀疏性、连贯性、标签富集以及下游类别信号保留来表征所得潜在特征。学到的稀疏表示保留了大多数下游组织类别信息，并且其潜在特征所检索到的图像块组比原始嵌入维度或 PCA 成分更连贯且标签更集中。与病理学专家的讨论进一步促成了一个 WSI 层面的潜在可视化工作流程，该流程将特征激活置于更大的组织背景中。总体而言，额外的 UNI2-h 评估表明所观察到的行为并非 CONCH 所特有，支持使用稀疏自编码器对组织病理学基础模型嵌入进行专家辅助分析，同时强调潜在特征应被视为需要病理学评估的候选概念，而不是自动验证的组织病理学概念。

title: PathoJev: Efficient Pathology Decisions from Shared Visual Context
zh_title: PathoJev：共享视觉上下文的高效病理决策模型
summary: 提出病理模型PathoJev，单次编码全切片后批量预测多个问题的答案概率，减少逐题推理延迟。
key_points: 9B与27B模型在三个全切片基准平均准确率77.2%与78.1%
分别高于SlideChat 5.4与6.3个百分点
复用混合骨干网络循环状态降低计算量
reason: 预印本新模型，有基准对比但未见外部验证或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: Pathology workflows require multiple visual judgments about the same slide, from identifying tumor type to assessing grade and invasion. Generating and parsing a separate textual response for each structured question adds latency between visual evidence and usable decisions. Building on the System One paradigm, we introduce PathoJev, a pathology model that directly predicts answer probabilities for whole-slide and region-level assessment. PathoJev encodes each slide once and evaluates independent question suffixes in batches over the shared visual context. Reusing the hybrid backbone's recurrent states further limits the computation that grows with slide-context length for each additional question. Across three whole-slide benchmarks, the 9B and 27B models achieve mean accuracies of 77.2% and 78.1%, exceeding SlideChat by 5.4 and 6.3 percentage points. Both scales also maintain competitive accuracy on five ROI benchmarks. On WSI-Bench, the 9B model runs 9.1x faster than SlideChat. Shared context accelerates eight-question workloads by 6.9x and 5.9x over separate prefix encoding, rising to 11.2x and 8.9x for 64 questions. These results provide a reusable probabilistic interface for combining multiple visual judgments in whole-slide and local tissue assessment. Code: https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev.
zh_abstract: 病理工作流程需要对同一张切片作出多项视觉判断，从识别肿瘤类型到评估分级和浸润。为每个结构化问题分别生成并解析一个文本回答，会增加视觉证据与可用决策之间的延迟。基于System One范式，我们提出PathoJev，一种直接预测全切片和区域级评估答案概率的病理模型。PathoJev对每张切片仅编码一次，并在共享视觉上下文上批量评估独立的问题后缀。复用混合骨干网络的循环状态，进一步限制了每增加一个问题时随切片上下文长度增长的计算量。在三个全切片基准上，9B和27B模型分别达到77.2%和78.1%的平均准确率，比SlideChat分别高出5.4和6.3个百分点。两种规模模型在五个ROI基准上也保持有竞争力的准确率。在WSI-Bench上，9B模型运行速度比SlideChat快9.1倍。共享上下文使八问题工作负载相较于单独前缀编码分别加速6.9倍和5.9倍，在64个问题时提升至11.2倍和8.9倍。这些结果为在全切片和局部组织评估中组合多项视觉判断提供了可复用的概率接口。代码：https://github.com/ChyaZhang/PathoJev。

title: Single-Annotation, Multi-Hypothesis Segmentation with Semantic-Spatial Residual Banks
zh_title: 单标注多假设分割与语义-空间残差库
summary: 提出语义-空间残差库方法，在每图仅一个标注的训练条件下生成覆盖多名标注者差异的分割假设集合。
key_points: 研究单标注训练、多假设输出的分割设定
冻结语义库并学习图像残差生成各假设
五个医学任务上覆盖度优于Probabilistic U-Net
reason: 有基线对比的预印本方法，医学任务验证但缺外部与临床验证
abstract: Multi-rater segmentation datasets show that a single image can admit several valid masks, yet most training sets expose only one annotation per image. We study single-annotation multi-hypothesis segmentation: each training image exposes one fixed mask, while the model must return a finite bank that covers held-out human annotations at test time. Our experiments reveal a representation tradeoff. Banks learned directly from images recover variations in local boundaries and extent but lose structural hypotheses, whereas frozen semantic features preserve structural grouping but underrepresent spatial variation. We introduce the Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank (SSRB), which freezes a semantic bank trained with balanced assignments and learns a residual from the image for each hypothesis. Across five medical endpoints, SSRB improves coverage of held-out masks at $K=8$ over a Probabilistic U-Net under the same one-mask constraint. On LIDC and LIDC-hard, it also produces substantially more distinct useful masks. On BSDS, it preserves the semantic bank's performance in grouping regions. Its advantage grows as more masks are returned, showing that residuals learned for corresponding heads improve coverage of local annotation variation while preserving how regions are grouped.
zh_abstract: 多阅片者分割数据集显示，单张图像可以对应多个有效掩膜，但大多数训练集每张图像只提供一个标注。我们研究单标注多假设分割：每张训练图像只提供一个固定掩膜，而模型在测试时必须返回一个有限集合，以覆盖留出的人类标注。我们的实验揭示了一种表示权衡。直接从图像学习得到的集合能够恢复局部边界和范围的变化，但会丢失结构性假设；而冻结的语义特征保留了结构分组，但对空间变化的表示不足。我们提出语义-空间残差集合（Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank，SSRB），它冻结通过平衡分配训练得到的语义集合，并针对每个假设从图像学习残差。在五个医学终点上，SSRB在相同单掩膜约束下，于$K=8$时相比Probabilistic U-Net提高了对留出掩膜的覆盖。在LIDC和LIDC-hard上，它还能产生显著更多不同的有用掩膜。在BSDS上，它保留了语义集合在区域分组方面的性能。随着返回更多掩膜，其优势增大，表明为对应头学习的残差提高了对局部标注变化的覆盖，同时保留了区域分组方式。

title: LAPIS: Clinically Constrained Patient-Identity Residual Learning for Chest X-Ray Anonymization
zh_title: LAPIS：胸片患者身份残差学习的匿名化方法
summary: 提出LAPIS方法，将胸片中的患者身份信息压缩至可替换残差通道以实现匿名化。
key_points: 用半正交基定义身份残差通道并加以替换
以空间对抗训练抑制互补部分的身份泄漏
在ChestX-ray14上按患者划分评估重识别攻击
属arXiv预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 隐私保护新方法且有公开数据集评估，但为预印本、无外部临床验证。
abstract: Biometric information in chest radiographs limits their release for research, as patients can be re-identified. We propose LAPIS, which jointly adapts a spatial chest-radiograph latent space so that patient-discriminative information concentrates in a compact, replaceable channel residual while most clinically relevant content stays in the complement. The residual is defined by an exactly semi-orthogonal basis, a spatial adversary suppresses identity leakage from the complement, and replacement-aware training teaches the decoder cross-patient residual swaps under output identity, clinical and realism constraints, so that replacing the residual yields a valid image. At release, the residual is replaced by a mixture of donor residuals. On patient-disjoint model, release and test sets from ChestX-ray14, we evaluate attackers adapted to the anonymized setting, a structural source-retrieval attack, and pathology classifiers trained on released images and tested on real ones. LAPIS reduces worst-case cross-study linkability from 0.961 to 0.791 AUC at a macro AUROC cost of 0.012 relative to reconstruction; a deformation-based baseline, however, remains better at structural source retrieval.
zh_abstract: 胸部 X 线片中的生物识别信息限制了其用于研究的发布，因为患者可能被重新识别。我们提出 LAPIS，它联合调整空间胸部 X 线片潜在空间，使患者判别性信息集中在一个紧凑、可替换的通道残差中，而大多数临床相关内容保留在互补部分。该残差由精确半正交基定义，空间对抗器抑制来自互补部分的身份泄漏，替换感知训练在输出身份、临床和真实性约束下教会解码器进行跨患者残差交换，从而使替换残差后生成有效图像。在发布时，残差由供体残差的混合替换。在来自 ChestX-ray14 的患者不相交模型集、发布集和测试集上，我们评估了适应匿名化设置的攻击者、一种结构性来源检索攻击，以及在发布图像上训练并在真实图像上测试的病理分类器。LAPIS 将最坏情况下的跨研究可链接性从 0.961 AUC 降低到 0.791 AUC，相对于重建而言宏观 AUROC 代价为 0.012；然而，基于变形的基线在结构性来源检索方面仍然更好。

title: Zonal-Aware Prostate Cancer Detection and Classification via Hadamard-Fused Mamba-UNet
zh_title: ZH-Mamba：分区感知的前列腺癌MRI检测框架
summary: 预印本提出ZH-Mamba多阶段框架，用Hadamard融合的Mamba-UNet做前列腺分区与病灶定位，再分类临床显著前列腺癌。
key_points: 双H-Mamba UNet分别完成腺体分区与病灶定位
可学习Hadamard变换融合分区与病灶特征，不增算力
摘要未报告外部验证或前瞻性评估
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未体现外部验证与公开代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection from prostate MRI requires a detailed understanding of the prostate anatomical context. Deep learning approaches have achieved promising results in zonal and lesion segmentation; however, the joint analysis of prostate zonal anatomy and lesion morphology in a unified framework remains relatively underexplored. In this work, we propose ZH-Mamba, a multi-stage zonal-aware csPCa detection framework consisting of two H-Mamba UNets models for prostate zonal segmentation and lesion localization, followed by an anatomy-aware Convolutional Neural Network classifier for csPCa detection. The proposed model leverages a learnable Hadamard Transform-based fusion mechanism to enhance zonal and lesion feature representations without increasing computational complexity. The learned fusion patterns consistently emphasize prostate regions, suggesting that the proposed fusion captures anatomically relevant feature representations. We demonstrate a strong zonal segmentation performance on the PI-CAI dataset, reaching Dice scores of $\textbf{0.95}$, $\textbf{0.85}$, and $\textbf{0.95}$ for whole gland (WG), peripheral zone (PZ), and transition zone (TZ), respectively, providing robust anatomical priors for downstream csPCa detection. Experimental results on an independent internal dataset confirm the generalization capability of the proposed zonal segmentation model. For lesion localization, the H-Mamba UNet achieves a competitive Dice score of $\textbf{0.70}$. Integrating the zonal masks and lesion localization, the proposed ZH-Mamba framework achieves an AUC of $\textbf{0.86}$, Average Precision ($\mathrm{AP}_{\mathrm{Patient}}$) of $\textbf{0.72}$, and F1 score of $\textbf{0.76}$, demonstrating the effectiveness of zonal-aware csPCa detection.
zh_abstract: 从前列腺MRI中准确检测临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）需要对前列腺解剖背景有详细理解。深度学习方法在分区和病灶分割方面已取得有希望的结果；然而，在统一框架中联合分析前列腺分区解剖和病灶形态仍相对未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们提出ZH-Mamba，一个多阶段分区感知csPCa检测框架，由两个用于前列腺分区分割和病灶定位的H-Mamba UNets模型，以及随后用于csPCa检测的解剖感知卷积神经网络分类器组成。所提出的模型利用基于Hadamard变换的可学习融合机制来增强分区和病灶特征表示，而不增加计算复杂度。学习到的融合模式一致地强调前列腺区域，提示所提出的融合捕获了解剖相关的特征表示。我们在PI-CAI数据集上展示了很强的分区分割性能，全腺体（WG）、外周带（PZ）和移行带（TZ）的Dice分数分别达到0.95、0.85和0.95，为下游csPCa检测提供了稳健的解剖先验。在独立内部数据集上的实验结果证实了所提出的分区分割模型的泛化能力。对于病灶定位，H-Mamba UNet达到具有竞争力的Dice分数0.70。整合分区掩膜和病灶定位，所提出的ZH-Mamba框架达到AUC 0.86、平均精度（AP_Patient）0.72和F1分数0.76，证明了分区感知csPCa检测的有效性。

title: CS-LDM: Clinically Guided Structure-Aware Latent Diffusion for Knee Radiographic Forecasting
zh_title: CS-LDM：临床引导的结构感知潜在扩散预测膝关节影像
summary: 预印本提出CS-LDM，以当前X光片与KL分级为条件，用结构感知潜在扩散模型预测患者未来膝关节影像。
key_points: 临床引导、结构感知的潜在扩散框架
采用LoRA适配与当前KL分级条件化
冻结教师模型诊断蒸馏，强调形态学可靠
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，未见外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a leading cause of physical disability and currently has no curative clinical treatment. Early diagnosis and accurate prognosis are therefore vital for managing its progression. Existing methods mainly predict future severity grades and provide limited visual explanation of structural change. Recent generation-guided approaches synthesize follow-up radiographs for progression assessment, but generated images are often judged by predictive accuracy or image realism, so they may satisfy a grading model while remaining morphologically unreliable. We therefore propose CS-LDM, a clinically guided, structure-aware latent diffusion framework that forecasts patient-specific future knee radiographs from the current X-ray and clinically available current KL grade, using LoRA adaptation, current-grade conditioning, and frozen-teacher diagnostic distillation. Experiments on the public Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) dataset show that CS-LDM improves future severity-grade consistency while maintaining competitive image fidelity. Further ordinal, OARSI, ROI-level, and stable/progressed analyses show that radiographic forecasting should be evaluated by balancing diagnostic consistency, anatomical plausibility, and structural preservation.
zh_abstract: 膝骨关节炎（KOA）是身体残疾的主要原因，目前尚无治愈性临床治疗。因此，早期诊断和准确预后对于管理其进展至关重要。现有方法主要预测未来严重程度分级，并对结构变化提供有限的视觉解释。近期生成引导方法合成随访X线片用于进展评估，但生成图像通常通过预测准确性或图像真实性来评判，因此它们可能满足分级模型却在形态学上仍不可靠。因此，我们提出 CS-LDM，一种临床引导、结构感知的潜在扩散框架，利用 LoRA 适配、当前分级条件化和冻结教师诊断蒸馏，从当前X线片和临床可用的当前 KL 分级预测患者特异性的未来膝关节X线片。在公开的骨关节炎倡议（OAI）数据集上的实验表明，CS-LDM 提高了未来严重程度分级一致性，同时保持有竞争力的图像保真度。进一步的序数、OARSI、ROI 层面以及稳定/进展分析表明，影像学预测应通过平衡诊断一致性、解剖合理性和结构保留来评估。

title: DiffUltra: Task-Guided Pathology Synthesis for Large-Scale Real-World Lung Ultrasound Data
zh_title: DiffUltra：面向真实世界肺超声数据的任务引导病理合成
summary: 预印本提出DiffUltra，按任务引导的潜在扩散流程生成肺超声病理图像，并用真实数据训练的过滤器筛选。
key_points: 按无回声、低回声、高回声分解病灶结构
两种策略将病灶插入或替换至背景
仅用真实数据训练过滤器筛选合成图像
reason: 针对超声数据稀缺的新颖合成方法预印本，尚无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Despite their scale, large medical imaging datasets may underrepresent clinically relevant pathological presentations. Synthetic data can expand coverage, but findings must remain compatible with surrounding anatomy. This is challenging in ultrasound, where findings resemble surrounding tissue and must be positioned relative to anatomical landmarks. We propose DiffUltra, a task-guided latent diffusion pipeline that models pathological structure and spatial context, and screens synthetic images for downstream utility. DiffUltra conditions generation on structural masks decomposing findings into anechoic, hypoechoic, and hyperechoic subregions. Two placement strategies insert findings into pathology-absent backgrounds or replace existing findings with structurally matched pathology from other patients. A filter trained exclusively on real data retains images whose predictions agree spatially with target boxes. We evaluate DiffUltra for lung ultrasound detection of pleural effusion and consolidation, using over 700,000 expert-annotated frames from 598 patients at 12 sites. Averaged across three real-data scales, synthetic insertion significantly improved video-level AUROC for both pleural effusion (p = 0.017) and consolidation (p < 0.01). For pleural effusion, frame-level average precision improved by 4.5 percentage points on average and by 6.1 points using only 10% of real data (p < 0.01 for both). Synthetic insertion also yielded larger average precision gains than an existing diffusion-based lesion-insertion method at every scale. At full scale, targeted synthesis improved AUROC for both pathologies by 1.1-3.9 points in an underrepresented anatomical zone and on a held-out acquisition system. These results suggest that anatomically constrained, task-guided synthesis can help address coverage gaps in ultrasound training data.
zh_abstract: 尽管规模庞大，大型医学影像数据集可能对临床相关病理表现的代表性不足。合成数据可以扩大覆盖范围，但发现必须与周围解剖结构保持相容。这在超声中具有挑战性，因为发现与周围组织相似，并且必须相对于解剖标志进行定位。我们提出 DiffUltra，一种任务引导的潜在扩散流程，对病理结构和空间上下文建模，并筛选合成图像以供下游使用。DiffUltra 以结构掩码为生成条件，将发现分解为无回声、低回声和高回声子区域。两种放置策略将发现插入无病变背景，或用其他患者结构匹配的病变替换现有发现。一个仅在真实数据上训练的滤波器保留预测在空间上与目标框一致的图像。我们评估 DiffUltra 用于胸腔积液和肺实变的肺部超声检测，使用来自12个中心598例患者的超过700,000帧专家标注图像。在三个真实数据规模上平均，合成插入显著提高了胸腔积液（p = 0.017）和肺实变（p < 0.01）的视频级 AUROC。对于胸腔积液，帧级平均精度平均提高4.5个百分点，而仅使用10%真实数据时提高6.1个百分点（两者 p < 0.01）。在每个规模上，合成插入也比现有的基于扩散的病灶插入方法产生更大的平均精度增益。在全规模下，靶向合成在代表性不足的解剖区域和留出采集系统上将两种病变的 AUROC 提高了1.1-3.9个百分点。这些结果表明，解剖约束的任务引导合成有助于解决超声训练数据中的覆盖缺口。

title: Report-Derived Labels, an Image Teacher and the Gap to Expert Labels in Knee MRI: An Analysis of One Entry to the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection Challenge
zh_title: 膝MRI中报告标签与图像教师模型对比专家标签
summary: 在RSNA 2026膝部异常检测挑战中，比较报告文本标签与公共图像模型预测相对专家标签的一致性。
key_points: 4407例训练研究中仅58例有专家标注
报告标签与图像模型的宏AUC为0.892与0.896
两者在不同病变上各有优势
reason: 预印本方法学分析，有基线对比但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: In the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection challenge, 58 of 4,407 training studies have expert labels for 12 findings, and the rest have only a radiology report. We compare training targets built from a language-model reading of the reports and from a public image model against two references: the expert labels and the 39,248 study-finding cells that the reports state as present or absent. The report labels and the out-of-fold predictions of the image model reach similar agreement with the expert labels (macro AUC 0.892 and 0.896) but fail on different findings. The report is better for ligament tears and patellofemoral osteoarthritis, which it never calls present when the experts do not; the image model is better for effusion, Baker's cyst, contusion, and synovitis, where the reports call the finding absent, leave it out, or call it present more often than the experts. Their equal mixture reaches 0.927 (gain over the report labels 0.035, 95% interval 0.019 to 0.052), also after removing the studies whose knee side was handled inconsistently. We did not observe a model-level gain from this better target: a 2.5D ResNet50 trained on the report labels alone scored 0.877 on the private leaderboard, after the deadline, against 0.872 for the same model trained on the mixture, and the out-of-fold advantage of the mixture is confounded by a change of code and by possible leakage through the image model's folds. A scanner prevalence prior raised agreement with the reports but not with the experts, so a report-derived reference can reward reporting habits. A rank correction for co-occurring findings gave small out-of-fold gains and no visible leaderboard effect. Our entry, a forked public ensemble with that correction, was displayed at rank 582 of 6,299 on the private leaderboard (0.943, a score shared by 287 teams). All results are exploratory; none of the models is meant for clinical use.
zh_abstract: 在 RSNA 2026 膝关节异常检测挑战赛中，4,407 项训练研究中有 58 项具有针对 12 种发现的专家标签，其余研究仅有放射学报告。我们比较了由语言模型读取报告构建的训练目标以及由公开图像模型构建的训练目标，并以两个参照为对照：专家标签，以及报告中声明为存在或不存在的 39,248 个研究-发现单元格。报告标签与图像模型的折外预测与专家标签达到相似的一致性（宏观 AUC 分别为 0.892 和 0.896），但在不同发现上失败。报告在韧带撕裂和髌股骨关节炎上更好，因为在专家不判定为存在时，它从不将其判为存在；图像模型在积液、Baker 囊肿、挫伤和滑膜炎上更好，而在这些发现上，报告比专家更常将其判为不存在、遗漏不写，或判为存在。二者的等权混合达到 0.927（较报告标签提升 0.035，95% 区间 0.019 至 0.052），在剔除膝关节侧别处理不一致的研究后也是如此。我们没有观察到这一更好的目标带来模型层面的增益：仅用报告标签训练的 2.5D ResNet50 在截止日期后于私有排行榜上得分为 0.877，而同一模型用混合目标训练得分为 0.872；并且混合目标的折外优势受到代码变更以及可能通过图像模型折次产生的泄漏所混杂。扫描仪患病率先验提高了与报告的一致性，但没有提高与专家标签的一致性，因此由报告衍生的参照可能会奖励报告习惯。针对共现发现的排名校正带来了小幅折外增益，且未观察到明显的排行榜效应。我们的参赛方案是一个带有该校正的分叉公共集成，在私有排行榜上显示为 6,299 支队伍中的第 582 名（0.943，该分数由 287 支队伍共享）。所有结果均为探索性；没有任何模型旨在用于临床。

title: Cross-Device Transfer of a Hospital-Trained Fetal Head Circumference Model to a Low-Cost Handheld Ultrasound Probe
zh_title: 医院训练胎儿头围模型迁移至低成本手持超声探头
summary: 将HC18训练的胎儿头围分割模型直接用于低成本手持探头图像，量化精度下降及预处理影响。
key_points: 域内误差2.34mm，手持图像升至16.12mm
预处理方式差异可解释约三分之一性能差距
18例患者，与同次医院扫描对照
reason: 预印本跨设备迁移实证，样本小但问题具体，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated fetal head circumference (HC) measurement reaches near-expert accuracy on the HC18 benchmark, but published models are trained and evaluated on hospital-grade equipment. We quantify what happens when such a model is carried to a low-cost handheld probe. A lightweight segmentation network (CSM, 0.13M parameters) was trained on HC18 across five independent runs and applied without modification to images from a $1,350 handheld probe (SonoQue C3), acquired at the same visit as the reference hospital scan in 18 patients. In-domain accuracy was 2.34 +/- 0.43 mm; on handheld images the same model gave 16.12 mm against the hospital record, a 6.9-fold degradation. Input preprocessing, a choice rarely reported, accounted for about a third of that gap: direct resizing gave 49.45 mm against 16.12 mm for an aspect-preserving pipeline. A leave-one-out data-efficiency curve showed that fine-tuning on two images significantly worsened accuracy, and that from four images upward error fell by 0.75 mm per doubling of the local dataset (p = 0.0045), although no training-set size up to 27 images significantly improved on the unmodified model. Much of the residual gap belongs to the reference rather than the model: scored against a manual tracing of the same image the model was already within 10.48 mm, and its disagreement with sonographer calipers on the same frame was a near-constant offset, negative in 10 of 10 cases. A single calibration constant estimated leave-one-out reduced that disagreement from 8.12 mm to 3.49 mm, reaching the intraobserver reproducibility reported for experienced sonographers, but did not improve agreement with the hospital record. Cross-device evaluations should therefore report the input preprocessing used and characterise the precision of their reference standard.
zh_abstract: 自动胎儿头围（HC）测量在HC18基准上达到接近专家的准确率，但已发表模型是在医院级设备上训练和评估的。我们量化了将此类模型迁移到低成本手持探头时会发生什么。一个轻量级分割网络（CSM，0.13M参数）在HC18上以五次独立运行进行训练，并在不作修改的情况下应用于来自一台1,350美元手持探头（SonoQue C3）的图像；这些图像在18例患者中与参考医院扫描在同一次就诊时采集。域内准确率为2.34 +/- 0.43 mm；在手持图像上，同一模型相对于医院记录的结果为16.12 mm，出现6.9倍退化。输入预处理这一很少被报告的选项约占该差距的三分之一：直接缩放给出49.45 mm，而保持长宽比的流程为16.12 mm。留一法数据效率曲线显示，用两张图像微调会显著降低准确率；从四张图像起，局部数据集每翻倍，误差下降0.75 mm（p = 0.0045），尽管直至27张图像的训练集规模均未显著优于未修改模型。剩余差距的很大部分归因于参考标准而非模型：以同一图像的人工描记为参照评分时，模型已在10.48 mm以内，并且其与超声医师在同一帧上的卡尺测量的不一致表现为近乎恒定的偏移，10/10例均为负。通过留一法估计的单个校准常数将该不一致从8.12 mm降至3.49 mm，达到经验丰富超声医师所报告的观察者内可重复性，但并未改善与医院记录的一致性。因此，跨设备评估应报告所使用的输入预处理，并描述其参考标准的精确度。

title: TheseusSyn: Unified Medical Image Synthesis via Context-Conditioned Masked Autoregression
zh_title: TheseusSyn：上下文条件化掩码自回归医学图像合成
summary: 提出以全局表征令牌为上下文约束的多码本离散分词与掩码自回归框架，通过迭代替换内容生成医学图像。
key_points: 多码本离散分词将医学图像转为令牌序列
掩码自回归结合局部邻域与全局上下文预测
目标为数据高效学习与隐私保护建模
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，条目未见外部验证与开源信息
abstract: High-fidelity medical image synthesis is promising for data-efficient learning and privacy-preserving model development. However, most existing approaches rely on symbolic or label-based conditioning, which constrains generative diversity and limits case-specific contextual fidelity. Inspired by the Ship of Theseus paradox, we propose TheseusSyn, a novel context-conditioned synthesis paradigm that generates images through iterative content replacement. Our framework employs a multi-codebook discrete tokenizer to convert medical images into sequences of token indices, extracted with a global representation token that serves as a contextual constraint. A masked autoregressive generative model then iteratively masks and predicts tokens conditioned on both local neighborhoods and the global context. By progressively replacing image content until the entire token sequence is renewed, TheseusSyn produces synthetic samples that preserve anatomical coherence and semantic consistency while introducing controlled diversity. We evaluate the proposed framework on multiple datasets from MedMNIST by constructing synthetic datasets with varying masking strategies and training ResNet-18 classifiers exclusively on either real or synthetic data. Experimental results demonstrate that classifiers trained on TheseusSyn-generated images achieve competitive performance on official test sets, indicating that the synthesized data preserve diagnostically relevant features and semantic consistency. Systematic analysis of masking strategies reveals their impact on structural fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. These results suggest that context-conditioned masked autoregression provides an effective and generalizable solution for label-free medical image synthesis, offering a scalable alternative to conventional data augmentation and class-conditioned generative models in medical imaging applications.
zh_abstract: 高保真医学图像合成在数据高效学习和隐私保护模型开发方面具有前景。然而，大多数现有方法依赖符号或基于标签的条件控制，这限制了生成多样性并限制了病例特定上下文保真度。受忒修斯之船悖论启发，我们提出TheseusSyn，一种新的上下文条件合成范式，通过迭代内容替换生成图像。我们的框架采用多码本离散分词器将医学图像转换为token索引序列，并使用一个作为上下文约束的全局表示token进行提取。然后，一个掩码自回归生成模型在局部邻域和全局上下文的条件下迭代地掩码并预测token。通过逐步替换图像内容直至整个token序列被更新，TheseusSyn生成合成样本，这些样本在引入受控多样性的同时保持解剖连贯性和语义一致性。我们在来自MedMNIST的多个数据集上评估所提出的框架，通过构建具有不同掩码策略的合成数据集，并仅在真实数据或合成数据上训练ResNet-18分类器。实验结果表明，在TheseusSyn生成的图像上训练的分类器在官方测试集上取得有竞争力的性能，表明合成数据保留了诊断相关特征和语义一致性。对掩码策略的系统分析揭示了其对结构保真度和下游分类准确率的影响。这些结果表明，上下文条件掩码自回归为无标签医学图像合成提供了一种有效且可泛化的解决方案，为医学影像应用中的传统数据增强和类别条件生成模型提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。

title: Decoding Lung Cancer with Artificial Intelligence: A Path to Personalized Diagnostics and Therapy.
source: PubMed · Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer

summary: 综述梳理深度学习与机器学习在 NSCLC 影像、病理与分子数据中用于检测、分型、标志物预测和预后评估。

涵盖 CNN 用于肿瘤检测与组织学分型
提及 PD-L1、EGFR、KRAS 等标志物预测

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.
zh_abstract: [《环境病理学、毒理学与肿瘤学杂志：国际环境毒理学与癌症学会官方刊物》] 非小细胞肺癌（non-small-cell lung cancer, NSCLC）占肺癌病例的大多数，并且仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。早期发现、准确分期和个体化治疗对于提高患者生存率至关重要。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的最新进展通过自动分析影像、病理和分子数据集，改变了NSCLC的诊疗。深度学习（deep learning, DL）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）模型，尤其是卷积神经网络（convolutional neural networks, CNNs），在肿瘤检测、组织学分类、生物标志物预测（PD-L1、EGFR、KRAS）和预后评估方面表现出高准确度。将AI与全切片成像（whole slide imaging, WSI）、计算机断层扫描（computed tomography, CT）、PET/CT和液体活检相结合，可实现无创肿瘤表征、早期复发检测和治疗反应预测。结合影像、基因组和临床数据的多模态AI方法，与传统方法相比，可提供更优的患者分层和个体化治疗规划。除诊断外，AI还通过基于影像组学的结节分类、多组学数据解读和药物发现促进治疗开发。特别是影像组学，可提取定量影像生物标志物，捕捉超出人类感知的肿瘤异质性。AI进一步支持外科、放疗和全身治疗中的临床决策，提高工作流程效率。尽管在数据质量、可解释性和临床采用方面存在挑战，AI在推进精准肿瘤学和提高NSCLC管理结局方面具有重大前景。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Three-Dimensional Preoperative Planning for Total Knee Arthroplasty in End-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis​.
source: PubMed · Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE

summary: 单中心回顾性初步研究评估AI三维术前规划系统预测假体尺寸与部件位置的可靠性。

主要结局为规划与植入假体尺寸一致性
次要结局含HKA角矫正与HSS评分
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性初步研究，无对照，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Accurate preoperative templating for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) remains challenging, and the accuracy of conventional planning methods is variable. This preliminary, retrospective, single-center study evaluated the reliability of a robot-independent, artificial intelligence (AI)-based, three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning system (AIKNEE) for predicting prosthesis size and component position in patients undergoing TKA for end-stage KOA. Twenty-eight knees from 24 patients with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 KOA were included. The primary outcome was the agreement between the planned and implanted prosthesis sizes. Secondary outcomes included correction of the coronal hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle, improvement in Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee scores, and early postoperative complications. The planned size matched the implanted size exactly in 53.57% of femoral components (15/28; 95% confidence interval [CI], 35.8%-70.5%) and 46.43% of tibial components (13/28; 95% CI, 29.5%-64.2%). Agreement within ±1 size was 85.71% for femoral components (24/28; 95% CI, 68.5%-94.3%) and 96.43% for tibial components (27/28; 95% CI, 82.3%-99.4%), giving an overall matching rate of 91.07% (51/56; 95% CI, 80.7%-96.1%). The postoperative HKA angle improved from 173.0° ± 3.9° to 178.2° ± 1.2° (P < 0.001), and the HSS score increased from 39.7 ± 2.2 preoperatively to 80.8 ± 1.3 at the 1-month follow-up (P < 0.001). No major early complications, including infection, dislocation, or deep venous thrombosis, were observed. Within this preliminary cohort, the AIKNEE system predicted prosthesis size with a reliability comparable to that reported for existing AI templating tools. Because the study was retrospective, single-arm, unblinded, and limited to 1 month of follow-up, these data characterize planning accuracy only and do not demonstrate clinical effectiveness; adequately powered, controlled studies with long-term follow-up are required.
zh_abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] 对于终末期膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者，全膝关节置换术（TKA）的准确术前模板规划仍具有挑战性，且传统规划方法的准确性不一。这项初步、回顾性、单中心研究评估了一种独立于机器人、基于人工智能（AI）的三维（3D）术前规划系统（AIKNEE）在因终末期 KOA 接受 TKA 的患者中预测假体尺寸和部件位置的可靠性。纳入 24 例 Kellgren-Lawrence 3-4 级 KOA 患者的 28 个膝关节。主要结局是计划假体尺寸与植入假体尺寸之间的一致性。次要结局包括冠状面髋-膝-踝（HKA）角的矫正、美国特种外科医院（HSS）膝关节评分的改善以及早期术后并发症。计划尺寸与植入尺寸完全匹配的比例为股骨部件 53.57%（15/28；95% 置信区间 [CI]，35.8%-70.5%）和胫骨部件 46.43%（13/28；95% CI，29.5%-64.2%）。在 ±1 个尺寸范围内的一致性为股骨部件 85.71%（24/28；95% CI，68.5%-94.3%）和胫骨部件 96.43%（27/28；95% CI，82.3%-99.4%），总体匹配率为 91.07%（51/56；95% CI，80.7%-96.1%）。术后 HKA 角从 173.0° ± 3.9° 改善至 178.2° ± 1.2°（P < 0.001），HSS 评分从术前 39.7 ± 2.2 提高至 1 个月随访时的 80.8 ± 1.3（P < 0.001）。未观察到包括感染、脱位或深静脉血栓形成在内的重大早期并发症。在这一初步队列中，AIKNEE 系统预测假体尺寸的可靠性可与现有 AI 模板规划工具所报告的可靠性相比。由于该研究为回顾性、单臂、非盲且随访仅限 1 个月，这些数据仅表征规划准确性，并不能证明临床有效性；需要足够把握度、对照设计并具有长期随访的研究。

title: CSF cytology: core principles, diagnostic pitfalls and emerging digital tools including artificial intelligence and telecytology.

summary: 叙述性综述总结脑脊液细胞学基本原则与分析前影响因素，并介绍自动细胞计数、AI与远程细胞学等新兴工具。
key_points: 强调样本处理延迟导致细胞自溶与丢失
快速离心涂片有助保存细胞形态
AI与远程细胞学仅作新兴方向概述
reason: 叙述性综述，AI仅占小部分且无具体性能数据
abstract: [Acta neuropathologica] Cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a cornerstone of diagnostic evaluation in infectious, autoimmune, haemorrhagic, and neoplastic disorders of the central nervous system despite advances in neuroimaging, molecular diagnostics, and digital technologies. This narrative review summarises established principles of cerebrospinal fluid cytology, highlights methodological limitations and diagnostic pitfalls, and integrates emerging developments, including automated cell counting, artificial intelligence, and telecytology. Pre-analytical factors are critical determinants of diagnostic accuracy. Delayed sample processing promotes pH-dependent autolysis and substantial cell loss, whereas rapid cytocentrifugation preserves cellular morphology and facilitates reliable assessment. Automated cell counters are increasingly implemented in routine laboratories and offer advantages in settings with limited technical staffing. However, current systems show limited precision in samples with low and slightly elevated cell counts and limited morphological evaluation. Manual chamber counting, particularly in the normal and low-cell-count range, remains the gold standard for quantitative CSF cell assessment, whereas expert microscopic examination remains the reference standard for qualitative cytomorphological assessment. Although the sensitivity of neuroimaging continues to improve, cerebrospinal fluid cytology retains a unique diagnostic role in the detection of infectious and neoplastic conditions and in the evaluation of subarachnoid haemorrhage. Cytological detection of erythrophages, siderophages, and haematoidin crystals can reveal haemorrhage and provide clues to its temporal stage. Overall, cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a valuable diagnostic tool when integrated with clinical, laboratory, microbiological, immunological, and imaging findings. Careful recognition of common pitfalls is essential. We recommend rapid cerebrospinal fluid processing, routine preparation of cytospin-based stained slides with expert microscopic review, and the implementation of automated or digital methods only within clearly validated workflows.
zh_abstract: [Acta neuropathologica] 尽管神经影像学、分子诊断和数字技术取得进展，脑脊液细胞学仍是中枢神经系统感染性、自身免疫性、出血性和肿瘤性疾病诊断评估的基石。本叙述性综述总结脑脊液细胞学的既定原则，强调方法学局限和诊断陷阱，并整合新兴进展，包括自动细胞计数、人工智能和远程细胞学。分析前因素是诊断准确性的关键决定因素。样本处理延迟会促进pH依赖性自溶和显著细胞丢失，而快速细胞离心涂片可保留细胞形态并有助于可靠评估。自动细胞计数仪正越来越多地应用于常规实验室，在技术人员有限的环境中具有优势。然而，当前系统在细胞计数低和轻度升高的样本中精度有限，且形态学评估能力有限。手工计数池计数，尤其是在正常和低细胞计数范围内，仍是脑脊液细胞定量评估的金标准；而专家显微镜检查仍是定性细胞形态学评估的参考标准。尽管神经影像学的敏感性不断提高，脑脊液细胞学在感染性和肿瘤性疾病的检测以及蛛网膜下腔出血的评估中仍具有独特的诊断作用。细胞学检测噬红细胞、含铁血黄素细胞和血褐素结晶可揭示出血并提供其时间阶段的线索。总体而言，当与临床、实验室、微生物学、免疫学和影像学发现相结合时，脑脊液细胞学仍是有价值的诊断工具。仔细识别常见陷阱至关重要。我们推荐快速处理脑脊液、常规制备细胞离心涂片染色玻片并由专家进行显微镜复核，并且仅在经过明确验证的工作流程中实施自动化或数字化方法。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA interactions (RRIs) play a vital role in cellular processes including gene regulation, RNA editing, and translational control. Aberrant RRIs are increasingly recognized as contributors to cancer initiation, progression, and metastasis. Accurate computational prediction of RRIs therefore offers significant opportunities for cancer biomarker discovery, understanding tumor biology, and therapeutic target identification. Among machine learning approaches, support vector machines (SVMs) have been applied in RRI prediction due to their robustness in handling high-dimensional, nonlinear data and relatively small training datasets. This chapter reviews SVM-based methods for RRI prediction, highlights representative tools and strategies, and discusses current challenges and relevance to cancer application. Emerging trends that integrate SVMs with deep learning and experimental data augmentation are also outlined, pointing toward pathways for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA 相互作用（RRIs）在包括基因调控、RNA 编辑和翻译控制在内的细胞过程中发挥至关重要的作用。异常的 RRIs 越来越被认为参与癌症发生、进展和转移。因此，准确计算预测 RRIs 为癌症生物标志物发现、理解肿瘤生物学以及治疗靶点识别提供了重要机会。在机器学习方法中，支持向量机（SVMs）因其在处理高维、非线性数据和相对较小训练数据集方面的稳健性，已被应用于 RRI 预测。本章综述基于 SVM 的 RRI 预测方法，重点介绍代表性工具和策略，并讨论当前挑战及其与癌症应用的相关性。还概述了将 SVMs 与深度学习和实验数据增强相结合的新兴趋势，指出通往临床转化的路径。

key_points: 分离确定性规划与大模型生成
四阶段注意力递减塑造脚本
约束校验与错误感知重试机制
reason: 预印本工程实现，无临床评估与对照，属增量档
abstract: Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Direct evidence for narrated bedtime audio in adults is mixed, and a recent active-controlled trial did not support such audio as a standalone treatment for sleep disturbance. We translate this uncertain evidence into conservative engineering requirements and present a multilingual pipeline for generating and narrating low-arousal sleep stories. The implemented prototype separates deterministic planning from large language model generation, represents content and delivery parameters explicitly, shapes each script through a four-phase attention taper, validates structural and lexical constraints, performs a bounded error-aware retry, and quarantines unresolved outputs. Provider-agnostic text-to-speech synthesis is followed by paragraph-aware joining, two-pass loudness normalization, and a publication gate that re-measures the saved, encoded file against fixed loudness, loudness-range, and true-peak limits. The product data model records stop position, replay, early abandonment, and completion while treating these events as ambiguous behavioral proxies rather than clinical outcomes. We contribute an evidence-to-requirement mapping, a traceable guardrail architecture with explicit acceptance thresholds, technical evaluation criteria, and a prospective protocol for testing sleep-onset effects. No clinical efficacy is claimed; the system is positioned as a relaxation and attentional-support tool whose benefit and possible reliance must be evaluated empirically.
zh_abstract: 生成式音频系统可以生成大量个性化睡前内容库，但普通媒体目标（留存、完成和新颖性）与支持向睡眠过渡的目标并不一致。关于成人 narrated bedtime audio（ narrated bedtime audio）的直接证据不一，且最近一项主动对照试验不支持将此类音频作为睡眠障碍的单独治疗。我们将这一不确定证据转化为保守的工程要求，并提出一个多语言流程，用于生成和叙述低唤醒睡眠故事。已实现的原型将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离，显式表示内容和交付参数，通过四阶段注意力递减塑造每个脚本，验证结构和词汇约束，执行有界且错误感知的重试，并隔离未解决的输出。在与提供商无关的文本转语音合成之后，进行段落感知拼接、两遍响度归一化，以及发布门控：对保存并编码的文件重新测量，以对照固定的响度、响度范围和真峰值限制。产品数据模型记录停止位置、重播、提前放弃和完成，同时将这些事件视为模糊的行为代理指标，而非临床结局。我们的贡献包括证据到要求的映射、具有明确验收阈值且可追踪的护栏架构、技术评估标准，以及用于测试入睡效应的前瞻性方案。未声称任何临床疗效；该系统被定位为一种放松和注意力支持工具，其获益和可能的依赖必须通过实证评估。

title: [Articles] An explainable artificial intelligence system for prognostic assessment and decision support in diabetic foot ulcer care: a multicentre derivation and validation study with prospective randomised evaluation
zh_title: 糖尿病足溃疡预后评估与决策支持的可解释AI多中心研究
summary: eClinicalMedicine 发表多中心衍生与验证研究，结合梯度提升树与神经网络可解释预测糖尿病足溃疡病程，并含前瞻性随机评估。
key_points: 多中心衍生并验证可解释预测模型
融合梯度提升树与神经网络
含前瞻性随机评估，复发估计需谨慎解读
reason: 多中心验证加前瞻性随机评估，属重要档上限
abstract: We demonstrate that integrating gradient-boosted trees and neural networks enables explainable prediction of complex DFU trajectories and may support prioritised, individualised clinical decision-making. Nevertheless, recurrence estimates should be interpreted cautiously.
zh_abstract: 我们证明，整合梯度提升树和神经网络能够实现对复杂DFU轨迹的可解释预测，并可能支持按优先级排序的个体化临床决策。然而，复发估计应谨慎解读。

title: Predicting persistent fever in patients with cancer receiving antibiotics: a machine learning approach
zh_title: 机器学习预测癌症患者抗生素治疗后持续发热
summary: 基于两家学术医院电子病历开发并外部验证模型，预测癌症患者用抗生素后48–72小时持续发热，外部AUROC 0.78。
key_points: 内部AUROC 0.82，外部验证AUROC 0.78
体温相关变量为主要预测因子
决策曲线分析显示净获益为正
reason: 有独立外部验证与决策曲线评估，属重要档
abstract: Persistent fever after initiating intravenous antibiotics is common in hospitalized patients with cancer and often leads to additional imaging and antimicrobial escalation. Early identification of patients unlikely to remain febrile could provide additional information during clinical reassessment. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict persistent fever 48–72 h after antibiotic initiation using electronic health records from two academic hospitals. Adult cancer patients with fever within 24–48 h of treatment were included. Models incorporated demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, vital signs, and temperature patterns. The best-performing model achieved an AUROC of 0.82 (95% CI 0.79–0.84) internally and 0.78 (95% CI 0.77–0.79) externally. Temperature-related variables were the dominant predictors. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net benefit across much of the evaluated threshold range. Retrospective assessment suggested that approximately one quarter of antibiotic escalations and chest CT scans occurred in patients correctly predicted not to remain febrile, highlighting the potential contextual value of fever predictions. These findings indicate that short-term fever persistence can be predicted with clinically meaningful accuracy using routine data. However, clinical use should be limited to an adjunctive role rather than standalone rule-out decision-making, and prospective studies are required to evaluate safety, clinician uptake, and real-world impact.
zh_abstract: 开始静脉抗生素治疗后持续发热在住院癌症患者中很常见，并且常导致额外的影像学检查和抗菌药物升级。早期识别不太可能持续发热的患者，可在临床再评估期间提供额外信息。我们开发并外部验证了机器学习模型，使用两家学术医院的电子健康记录来预测抗生素开始后48–72小时内的持续发热。纳入治疗开始24–48小时内发热的成年癌症患者。模型纳入了人口学特征、合并症、实验室结果、生命体征和体温模式。表现最佳的模型在内部达到AUROC 0.82（95% CI 0.79–0.84），在外部达到0.78（95% CI 0.77–0.79）。体温相关变量是主要预测因子。决策曲线分析显示，在评估阈值范围的大部分区间内净获益为正。回顾性评估提示，约四分之一的抗菌药物升级和胸部CT扫描发生于被正确预测为不会持续发热的患者中，凸显了发热预测的潜在情境价值。这些发现表明，使用常规数据能够以具有临床意义的准确度预测短期发热持续。然而，临床使用应仅限于辅助作用，而非独立的排除决策，并且需要前瞻性研究评估安全性、临床医生采纳情况和真实世界影响。

title: Interpretability-driven feature engineering enables compact and accurate multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B
zh_title: 可解释性特征工程实现乙肝住院多结局风险分层
summary: 基于3.6万余条住院记录构建紧凑机器学习模型，对慢性乙肝住院患者的肝硬化与肝癌等结局进行风险分层。
key_points: 纳入22,001名患者的36,024条住院记录
用SHAP主效应与交互项构建紧凑模型
采用时间验证与独立外部验证并报告校准
reason: 同行评审、大样本且含独立外部验证与决策曲线分析，属重要档
abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) often trades predictive performance against interpretability. This study develops an interpretability-driven feature engineering framework for multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B. A total of 36,024 hospitalization records from 22,001 patients were included. The framework integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based main and interaction effects was used to construct compact machine learning models for classifying disease non-progression, liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). SHAP main effects selected the top 15 features per outcome; TreeSHAP interactions selected four pairwise terms. Performance was evaluated using patient-level data splitting, temporal validation, and independent external validation, with calibration and decision-curve analyses. The full-feature models achieved superior discrimination (AUCs: 0.927, 0.897, and 0.899) for classifying hospitalization-recorded disease non-progression, LC, and HCC, respectively. The corresponding compact models maintained strong discrimination (AUCs: 0.911, 0.882, and 0.890) with 80.8% fewer features. Interaction models yielded subtle AUC shifts (AUCs: 0.912, 0.881, and 0.891) while characterizing potential clinical joint-effect patterns. Temporal validation yielded AUCs of 0.863, 0.827, and 0.847, while external validation yielded AUCs of 0.829, 0.865, and 0.827, respectively. The framework produced compact and transparent models for contemporaneous risk stratification in clinical practice, seamlessly uniting predictive accuracy with multi-level interpretability.
zh_abstract: 临床人工智能（AI）常常在预测性能与可解释性之间进行权衡。本研究开发了一个可解释性驱动的特征工程框架，用于慢性乙型肝炎住院时的多结局风险分层。共纳入22,001例患者的36,024条住院记录。该框架整合了基于SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）的主效应和交互效应，用于构建紧凑型机器学习模型，以对疾病未进展、肝硬化（LC）和肝细胞癌（HCC）进行分类。SHAP主效应为每个结局选择前15个特征；TreeSHAP交互作用选择了4个成对项。采用患者层面数据拆分、时间验证和独立外部验证评估性能，并进行校准和决策曲线分析。全特征模型在分类住院记录中的疾病未进展、LC和HCC时分别实现了更优的区分度（AUC：0.927、0.897和0.899）。相应紧凑模型在特征数减少80.8%的情况下保持了较强的区分度（AUC：0.911、0.882和0.890）。交互模型产生了轻微的AUC变化（AUC：0.912、0.881和0.891），同时刻画了潜在的临床联合效应模式。时间验证的AUC分别为0.863、0.827和0.847，外部验证的AUC分别为0.829、0.865和0.827。该框架生成了用于临床实践中同期风险分层的紧凑且透明的模型，将预测准确性与多层次可解释性无缝结合。

title: External validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 临床预测模型外部验证与落地的系统评价
summary: 分析1072个机器学习临床预测模型，发现仅少数完成外部验证或进入临床实施。
key_points: 1072个模型中88.1%无后续转化研究
仅9.9%经外部验证，5.2%进入临床实施
公开代码与TRIPOD依从性显著关联转化
reason: JAMIA系统评价纳入1072项研究、结论明确，属重要档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 评估临床预测模型的外部验证和临床实施反映的是转化路径中的连续阶段还是不同阶段。这项横断面meta流行病学研究分析了2017-2019年间跨临床领域发表的1072个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至2025年8月的引文筛查评估下游外部验证和临床实施。评估的暴露因素包括公开代码可用性、TRIPOD依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠。在1072项研究中，88.1%缺乏转化后续研究。仅9.9%进行了外部验证，5.2%达到临床实施。代码可用性（比值比[OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91-4.84）和更高的TRIPOD依从性（每增加10%的OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04-3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施并不一致相关。值得注意的是，39%已实施的模型缺乏先前的外部验证。独立团队主要开展外部验证（72.6%），而实施常涉及原始开发团队。研究结果表明显算法转化存在分化。强调可评估性的特征（代码可用性、报告透明度）促进外部验证，但并不能确保临床实施。实施前频繁绕过独立验证突显了对机构和操作因素的依赖，而非可推广的方法学。外部验证和临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而非受一组统一因素影响的连续阶段。当前实践促进了验证，但未充分满足真实世界部署的操作要求。

title: Understanding clinical reasoning variability in medical large language models: a mechanistic interpretability study
zh_title: 医学大模型临床推理变异性的机制可解释研究
summary: 用3035条医生验证扰动测试三个医学大模型，发现推理稳定性差，并以稀疏自编码器解析内部表征。
key_points: 仅提示格式变化即可使分期准确率变动超50%
临床信息不足时模型仍给出确定性分期
稀疏自编码器显示MedGemma存在分层编码
reason: 方法新颖、扰动规模大，但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Medical large language models achieving high benchmark accuracy exhibit unexplained variability in clinical tasks, producing errors that clinicians cannot safeguard against. We evaluated clinical reasoning stability in GPT-5, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, and OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B using 3035 systematic perturbations from physician-validated oncology SOAP, brief vignette, and MIMIC cases. We trained sparse autoencoders on 1 billion tokens from 50,000 MIMIC-IV clinical notes to decompose their internal representation. We find models exhibit dramatic reasoning instability, shifting staging accuracy by over 50% based solely on prompt format, or generating definitive staging in clinically insufficient scenarios. Sparse autoencoder analysis revealed hierarchical encoding in MedGemma, where high-magnitude features encode lexical identity and low-magnitude features encode contextual meaning. OpenBioLLM distributes information uniformly. We demonstrate that these internal encoding structures differentially affect retrieval and reasoning interventions, suggesting interventions effective for one architecture may harm another. These results motivate architecture-specific safety validation as a component of pre-deployment evaluation for medical LLMs.
zh_abstract: 在基准测试中取得高准确率的医学大型语言模型在临床任务中表现出无法解释的变异性，产生临床医生无法防范的错误。我们使用来自医生验证的肿瘤学SOAP、简要病例摘要和MIMIC病例的3035个系统性扰动，评估了GPT-5、MedGemma-27B-Text-IT和OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B的临床推理稳定性。我们在来自50,000份MIMIC-IV临床记录的10亿个token上训练稀疏自编码器，以分解其内部表示。我们发现模型表现出显著的推理不稳定性，仅因提示格式不同就使分期准确率变化超过50%，或在临床信息不足的情况下生成确定性分期。稀疏自编码器分析揭示了MedGemma中的分层编码，其中高幅度特征编码词汇身份，低幅度特征编码上下文含义。OpenBioLLM均匀分布信息。我们证明这些内部编码结构对检索和推理干预产生不同影响，表明对一种架构有效的干预可能损害另一种架构。这些结果推动将架构特异性安全验证作为医学LLM部署前评估的组成部分。

title: Generation of synthetic clinical text: a systematic review
zh_title: 合成临床文本生成：系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入87篇文献，量化分析合成临床文本的生成目的、技术与评估方法，提示LLM提示已成为主要文本来源。
key_points: 检索四库1148篇，最终纳入87篇相关文献
约40篇以提示大模型作为合成文本来源
63篇使用GPT类技术，其中47篇涉及ChatGPT
reason: 同行评审系统综述、纳入文献较多且结论明确，但属综述档上限
abstract: Generating medical synthetic text represents an effective solution for clinical NLP issues like sparsity and privacy. This paper conducts a systematic review on synthetic clinical text generation by formulating quantitative analysis to three research questions concerning the generation’s purpose, generation techniques, and the evaluation methods. We searched four databases including PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect and Web of Science for publications associated with the topic and identified 87 relevant articles out of 1148. Results showed that the generation purposes were dedicated to Trustworthy, Medical Assistance, and Language Resource themes. Prompting LLMs was the main source of synthetic text (40 articles). GPTs were the main predominant technique used to generate the text (63 articles), especially ChatGPT (47 articles). Additionally, there were four main aspects of evaluation, including similarity, privacy, structure, and utility, where utility was the prevailing method for assessment (52 articles). The synthetic medical text empowered data augmentation and clinical documentation. Using text alteration, controlling real text portions, and federated learning, generative models can produce privacy-preserving medical text. This accelerates the development of new digital health applications.
zh_abstract: 生成医学合成文本是解决临床自然语言处理（NLP）中稀疏性和隐私性等问题的有效方案。本文通过围绕生成目的、生成技术和评估方法这三个研究问题开展定量分析，对合成临床文本生成进行了系统综述。我们检索了PubMed、Scopus、ScienceDirect和Web of Science四个数据库中与该主题相关的出版物，从1148篇中识别出87篇相关文章。结果显示，生成目的集中于可信性（Trustworthy）、医疗辅助（Medical Assistance）和语言资源（Language Resource）主题。提示大语言模型是合成文本的主要来源（40篇）。GPT是用于生成文本的主要主流技术（63篇），尤其是ChatGPT（47篇）。此外，评估主要有四个方面，包括相似性、隐私性、结构和效用，其中效用是占主导地位的评估方法（52篇）。合成医学文本增强了数据扩增和临床文档记录。利用文本改写、控制真实文本部分以及联邦学习，生成模型能够产生隐私保护型医学文本。这加速了新型数字健康应用的发展。

title: Subgroup deployment-readiness audit of calibration and clinical utility in perioperative infection prediction.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 围手术期感染预测模型的分组校准与部署就绪度审计
summary: JAMIA 发表研究，审计术后感染预测模型在不同临床亚组中的校准与净获益，基于10719例手术的回顾性数据。
key_points: 纳入10719例手术、504例术后感染事件
按性别、年龄、生理储备分组评估校准与净获益
比较等渗重校准与去掉SMOTE后的重拟合
reason: 大样本回顾性内部验证，属设计规范的回顾性研究档，无外部验证故不超6
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA] 我们审计了一个用于手术结束后的术后感染模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪度，并评估了对亚组校准不良的缓解情况。我们分析了来自10 719例手术（2014-2022年）的折外预测（out-of-fold predictions），这些手术中有504例入院时存在（present-on-admission, POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄和一项临床生理储备替代指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准、阈值特异性错误和决策曲线净获益，将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们将不进行重校准与常用重校准及组特异性交叉拟合等渗重校准进行比较，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性和男性的性别边际区分度相似（0.878 vs 0.875）。总体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为-1.02，衰弱患者为-0.86，衰弱前期患者为-1.34；仅有6个事件的非衰弱层无法估计。在源队列中，t = 0.10时，衰弱患者的净获益为正，衰弱前期患者的净获益为负，但衰弱前期的负效用未在可确定期（2018-2022年）和时间分析中持续存在。常用重校准将总体校准从-1.020移至-0.007。去除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未降低储备梯度。时间留出AUROC为0.851，并持续存在过度预测。2018年之前入院时存在编码实际上缺失；因此，依赖患病率的结果还额外报告了可确定的2018-2022年期间，并且确定情况因生理储备而异。仅评估区分度或性别边际评估会遗漏与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确定会影响依赖患病率的解释。联合亚组评估可以识别汇总指标所遗漏的与部署相关的局限性。在临床部署前，仍需使用可比结局确定方法进行前瞻性验证。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled detection of vascular perfusion defects on ventilation/perfusion (V/Q) scintigraphy for pulmonary embolism.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: AI自动分割V/Q显像肺灌注缺损检测肺栓塞
summary: 在2118例回顾性平面V/Q显像上比较四种AI模型自动分割灌注缺损与人工标注的表现。
key_points: 回顾性纳入2019—2023年2118例患者扫描
四种2D网络与人工标注者对比
目标是标准化V/Q不匹配缺损的量化
reason: 单中心回顾性、样本量大且有人工对照，但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Accurate interpretation of planar ventilation-perfusion (V/Q) scintigraphy, used for diagnosing pulmonary embolism (PE) based on PIOPED/EANM guidelines, requires objective assessment of mismatched V/Q defects. Manual delineation of V/Q defects is time-consuming, subject to interobserver variability, and rarely performed in practice, limiting standardized reporting and quantification of disease burden. To address these challenges, we evaluated four modern AI models for automated segmentation of vascular perfusion defects in planar V/Q scans and compared their performance to human annotators. We retrospectively identified 2,118 patients who underwent planar V/Q scans at The Ottawa Hospital (June 2019-February 2023). Six standard projections (ANT, POST, LAO, RAO, LPO, RPO) were included. Four 2D neural networks (U-Net, nnU-Net, Swin UNETR, and a Bottleneck Transformer U-Net [BTU-Net]) were trained on 1,313 patients (7,878 projections) and validated on 329 (1,974 projections) using physician-annotated defects. A hold-out test set of 46 high probability patients was used to evaluate segmentation quality, and defect detection accuracy using free-response receiver operating characteristic (FROC) analysis. BTU-Net was the only model performing on par with human readers, showing robust sensitivity across the entire range of segmentation probabilities. At 1.5 false positives per projection rate (FPPR), BTU-Net outperformed other models with sensitivity of 0.529 ± 0.026, On a separate hold-out set of low likelihood of disease patients (n=430), the lowest FPPR was 0.08 ± 0.01 for BTU-Net (P<0.0001). BTU-Net enables rapid, consistent, and accurate interpretation of planar V/Q scans. Such tools may enhance diagnostic efficiency, standardize reporting, and support non-expert readers in evaluating PE.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 基于PIOPED/EANM指南，平面通气-灌注（V/Q）闪烁显像用于诊断肺栓塞（PE），其准确解读需要对不匹配的V/Q缺损进行客观评估。手工勾画V/Q缺损耗时、受观察者间变异影响，且在实践中很少执行，限制了标准化报告和疾病负担量化。为应对这些挑战，我们评估了四种现代AI模型，用于平面V/Q扫描中血管灌注缺损的自动分割，并将其性能与人类标注者进行比较。我们回顾性识别了2019年6月至2023年2月在The Ottawa Hospital接受平面V/Q扫描的2,118例患者。纳入六个标准投影（ANT、POST、LAO、RAO、LPO、RPO）。四种二维神经网络（U-Net、nnU-Net、Swin UNETR和Bottleneck Transformer U-Net [BTU-Net]）在1,313例患者（7,878个投影）上训练，并在329例患者（1,974个投影）上使用医师标注缺损进行验证。使用46例高概率患者的留出测试集评估分割质量，并使用自由响应受试者工作特征（FROC）分析评估缺损检测准确性。BTU-Net是唯一表现与人类阅片者相当的模型，在整个分割概率范围内均表现出稳健的敏感性。在每投影假阳性率为1.5（FPPR）时，BTU-Net以0.529 ± 0.026的敏感性优于其他模型；在另一个低疾病可能性患者（n=430）的单独留出集上，BTU-Net的最低FPPR为0.08 ± 0.01（P<0.0001）。BTU-Net能够实现平面V/Q扫描快速、一致且准确的解读。此类工具可能提高诊断效率、标准化报告，并支持非专家阅片者评估PE。

title: Machine learning and deep learning for diagnosis of endometriosis: systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习诊断子宫内膜异位症：系统综述与meta分析
summary: 纳入22项研究的系统综述与meta分析显示，ML/DL诊断子宫内膜异位症的合并敏感度0.90、特异度0.75、SROC-AUC 0.92。
key_points: 纳入22项研究，按PRISMA规范并使用QUADAS-2评估偏倚
合并敏感度0.90、特异度0.75、SROC-AUC 0.92
多中心设计与深度学习与更低敏感度相关
reason: 系统综述纳入22项研究且结论明确，按规则可到重要档，但异质性限制证据。
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] To assess the diagnostic accuracy of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for endometriosis. A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines (PROSPERO: CRD420251231469). Databases were searched through November 24, 2025. Twenty-two eligible studies were included. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-2. Pooled analysis was conducted in Stata 18.0. Pooled sensitivity was 0.90 (95% CI 0.86-0.93), specificity 0.75 (95% CI 0.64-0.84), and SROC-AUC 0.92 (95% CI 0.89-0.94). A positive prediction increased disease probability from 10% to 29%, whereas a negative prediction reduced it to 1%. Multicenter design and DL were associated with lower sensitivity. Results were robust. ML/DL models demonstrate high diagnostic performance and are promising for non-invasive auxiliary diagnosis. Large multicenter prospective studies and multimodal models are needed to enable clinical translation.Systematic Review Registration: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251231469, identifier CRD420251231469.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 评估机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型对子宫内膜异位症的诊断准确性。按照PRISMA指南（PROSPERO：CRD420251231469）进行系统综述和荟萃分析。数据库检索截至2025年11月24日。纳入22项符合条件的研究。使用QUADAS-2评估偏倚风险。在Stata 18.0中进行合并分析。合并敏感性为0.90（95% CI 0.86-0.93），特异性为0.75（95% CI 0.64-0.84），SROC-AUC为0.92（95% CI 0.89-0.94）。阳性预测将疾病概率从10%提高到29%，而阴性预测将其降低到1%。多中心设计和DL与较低的敏感性相关。结果稳健。ML/DL模型表现出高诊断性能，有望用于无创辅助诊断。需要大型多中心前瞻性研究和多模态模型以实现临床转化。系统综述注册：https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251231469，标识符CRD420251231469。

title: CT-based deep learning integrating pancreatic imaging and body composition for severity prediction in acute pancreatitis.
zh_title: CT深度学习融合人体成分预测急性胰腺炎严重度
summary: 双中心回顾性研究基于胰腺三维与L3层面脂肪、肌肉二维深度学习模型预测急性胰腺炎严重度，主队列426例、外部测试110例。
key_points: 主队列426例，外部中心测试集110例
构建胰腺、VAT、SM及联合等六个模型
纳入发病72小时内CT，回顾性设计

abstract: [Insights into imaging] To develop and validate a deep learning (DL)-based CT model integrating pancreatic imaging and CT-derived body composition for severity prediction in acute pancreatitis (AP). In this retrospective dual-center study, patients with AP who underwent CT within 72 h of symptom onset were enrolled from January 2021 to September 2025 at Center 1 and January 2023 to September 2024 at Center 2. The primary dataset (n = 426) was randomly divided into a training set (n = 298) and an internal test set (n = 128), while 110 patients from Center 2 served as the external test set. A three-dimensional DL model was developed for pancreatic imaging, and two-dimensional DL models were constructed for L3-level visceral adipose tissue (VAT) and skeletal muscle (SM). Six predictive models were constructed: clinical, pancreas, VAT, SM, pancreas-clinical (PC), and combined. Performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis, DeLong testing, calibration, decision curve analysis, net reclassification improvement (NRI), and integrated discrimination improvement (IDI). The combined model achieved area under the curve (AUCs) of 0.897 (95% CI: 0.862-0.932), 0.909 (95% CI: 0.861-0.958), and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.856-0.964) in the training, internal test, and external test sets, respectively. The combined model outperformed the PC model in the training set (p = 0.002) and external test set (p = 0.020). NRI and IDI analyses confirmed the incremental predictive value of body composition features. A CT-based DL model integrating pancreatic imaging, body composition, and clinical variables demonstrated good performance for AP severity prediction. Question Early severity stratification in AP remains challenging because conventional clinical and imaging assessments may not fully capture pancreatic injury and systemic disease status. Findings A CT-based DL model integrating pancreatic imaging, body composition, and clinical variables demonstrated good performance for severity prediction in AP. Critical Relevance Statement This study evaluates the value of integrating pancreatic imaging and CT-derived body composition information and supports the use of routinely acquired CT data for early risk stratification, potentially facilitating more individualized monitoring and management of AP.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 开发并验证一个基于深度学习（DL）的CT模型，整合胰腺影像与CT衍生的身体成分，用于急性胰腺炎（AP）的严重程度预测。在这项回顾性双中心研究中，纳入自2021年1月至2025年9月在中心1、以及2023年1月至2024年9月在中心2、于症状发作72小时内接受CT检查的AP患者。主要数据集（n = 426）随机分为训练集（n = 298）和内部测试集（n = 128），而来自中心2的110例患者作为外部测试集。开发了一个用于胰腺影像的三维DL模型，并构建了用于L3层面内脏脂肪组织（VAT）和骨骼肌（SM）的二维DL模型。构建了六个预测模型：临床、胰腺、VAT、SM、胰腺-临床（PC）和联合模型。使用受试者工作特征分析、DeLong检验、校准、决策曲线分析、净重分类改善（NRI）和综合判别改善（IDI）评估性能。联合模型在训练集、内部测试集和外部测试集中的曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.897（95% CI：0.862-0.932）、0.909（95% CI：0.861-0.958）和0.910（95% CI：0.856-0.964）。联合模型在训练集（p = 0.002）和外部测试集（p = 0.020）中优于PC模型。NRI和IDI分析证实了身体成分特征的增量预测价值。一个整合胰腺影像、身体成分和临床变量的基于CT的DL模型在AP严重程度预测中表现出良好性能。【问题】AP的早期严重程度分层仍然具有挑战性，因为传统临床和影像评估可能无法完全反映胰腺损伤和全身疾病状态。【发现】一个整合胰腺影像、身体成分和临床变量的基于CT的DL模型在AP严重程度预测中表现出良好性能。【关键相关性声明】本研究评估了整合胰腺影像和CT衍生身体成分信息的价值，并支持使用常规获取的CT数据进行早期风险分层，可能有助于促进AP更个体化的监测和管理。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Assessing the Relationship Between Mandibular Third Molars and the Inferior Alveolar Nerve on Panoramic Radiographs: A Systematic Review.
source: PubMed · Medicina oral, patologia oral y cirugia bucal
zh_title: AI评估下颌第三磨牙与下牙槽神经关系的系统综述
summary: 系统评价AI模型在全景片上判断下颌第三磨牙与下牙槽神经关系时的准确性。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Cochrane、Embase与Scopus
纳入2020年1月至2026年4月发表研究
以CBCT或专家判断作为参考标准
关注术前神经损伤风险评估的准确性

abstract: [Medicina oral, patologia oral y cirugia bucal] Extracting mandibular third molars is a common procedure that carries a risk of injury to the inferior alveolar nerve (IAN). Panoramic radiographs (PR) are commonly used for preoperative assessment of the mandibular third molars, but they are not very reliable for evaluating the relationship of the IAN. This systematic review aims to evaluate the accuracy of artificial intelligence (AI) models in assessing the relationship between mandibular third molars and the IAN. We conducted systematic searches in MEDLINE (via PubMed), the Cochrane Library, Embase, and Scopus for studies published between January 2020 and April 2026. Eligible studies evaluated artificial intelligence systems that analyze panoramic radiographs to assess the relationship between mandibular third molars and the IAN, using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) or expert assessments as references. The studies had to report key diagnostic performance metrics. Two independent reviewers carried out study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessments using the QUADAS-2 tool. We included eleven studies with more than 9,700 patients. The AI models reviewed, including architectures such as ResNet, VGG, and YOLO, demonstrated promising diagnostic performance. Their accuracy ranged from 0.630 to 0.896, with sensitivity and specificity reaching up to 0.92 and 0.95, respectively. No single architecture was consistently superior, but AI models outperformed less experienced human observers in the studies that included this comparison. Validation against CBCT usually yielded more reliable performance metrics than validation based solely on expert opinion. AI models show promise as decision-support tools in the radiographic assessment of the relationship between mandibular third molars and the inferior alveolar nerve on panoramic radiographs. However, variations in datasets, reference standards, and validation methods across studies mean that no single architecture can yet be considered superior. Larger, multicenter, prospective studies with external validation are necessary to confirm these systems' performance before they can be widely used in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Medicina oral, patologia oral y cirugia bucal] 拔除下颌第三磨牙是一项常见操作，存在损伤下牙槽神经（inferior alveolar nerve, IAN）的风险。全景X线片（panoramic radiographs, PR）常用于下颌第三磨牙的术前评估，但其在评估IAN关系方面并不可靠。本系统评价旨在评估人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）模型在评估下颌第三磨牙与IAN关系方面的准确性。我们在MEDLINE（通过PubMed）、Cochrane Library、Embase和Scopus中进行了系统检索，检索2020年1月至2026年4月发表的研究。符合条件的研究评估了分析全景X线片以评估下颌第三磨牙与IAN关系的人工智能系统，并以锥形束计算机断层扫描（cone-beam computed tomography, CBCT）或专家评估作为参考。这些研究必须报告关键诊断性能指标。两名独立评审者使用QUADAS-2工具进行研究选择、数据提取和偏倚风险评估。我们纳入了11项研究，涉及超过9,700例患者。所审查的AI模型，包括ResNet、VGG和YOLO等架构，显示出有希望的诊断性能。其准确度范围为0.630至0.896，灵敏度和特异度分别最高达0.92和0.95。没有单一架构始终更优，但在包含该比较的研究中，AI模型优于经验较少的人类观察者。以CBCT为参考进行验证通常比仅基于专家意见的验证产生更可靠的性能指标。AI模型有望作为决策支持工具，用于在全景X线片上对下颌第三磨牙与下牙槽神经关系的影像学评估。然而，各研究在数据集、参考标准和验证方法上的差异意味着目前尚不能认为任何单一架构更优。需要更大规模、多中心、前瞻性并带有外部验证的研究来确认这些系统的性能，之后才能将其广泛用于临床实践。

title: Statistical Pitfalls in Large Language Model Evaluation: A Practical Guide to Study Design and Analysis.
zh_title: 大语言模型评估中的统计陷阱：研究设计实用指南
summary: 指出医学大模型评估中多来源回答同一组问题却按独立观测分析的设计—统计错配，并给出配对设计分析建议。
key_points: 同一问题集由多模型、医生或患教材料作答
由此产生的观测本质上相互配对
许多研究误用假设独立观测的统计方法
提出研究设计与分析上的实用改进建议
reason: 方法学指南类文章，无原始数据，上限6分，取值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of clinical epidemiology] Studies evaluating large language models in medicine increasingly follow a common design in which a fixed set of clinical questions is posed to several sources, such as different language models, clinicians, or patient-education resources. The responses are then scored for outcomes including accuracy, completeness, readability, or similar measures. Because each source answers the same set of questions, the resulting observations are inherently paired: the question functions as the repeated unit across sources. Despite this structure, many studies analyze the resulting data using statistical procedures that assume independent observations. Treating paired observations as independent introduces a mismatch between the study design and the statistical analysis. In evaluations where multiple sources respond to the same questions, the responses are naturally correlated because they are influenced by shared characteristics of the question, such as difficulty or ambiguity. Ignoring this dependence can reduce statistical power and distort the nominal type I error rate. These issues arise when commonly used independent-sample procedures, including the Mann-Whitney test, the Kruskal-Wallis test, one-way analysis of variance, or unpaired t-tests, are applied to datasets generated from identical question sets. The appropriate analytical framework instead treats the question as the unit of pairing. Methods designed for repeated or paired observations, such as the Friedman test or repeated-measures analysis of variance for overall comparisons, followed by paired contrasts using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test or paired t-tests with appropriate multiplicity correction, provide analyses that align with the underlying design. Effect sizes and regression approaches that account for the paired structure, including mixed-effects models with question treated as a random effect, may further strengthen inference. Recognizing the repeated-measures nature of these evaluations provides a straightforward path toward more statistically coherent analyses.
zh_abstract: 评估医学大语言模型的研究越来越遵循一种常见设计：将一组固定的临床问题提交给若干来源，例如不同的语言模型、临床医生或患者教育资源。随后对回答按准确性、完整性、可读性或类似指标等结局进行评分。由于每个来源回答同一组问题，所得观察本质上是配对的：问题作为跨来源的重复单位。尽管存在这种结构，许多研究仍使用假设观察独立的统计程序分析所得数据。将配对观察视为独立会造成研究设计与统计分析之间的不匹配。在多个来源回答相同问题的评估中，回答自然相关，因为它们受到问题共同特征（如难度或歧义性）的影响。忽视这种依赖性可能降低统计功效并扭曲名义I型错误率。当常用的独立样本程序——包括Mann-Whitney检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验、单因素方差分析或非配对t检验——应用于由相同问题集生成的数据集时，这些问题就会出现。相反，合适的分析框架将问题视为配对单位。为重复或配对观察设计的方法，例如用于总体比较的Friedman检验或重复测量方差分析，随后使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验或经适当多重性校正的配对t检验进行配对对比，可提供与底层设计一致的分析。考虑配对结构的效应量和回归方法，包括将问题视为随机效应的混合效应模型，可进一步增强推断。认识到这些评估的重复测量性质，为开展统计上更一致的分析提供了一条直接路径。

title: An interpretable deep learning framework for revealing fine-grained spatial domains.
zh_title: 可解释深度学习框架RIF识别精细空间域
summary: 提出半监督图神经网络框架RIF，用于空间转录组精细空间域划分并通过网络可解释性检测空间变异基因。
key_points: 利用伪标签半监督图神经网络保持组织结构
双预处理集成策略提升鲁棒性与泛化
可在多个测序平台上优于现有对比算法
小鼠脑组织中解析海马亚区与嗅球分层
reason: 同行评审新方法，多平台对比优于现有算法，但缺外部临床验证
abstract: [Cell reports methods] Spatial transcriptomics enables gene expression profiling with preserved spatial context, yet accurate spatial domain delineation remains challenging. We present RIF, a robust and interpretable deep learning framework for fine-grained spatial domain identification. RIF leverages graph neural networks semi-supervised with pseudo-labels to preserve tissue structural integrity. It incorporates a dual-preprocessing ensemble strategy to improve model robustness and generalization. It further enables spatially variable gene detection through network interpretability. Across multiple sequencing platforms, RIF outperformed state-of-the-art comparison algorithms in spatial domain identification. In mouse brain tissue, RIF identified corresponding hippocampal subfields in the spatially separated dorsal and ventral regions and resolved the laminar organization of the olfactory bulb. In breast cancer, RIF-defined domains suggest suppressed T cell activity associated with hypoxic and oxidative microenvironments. In an invasive ductal carcinoma dataset of more than 720,000 cells, RIF-defined domains suggest an epithelial-mesenchymal transition gradient, including reduced hormone dependence and extracellular matrix remodeling.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports methods] 空间转录组学能够在保留空间背景的情况下进行基因表达谱分析，但准确划分空间域仍具有挑战性。我们提出RIF，一种用于细粒度空间域识别的稳健且可解释的深度学习框架。RIF利用带伪标签的半监督图神经网络来保持组织结构完整性。它采用双预处理集成策略来提高模型的稳健性和泛化能力。它还通过网络可解释性实现空间可变基因检测。在多个测序平台上，RIF在空间域识别方面优于最先进的对比算法。在小鼠脑组织中，RIF识别了空间分离的背侧和腹侧区域中相应的海马亚区，并解析了嗅球的层状组织。在乳腺癌中，RIF定义的域提示与缺氧和氧化微环境相关的T细胞活性受抑制。在一个包含超过720,000个细胞的浸润性导管癌数据集中，RIF定义的域提示上皮-间质转化梯度，包括激素依赖性降低和细胞外基质重塑。

title: CT-Based Pulmonary Segment Delineation: An Imaging Informatics Review of Methods, Benchmarks, Robustness, and Clinical Deployment.

zh_title: CT肺段分割的成像信息学综述：方法、基准与部署
summary: 该综述从成像信息学角度梳理CT支气管肺段分割的传统多阶段流程与深度学习框架，包括CNN、GNN、隐式神经表示与高斯混合模型。
