abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Accurate bronchopulmonary segment delineation on computed tomography (CT) is essential for segmentectomy planning, computer-assisted thoracic interventions, and fine-grained quantitative lung analysis. However, segment-level parenchymal partitioning remains technically challenging because intersegmental boundaries are often subtle or indistinct on routine CT, requiring bronchovascular priors-particularly airway and vascular trees-to guide anatomically plausible delineation. This review presents an imaging informatics-based synthesis of CT-based pulmonary segment delineation, covering conventional multi-stage pipelines and recent deep learning frameworks, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), graph neural networks (GNNs), implicit neural representations, and continuous spatial modeling parameterized by Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). We organize evaluation practices into three complementary categories: direct ground-truth-based metrics, indirect anatomy-referenced criteria, and reference-free plausibility or quality-control measures. We further review publicly available datasets, annotation protocols, and benchmark limitations that currently hinder reproducible and fair segment-level comparison. From a deployment perspective, we discuss clinical workflow requirements, robustness challenges, and the need for anatomy-aware and data-efficient methods. Illustrative analyses of a single cystic fibrosis (CF) case using a distance-based method show how removal of a segmental airway branch or omission of lobar constraints can substantially alter the resulting segment territories. These case-specific observations motivate broader robustness evaluation, uncertainty-aware quality control, boundary-level plausibility checks, and deployment-oriented validation beyond conventional overlap-based metrics.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 在计算机断层扫描（computed tomography，CT）上准确勾画支气管肺段对于肺段切除术规划、计算机辅助胸部介入以及细粒度定量肺分析至关重要。然而，肺段水平的肺实质分区在技术上仍具有挑战性，因为段间边界在常规CT上通常细微或不清晰，需要支气管血管先验——尤其是气道和血管树——来指导解剖上合理的勾画。本综述从影像信息学角度对基于CT的肺段勾画进行综合，涵盖传统多阶段流程和近期深度学习框架，包括卷积神经网络（CNNs）、图神经网络（GNNs）、隐式神经表示以及由高斯混合模型（Gaussian mixture models，GMMs）参数化的连续空间建模。我们将评价实践组织为三个互补类别：基于直接金标准的指标、间接以解剖为参照的标准，以及无参考的合理性或质量控制指标。我们进一步综述公开可用数据集、标注方案以及目前阻碍可重复且公平的肺段水平比较的基准局限性。从部署视角，我们讨论临床工作流程需求、稳健性挑战，以及对解剖感知和数据高效方法的需求。使用基于距离的方法对单个囊性纤维化（cystic fibrosis，CF）病例进行的示例性分析显示，去除某一肺段气道分支或省略肺叶约束可显著改变所得的肺段区域。这些病例特异性观察促使开展更广泛的稳健性评估、不确定性感知的质量控制、边界水平合理性检查，以及超越传统基于重叠指标的面向部署验证。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Graph Methods for Microbiome Research: A Systematic Review.
zh_title: 微生物组研究的AI图方法系统综述
summary: 系统综述梳理以菌群为节点、关系为边的图方法，提出网络表示、经典图分析与图表示学习三类分类框架。
key_points: 图方法将分类单元建模为节点、关系为边
提出三分法归类各研究主要贡献
涵盖从经典网络分析到图表示学习的演进
reason: 系统综述方法学梳理清晰，但非原始研究且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [WIREs mechanisms of disease] The complexity of high-throughput sequencing data in microbiome research necessitates advanced analytical methods to decipher microbial community structures and interactions. Graph-based methods, which model taxa as nodes and their relationships as edges, have emerged as a powerful framework for this purpose. However, the rapid evolution of these techniques, from classical network analysis to modern graph representation learning, has created a fragmented and complex methodological landscape. This systematic review provides a comprehensive synthesis and structured overview of the field. We systematically review the literature and propose a three-part classification to categorize the primary contribution of each study: (1) novel methods for microbial network representation, (2) applications of classical graph analysis, and (3) the emerging use of graph representation learning for predictive modeling. We summarize the most frequent applications within each class, including keystone species identification, community clustering, and graph-based disease classification. Furthermore, we identify critical cross-cutting challenges, such as the lack of standardized tools and the need for improved model interpretability. By structuring the current landscape of graph-based methods, this review serves as a crucial guide for researchers to select appropriate models and highlights key gaps to direct future research.
zh_abstract: [WIREs mechanisms of disease] 微生物组研究中高通量测序数据的复杂性，需要先进的分析方法来解析微生物群落结构和相互作用。基于图的方法将分类单元建模为节点、将其关系建模为边，已成为实现这一目的的有力框架。然而，这些技术的快速演进——从经典网络分析到现代图表示学习——造成了碎片化且复杂的方法学格局。本系统综述对该领域进行了全面综合和结构化概述。我们系统回顾文献，并提出三部分分类，以归类每项研究的主要贡献：（1）用于微生物网络表示的新方法；（2）经典图分析的应用；（3）图表示学习用于预测建模的新兴应用。我们总结每一类别中最常见的应用，包括关键物种识别、群落聚类和基于图的疾病分类。此外，我们识别出关键的跨领域挑战，如缺乏标准化工具以及需要提高模型可解释性。通过构建基于图的方法的当前格局，本综述为研究人员选择合适模型提供了关键指南，并突出了指导未来研究的关键空白。

title: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy: a systematic review.
zh_title: 宫颈图像引导近距离放疗AI应用系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020纳入52项研究，评估AI在宫颈癌图像引导近距离放疗的分割、计划、重建、配准与施源器选择中的应用与表现。
key_points: 纳入2010–2026年52项原创研究
深度学习分割表现因器官与研究而异
部分危及器官Dice接近或超过0.90
reason: 系统综述纳入52项研究、结论明确，但综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Imaging-guided interventional radiotherapy (IG-IRT) is the standard of care for locally advanced cervical cancer but remains time-consuming and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool to improve efficiency and reproducibility. A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, searching PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science for studies published between 2010 and 2026 investigating AI-based imaging applications in cervical IRT. Eligible studies included original research evaluating segmentation (targets and organ at risk), planning, reconstruction, image registration and applicator selection. Fifty-two studies were included. Deep learning-based segmentation showed variable performance across anatomical structures and studies, with Dice coefficients approaching or exceeding 0.90 for some organs at risk and target volumes in the best-performing models. Individual studies reported shorter processing times, reduced contouring variability, accurate applicator reconstruction, and potential support for applicator selection. However, the substantial methodological and clinical heterogeneity precluded direct comparisons among AI approaches. The available studies suggest that AI may support the automation of selected workflow steps and assist treatment-related decision-making in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy. While several applications have achieved high technical performance, most remain at the proof-of-concept stage, and robust external validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed before routine clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 影像引导介入放疗（Imaging-guided interventional radiotherapy，IG-IRT）是局部晚期宫颈癌的标准治疗，但仍耗时且依赖操作者。人工智能（Artificial intelligence，AI）已成为提高效率和可重复性的有前景工具。按照PRISMA 2020指南开展了一项系统评价，检索PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science，获取2010年至2026年发表的研究，探讨基于AI的影像应用在宫颈IRT中的应用。符合条件的研究包括评估分割（靶区和危及器官）、计划、重建、图像配准和施源器选择的原创研究。共纳入52项研究。基于深度学习的分割在不同解剖结构和不同研究中表现不一，在表现最佳的模型中，某些危及器官和靶区的Dice系数接近或超过0.90。单项研究报告了更短的处理时间、更低的勾画变异性、准确的施源器重建以及对施源器选择的潜在支持。然而，显著的方法学和临床异质性阻碍了AI方法之间的直接比较。现有研究表明，AI可能支持部分工作流程步骤的自动化，并辅助影像引导宫颈介入放疗中的治疗相关决策。虽然若干应用已达到较高的技术性能，但大多数仍处于概念验证阶段，在常规临床采用前需要稳健的外部验证和前瞻性临床评估。

title: Small molecule structure elucidation from NMR spectra with generative and reasoning models
zh_title: 生成与推理模型从NMR谱解析小分子结构
summary: bioRxiv 预印本提出 ChefNMR2 原子流匹配生成模型，结合大模型推理智能体，从分子式与一维NMR谱自动解析结构。
key_points: 从分子式与1H/13C谱预测结构
推理智能体迭代筛选候选结构
多基准上优于现有工具
reason: 预印本新方法有基准对比，未同行评审、无独立验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Elucidating the structures of unknown small molecules remains a major challenge in chemistry, pharmacology, and drug discovery. While nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is the gold standard for structure elucidation, interpreting spectra remains labor-intensive and requires expert knowledge to navigate the vast space of possible structures. Here, we present an AI system for rapid, automated de novo structure elucidation that combines a molecular generative model with a scientific reasoning agent. Its generative component, ChefNMR2, is an atomic flow-matching model that predicts small-molecule structures from molecular formulae and one-dimensional 1H and 13C NMR spectra. ChefNMR2-Agent augments our generative model with large language models (LLMs) to reason over and refine candidate structures. Across diverse benchmarks, ChefNMR2 substantially outperforms existing tools, offering calibrated confidence estimates and two to three orders of magnitude faster inference than frontier LLMs. We use ChefNMR2-Agent to elucidate the structures of four novel natural products, matching human-chemist accuracy in a fraction of the time. Our work demonstrates how specialized generative models and general-purpose reasoning agents can unite to solve challenging scientific inverse problems and accelerate NMR structure elucidation, thus opening new possibilities for AI-driven small-molecule discovery across diverse disciplines.
zh_abstract: 阐明未知小分子的结构仍然是化学、药理学和药物发现中的重大挑战。尽管核磁共振（NMR）波谱是结构阐明的金标准，但解读谱图仍然劳动密集，并且需要专家知识来在可能结构的巨大空间中导航。在此，我们提出一个用于快速、自动化从头结构阐明的AI系统，它将分子生成模型与科学推理智能体相结合。其生成组件ChefNMR2是一个原子流匹配模型，可从分子式和一维1H与13C NMR谱预测小分子结构。ChefNMR2-Agent用大型语言模型（LLM）增强我们的生成模型，以对候选结构进行推理和细化。在多样化基准上，ChefNMR2大幅优于现有工具，提供经校准的置信度估计，并且推理速度比前沿LLM快两到三个数量级。我们使用ChefNMR2-Agent阐明了四种新型天然产物的结构，在极短时间内达到与人类化学家相当的准确率。我们的工作展示了专用生成模型和通用推理智能体如何联合起来解决具有挑战性的科学逆问题并加速NMR结构阐明，从而为跨学科AI驱动的小分子发现开辟新可能。

title: Artificial intelligence across the cataract care continuum: a systematic scoping review introducing the CAICC framework and the surgical complexity prediction gap.
zh_title: 白内障全病程AI应用范围综述与CAICC框架
summary: 按PRISMA-ScR检索2020年至2025年7月的原创研究，梳理AI在白内障诊疗全流程的分布、任务表现与验证成熟度，提出CAICC框架并指出手术复杂度预测缺口。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA-ScR的范围综述
提出白内障AI临床连续体CAICC证据图
指出手术复杂度预测的证据空白
reason: 范围综述有信息量但无新数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [BMC ophthalmology] Cataracts remain a leading cause of reversible blindness, and artificial intelligence (AI) applications now span the cataract care pathway. However, the distribution of these applications and their validation maturity remain unclear. This review mapped AI across the care continuum, summarized task-specific performance, characterized validation maturity, and identified evidence gaps. The Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) was followed. PubMed, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, WorldCat, and the American Academy of Ophthalmology Meeting Archive were searched; the final search was completed on 20 July 2025. Eligible studies were English-language primary research published from 1 January 2020 through 20 July 2025. A review-specific cataract artificial intelligence clinical continuum (CAICC) evidence-mapping framework was developed during data charting and synthesis. Two reviewers independently conducted study selection, data extraction, endpoint adjudication, and validation-maturity assessment. Performance was summarized descriptively; validation maturity characterized evaluation independence and clinical stage, not risk of bias or overall methodological quality. Of 361 reports sought for retrieval, 122 (33.8%) were not retrieved; 113/122 (92.6%) were considered plausibly eligible from available metadata. The final synthesis included 185 studies: detection (n = 52), characterization (n = 50), personalized surgical planning (n = 27), intelligent surgery (n = 28), recovery (n = 24), and patient engagement (n = 4). Among 181 validation-applicable included studies, internal testing was the most frequent highest-maturity category (123/181, 68.0%), followed by external testing (33/181, 18.2%), prospective single-center evaluation (6/181, 3.3%), and prospective multicenter evaluation (2/181, 1.1%); 17/181 (9.4%) had no independent or unclear testing. Among the retrieved and included studies, no comprehensive clinically validated multimodal preoperative cataract surgical-complexity model was identified. Most included studies remained at internal validation stages, and prospective multicenter evaluation was rare. Because 122/361 reports sought for retrieval were unavailable and most were considered plausibly eligible, retrieval bias may affect the comprehensiveness of the evidence map. Future research should prioritize multimodal preoperative surgical-complexity prediction, independent external test
zh_abstract: [BMC ophthalmology] 白内障仍是可逆性失明的主要原因，人工智能（AI）应用现已覆盖白内障照护路径。然而，这些应用的分布及其验证成熟度仍不清楚。本综述将AI映射至整个照护连续体，总结任务特异性性能，刻画验证成熟度，并识别证据空白。遵循系统综述和荟萃分析扩展范围综述的首选报告条目（PRISMA-ScR）。检索了PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane Library、WorldCat和美国眼科学会会议档案；最终检索于2025年7月20日完成。符合条件的研究为2020年1月1日至2025年7月20日发表的英文原创研究。在数据图表化与综合过程中开发了综述专用的白内障人工智能临床连续体（CAICC）证据映射框架。两名评审员独立进行研究选择、数据提取、终点判定和验证成熟度评估。性能采用描述性总结；验证成熟度刻画的是评价独立性和临床阶段，而非偏倚风险或总体方法学质量。在361份拟检索报告中，122份（33.8%）未能获取；122份中的113份（92.6%）根据现有元数据被认为可能符合条件。最终综合纳入185项研究：检测（n = 52）、表征（n = 50）、个性化手术规划（n = 27）、智能手术（n = 28）、恢复（n = 24）和患者参与（n = 4）。在181项可评估验证的纳入研究中，内部测试是最常见最高成熟度类别（123/181，68.0%），其次是外部测试（33/181，18.2%）、前瞻性单中心评价（6/181，3.3%）和前瞻性多中心评价（2/181，1.1%）；17/181（9.4%）无独立测试或测试情况不明确。在已检索并纳入的研究中，未识别出全面的、经临床验证的多模态术前白内障手术复杂性模型。大多数纳入研究仍处于内部验证阶段，前瞻性多中心评价罕见。由于361份拟检索报告中有122份无法获取，且其中大多数被认为可能符合条件，检索偏倚可能影响证据图谱的全面性。未来研究应优先关注多模态术前手术复杂性预测、独立外部测试

title: Agentic cryo-EM structure determination with CryoPilot
zh_title: CryoPilot：智能体自主完成冷冻电镜结构解析
summary: 预印本提出由两个语言模型智能体驱动的系统，从原始显微照片自动完成冷冻电镜三维重建与原子模型验证。
key_points: 重建智能体评估中间图像并选择CryoSPARC任务
可比较并保留、修改或回退处理决策
持久化环境记录全部处理历史以保证可追溯
reason: 新方法清晰的智能体系统预印本，尚无独立评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo EM) relies on mature computational tools, but experts must still inspect intermediate results, choose among alternative processing routes, and decide when earlier choices should be revised. Here we present CryoPilot, a system of two language model agents that carries cryo-EM data from raw micrographs through three-dimensional reconstruction to validated atomic models. Rather than executing a predefined pipeline, its reconstruction agent evaluates intermediate images and quantitative diagnostics, selects and parameterizes CryoSPARC jobs, tests alternative strategies, compares their outcomes, and retains, revises, or reverts decisions accordingly. A persistent programming environment and session database preserve the complete processing history, making each decision traceable and allowing multi day workflows to proceed with minimal human intervention. Its modeling agent determines map handedness, builds atomic models with CryoZeta, removes regions the density does not support, and optimizes each model by testing refinement steps against map fit, geometry, and DAQ, a measure of local model to map agreement. Across nine public EMPIAR datasets, eight reconstructions reached 2.61 to 3.51 A resolution, and refined models from seven maps agreed with reference structures to within 0.4 to 4.9 A Calpha; RMSD. For a challenging alpha latrocrustotoxin dataset, a single change of particle picking strategy that we suggested enabled CryoPilot to improve the reconstruction from 5.9 to 4.15 A. CryoPilot establishes an adaptive and auditable framework for agent-driven cryo-EM structure determination.
zh_abstract: 单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜（cryo EM）依赖成熟的计算工具，但专家仍必须检查中间结果、在替代处理路线中作出选择，并决定何时应修改先前选择。在此我们介绍CryoPilot，一个由两个语言模型智能体组成的系统，可将cryo-EM数据从原始显微照片经过三维重建推进至经验证的原子模型。其重建智能体并非执行预定义流程，而是评估中间图像和定量诊断、选择并参数化CryoSPARC作业、测试替代策略、比较其结果，并据此保留、修改或回退决策。持久化编程环境和会话数据库保存完整处理历史，使每个决策可追溯，并允许多日工作流在最少人工干预下进行。其建模智能体确定密度图手性，使用CryoZeta构建原子模型，去除密度不支持的区域，并通过针对密度图拟合、几何结构和DAQ（局部模型与密度图一致性的度量）测试细化步骤来优化每个模型。在九个公共EMPIAR数据集上，八个重建达到2.61至3.51 Å分辨率，来自七个密度图的细化模型与参考结构的一致性在0.4至4.9 Å Cα RMSD范围内。对于具有挑战性的α-latrocrustotoxin数据集，我们建议的单次颗粒挑选策略改变使CryoPilot能够将重建分辨率从5.9 Å提高到4.15 Å。CryoPilot为智能体驱动的cryo-EM结构测定建立了一个自适应且可审计的框架。

title: A comprehensive map of the sequence basis of transcription initiation in humans
zh_title: 人类转录起始序列基础的综合图谱
summary: 预印本构建了基于200余项转录起始谱实验的深度学习模型图谱，可从局部DNA序列预测起始模式并解析序列决定因素。
key_points: 基于200余项转录起始谱实验训练深度学习模型
覆盖全部主要人类器官及多种癌症类型
模型可从局部DNA序列预测转录起始模式并解码序列决定因素

abstract: Transcription initiation is a key marker of active enhancers and promoters. Here we describe an atlas of efficient and interpretable deep learning models trained on over 200 transcription initiation profiling experiments representing all major human organs and many cancer types. We show that our models accurately predict initiation patterns from local DNA sequence and decode their sequence determinants across diverse cellular contexts.
zh_abstract: 转录起始是活跃增强子和启动子的关键标志。在此，我们描述了一个图谱，包含在代表所有主要人体器官和多种癌症类型的超过200项转录起始谱分析实验中训练的高效且可解释的深度学习模型。我们表明，我们的模型能够从局部DNA序列准确预测起始模式，并在多种细胞情境中解析其序列决定因素。

title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
source: PubMed · Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
zh_title: 大模型驱动的近距离放疗计划权重优化框架
summary: 本地部署DeepSeek-R1结合RAG与自动规划算法，迭代优化近距离放疗计划的目标函数权重。
key_points: 本地部署DeepSeek-R1嵌入迭代规划回路
检索增强生成构建临床知识库辅助推理
目标为替代人工权重调参直至收敛
reason: 单中心计划优化研究，缺乏临床结局与对照，属增量档
abstract: [Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences] Seed implant brachytherapy (SIBT) is an effective cancer treatment modality; however, clinical planning often relies on manual adjustment of objective function weights, leading to inefficiencies and suboptimal results. This study proposes an adaptive weight optimization framework for SIBT planning, driven by large language models (LLMs). A locally deployed DeepSeek-R1 LLM is integrated with an automatic planning algorithm in an iterative loop. Starting with fixed weights, the LLM evaluates plan quality and recommends new weights in the next iteration. This process continues until convergence criteria are met, after which the LLM conducts a comprehensive evaluation to identify the optimal plan. A clinical knowledge base, constructed and queried via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enhances the model's domain-specific reasoning. The proposed method was retrospectively validated on 23 patient cases who underwent head-and-neck SIBT, showing that the LLM-assisted approach maintained clinical target volume (CTV) coverage and reduced excessive target dose relative to fixed-weight planning; in the eight patients with available organs at risk (OARs) contours, OAR dose metrics showed favorable numerical trends. The study demonstrates the potential of LLMs as assistive tools for SIBT planning under clinician supervision.
zh_abstract: [Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences] 放射性粒子植入近距离治疗（seed implant brachytherapy，SIBT）是一种有效的癌症治疗方式；然而，临床计划制定往往依赖人工调整目标函数权重，导致效率低下和结果欠佳。本研究提出一种由大语言模型（large language models，LLMs）驱动的SIBT计划自适应权重优化框架。将本地部署的DeepSeek-R1 LLM与自动计划算法集成于迭代循环中。从固定权重开始，LLM评估计划质量并在下一次迭代中推荐新权重。此过程持续至满足收敛标准，随后LLM进行综合评估以确定最优计划。通过检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation，RAG）构建并查询的临床知识库增强了模型的领域特定推理能力。所提方法在23例接受头颈部SIBT的患者病例上进行了回顾性验证，结果显示，相对于固定权重计划，LLM辅助方法维持了临床靶区（clinical target volume，CTV）覆盖并降低了过高的靶区剂量；在8例具有可用危及器官（organs at risk，OARs）轮廓的患者中，OAR剂量指标显示出有利的数值趋势。该研究证明了LLM作为临床医生监督下SIBT计划辅助工具的潜力。

title: Artificial intelligence across the gastric cancer care continuum: Clinical evidence, multimodal integration, and translation.
zh_title: 人工智能覆盖胃癌全程诊疗：证据与转化综述
summary: 结构化叙述综述梳理内镜、影像、数字病理、预后建模与治疗选择中的AI证据，强调区分技术可行性与转化成熟度。
key_points: 检索2022年1月至2026年7月PubMed与Web of Science文献
覆盖内镜、影像、病理、预后与手术支持等环节
优先纳入前瞻性、多中心、外部验证研究
reason: 叙述性综述，覆盖范围广但非系统综述且无新数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [iScience] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied across the gastric cancer care continuum, but its clinical maturity differs substantially among endoscopy, cross-sectional imaging, digital pathology, prognostic modeling, treatment selection, and surgical support. Existing reviews have often focused on individual modalities or summarized algorithmic performance without systematically distinguishing technical feasibility from translational readiness. We conducted a structured narrative review of studies indexed in PubMed/MEDLINE and the Web of Science Core Collection from January 2022 through July 2026, supplemented by backward and forward citation tracking. Earlier landmark studies were retained when necessary to explain the development of major applications. Priority was given to prospective, multicenter, externally validated, and clinically actionable studies. Evidence maturity was assessed according to study design, validation breadth, workflow relevance, calibration and clinical-utility assessment, and implementation evidence. The main constraint on gastric cancer AI is no longer pattern-recognition capability but the absence of reproducible clinical benefit under real-world conditions. Priorities include multiregional prospective validation, standardized calibration and decision curve assessment, comparison of clinicians with and without AI, integration into existing workflows, evaluation of economic and patient-level outcomes, and post-deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于胃癌诊疗全程，但其在内镜、横断面成像、数字病理、预后建模、治疗选择和手术支持中的临床成熟度差异显著。现有综述往往聚焦于单一模态，或总结算法性能而未系统区分技术可行性与转化就绪度。我们对2022年1月至2026年7月期间收录于PubMed/MEDLINE和Web of Science核心合集的研究进行了结构化叙述性综述，并辅以向后和向前引文追踪。必要时保留了较早的里程碑研究，以解释主要应用的发展。优先考虑前瞻性、多中心、外部验证和具有临床可操作性的研究。证据成熟度根据研究设计、验证广度、工作流程相关性、校准与临床效用评估以及实施证据进行评估。胃癌AI的主要制约已不再是模式识别能力，而是在真实世界条件下缺乏可重复的临床获益。优先事项包括多区域前瞻性验证、标准化校准和决策曲线评估、比较使用与不使用AI的临床医生、整合到现有工作流程、评估经济结局和患者层面结局，以及部署后监测。

title: Artificial Intelligence-driven Biomarker Discovery for Precision Psychiatry.
source: PubMed · Clinical psychopharmacology and neuroscience : the official scientific journal of the Korean College of Neuropsychopharmacology
zh_title: AI驱动的精准精神病学生物标志物发现
summary: 综述指出语言模型、自监督学习与变异效应预测可改善精神科表型质量与小样本限制，但尚未进入临床检测阶段。
key_points: 语言模型可将临床文本转为可分析变量
自监督模型利用精神科已有未标注信号
尚无AI能力达到成为临床检测的阶段
reason: 叙述性综述，无系统检索与量化结论，属增量档
abstract: [Clinical psychopharmacology and neuroscience : the official scientific journal of the Korean College of Neuropsychopharmacology] Poor phenotype quality and small cohorts remain major constraints in psychiatric biomarker research, and recent methodological advances increasingly address them. Language models turn clinical text into analysable variables at a scale manual chart review cannot reach. Self-supervised models learn from the unlabelled signals psychiatry already collects. Variant-effect prediction makes molecular interpretation computable, and research agents have generated and experimentally confirmed candidates outside psychiatry. These capabilities act early, on what is measured, what can be learned from it and which candidates are proposed. None of the artificial intelligence capabilities reviewed here yet reaches the stages at which a candidate becomes a clinical test. Producing candidates is becoming cheap while qualifying them is not. This review is organised around that asymmetry rather than by disorder or marker catalogue. It separates the measured characteristic, the prediction model and the intended clinical use, and treats method family as distinct from evidential stage. Across the selected evidence, discrimination is supported more strongly in development data than in independent evaluation, and prospective evidence that model-guided use improves care is scarce. Many reported metrics also address a simpler task than the intended decision: diagnosis instead of differential diagnosis, general prognosis instead of differential treatment benefit. The review proposes a six-stage framework linking intended use, measurement validity, model evaluation, comparative utility and monitored deployment, and places each capability on it, clarifying where methodological progress can accelerate discovery and where conventional clinical validation remains indispensable.
zh_abstract: [Clinical psychopharmacology and neuroscience : the official scientific journal of the Korean College of Neuropsychopharmacology] 表型质量差和队列规模小仍是精神科生物标志物研究的主要限制，而近期的方法学进展正日益应对这些问题。语言模型可将临床文本转化为可分析的变量，其规模是人工病历回顾无法达到的。自监督模型可从精神科已经收集的未标注信号中学习。变异效应预测使分子解释可计算化，且研究智能体已在精神科之外生成并实验确认了候选物。这些能力在早期发挥作用，涉及测量什么、能从中学习什么以及提出哪些候选物。本文综述的人工智能能力尚无一达到候选物成为临床检测的阶段。产生候选物正变得廉价，而对其作出资格认定并非如此。本综述围绕这种不对称性组织，而非按疾病或标志物目录组织。它将所测量的特征、预测模型和预期临床用途区分开来，并将方法家族视为不同于证据阶段。在所选取的证据中，区分能力在开发数据中得到的支持强于独立评估，而模型指导的使用可改善照护的前瞻性证据稀缺。许多报告的指标还针对比预期决策更简单的任务：诊断而非鉴别诊断，一般预后而非差异性治疗获益。本综述提出一个六阶段框架，将预期用途、测量有效性、模型评估、比较效用和受监测部署联系起来，并将每种能力置于其中，阐明方法学进展可在何处加速发现，以及传统临床验证在何处仍不可或缺。

title: Trigger-first large language model-assisted adverse drug reaction surveillance: A pharmacist-supervised retrospective cohort study.
source: PubMed · Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy
zh_title: 药师监督的触发器+大模型药物不良反应监测
summary: 探索性回顾性队列研究，评估电子触发器结合大语言模型辅助审阅在药物不良反应监测中的候选富集与分阶段表现。
key_points: 7950例住院暴露事件，28例为ADR阳性
Qwen3-4B-Instruct 与机构LoRA微调模型对比
单中心回顾性，阳性事件少
reason: 单中心回顾性、阳性样本少，属值得一看档
abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] Active pharmacovigilance in low-prevalence settings requires review of large electronic health record cohorts. We evaluated a pharmacist-supervised workflow combining electronic triggers with large language model (LLM)-assisted review. To assess candidate enrichment and stage-specific performance for adverse drug reaction (ADR) surveillance. In this retrospective cohort study, two pharmacists established a blinded reference standard for 7950 exposure episodes from 7950 unique inpatients. A prespecified Chinese Hospital Pharmacovigilance System trigger selected candidates for Qwen3-4B-Instruct and an institution-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-fine-tuned model trained on 410 patient-disjoint cases involving other medicines. Paired errors were compared using exact McNemar tests. Twenty-eight episodes were ADR-positive. The trigger selected 167 candidates (2.10%), with 100.0% sensitivity (95% confidence interval, 87.66-100.0%) and 98.25% specificity. For the base versus LoRA-fine-tuned model, sensitivity was 82.14% versus 92.86%, specificity 88.49% versus 94.96%, positive predictive value 58.97% versus 78.79%, and F1 score 68.66% versus 85.25%. LoRA reduced false positives from 16 to 7 (9 corrected, 0 new; P = 0.0039). The numerical increase in sensitivity was not statistically significant (P = 0.250), with only 28 ADR-positive episodes available for evaluation. Trigger-first screening reduced review volume, while LoRA fine-tuning improved false-positive control. LLM classifications should support pharmacist review and should not be used as an autonomous exclusion rule.
zh_abstract: [临床与社会药学探索研究] 低患病率环境中的主动药物警戒需要对大型电子健康记录队列进行审查。我们评估了一种由药师监督的工作流程，该流程将电子触发器与大型语言模型（LLM）辅助审查相结合。旨在评估药物不良反应（ADR）监测中的候选者富集和阶段特异性性能。在这项回顾性队列研究中，两名药师为来自7950名不同住院患者的7950个暴露事件建立了盲法参考标准。一个预先指定的中国医院药物警戒系统触发器为Qwen3-4B-Instruct和一个机构特定的低秩适应（LoRA）微调模型筛选候选者，该模型在410个涉及其他药物的患者不重叠病例上训练。使用精确McNemar检验比较配对错误。28个事件为ADR阳性。触发器筛选出167个候选者（2.10%），灵敏度为100.0%（95%置信区间，87.66-100.0%），特异度为98.25%。对于基础模型与LoRA微调模型，灵敏度为82.14% vs 92.86%，特异度为88.49% vs 94.96%，阳性预测值为58.97% vs 78.79%，F1分数为68.66% vs 85.25%。LoRA将假阳性从16降至7（纠正9个，新增0个；P = 0.0039）。灵敏度的数值增加无统计学显著性（P = 0.250），仅28个ADR阳性事件可供评估。触发器优先筛查减少了审查量，而LoRA微调改善了假阳性控制。LLM分类应支持药师审查，不应作为自主排除规则使用。

title: Parent Perceptions of Virtual and Artificial Intelligence Scribes at Pediatric Medical Visits.
zh_title: 儿科就诊中家长对虚拟与AI记录员的看法
summary: 通过半结构式访谈，了解家长对儿科门诊中虚拟记录员实际使用及假设AI记录员使用的感受与顾虑。
key_points: 中西部诊所系统11名儿科初级保健医生参与
访谈0–17岁患儿的家长，属定性研究
同时询问虚拟记录员体验与假设AI场景
仅反映家长主观感知，无效果指标
reason: 小样本定性访谈，仅报告感知无结局指标，属增量档
abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] BACKGROUND: Scribes help physicians decrease electronic medical record documentation burden. There is transition from virtual to artificial intelligence (AI) scribes. A gap exists in our understanding of parent perspectives on technology-based scribe use at pediatric medical visits. OBJECTIVES: The objectives of this study were to explore parent perceptions of pediatric medical visits of lived experience with virtual scribe presence and consideration of hypothetical AI scribe use. METHODS: Semistructured qualitative interviews were conducted with parents of children aged 0 to 17 who visited 1 of 11 primary care pediatricians who worked with virtual scribes at a Midwestern clinic system. Parents were asked to reflect on visits with virtual scribe presence and their perceptions of hypothetical AI scribe use. Interviews were conducted by trained interviewers, recorded, and transcribed. Thematic analysis was applied to the transcripts using grounded theory and the constant comparative method. RESULTS: Interviews were completed by 33 parents, including 76% females, with a mean age of 40.30 years (standard deviation [SD] = 11.33). Two themes emerged regarding virtual scribe presence. First was that Parents felt heard, seen, and valued. Parents perceived greater focus and attention from the pediatrician. Second was Building trust in a third-party listener. Parents noted elements that built trust and overall low noticeability of scribe. Two themes emerged regarding hypothetical AI scribes. First was Valuing human information processing. Parents described concerns about AI accuracy and security and greater trust in human understanding. Second was AI as an Efficient workforce. Parents noted potential benefits for cost, reliability, and documentation. CONCLUSION: Parents described enhanced pediatrician connection at lived experience visits with virtual scribe presence. When considering hypothetical AI scribes, they perceived possible benefits but overall concerns for accuracy, security, and understanding. Studies of parents who experienced AI scribe presence at pediatric medical visits would be helpful to assess their perceptions of positive elements, benefits, and concerns.
zh_abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] 【背景】医疗记录员（scribes）帮助医生减轻电子病历记录负担。目前正从虚拟记录员向人工智能（AI）记录员过渡。对于儿科就诊中使用基于技术的记录员，家长看法仍存在认识空白。【目的】本研究旨在探讨家长对儿科就诊中亲身经历虚拟记录员在场的看法，以及对假设使用AI记录员的考虑。【方法】对0至17岁儿童家长进行半结构化定性访谈，这些儿童曾就诊于11名在中西部诊所系统中使用虚拟记录员的儿科初级保健医生之一。请家长回顾有虚拟记录员在场的就诊经历，并表达对假设使用AI记录员的看法。访谈由受过培训的访谈员进行、录音并转录。采用扎根理论和持续比较法对转录文本进行主题分析。【结果】33名家长完成访谈，其中76%为女性，平均年龄40.30岁（标准差[SD]=11.33）。关于虚拟记录员在场，出现两个主题。第一是家长感到被倾听、被看见和被重视。家长认为儿科医生更加专注和投入。第二是建立对第三方倾听者的信任。家长指出建立信任的因素，以及记录员总体不易被注意。关于假设的AI记录员，出现两个主题。第一是重视人类信息处理。家长描述了对AI准确性和安全性的担忧，并更信任人类理解。第二是将AI视为高效劳动力。家长指出其在成本、可靠性和记录方面的潜在益处。【结论】家长描述了在有虚拟记录员在场的亲身经历就诊中儿科医生连接感增强。在考虑假设的AI记录员时，他们感知到可能益处，但总体上对准确性、安全性和理解能力存在担忧。对在儿科就诊中经历过AI记录员在场的家长开展研究，将有助于评估他们对积极要素、益处和担忧的看法。

title: An interpretable multimodal deep learning model for physiological stress detection.
zh_title: 可解释多模态深度学习用于生理应激检测
summary: 融合心电图、皮肤电与呼吸信号的可解释多模态框架，在受试者独立验证下取得约94.8%准确率与0.97 AUC。
key_points: 分别建模心电、皮电与呼吸并做多模态融合
受试者独立验证：准确率94.8%、AUC 0.97
受试者依赖实验下准确率达97.2%
多模态融合一致优于任一单一模态
reason: 仅有指标对比、无临床结局或前瞻设计，样本与外部验证不明，属增量档
abstract: [PloS one] Stress is a major contributor to physical and mental health disorders, underscoring the need for reliable and interpretable detection systems. We present an interpretable multimodal deep learning framework that integrates electrocardiogram (ECG), electrodermal activity (EDA), and respiration signals using modality-specific neural architectures complemented by feature-based classical models. To ensure robustness and generalizability, the framework was evaluated under both subject-independent and subject-dependent protocols. Results show that multimodal fusion consistently outperformed single modalities, achieving 94.8% accuracy, 93.9% F1-score, and 0.97 AUC under subject-independent validation, compared with 86-91% accuracy for individual signals. In subject-dependent experiments, performance reached 97.2% accuracy and 96.8% F1-score. Comparative analysis with recent state-of-the-art methods demonstrated the competitiveness of our approach, while ablation studies confirmed the contribution of each modality and fusion strategy. Statistical significance testing with (p < 0.05) further validated the reliability of these gains. Importantly, interpretability analyses using Grad-CAM and attention visualization provided physiological insights, revealing that the model emphasizes clinically meaningful regions such as ECG R-peaks and phasic EDA fluctuations. By uniting high performance, robustness, and interpretability, this work advances stress detection research and offers a physiologically grounded framework for continuous mental health monitoring.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 压力是躯体和精神健康障碍的主要促成因素，凸显了对可靠且可解释检测系统的需求。我们提出一个可解释的多模态深度学习框架，该框架使用模态特异性神经架构整合心电图（electrocardiogram, ECG）、皮肤电活动（electrodermal activity, EDA）和呼吸信号，并以基于特征的经典模型作为补充。为确保稳健性和泛化性，该框架在受试者独立和受试者依赖两种方案下进行了评估。结果显示，多模态融合始终优于单一模态，在受试者独立验证下达到94.8%的准确率、93.9%的F1分数和0.97的AUC，而单个信号的准确率为86-91%。在受试者依赖实验中，性能达到97.2%的准确率和96.8%的F1分数。与近期最先进方法的比较分析证明了我们方法的竞争力，而消融研究证实了每种模态和融合策略的贡献。统计学显著性检验（p < 0.05）进一步验证了这些增益的可靠性。重要的是，使用Grad-CAM和注意力可视化进行的可解释性分析提供了生理学见解，揭示模型强调具有临床意义的区域，如心电图R峰和相位性EDA波动。通过结合高性能、稳健性和可解释性，这项工作推进了压力检测研究，并为持续心理健康监测提供了一个具有生理学基础的框架。

title: Artificial intelligence innovations in low vision rehabilitation: a systematic review of emerging technologies.
zh_title: AI在低视力康复中的系统综述
summary: 综述19项研究，梳理AI在低视力康复六大应用领域的现状。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA指南开展系统综述
检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore
共纳入19项研究
覆盖六个应用领域
reason: 规范系统综述但纳入研究仅19项、无结局证据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Low vision is one of the major types of visual impairment worldwide and when diagnosed early can help with its management. Artificial intelligence (AI) has recently shown promising outcomes in all fields including health, with low vision rehabilitation being one of its significant applications. This systematic review aims to provide an up-to-date and comprehensive evaluation of the application of AI in the management of low vision. The systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. All relevant published papers were retrieved through searches from PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore, without date restrictions. All retrieved articles from electronic databases were collated and managed in Covidence software. Nineteen studies were included, consisting of six application domains, which include assistive navigation and wayfinding (n = 8), environmental interaction and object recognition (n = 5), reading and text access (n = 2), educational accessibility (n = 1), medical applications (n = 3), and digital accessibility optimization (n = 1). Navigation systems demonstrated the strongest performance, with leading systems achieving sub-meter location error and 100% task success rates in real-world testing. Object recognition accuracies reached 97%, hazard detection achieved 92.0% dynamic accuracy with temporal filtering, and multimodal environmental understanding received risk assessment ratings of 9.40/10. Recurring technical limitations included sensitivity to lighting conditions, processing latency, and connectivity dependency. AI assistive technologies for low vision demonstrate technical feasibility with promising performance. However, important evidence gaps limit clinical application: the absence of prospective validation, limited comparative effectiveness data, and minimal patient-centered outcomes. Future studies should use standardized outcomes, larger and more diverse datasets, and longitudinal evaluations to demonstrate real-world impact. https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261324781, CRD420261324781.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] 低视力是全球主要视觉损伤类型之一，早期诊断有助于其管理。人工智能（Artificial intelligence，AI）近来在所有领域（包括健康领域）显示出有前景的结果，低视力康复是其重要应用之一。本系统评价旨在对AI在低视力管理中的应用提供最新且全面的评估。该系统评价遵循系统评价与荟萃分析首选报告条目（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses，PRISMA）指南。所有相关已发表论文均通过检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和IEEE Xplore获取，无日期限制。从电子数据库检索到的所有文章均在Covidence软件中整理和管理。共纳入19项研究，涵盖6个应用领域，包括辅助导航与寻路（n = 8）、环境交互与物体识别（n = 5）、阅读与文本获取（n = 2）、教育可及性（n = 1）、医学应用（n = 3）和数字可及性优化（n = 1）。导航系统表现出最强性能，领先系统在真实世界测试中达到亚米级定位误差和100%任务成功率。物体识别准确率达到97%，危险检测在采用时间滤波后达到92.0%的动态准确率，多模态环境理解获得9.40/10的风险评估评分。反复出现的技术局限性包括对光照条件的敏感性、处理延迟和连接依赖性。用于低视力的AI辅助技术显示出技术可行性，并具有有前景的性能。然而，重要的证据空白限制了临床应用：缺乏前瞻性验证、比较有效性数据有限以及患者中心结局极少。未来研究应使用标准化结局、更大且更多样化的数据集以及纵向评估来证明真实世界影响。https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261324781，CRD420261324781。

title: EMBER: Contextualized gene representations enable compositional prediction across cellular perturbations
zh_title: EMBER：情境化基因表征实现跨细胞扰动的组合预测
summary: 预印本提出以基因为中心的基础模型EMBER，通过对比学习与掩码表达重建预训练，用冻结编码器加轻量探针预测单细胞扰动效应。
key_points: 以基因为中心的基础模型，学习依赖情境的功能表征
预训练结合交互引导对比学习与掩码表达重建
冻结编码器，再由轻量探针组合嵌入做任务预测
reason: 预印本新方法，思路清晰但无外部验证与公开评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Predicting the effects of individual and combined perturbations is central to identifying context-specific vulnerabilities and designing targeted interventions. Yet learning gene representations that integrate functional relationships with cellular state and transfer across perturbation tasks remains challenging. Here, we present EMBER, a gene-centric foundation model that learns context-dependent functional representations of genes. EMBER combines interaction-guided contrastive learning with masked expression reconstruction during pretraining on a single-cell corpus curated for diversity and balanced sampling across cell types and experimental batches. EMBER decouples gene representation learning from task-specific prediction through a composable embedding framework: the pretrained encoder remains frozen, while lightweight probes combine contextualized gene embeddings to predict individual and combined perturbation effects. The same pretrained representations support single-gene perturbation-response prediction, digenic interaction prediction, and multi-target drug-response prediction. EMBER improves cross-context perturbation-response prediction and genetic-interaction ranking relative to evaluated baselines. EMBER also prioritized SCFD1, a mediator of autophagosome-lysosome fusion, as a candidate dependency during mTOR inhibition. Together, these results establish contextualized gene embeddings as reusable building blocks for modeling genetic and pharmacological perturbations, supporting the prioritization of genetic interactions and context-specific interventions for experimental testing.
zh_abstract: 预测单一扰动和联合扰动的效应是识别情境特异性脆弱性并设计靶向干预的核心。然而，学习整合功能关系与细胞状态并能在扰动任务间迁移的基因表征仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出EMBER，一种以基因为中心的基础模型，可学习基因的情境依赖性功能表征。EMBER在针对多样性以及跨细胞类型和实验批次平衡采样而整理的单细胞语料库上进行预训练，结合了交互引导的对比学习与掩码表达重建。EMBER通过可组合嵌入框架将基因表征学习与任务特异性预测解耦：预训练编码器保持冻结，而轻量级探针组合情境化基因嵌入以预测单一扰动和联合扰动效应。相同的预训练表征支持单基因扰动响应预测、双基因相互作用预测和多靶点药物响应预测。相对于所评估的基线，EMBER改善了跨情境扰动响应预测和遗传相互作用排序。EMBER还将自噬体-溶酶体融合的介导因子SCFD1优先列为mTOR抑制期间的候选依赖基因。总之，这些结果确立了情境化基因嵌入作为可复用的构建模块，用于建模遗传和药理学扰动，支持优先考虑用于实验测试的遗传相互作用和情境特异性干预。

title: A multimodal deep learning model for classifying early- versus late-stage osteonecrosis of the femoral head on biparametric MRI.
zh_title: 双参数MRI多模态深度学习分期股骨头坏死
summary: 回顾性纳入530例患者851个髋，结合STIR、T1-FSE影像与临床参数构建多模态深度学习模型区分股骨头坏死早期与晚期，按患者划分训练与测试集。
key_points: 530例患者、851个髋的回顾性数据
融合STIR、T1-FSE与临床参数
仅报告内部训练/测试集划分
reason: 样本量可观但仅内部验证，属回顾性单中心档
abstract: [BMC musculoskeletal disorders] Precise early- versus late-stage stratification of osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH) is critical for hip-preserving treatment selection, yet conventional MRI interpretation suffers from interobserver variability and limited objectivity. This study aimed to develop a multimodal deep learning model integrating biparametric MRI (STIR and T1-FSE) with clinical parameters (including age, sex, affected side (left, right, or bilateral), and etiology) to differentiate early- from late-stage ONFH and provide objective imaging evidence. This retrospective study included 530 patients with ONFH, yielding imaging data from 851 hips. The collected data comprised STIR sequences, T1-FSE sequences, and clinical information, including age, sex, and etiology. The dataset was randomly divided at the patient level into a training set (424 patients, 675 hips) and a test set (106 patients, 176 hips) at an 8:2 ratio. Seven models were constructed: a clinical model, a STIR model, a T1-FSE model, a bpMRI model, a STIR-clinical model, a T1-FSE-clinical model, and a bpMRI-clinical model. Early- and late-fusion strategies were used for multimodal integration. The diagnostic performance of the seven models for classifying early- versus late-stage ONFH was systematically compared, with particular emphasis on their ability to identify borderline cases at the transition between clinical stages. Model interpretability was assessed using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM). The early-fusion bpMRI-clinical model achieved the highest AUC of 0.944 (95% CI 0.905-0.973), accuracy 90.9%, sensitivity 89.0%, and specificity 92.9%, significantly outperforming single-sequence models (all P < 0.05). The confusion matrix showed that the model misclassified 10 late-stage cases as early-stage and 6 early-stage cases as late-stage. Grad-CAM visualizations indicated that the model primarily focused on clinically relevant regions, including the necrotic lesion boundary, areas of bone marrow edema, and subchondral structural abnormalities. These attention patterns were highly consistent with the core imaging features used for early- versus late-stage ONFH stratification. This study presents an interpretable multimodal deep learning framework that integrates dual-sequence MRI with clinical parameters. The framework accurately differentiates early- from late-stage ONFH according to the ARCO classification and provides objective evidence for determining the critical threshold for hip-pr
zh_abstract: [BMC musculoskeletal disorders] 股骨头坏死（osteonecrosis of the femoral head，ONFH）的精准早期与晚期分层对于保髋治疗选择至关重要，但传统MRI判读存在观察者间变异且客观性有限。本研究旨在开发一种多模态深度学习模型，整合双参数MRI（biparametric MRI，bpMRI；STIR和T1-FSE）与临床参数（包括年龄、性别、受累侧（左侧、右侧或双侧）和病因），以区分早期与晚期ONFH并提供客观影像学证据。这项回顾性研究纳入530例ONFH患者，获得851个髋部的影像数据。收集的数据包括STIR序列、T1-FSE序列和临床信息（包括年龄、性别和病因）。数据集在患者层面按8:2比例随机分为训练集（424例患者，675个髋部）和测试集（106例患者，176个髋部）。构建了七个模型：临床模型、STIR模型、T1-FSE模型、bpMRI模型、STIR-临床模型、T1-FSE-临床模型和bpMRI-临床模型。采用早期融合和晚期融合策略进行多模态整合。系统比较了七种模型对早期与晚期ONFH分类的诊断性能，特别强调其识别临床分期过渡期临界病例的能力。使用梯度加权类激活映射（Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping，Grad-CAM）评估模型可解释性。早期融合的bpMRI-临床模型取得最高AUC为0.944（95% CI 0.905-0.973）、准确率90.9%、灵敏度89.0%和特异度92.9%，显著优于单序列模型（所有P < 0.05）。混淆矩阵显示，该模型将10例晚期病例误分类为早期，将6例早期病例误分类为晚期。Grad-CAM可视化表明，模型主要关注临床相关区域，包括坏死病灶边界、骨髓水肿区域和软骨下结构异常。这些注意力模式与用于早期与晚期ONFH分层的核心影像特征高度一致。本研究提出了一个可解释的多模态深度学习框架，将双序列MRI与临床参数整合。该框架根据ARCO分类准确区分早期与晚期ONFH，并为确定髋部保...的临界阈值提供客观证据。

title: Mechanistic gene-regulation-based trajectory inference with bowside
zh_title: bowside：基于基因调控机制的单细胞轨迹推断
summary: 预印本提出bowside浅层神经随机分化模型，可同时推断单细胞轨迹并重建基因调控网络。
key_points: 以浅层神经随机分化模型机制化建模基因调控
在造血与iPSC重编程数据上恢复表达趋势
可检索已知命运决定调控模块
reason: 预印本新方法，有基线场景演示但缺乏系统外部评测，属值得一看档。
abstract: While single-cell RNA sequencing enables the in-depth study of differentiation processes, simultaneous trajectory inference and gene regulatory network reconstruction remain challenging. We propose bowside, a shallow neural stochastic differentiation model that mechanistically models gene regulation. Our method successfully recovers gene expression trends and the underlying regulatory interactions. We demonstrate bowside on hematopoiesis and induced pluripotent stem cell reprogramming data, retrieving known fate-determining network motifs.
zh_abstract: 虽然单细胞RNA测序能够深入研究分化过程，但同时进行轨迹推断与基因调控网络重建仍具挑战性。我们提出bowside，一种从机制上建模基因调控的浅层神经随机分化模型。我们的方法成功恢复了基因表达趋势及其潜在的调控相互作用。我们在造血和诱导多能干细胞重编程数据上展示了bowside，并检索到已知的命运决定网络基序。

title: Task-Dependent Performance of GNNs and Pretrained Models in ADMET Prediction
zh_title: ADMET预测中GNN与预训练模型的任务依赖性表现
summary: 预印本在六个ADMET终点上以匹配调参预算和骨架划分，基准比较GNN、冻结预训练模型与指纹基线。
key_points: 六个TDC ADMET终点，采用骨架划分评测
各模型族匹配50次试验调参预算
取十个随机种子的中位数以控制泄漏
reason: 预印本基准研究，方法学严谨但属对既有表征的系统比较，属值得一看档。
abstract: Structure-based prediction of ADMET (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity) properties promises fast, low-cost screening of drug candidates, yet model selection remains unclear because published comparisons of molecular representations often use unmatched tuning budgets and leakage-prone evaluation protocols, producing performance differences that may not reflect model quality. To address this gap, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs), frozen pretrained models (ChemBERTa, MolCLR), and fingerprint baselines across six Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET endpoints under scaffold-split evaluation. To make it really fair we gave every model family a matched 50-trial, validation-selected tuning budget and reported the median over ten seeds; architecture and hyperparameter selection use validation data only, with the held-out test split reserved for final performance estimation. Under this fair comparison protocol, emph{no model family dominates} and the differences between families fall within the seed-to-seed range on most endpoints. The GNN is clearly best only on Caco-2 permeability (R$^2 approx 0.48$), and a controlled ablation shows this advantage comes entirely from auxiliary physicochemical descriptors rather than the graph representation; Morgan fingerprints are competitive on hERG (AUC $approx 0.77$) and give the best median on both clearance endpoints, while MolCLR is best on Tox21. For hepatocyte clearance and half-life, all models yield near-zero or negative R$^2$. No single hyperparameter-optimization strategy, among seven evaluated, consistently outperforms random search at this budget, and we show that selecting the optimizer using test-set performance or reporting only single best-trial runs can substantially inflate a favored model's apparent advantage. Reliable ADMET modeling therefore requires endpoint-specific model selection together with fair, leakage-controlled, seed-averaged evaluation, offering more trustworthy decision support for early-stage drug candidate prioritization.
zh_abstract: 基于结构的ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）性质预测有望实现快速、低成本的候选药物筛选，但模型选择仍不明确，因为已发表的分子表示比较常使用不匹配的调参预算和易发生泄漏的评估方案，所产生的性能差异可能并不反映模型质量。为弥补这一空白，我们在骨架划分评估下，对六个Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET终点基准测试了图神经网络（GNN）、冻结预训练模型（ChemBERTa、MolCLR）和指纹基线。为实现真正公平，我们为每个模型家族提供了相匹配的50次试验、基于验证集选择的调参预算，并报告十个随机种子的中位数；架构和超参数选择仅使用验证数据，留出测试划分保留用于最终性能估计。在这一公平比较方案下，emph{没有任何模型家族占主导}，且大多数终点上家族之间的差异落在种子间范围内。GNN仅在Caco-2渗透性（R$^2 approx 0.48$）上明显最佳，且受控消融表明这一优势完全来自辅助物理化学描述符而非图表示；Morgan指纹在hERG（AUC $approx 0.77$）上具有竞争力，并在两个清除率终点上给出最佳中位数，而MolCLR在Tox21上最佳。对于肝细胞清除率和半衰期，所有模型给出的R$^2$接近零或为负。在评估的七种超参数优化策略中，没有一种在此预算下持续优于随机搜索，并且我们表明，使用测试集性能选择优化器或仅报告单次最佳试验运行，可能大幅夸大偏好模型的表观优势。因此，可靠的ADMET建模需要终点特异性模型选择，并结合公平、泄漏受控、种子平均的评估，从而为早期候选药物优先级排序提供更可信的决策支持。

title: Virology-aware artificial intelligence for respiratory antiviral discovery: from molecular docking biases to RdRp-centered benchmarking.
zh_title: 面向呼吸道抗病毒药物发现的病毒学感知AI
summary: 综述指出抗病毒AI多依赖非病毒靶点基准，主张围绕RdRp等呼吸道RNA病毒聚合酶建立专门评测。
key_points: 聚焦RdRp与聚合酶复合物等保守靶点
质疑通用蛋白-配体基准的可外推性
提出以RdRp为中心的基准化方向
reason: 观点/综述类，无论点验证数据，综述上限内取增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Respiratory RNA viruses remain a persistent threat because they combine high transmissibility, rapid evolution, immune escape, zoonotic spillover, and incomplete therapeutic coverage. RNA-dependent RNA polymerases (RdRps) and polymerase complexes are among the most conserved and pharmacologically actionable viral targets, yet they are also challenging computational targets because their ligandable states depend on RNA templates, cofactors, divalent metals, multidomain architecture, and conformational transitions. Artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), geometric deep learning (GDL), and generative molecular design are increasingly used to accelerate antiviral discovery, yet their performance is often inferred from general protein-ligand benchmarks dominated by non-viral targets. This review argues that respiratory RNA virus polymerases are a high-value but comparatively underrepresented class of antiviral targets and a complementary test case for evaluating AI-guided drug discovery. We synthesize current approaches in computer-aided drug design (CADD), molecular docking, ML-assisted virtual screening, molecular representations, pose-generation models, generative AI, and protein-ligand affinity benchmarking. We emphasize that docking scores, predicted affinity, and root-mean-square error (RMSE) values are insufficient unless linked to target engagement, enzymatic inhibition, cell-based antiviral activity, cytotoxicity, resistance, and pharmacological feasibility. We propose an RdRp-centered AI pipeline that integrates curated polymerase structural ensembles, leakage-resistant benchmarking, antiviral-specific evaluation tasks, ADME/Tox filtering, biochemical validation, cell-based infection assays, resistance profiling, and iterative model refinement. Moving beyond docking scores requires benchmarking models under virologically realistic conditions and validating whether computational prioritization enriches compounds with experimentally actionable antiviral activity.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] 呼吸道RNA病毒仍然是持续存在的威胁，因为它们兼具高传播性、快速进化、免疫逃逸、人畜共患溢出和不完全的治疗覆盖。RNA依赖的RNA聚合酶（RdRps）和聚合酶复合物是最保守且药理学上最可干预的病毒靶点之一，但它们也是具有挑战性的计算靶点，因为其可配体结合状态取决于RNA模板、辅因子、二价金属、多结构域结构和构象转换。人工智能（AI）、机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）、几何深度学习（GDL）和生成式分子设计正越来越多地用于加速抗病毒药物发现，但其性能常从以非病毒靶点为主的一般蛋白质-配体基准推断。本综述认为，呼吸道RNA病毒聚合酶是一类高价值但相对代表性不足的抗病毒靶点，也是评估AI引导药物发现的补充性测试案例。我们综合了计算机辅助药物设计（CADD）、分子对接、ML辅助虚拟筛选、分子表征、构象生成模型、生成式AI和蛋白质-配体亲和力基准测试的当前方法。我们强调，对接分数、预测亲和力和均方根误差（RMSE）值不足，除非与靶点结合、酶抑制、基于细胞的抗病毒活性、细胞毒性、耐药性和药理学可行性相关联。我们提出以RdRp为中心的AI流程，整合经过整理的聚合酶结构集合、抗泄漏基准测试、抗病毒特异性评估任务、ADME/Tox过滤、生化验证、基于细胞的感染试验、耐药性分析和迭代模型优化。超越对接分数需要在病毒学上逼真的条件下对模型进行基准测试，并验证计算优先级排序是否富集具有实验上可操作的抗病毒活性的化合物。

title: Artificial intelligence in health insurance fraud detection: a global and regional systematic review.
zh_title: AI用于医保欺诈检测：全球与区域系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020系统综述AI识别医保欺诈的方法、评估与实施障碍。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA 2020，检索七个电子数据库
纳入2016–2025年发表的研究
用Silvi AI平台完成题录筛选
关注方法学、性能评估与实施挑战
reason: 系统综述但主题偏医保管理，与临床AI距离较远，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Health insurance fraud imposes substantial financial burdens on healthcare systems and reduces the efficiency of healthcare resource utilization worldwide. Traditional fraud detection approaches often struggle to analyse large and complex healthcare claims data, making artificial intelligence (AI) an increasingly important tool for identifying fraudulent activities. This study systematically reviews global and regional evidence on AI applications in health insurance fraud detection, with particular emphasis on methodological approaches, performance evaluation, and implementation challenges. This systematic review followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Seven electronic databases were searched for studies published between 2016 and 2025. Titles and abstracts were screened using the Silvi AI platform, followed by eligibility assessment according to pre-defined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Data were extracted using a standardized framework, and methodological quality was assessed using the Drummond 10-item checklist. From 450 identified records, 33 studies met the eligibility criteria. The included studies demonstrated substantial heterogeneity in datasets, AI methodologies, fraud types, and performance evaluation metrics. Machine learning was the most frequently applied approach, followed by deep learning, graph-based learning, and hybrid AI frameworks. Although AI-based methods consistently improved fraud detection performance, challenges related to dataset imbalance, standardized reporting, interpretability, external validation, and economic evaluation remain significant barriers to widespread implementation. AI demonstrates considerable potential for improving health insurance fraud detection. However, future research should prioritize standardized evaluation frameworks, explainable AI, external validation across diverse healthcare systems, and economic assessment to support the responsible and scalable deployment of AI-enabled fraud detection systems.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 健康保险欺诈给医疗系统带来沉重财务负担，并降低全球医疗资源利用效率。传统欺诈检测方法往往难以分析大型复杂医疗索赔数据，使人工智能（AI）成为识别欺诈活动日益重要的工具。本研究系统综述了AI在健康保险欺诈检测中应用的全球和区域证据，特别强调方法学、性能评估和实施挑战。本系统综述遵循PRISMA 2020指南。检索了七个电子数据库，纳入2016年至2025年间发表的研究。使用Silvi AI平台筛选标题和摘要，随后根据预设纳入和排除标准进行资格评估。采用标准化框架提取数据，并使用Drummond 10项清单评估方法学质量。从450条识别记录中，33项研究符合资格标准。纳入研究在数据集、AI方法学、欺诈类型和性能评估指标方面存在显著异质性。机器学习是最常应用的方法，其次是深度学习、基于图的学习和混合AI框架。尽管基于AI的方法持续改善欺诈检测性能，但数据集不平衡、标准化报告、可解释性、外部验证和经济评估相关挑战仍是广泛实施的重要障碍。AI在改善健康保险欺诈检测方面展现出相当大的潜力。然而，未来研究应优先考虑标准化评估框架、可解释AI、跨多样医疗系统的外部验证和经济评估，以支持AI赋能欺诈检测系统的负责任和可扩展部署。

title: Artificial intelligence for medication recognition and safety: a systematic review of detection, classification, OCR, and digital health applications.

abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Medication errors and adverse drug events remain causes of patient harm, underscoring the need for technologies supporting medication identification, verification, and medication safety. Artificial intelligence (AI), computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), and digital health technologies are applied to medication recognition. To systematically review AI-based medication recognition systems and characterize recognition tasks, computational approaches, datasets, evaluation, validation, generalizability, deployment, applications, and emerging directions. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020. Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and PubMed/MEDLINE were searched for publications from 1 January 2016 to 4 September 2026, using two conceptual blocks covering medication recognition and AI methods. Of 895 retrieved records, 136 duplicates were removed, and 759 records underwent screening. After full-text assessment, 14 reports were excluded, and 91 studies were included. Title-and-abstract screening yielded 84.72% observed agreement (Cohen's κ = 0.527 ). For methodological assessment, both reviewers independently applied D1-D8 to the 91 included studies before consensus resolution. Across 728 domain-level assessments, observed agreement was 97.66%, with an aggregate Cohen's κ of 0.959; domain-specific κ values ranged from 0.857 to 1.000. Evidence was synthesized through cross-study analysis and four evidence maps. Evidence shows use of detection, classification, OCR/imprint recognition, hybrid and multimodal architectures, alongside few-shot, low-shot, zero-shot, and incremental learning. Applications extend to assistive, mobile, and IoT-enabled systems, medication verification, and clinical decision support. Heterogeneity in datasets, imaging conditions, evaluation protocols, and validation strategies limits comparison and generalizability. External validation, cross-dataset testing, unseen-medication evaluation, prospective deployment, and clinical testing remain limited. AI-based medication recognition is evolving from a computer vision task into a digital informatics component supporting medication safety, accessibility, verification, and patient care. Future research should prioritize diverse datasets, leakage control, independent multicenter validation, unseen-medication evaluation, explainable and privacy-preserving AI, interoperability, and resource-efficient deployment. title: Artificial intelligence-supported revision of nursing care plans in a standardised newborn vignette: a one-group pretest-posttest study.
source: PubMed · Journal of research in nursing : JRN
zh_title: AI辅助修订护理计划：新生儿情景单组研究
summary: 菲律宾一所公立大学40名二年级护生用生成式AI「反思-比较-修订」流程修改护理计划，两名盲评教育者评分显示各维度文书质量提升。
key_points: 单组前后测设计，共40名护理学生
两名盲评教育者用Q-DIO工具评分配对计划

abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] Nursing students often produce care plans that are plausible yet generic, with weak linkage among diagnoses, interventions and outcomes. Teacher-mediated, bounded generative AI may support revision while preserving clinical judgement. To assess whether an AI-supported Reflect-Compare-Revise workflow improves nursing care plan quality and diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment using a standardised newborn vignette. A one-group pretest-posttest study involved 40 second-year nursing students at a public university in the Philippines. Students wrote an unaided care plan, then revised it using the structured workflow. Two blinded nurse-educator raters scored paired plans using the Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes instrument. Post-revision documentation quality improved across all domains, with the largest raw gains in diagnostic formulation and nursing-sensitive outcomes. Interventions and outcomes remained the weaker downstream domains, with outcomes lowest at posttest. Diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment and specificity increased, although explicit cross-linking remained inconsistent. This study adds preliminary evidence for nursing education: higher scores after guided AI-supported revision were associated with clearer and more coherent clinical reasoning in care planning. Policy recommendations are to permit bounded AI use with standardised prompts, revision logs/checklists, rubric-based feedback and verification safeguards to protect documentation integrity and patient safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] 护理学生常制定出看似合理但泛化的护理计划，诊断、干预和结局之间联系薄弱。教师介导的、有边界的生成式人工智能（AI）可能支持修订，同时保留临床判断。旨在使用标准化新生儿情景案例，评估AI支持的反思-比较-修订工作流程是否改善护理计划质量以及诊断-干预-结局的一致性。一项单组前测-后测研究纳入菲律宾一所公立大学的40名二年级护理学生。学生先独立撰写一份护理计划，然后使用结构化工作流程进行修订。两名设盲的护理教育者评分员使用诊断、干预和结局质量量表（Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes instrument）对配对护理计划进行评分。修订后文档质量在所有领域均有改善，诊断表述和护理敏感结局的原始增益最大。干预和结局仍是较弱的下游领域，其中结局在后测时最低。诊断-干预-结局的一致性和特异性提高，尽管显式交叉链接仍不一致。本研究为护理教育增加了初步证据：在指导性AI支持修订后获得更高分数与护理计划中更清晰、更连贯的临床推理相关。政策建议是允许有边界的AI使用，并配以标准化提示、修订日志/清单、基于评分量规的反馈和验证保障措施，以保护文档完整性和患者安全。

title: Machine Learning Based Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease using Full Blood Count from a Ghanaian Hospital Population with an Integrated Web Application

summary: medRxiv 预印本，用加纳一家医院155例患者全血细胞计数数据评估机器学习检测慢性肾病，并分析SMOTE应用位置对性能的影响。

比较11种算法、6种重采样与13种集成
SMOTE用于划分前时准确率83.9%
reason: 预印本、单中心小样本，仅交叉验证且指出重采样偏差，属增量档
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is usually silent until advanced, and the tests confirming it are frequently unaffordable in sub-Saharan Africa, whereas the full blood count (FBC) is inexpensive and widely performed. We assessed whether machine learning applied to the FBC can detect CKD, and how far its reported performance depends on where synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) is applied. Records of 155 patients at the Ho Technical University Hospital, Ghana, 43 (27.7%) with CKD, yielded ten features: age, cardiovascular disease and eight raw FBC parameters. Eleven algorithms, six resampling strategies and thirteen ensembles were compared under repeated stratified cross-validation. With SMOTE applied before the train-test split, the protocol under which the deployed models were fitted, Random Forest and Extra Trees both reached an accuracy of 83.9%, with sensitivities of 0.893 and 0.857 and areas under the curve (AUC) of 0.925 and 0.939; repeated cross-validation gave an accuracy of 0.809 {+/-} 0.051 and an AUC of 0.897. With resampling confined to the training folds, the same features gave a held-out accuracy of 61.5% and an AUC of 0.604 in 39 unseen patients. Age was the only variable separating the groups after correction for multiple testing (median 64 versus 47 years, adjusted p = 0.0026). The models are deployed as NephroScan GH (https://nephroscangh.com), which explains every prediction. The FBC carries a real but moderate signal for CKD, and the 22.4 point gap between the two protocols quantifies how far a single preprocessing decision can move a reported accuracy.
zh_abstract: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）通常在进展前无症状，而确诊检查在撒哈拉以南非洲常难以负担，但全血细胞计数（FBC）廉价且广泛开展。我们评估将机器学习应用于FBC能否检测CKD，以及其报告的性能在多大程度上取决于合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）应用于何处。加纳Ho Technical University Hospital的155例患者记录中，43例（27.7%）患有CKD，提取了十个特征：年龄、心血管疾病和八项原始FBC参数。在重复分层交叉验证下比较了十一种算法、六种重采样策略和十三种集成模型。在训练-测试划分之前应用SMOTE（即部署模型拟合所采用的方案）时，随机森林和Extra Trees均达到83.9%的准确率，灵敏度分别为0.893和0.857，曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.925和0.939；重复交叉验证给出的准确率为0.809 {+/-} 0.051，AUC为0.897。当重采样仅限于训练折时，相同特征在39例未见患者中给出的留出准确率为61.5%，AUC为0.604。经多重检验校正后，年龄是唯一区分组间的变量（中位数64岁对47岁，校正p = 0.0026）。这些模型部署为NephroScan GH（https://nephroscangh.com），可解释每一次预测。FBC对CKD具有真实但中等强度的信号，两种方案之间22.4个百分点的差距量化了单一预处理决策能使报告准确率移动多远。

title: Privacy-preserving synthetic data from a national CIDP registry: validation against real-world evidence.
zh_title: 国家CIDP登记库的隐私保护合成数据验证
summary: 以已发表病例对照研究为参照，验证意大利CIDP登记库生成合成数据的保真度与解析有效性。

abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] Research in chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP) is constrained by low prevalence, limited data sharing, and privacy regulations. Disease registries mitigate some of these barriers, yet the reuse of individual-level data remains challenging. Artificial intelligence- and regression-based synthetic data (SD) generation may offer a privacy-preserving solution, provided analytical validity is maintained. We aimed to validate SD derived from the Italian CIDP Registry using a published case-control study as a reference framework. We analyzed a matched case-control dataset including 195 CIDP cases and 195 controls to examine lifestyle and dietary factors associated with CIDP risk. SD were generated using sequential conditional models stratified by sex. Fidelity was assessed by comparing real and SD in terms of marginal distributions, data distinguishability (propensity score mean squared error), and preservation of associations with CIDP risk using univariable and multivariable logistic regression. SD preserved the original case-control balance and sex distribution. Marginal distributions showed high concordance between real and SD, with minor smoothing in a small number of multi-level dietary variables. Distinguishability analyses indicated low separability between real and synthetic records. Univariable associations with CIDP risk were closely replicated, including the protective effects of higher fish and rice intake. Multivariable models demonstrated highly concordant effect estimates between datasets. SD derived from the Italian CIDP Registry accurately reproduces key analytical properties of real-world data while preserving patient privacy. This approach enables reproducible and shareable CIDP research and may support future applications, including synthetic standard-of-care comparator cohorts and precision medicine-oriented investigations.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] 慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经根神经病（chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy, CIDP）的研究受到患病率低、数据共享有限和隐私法规的限制。疾病登记库减轻了其中一些障碍，但个体水平数据的再利用仍具有挑战性。基于人工智能和回归的合成数据（synthetic data, SD）生成可能提供一种保护隐私的解决方案，前提是保持分析有效性。我们旨在以一项已发表的病例对照研究作为参考框架，验证源自意大利CIDP登记库的SD。我们分析了一个匹配的病例对照数据集，包括195例CIDP病例和195例对照，以考察与CIDP风险相关的生活方式和饮食因素。SD采用按性别分层的序贯条件模型生成。通过比较真实数据与SD的边际分布、数据可区分性（倾向评分均方误差），以及使用单变量和多变量logistic回归对CIDP风险关联的保留情况来评估保真度。SD保留了原始病例对照平衡和性别分布。边际分布显示真实数据与SD高度一致，仅少数多水平饮食变量存在轻微平滑。可区分性分析表明真实记录与合成记录之间的可分离性低。与CIDP风险的单变量关联被密切复现，包括较高鱼类和米饭摄入的保护作用。多变量模型显示数据集之间的效应估计值高度一致。源自意大利CIDP登记库的SD在保护患者隐私的同时，准确再现了真实世界数据的关键分析特性。该方法使CIDP研究可重复且可共享，并可能支持未来应用，包括合成标准治疗对照队列和面向精准医学的研究。

title: Attitudes and perceptions toward artificial intelligence among practicing rheumatologists in Iraq: a cross-sectional web-based survey.
zh_title: 伊拉克风湿科医生AI态度横断面调查
summary: 2025年10月至2026年1月网络问卷调查伊拉克执业风湿科医生对人工智能的态度，并分析其与人口学和职业特征的关联。

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of healthcare, particularly in rheumatology, where clinicians must integrate complex clinical, laboratory, and imaging data. Physicians' perceptions of AI may substantially influence the extent to which it is implemented responsibly in routine clinical practice. This study aimed to assess the attitudes of practicing rheumatologists in Iraq toward artificial intelligence and to examine their association with demographic and professional characteristics. A four-month web-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from October 2025 to January 2026. A questionnaire adapted from previous studies was refined through expert review and pilot testing before distribution. The questionnaire comprised demographic information, attitude statements measured on a five-point Likert scale, and items assessing general perceptions of artificial intelligence. Composite attitude scores were categorized using modified Bloom's cutoff criteria. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS and R. A total of 162 complete responses were collected. Most respondents were aged 35-44 years (42.0%), male (56.8%), and specialists (67.9%). Overall, 61.7% reported familiarity with AI and 69.1% had already used AI in rheumatology practice. Most participants 56.8% exhibited a poor attitude, 32.1% a moderate attitude, and 11.1% a good attitude toward AI. Bivariate analysis identified familiarity with AI ( p = 0.003 ) and involvement in research ( p = 0.009 ) as significantly associated with more favorable attitudes. Iraqi rheumatologists demonstrate cautious engagement with artificial intelligence, with the majority displaying poor-to-moderate overall attitude scores on the standardized composite scale. Greater familiarity with AI and research involvement were associated with more favorable attitudes, highlighting the importance of targeted digital literacy and specialty-specific education to support effective AI adoption in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能正日益成为医疗保健的重要组成部分，尤其是在风湿病学中，临床医生必须整合复杂的临床、实验室和影像数据。医生对AI的看法可能显著影响其在常规临床实践中负责任实施的程度。本研究旨在评估伊拉克执业风湿病学家对人工智能的态度，并检验其与人口学和专业特征的关联。于2025年10月至2026年1月开展了一项为期四个月的网络横断面调查。问卷改编自既往研究，在发放前通过专家评审和预试验进行了完善。问卷包括人口学信息、以五点Likert量表测量的态度陈述，以及评估对人工智能总体认知的条目。综合态度评分采用改良Bloom截断标准进行分类。使用SPSS和R进行统计分析。共收集162份完整回复。大多数受访者年龄为35-44岁（42.0%），男性（56.8%），专科医生（67.9%）。总体而言，61.7%报告熟悉AI，69.1%已在风湿病学实践中使用过AI。大多数参与者（56.8%）对AI表现出较差态度，32.1%为中等态度，11.1%为良好态度。双变量分析确定，对AI的熟悉程度（ p = 0.003 ）和研究参与（ p = 0.009 ）与更有利的态度显著相关。伊拉克风湿病学家对人工智能表现出谨慎的参与，多数人在标准化综合量表上的总体态度评分为差至中等。对AI更熟悉和研究参与与更有利的态度相关，突显了有针对性的数字素养和专科特异性教育对支持临床实践中有效采用AI的重要性。
