title: Multiscale Spatial Characterization of Glioma MRI with MUSE and Radiomics
zh_title: MUSE与影像组学刻画胶质瘤MRI空间异质性
summary: 基于公开UCSF-PDGM队列416例，用MUSE变差函数场与方向性影像组学刻画胶质瘤MRI异质性。
key_points: 使用公开UCSF-PDGM的增强T1与肿瘤分割
416例基线患者，其中375例有配对方向性GLCM
预印本，回顾性、无外部验证
reason: 预印本回顾性方法研究，仅公共数据集内部分析，无外部验证
abstract: Purpose. Characterizing glioma heterogeneity requires measurements that retain the physical scale and orientation of intratumoral intensity dependence. We evaluate the original 3D variographic field produced by the MUSE tool (Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment) alongside directional radiomics and independent image-based molecular classification. Methods. We analyzed postcontrast T1-weighted magnetic resonance images and enhancing-tumor segmentations from the public UCSF-PDGM collection. Verified MUSE outputs were available for 416 independent baseline patients, of whom 375 had paired directional gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) measurements. Each MUSE field retained 328 original experimental directional variograms with physical lag distances, semivariances, orientations, and voxel-pair support. Agreement was assessed at aligned offsets and through between-tumor comparisons. Patient-level permutation tests evaluated associations with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) status on 2,508 native direction-lag coordinates. A standalone 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) provided a separate IDH classification benchmark. Results. At 9,371 geometrically aligned offsets, native MUSE semivariance and half GLCM contrast correlated strongly (Pearson r = 0.954). Across 31,599 eligible between-tumor comparisons, representation-level dissimilarities showed Spearman {rho}_S = 0.862, with sensitivity to GLCM feature family and long-offset sampling support. In 364 grade-4 tumors, including 24 IDH-mutant cases, the original MUSE field was associated with IDH after conventional adjustment (global permutation p = 0.00050), but the association was attenuated after primary directional GLCM adjustment (p = 0.256). The independent CNN achieved an out-of-fold IDH ROC-AUC of 0.792 and PR-AUC of 0.414 across 416 patients. Native MUSE examples revealed scale- and direction-dependent spatial behavior, including distances beyond those sampled by the GLCM protocol. Conclusion. Variograms by MUSE provide a physically indexed description of tumor spatial heterogeneity that can accompany radiomic analysis and CNN classification. The observed statistical overlap is substantial, and incremental clinical discrimination beyond directional GLCM features remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 【目的】刻画胶质瘤异质性需要能够保留瘤内强度依赖性的物理尺度和方向的测量。我们评估 MUSE 工具（Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment）生成的原始三维变异函数场（3D variographic field），并将其与方向性放射组学（directional radiomics）和独立的基于图像的分子分类进行比较。【方法】我们分析了来自公开 UCSF-PDGM 数据集的增强后 T1 加权磁共振图像和强化肿瘤分割。416 名独立基线患者有经验证的 MUSE 输出，其中 375 名具有配对的方向性灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）测量。每个 MUSE 场保留了 328 个原始实验方向变异函数，包含物理滞后距离、半方差、方向以及体素对支持。在对齐偏移处以及通过肿瘤间比较评估一致性。患者水平置换检验在 2,508 个原始方向-滞后坐标上评估与异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）状态的关联。一个独立的 3D 残差卷积神经网络（CNN）提供了单独的 IDH 分类基准。【结果】在 9,371 个几何对齐偏移处，原始 MUSE 半方差与半数 GLCM 对比度强相关（Pearson r = 0.954）。在 31,599 个符合条件的肿瘤间比较中，表征水平差异显示 Spearman ρ_S = 0.862，并对 GLCM 特征家族和长偏移采样支持具有敏感性。在 364 个 4 级肿瘤中（包括 24 个 IDH 突变病例），原始 MUSE 场在常规调整后与 IDH 相关（全局置换 p = 0.00050），但在主要方向性 GLCM 调整后该关联减弱（p = 0.256）。独立 CNN 在 416 名患者中取得 0.792 的折外 IDH ROC-AUC 和 0.414 的 PR-AUC。原始 MUSE 示例揭示了尺度和方向依赖的空间行为，包括超出 GLCM 方案所采样距离的范围。【结论】MUSE 的变异函数提供了肿瘤空间异质性的物理索引描述，可作为放射组学分析和 CNN 分类的补充。观察到的统计重叠很大，而超越方向性 GLCM 特征的增量临床判别能力仍未确立。

title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry
zh_title: 多模态证据与贝叶斯主动询问的可审计分层推理
summary: 用合成舌象、脉压与声学观测做序贯贝叶斯问诊评估，600例合成测试中家族判别准确率87%。
key_points: 区分客观多模态推断与主动问诊的合成评测框架
25个类型化问题逐步收窄至33个细术语
代价敏感信息增益将家族准确率提至95.5%
reason: 仅合成数据评测，无真实临床验证，属增量证据
abstract: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage. In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.
zh_abstract: 大多数多模态分类器假设所有有用的证据都预先可用，而临床问诊是序贯的。我们提出一个合成评估框架，将客观多模态推断与主动问诊分开。一个客观模型将合成的舌象、双侧多压力脉搏和声学观察映射到八个证候家族。一个带来源信息（provenance-bearing）的知识核心（Knowledge Core）和一个仅用于训练的答案模型支持使用25个类型化问题在33个细术语上进行贝叶斯收窄，同时七个安全性问题保留在诊断后验之外。弱的共享症状因子限制了细术语对客观表型的影响，并且一个仅客观探针测试泄漏。在一项预注册的600例合成评估中，客观家族准确率为87.0%。成本敏感期望信息增益（cost-sensitive expected information gain, cost-EIG）将家族准确率提高到95.5%，将确切细术语准确率提高到42.5%，而未优化的固定顺序基线分别为92.7%和33.0%。选择性家族准确率在95.3%覆盖率下达到96.9%。然而，cost-EIG平均比固定顺序询问更多问题（9.795对9.352）。缺失音频路由保留了94.0%的家族准确率，并且当所有客观模态均缺失时，工作流不变量强制弃权。置换细术语答案似然将家族准确率降低到78.7%。六项冻结检查中有五项通过，但问题效率假设未通过。比较是描述性的，因为仅保留了聚合输出，而非配对病例级输出。这些结果建立了一个可重复的合成工作流，而非临床诊断或治疗有效性。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
zh_title: Alpha-TCM：中医引导的多模态推理九层框架
summary: 预印本提出面向中医的多层可审计架构，仅以合成数据实例化前五层，作者声明非完整临床实现。
key_points: 九层架构覆盖语义定义、采集、质控到治理
仅合成舌象、脉波等数据验证第1-5层
强调知识、证据与推断分离以便审计
reason: 系统设计提案加合成数据原型，无真实临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation. Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection. Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.
zh_abstract: Alpha-TCM 在一个核心论点下做出两项贡献：可审计系统应将领域知识、病例证据、概率推断和下游权限分开。首先，它提出一个面向中医的九层架构，涵盖语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带来源信息的知识、概率推断、纵向更新、约束决策、语言交互和人类治理。每一层规定其信息契约、失效边界、依赖关系和验证状态。这是一个系统设计提案，而非完整临床实施的声明。其次，一个受控合成原型实例化第1-5层以审计知识-证据接口。四个条件高斯编码器处理合成舌图像、脉搏波形、问诊字段和文本，而一个冻结桥接器预测五维合成结局。一个版本化上下文先验独立于渲染器编译。融合在添加上下文之前移除重复的参考先验信息。等量信息对照、先验正则化、分级污染和结构损坏测试上下文收益、贝叶斯特异性和冲突检测。在十个配对种子和四种训练规模上，上下文知识在600和1,200例时相对于边际委员会融合改善了平均绝对误差，但相对于等量信息神经对照没有改善。完全错误的上下文在每种规模下都损害性能，而先验效应不一致，冲突分数未追踪病例级损害。结果支持低数据合成环境中的上下文结构，而非特定的贝叶斯优势。该原型不对中医理论或临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向或迁移有效性建立任何主张。

title: Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data
zh_title: 可穿戴加速度计信号检测脑癌进展
summary: 研究利用腕戴加速度计数据与粗糙路径签名特征，分类高级别胶质瘤患者稳定与进展状态。
key_points: 高级别胶质瘤常规用增强MRI每2-3月评估
加速度计可连续无创监测患者功能
将记录转为步行路径片段并提取签名特征
reason: 预印本、单研究可穿戴方法，摘要无样本量与对照结果，属增量档
abstract: Glioblastoma and other high-grade gliomas (HGG) have a poor prognosis and are associated with progressive functional decline. The standard of care to assess progressive disease is contrast-enhanced MRI, which is expensive, claustrophobic, and performed only once every 2-3 months. Wearable accelerometers offer a non-invasive alternative for continuously monitoring patient function between clinic visits. However, accelerometry data streams are typically noisy and highly patient-specific, making conventional time series methods and summary statistics poorly suited to detecting clinically meaningful change. This work aims to classify stable versus progressive disease states by applying rough path signatures for feature extraction from wrist-worn accelerometer data. We convert accelerometer recordings from HGG patients enrolled in the BrainWear study into walking-path segments and use signature kernel maximum mean discrepancy (SigMMD) to quantify change in patients' walking behaviour. We overcome the challenge of inter-patient heterogeneity by adjusting for the natural variation in a patient's walking during stable tumour periods. This patient-specific normalisation substantially improves separation, yielding a candidate biomarker of tumour progression. Our results provide proof-of-concept evidence that signature-based analysis of wearable accelerometry can distinguish stable from progressive disease states, motivating larger longitudinal studies of continuous wearable monitoring as a digital biomarker in neuro-oncology.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤和其他高级别胶质瘤（HGG）预后较差，并与进行性功能下降相关。评估疾病进展的标准方法是增强MRI，但其费用高、可能引起幽闭恐惧，并且每2—3个月仅进行一次。可穿戴加速度计提供了一种非侵入性替代方法，可在门诊就诊之间连续监测患者功能。然而，加速度计数据流通常噪声大且高度具有患者特异性，使传统时间序列方法和汇总统计量不适用于检测具有临床意义的变化。本研究旨在通过应用粗糙路径签名从腕戴式加速度计数据中提取特征，对稳定与进展性疾病状态进行分类。我们将BrainWear研究中入组的HGG患者的加速度计记录转换为行走路径片段，并使用签名核最大均值差异（SigMMD）量化患者行走行为的变化。我们通过校正患者在肿瘤稳定期行走的自然变异，克服了患者间异质性的挑战。这种患者特异性归一化显著改善了区分度，产生了肿瘤进展的候选生物标志物。我们的结果提供了概念验证证据，表明对可穿戴加速度计数据进行基于签名的分析能够区分稳定与进展性疾病状态，从而推动开展更大规模的纵向研究，将连续可穿戴监测作为神经肿瘤学中的数字生物标志物。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 医护人员视角下的医疗算法偏见
summary: 研究基于问卷与访谈，分析不同岗位医护人员对医疗AI算法偏见、公平性与采纳意愿的看法。
key_points: 偏见成因与评估标准看法因岗位而异
感知公平与算法接受和采用相关
作者认为需更多研究保障医疗AI公平
reason: 问卷访谈研究，样本未说明，属增量证据
abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.
zh_abstract: 本文关注医疗信息系统中机器学习（machine learning）与人工智能（artificial intelligence）应用的算法偏见。基于对具有不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医疗专业人员的问卷调查和访谈所获定量数据与定性评论，本研究提供了关于算法偏见、感知公平性以及预期接受和采用机器学习算法及算法生成结果之间关系的发现。结果表明，医疗专业人员对算法偏见成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性和偏见缓解方法的看法，可能因其岗位角色、视角、任务和算法特征而异。需要更多研究来调查算法偏见，以确保医疗中的公平与平等。

title: DES-JEPA: Learning a Shared Vocabulary for High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences
zh_title: DES-JEPA：高维离散事件序列的共享词表学习
summary: 提出DES-JEPA联合嵌入预测架构，为跨领域高维离散事件序列（含患者临床事件轨迹）学习共享离散词表。
key_points: 针对事件类型数量庞大、跨域标签不对应的难题
现有事件序列基础模型仅支持少量固定事件类型
摘要未给出临床数据集上的量化结果
reason: 方法类预印本，临床评估信息不足，属增量档
abstract: Temporal foundation models such as Chronos and TimesFM generalize across domains through a shared numerical observation space. In contrast, discrete event sequences (DESs), including operational event logs or patient clinical-event trajectories, have domain-specific event vocabularies whose labels lack a consistent correspondence across domains. Beyond this lack of consistency, the number of distinct events in real-world settings is high enough to challenge both classical temporal point process modeling and current in-context foundation inference models such as FIM-PP. Critically, current foundation models for DESs are limited to a small, fixed number of event types, restricting their applicability to realistic, high-dimensional event streams. To address this, we propose two complementary modules: (i) DES-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns a shared discrete vocabulary from synthetic stochastic processes with unaligned event vocabularies; and (ii) DES-PFN, a discrete event sequence prior-fitted network that reuses the learned vocabulary for in-context next-event prediction. Without task-specific fine-tuning, this framework achieves competitive zero-shot performance on eight unseen real-world datasets and scales up to 700 distinct event types.
zh_abstract: 诸如Chronos和TimesFM的时间基础模型通过共享的数值观测空间实现跨领域泛化。相比之下，离散事件序列（discrete event sequences, DESs），包括运营事件日志或患者临床事件轨迹，具有领域特定的事件词表，其标签在跨领域间缺乏一致对应关系。除了这种不一致性外，真实环境中不同事件的数量高到足以挑战经典时间点过程建模和当前上下文基础推理模型（如FIM-PP）。关键的是，当前用于DES的基础模型受限于少量固定数量的事件类型，限制了其适用于现实的高维事件流。为解决此问题，我们提出两个互补模块：（i）DES-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测架构，从未对齐事件词表的合成随机过程中学习共享离散词表；（ii）DES-PFN，一种离散事件序列先验拟合网络，复用已学习词表进行上下文下一事件预测。无需任务特定微调，该框架在八个未见真实世界数据集上取得有竞争力的零样本性能，并可扩展至700种不同事件类型。

title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
zh_title: 以大模型作为评判者与考生预测医学试题难度
summary: 用开源大模型对USMLE与PANCE题目作难度评分、配对比较及模拟作答，融合信号预测试题难度。
key_points: 利用评判与应试两类信号替代纯文本特征
数据来自美国医师执照类考试题库
摘要未披露最终预测性能指标
reason: 医学教育场景预印本，结果信息有限，属增量档
abstract: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.
zh_abstract: 仅凭试题文本预测医学试题难度仍然具有挑战性。既往工作在很大程度上依赖于语言学特征或由通用语言模型和领域专用语言模型得到的文本表征，但预测性能一直较为有限。本研究采取了一种不同方法，利用开放权重大型语言模型（LLMs）与试题交互时出现的难度相关信号。我们使用USMLE和PANCE医师资格考试试题，考察了LLMs的两种角色。作为评判者，模型提供绝对难度评分和成对难度比较。作为模拟考生，模型生成基于作答的信号，包括正确性、计分选项概率、作答熵以及前两个选项之间的概率差。随后，我们在下游预测模型中将最强的评判信号和作答信号与基线试题特征相结合。成对难度判断是两个数据集中最一致的单个LLM信号，而模拟考生信号和绝对判断在某些特征组合中提供了互补信息。最佳配置在USMLE上达到Spearman相关系数 $ρ$ = .447，超过2024年BEA共享任务中的最佳系统（$ρ$ = .25），并在PANCE上达到 $ρ$ = .494。这些结果与专有前沿模型Claude Opus 5给出的直接绝对判断相当（分别为 $ρ$ = .443和.488）。总体而言，开放权重LLMs的评判信号和作答信号捕获了超出文本表征的难度相关信息。由于这些模型可在本地部署，该方法为预测未发布或高保密性试题的难度提供了一种实用选择。

title: AAV-CapNet: Multi-Omics Deep Learning with Fourier Enhancement and Cross-Attention for Predicting Infectivity of Known AAV Capsid Variants.
zh_title: AAV-CapNet：多组学深度学习预测衣壳变体感染性
summary: 构建融合傅里叶频域增强与交叉注意力的多组学模型，预测20种AAV衣壳变体在52个癌细胞系的感染性。
key_points: 自建392条验证测量数据，重复五折交叉验证
低假阳性率条件下适用于高通量筛选
对未见血清型泛化较差
reason: 样本量小、仅交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: [Viruses] This work builds AAV-CapNet, a deep learning model integrating Fourier frequency enhancement and cross-attention fusion, to predict the infectivity of 20 AAV capsid variants across 52 cancer cell lines with a self-built multi-omics dataset of 392 validated measurements. Validated via stratified splitting and repeated five-fold cross-validation, it extracts dual-domain capsid features fused with host transcriptomics for joint classification and regression. The model exhibits favourable performance under low-false-positive-rate conditions suitable for high-throughput screening. Attention mapping and ablation tests validate core modules' necessity. Despite poor generalization to unseen serotypes, this interpretable tool facilitates intraserotype capsid screening and rational engineering.
zh_abstract: 【病毒】本工作构建了AAV-CapNet，这是一种整合傅里叶频率增强和交叉注意力融合的深度学习模型，利用一个包含392个经验证测量值的自建多组学数据集，预测20种AAV衣壳变体在52个癌细胞系中的感染性。通过分层划分和重复五折交叉验证进行验证，该模型提取双域衣壳特征并与宿主转录组学融合，用于联合分类和回归。该模型在适合高通量筛选的低假阳性率条件下表现出良好性能。注意力映射和消融实验验证了核心模块的必要性。尽管对未见血清型的泛化能力较差，这一可解释工具仍有助于血清型内衣壳筛选和理性工程。

title: Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images
zh_title: 医学图像最优传输的凸势能学习方法
summary: 通过参数化凸势函数估计医学图像间最优传输映射，在2D与3D数据集上误差低于现有方法。
key_points: 构造保证无旋的传输映射，符合Brenier定理
在2D与3D医学影像数据集上评测
传输误差更低、图像重建质量更优
reason: 预印本方法改进，仅有指标对比，缺乏临床验证
abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.
zh_abstract: 计算医学图像之间的最优传输映射在形态学分析中起着基础性作用。然而，现有方法要么难以扩展到大型三维医学图像，要么依赖于只能提供近似传输映射的正则化公式。为了提高下游医学图像分析的准确性，我们提出了一种通过参数化凸势函数来估计最优传输映射的新方法。根据构造，所得的传输映射保证是无旋的，这与Brenier定理一致。我们在二维和三维医学成像数据集上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了更低的传输估计误差，并产生了更高质量的图像重建。

title: Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults
zh_title: 基于轮廓步态组学的老年人衰弱评估
summary: 预印本用66名老年人的标准化轮廓与步态能量图提取90个描述符，结合嵌套交叉验证与SHAP预测Fried衰弱表型。
key_points: 66名老年人，以Fried衰弱表型为标签
提取90个形状、运动与纹理描述符
mRMR筛选特征并用SHAP解释预测
reason: 预印本小样本（66人）单队列研究，仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.
zh_abstract: 步行为了解身体功能提供了一个窗口，可能支持可解释的基于视频的衰弱评估。我们开发了基于轮廓的“步态组学”（gaitomics），将衰弱预测与可测量的身体形态和运动模式联系起来。在66名使用Fried衰弱表型（Fried Frailty Phenotype）评估的老年人中，标准化轮廓和步态能量图像产生了90个描述形状、时间变化、运动和纹理的描述符。使用互信息差准则的最小冗余最大相关选择优先选择信息丰富的特征，同时限制冗余。每个分类器均在参与者层面采用五折外层和三折内层的嵌套分层交叉验证进行评估，特征排序和特征数量选择仅限于训练分区。Shapley加性解释检查了对留出预测的贡献。双侧轮廓差异在三分类以及涉及衰弱参与者的两项比较的汇总特征选择排名中居首。归因谱在不同任务间存在差异，其中纹理和连续帧轮廓差异在三分类中突出。在分类器特异性评估中，CatBoost取得了最高的平均三分类micro-AUC，为0.647 ± 0.085。领先的两两比较平均micro-AUC分别为：衰弱 vs 非衰弱为0.833 ± 0.249，衰弱 vs 前衰弱为0.765 ± 0.168，前衰弱 vs 非衰弱分类为0.554 ± 0.129。这些发现将模型预测与明确的步态特征联系起来，同时揭示了任务依赖性的特征优先级以及前衰弱与非衰弱参与者区分有限。该框架为进一步研究提供了可解释的基础，但仍需要更大规模的独立研究来确定其可靠性和临床相关性。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
zh_title: 元初始化加速隐式神经表示的可变形医学图像配准
summary: 预印本提出用元初始化（Reptile 与 STRAINER 迁移）加速基于隐式神经表示的可变形医学图像配准，并在 OASIS-1 上测试。
key_points: 以 KAN-IDIR 作为 INR 位移场基础模型
OASIS-1：364 对训练，49 对用于测试时适配
两种初始化方案在第1500步时 Dice 更高、HD95更低
reason: 预印本、单数据集内部测试、仅方法增量，属增量档
abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.
zh_abstract: 用于可变形医学图像配准的隐式神经表示（INR）方法需要针对每个新图像对优化网络参数，使适应速度成为实际限制。本工作研究是否可以利用从先前已解决配准任务集合中学习到的初始化来加速早期适应。我们考察两种方案：Reptile元初始化和STRAINER对坐标网络共享组件的迁移。使用KAN-IDIR作为基础INR位移场模型。实验在OASIS-1上进行，使用364个连续图像对进行训练，49个图像对用于测试时适应。配准质量使用平均Dice和HD95，以及在迭代1500时负雅可比行列式体素比例进行评估。在所研究的配置中，两种方案在早期迭代中均比随机初始化获得更高的Dice和更低的HD95。在小迭代预算下，Reptile在数值上优于STRAINER，尽管它们的预训练预算不匹配。随着迭代次数增加，方案之间的差异缩小。STRAINER预训练耗时39-40分钟，而Reptile耗时44.98小时。

title: AI: It's in your phone, why not in your practice?
source: PubMed · OTA international : the open access journal of orthopaedic trauma
zh_title: OTA综述：AI在骨科创伤中的应用路径
summary: OTA人工智能工作组在年会上介绍AI在骨科创伤的应用，包括跌倒风险预测、影像自动诊断与计算机模拟临床试验框架。
key_points: AI可用于老年人跌倒风险预测
影像自动诊断与结局评估是应用方向
提出基于虚拟患者队列的模拟试验框架
reason: 会议综述/观点类，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [OTA international : the open access journal of orthopaedic trauma] Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an ascendant technical field with potential to revolutionize health care and orthopaedics. This paper highlights ways in which AI is already affecting members of the Orthopaedic Trauma Association (OTA), while identifying paths to clinical application, as presented at the 2025 OTA Annual Meeting's Basic Science Focus Forum. A report from the OTA AI Task Force shared some initial accomplishments, including the crafting of a position statement. Areas of AI application in orthopaedic trauma were discussed, including the prediction of fall risk in the elderly, capabilities for automated image-based diagnosis and outcome assessment, and efforts toward creating a framework for in silico clinical trials that rely upon virtual patient cohorts. Together these applications show how AI is emerging as a foundational tool in orthopaedic trauma research. Over the next few years, these products will be moving from the research laboratory to the clinic. For the tools to be of greatest benefit, a measured development approach using teams of data scientists partnered with orthopaedic trauma surgeons must be adopted. Academia and Industry are both progressing in this direction-the best path forward will likely involve shared development efforts. As these efforts progress, OTA members will undoubtedly be involved. Both they and their patients stand to be the primary beneficiaries of many of these developments.
zh_abstract: [OTA International：骨科创伤开放获取期刊] 人工智能（AI）是一个新兴技术领域，有潜力彻底改变医疗保健和骨科。本文强调AI已经影响骨科创伤协会（OTA）成员的方式，同时确定临床应用路径，如2025年OTA年会基础科学焦点论坛上所展示。OTA AI特别工作组的一份报告分享了一些初步成果，包括起草一份立场声明。讨论了AI在骨科创伤中的应用领域，包括预测老年人跌倒风险、基于图像的自动诊断和结局评估能力，以及为依赖虚拟患者队列的计算机模拟临床试验创建框架的努力。这些应用共同表明AI如何正在成为骨科创伤研究中的基础工具。在未来几年，这些产品将从研究实验室走向临床。为使这些工具带来最大益处，必须采用由数据科学家团队与骨科创伤外科医生合作的审慎开发方法。学术界和产业界都在朝这一方向推进——最佳前进路径很可能涉及共同开发努力。随着这些努力推进，OTA成员无疑将参与其中。他们及其患者将成为许多此类进展的主要受益者。

abstract: [Advances in physiology education] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping physiology education, but the central challenge is epistemic, not technological. Learners are often more fluent with AI tools than their instructors, yet less fluent in the physiology those tools describe: a pattern this Perspective terms the reverse native-speaker problem. AI-generated explanations of physiological mechanisms are rarely overtly wrong. An interpretive framework proposed by means of this perspective states that explanations that appear plausible step by step may become become inconsistent when organ systems are considered together. It is therefore argued that the educator role is shifting from transmitting information to certifying coherence and proposes a classroom exercise, the error-hunt, for identifying seeded, systems-level inconsistencies in AI-generated explanations.
zh_abstract: [《Advances in Physiology Education》] 生成式人工智能（AI）正在重塑生理学教育，但核心挑战是认识论层面的，而非技术层面的。学习者往往比其教师更熟练使用AI工具，却对这些人工具所描述的生理学更不熟练：本视角将这一模式称为反向母语者问题。AI生成的生理机制解释很少明显错误。通过本视角提出的一个解释框架指出，逐步看起来合理的解释在将器官系统放在一起考虑时可能变得不一致。因此，本文认为教育者的角色正从传递信息转向认证连贯性，并提出一个课堂练习——找错（error-hunt），用于识别AI生成解释中植入的系统级不一致。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Yang Xiaodong; conditions: Medical Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 40; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Laparoscopic skills training requires hand-eye coordination, spatial orientation, instrument control, and precise handling of materials. Structured feedback supports skills development, but frequent individualized instructor feedback may be limited by available time and resources. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) may help organize performance information into personalized training recommendations. This single-center, randomized, parallel-group, active-controlled trial plans to enroll 40 fourth-year clinical medical students with no or limited laparoscopic simulation experience. Participants will be assigned in a 1:1 ratio to AI-assisted personalized feedback or structured rule-based template feedback. Both groups will complete the same training program using a 14-ball pegboard transfer task and study-developed shape-cutting tasks. Training duration, equipment, general instructor guidance, and four scheduled feedback opportunities will be standardized. Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery (FLS) tasks will be used at scheduled assessments rather than as repeated training exercises. The AI group will receive feedback generated through a predefined generative AI workflow using de-identified structured performance records and self-assessments. Outputs will undergo predefined quality review before delivery. The comparison group will receive feedback generated using fixed criteria, priority rules, and feedback statements. The primary outcome is the study-defined Precision Cutting Objective Score on the FLS task after cutting training, approximately 4 weeks after baseline. The key secondary outcome is the study-defined Peg Transfer Objective Score on the FLS task after transfer training, approximately 2 weeks after baseline. Additional assessments will evaluate technical skill development and skill retention 4 to 8 weeks after training completion. Participants will not be informed of their feedback source. Technical performance will be assessed from anonymized videos by evaluators unaware of group assignment. The study tests the hypothesis that AI-assisted personalized feedback improves laparoscopic skills learning more than structured rule-based feedback. Because both groups receive feedback under otherwise standardized training conditions, the comparison is intended to identify the additional educational value of the AI-assisted approach.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Yang Xiaodong；研究条件：医学教育；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：40；状态：尚未招募] 腹腔镜技能训练需要手眼协调、空间定向、器械控制和材料精确操作。结构化反馈支持技能发展，但频繁的个体化导师反馈可能受可用时间和资源限制。生成式人工智能（AI）可能有助于将表现信息组织为个性化训练建议。这项单中心、随机、平行组、阳性对照试验计划入组 40 名无或仅有有限腹腔镜模拟经验的四年级临床医学生。参与者将按 1:1 比例分配至 AI 辅助个性化反馈组或结构化基于规则的模板反馈组。两组将完成相同的训练项目，使用 14 球钉板转移任务和研究自行开发的形状切割任务。训练时长、设备、一般导师指导和四次预定反馈机会将标准化。腹腔镜手术基础（Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery, FLS）任务将用于预定评估，而不是作为重复训练练习。AI 组将接受通过预定义的生成式 AI 工作流生成的反馈，该工作流使用去标识化的结构化表现记录和自我评估。输出在交付前将经过预定义的质量审查。对照组将接受使用固定标准、优先级规则和反馈语句生成的反馈。主要结局是切割训练后约基线后 4 周时 FLS 任务上研究定义的精密切割客观评分。关键次要结局是转移训练后约基线后 2 周时 FLS 任务上研究定义的钉转移客观评分。额外评估将评价训练完成后 4 至 8 周的技术技能发展和技能保持。参与者不会被告知其反馈来源。技术表现将由不知道分组情况的评估者根据匿名视频进行评估。该研究检验以下假设：AI 辅助个性化反馈比结构化基于规则的反馈更能改善腹腔镜技能学习。由于两组在其他方面标准化的训练条件下均接受反馈，该比较旨在识别 AI 辅助方法的额外教育价值。

abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.
zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] 放射科采用人工智能（AI）的速度，快于研究AI对放射科医生知觉专长和判读技能影响的速度。问题已部分从这些工具在基准任务上表现是否良好，转变为当这些工具的使用成为常规时临床判断会发生什么。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏差（automation bias），即未经充分审视就遵循AI建议的倾向；以及技能退化（deskilling），即因不使用而导致知觉和判读能力侵蚀，通常在AI支持被撤除时显现。无论经验如何，错误的AI输出都会降低准确性；辅助带来的获益在不同阅片者和任务间不可预测地变化；并且在撤除AI后性能下降；这两种风险均未在放射学中开展纵向研究。提出一种置信度分层分诊模型，其中由校准后的AI置信度（而非仅依据发现）将病例分流至低、中、高置信度流程：在独立阅片前暂不显示输出；显示输出并附带不确定性信号和检查清单；或显示输出并随机盲法审核。已证明的本地置信度校准是部署的前提条件，流程阈值和审核率应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权，而不仅依据错误概率。该模型不是对每个病例应用同一种工作流程，而是将放射科医生的注意力重新分配到AI错误最可能出现且后果最严重的地方，从而落实四项原则：使放射科医生留在决策环路中、让AI不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人-AI交互作为一个系统进行治理。还提出一个研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否能减少自动化偏差和技能侵蚀。

The primary outcome is the proportion of participants achieving a modified Rankin Scale (mRS) score of 0-1 at 90 ± 7 days. Safety outcomes include symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, parenchymal hematoma, all-cause mortality, and serious systemic bleeding.

title: A physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin for personalized estimation of arterial stiffness
zh_title: 物理信息外周血流动力学数字孪生估计动脉僵硬度
summary: 基于单点肱动脉压力波形与物理信息数字孪生模型估计动脉僵硬度，118 人队列盲测验证。

仅需单点肱动脉波形，无需双点测量

reason: 单中心小样本（118 例）、仅内部盲测的算法建模研究，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Arterial stiffness, commonly assessed by pulse wave velocity (PWV), is an important biomarker of cardiovascular risk, yet conventional PWV measurements require dual-site recordings that limit scalability in clinical settings. Here we introduce a physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin framework for estimating central-brachial arterial stiffness from a single brachial pressure waveform. Using our laboratory-developed cuff device, high-resolution brachial pulse waveforms were collected in a cohort of 118 subjects. The digital twin then personalizes a reduced-order wave propagation model through PDE-constrained optimization, generating a compact parameter space that encodes ventricular–vascular characteristics relevant to stiffness. Incorporating digital-twin-derived parameters improved PWV estimation on a blind test cohort ( r = 0.67, RMSE = 1.12 m/s) compared with a baseline model using only age and blood pressure ( r = 0.22, RMSE = 1.90 m/s). These results indicate that physics-informed digital twins can enable scalable, noninvasive assessment of vascular aging from accessible peripheral waveforms.
zh_abstract: 动脉僵硬度通常通过脉搏波速度（PWV）评估，是心血管风险的重要生物标志物，但传统PWV测量需要双部位记录，限制了临床环境中的可扩展性。在此，我们引入一个物理信息驱动（physics-informed）的外周血流动力学数字孪生框架，用于从单个肱动脉压力波形估计中心-肱动脉僵硬度。使用我们实验室开发的袖带设备，在118名受试者队列中采集了高分辨率肱动脉脉搏波形。数字孪生随后通过偏微分方程（PDE）约束优化个性化一个降阶波传播模型，生成一个紧凑参数空间，编码与僵硬度相关的心室-血管特征。与仅使用年龄和血压的基线模型（r = 0.22，RMSE = 1.90 m/s）相比，纳入数字孪生衍生参数在盲测队列上改善了PWV估计（r = 0.67，RMSE = 1.12 m/s）。这些结果表明，物理信息驱动的数字孪生能够利用可获取的外周波形实现可扩展、无创的血管老化评估。

abstract: [Oral diseases] Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have shown promise for the detection of periodontal disease. This study aimed to synthesize current evidence on the diagnostic performance of AI models applied to cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) for periodontal disease. A comprehensive literature search of MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase was conducted to identify studies on AI-assisted diagnosis of periodontal disease using CBCT published up to December 2025. The Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies-2 (QUADAS-2) tool was used to assess the risk of bias. Among 10,099 records screened, eight studies met the inclusion criteria. These studies indicate that AI models, predominantly based on convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures applied to CBCT images, have substantial potential for detecting periodontal bone loss and related conditions. However, diagnostic performance metrics varied markedly across studies, and direct comparisons with human clinicians produced inconsistent findings, underscoring the need for more rigorous study designs and standardized datasets. Despite limitations arising from heterogeneous methodologies and non-standardized data collection, CBCT-based AI models show considerable promise for enhancing periodontal disease diagnosis. Further high-quality, methodologically robust research is warranted to validate and optimize these approaches for clinical use. PROSPERO: CRD420251273846.
zh_abstract: [口腔疾病] 人工智能（AI）的近期进展已在牙周病检测方面显示出前景。本研究旨在综合当前关于应用于锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）的AI模型对牙周病诊断性能的证据。对MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Embase进行了全面文献检索，以识别截至2025年12月发表的关于使用CBCT进行AI辅助牙周病诊断的研究。使用诊断准确性研究质量评估-2（QUADAS-2）工具评估偏倚风险。在筛选的10,099条记录中，有8项研究符合纳入标准。这些研究表明，主要基于卷积神经网络（CNN）架构并应用于CBCT图像的AI模型在检测牙周骨丧失及相关状况方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，各研究之间的诊断性能指标差异显著，且与人类临床医生的直接比较产生了不一致的结果，这凸显了需要更严谨的研究设计和标准化数据集。尽管存在由异质性方法和非标准化数据收集引起的局限性，基于CBCT的AI模型在增强牙周病诊断方面显示出相当大的前景。需要进一步开展高质量、方法学稳健的研究，以验证和优化这些方法以供临床使用。PROSPERO：CRD420251273846。

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology in the fields of medicine and ophthalmology. Recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and convolutional neural networks have significantly improved cataract detection and grading, intraocular lens power calculations, surgical decision-making, risk prediction and patient education. Intraoperative AI-assisted surgical phase recognition, workflow analysis, real-time guidance, robotic technologies and femtosecond laser integration can improve surgical precision, efficiency and safety. AI has shown promise in predicting visual outcomes, detecting postoperative complications and facilitating telemedicine follow-up. Though challenges with AI include transparency, data diversity, regulatory oversight and clinical validation, continued advances are expected to further personalise cataract surgery, support clinical decision-making, optimise surgical performance and improve patient outcomes. This narrative summarises the current and emerging applications of AI in preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative management of cataracts.
zh_abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] 人工智能（AI）已成为医学和眼科领域的一项变革性技术。机器学习、深度学习和卷积神经网络的最新进展显著改善了白内障检测与分级、人工晶状体度数计算、手术决策、风险预测和患者教育。术中 AI 辅助的手术阶段识别、工作流程分析、实时引导、机器人技术和飞秒激光整合可提高手术精确性、效率和安全性。AI 在预测视力结局、检测术后并发症和促进远程医疗随访方面显示出前景。尽管 AI 面临透明度、数据多样性、监管监督和临床验证等挑战，但持续进展预计将进一步实现白内障手术个性化、支持临床决策、优化手术表现并改善患者结局。本叙述性综述总结了 AI 在白内障术前、术中和术后管理中的当前和新兴应用。

title: Richer database context improves LLM-generated EHR phenotyping algorithms
zh_title: 更丰富的数据库上下文提升大模型生成电子病历表型算法

abstract: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】评估大语言模型（large language model, LLM）生成2型糖尿病（type 2 diabetes, T2DM）表型SQL的能力以及数据库实施背景的影响。【材料与方法】八个可公开访问的基于LLM的系统在逐渐丰富的提示下生成SQL，使用合成数据和北卡罗来纳大学（University of North Carolina, UNC）Health电子健康记录（electronic health record, EHR）数据，二者均基于观察性医疗结果合作组织（Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership, OMOP）模型。使用SQL可执行性、F1、阳性预测值（positive predictive value, PPV）和召回率，将输出与电子病历与基因组学（Electronic Medical Records and Genomics, eMERGE）T2DM参考表型进行比较。【结果】有限上下文的合成输出中少于55%在未经修改的情况下可执行，且有限上下文的UNC EHR输出中没有任何一个在未经修改的情况下可执行。详细的代码本（L3）将合成OMOP中的可执行性提高至81.3%，将UNC EHR中的可执行性提高至100%；添加样本行（L4）将合成数据的可执行性提高至100%。有限上下文的召回率低至0.01，而高上下文输出在合成L4中达到召回率≥0.99，在UNC L3中达到>0.90，尽管UNC PPV仍显著低于召回率。在可获得的最高上下文水平下，Beta F1在合成OMOP中范围为0.72-0.99，在UNC EHR中为0.57-0.68；所有UNC模型均超过诊断代码基线（F1=0.54）。表现最佳的合成模型在UNC EHR上从F1=0.99降至0.64。【讨论】更丰富的数据库背景与更一致的SQL可执行性和召回率相关，而模型排名在不同数据集间有所变化。【结论】当提供足够的数据库背景时，LLMs能够生成具有临床意义的T2DM表型SQL，但真实世界数据中有限的PPV凸显了本地验证的必要性。

title: EM-BENCH: A Reproducible Framework for Benchmarking Guideline-Concordant Clinical Decision Making in Large Language Models
zh_title: EM-BENCH：大模型指南一致性临床决策基准
summary: medRxiv预印本，发布经医师验证的急诊指南一致性基准，含210个二元临床情景，评测149种模型配置。
key_points: 覆盖ACEP 25项政策下70个关键问题
预设答案加确定性评分，可复现
对比闭源与开源权重模型表现
reason: 新公开评测基准且设计可复现，但规模有限、未经同行评审，属值得一看档
abstract: Background Physicians increasingly use artificial intelligence tools to support clinical work, yet there is no accepted standard for measuring the competency of large language models (LLMs) in clinical decision support. We developed EM-BENCH, a physician-validated, deterministically scored benchmark for evaluating whether models reliably apply the American College of Emergency Physicians (ACEP) guidelines to clinical decisions. Methods EM-BENCH comprises 210 binary clinical vignettes covering all 70 critical questions across 25 ACEP clinical policies. We evaluated 149 LLM configurations representing 79 base models using prespecified answers and deterministic scoring. Each vignette had a prespecified correct answer to a binary yes-or-no question based on an ACEP recommendation. We examined associations between accuracy and model access tier (closed-access vs. open-weight models), model size, release date, clinical policy, recommendation evidence level, and reasoning settings. Results No configuration achieved complete guideline concordance. The highest performing configuration answered 207 of 210 vignettes correctly (98.6%). Closed-access models outperformed open-weight models (median accuracy, 91% vs. 63%; Hodges-Lehmann location shift, 26 percentage points; 99% CI, 20 to 33; adjusted P<0.001). Among open-weight model families, a 10-fold increase in parameter count was associated with a 14-percentage-point increase in accuracy (99% CI, 7.7 to 20; adjusted P<0.001). Across all models, accuracy increased by 8.9 percentage points per release year (99% CI, 3.6 to 14; adjusted P<0.001). Neither enabling a thinking mode (pseudomedian change, 0.95 percentage points; 99% CI, -2.6 to 3.1; adjusted P=1.00) nor high versus low reasoning effort (0.91 percentage points; 99% CI, -0.69 to 3.1; adjusted P=0.56) consistently improved accuracy. Conclusions Contemporary LLMs showed improving but incomplete ability to apply ACEP guidelines. Concordance varied markedly across models and was associated with access tier, size, and release recency, while additional inference-time reasoning offered inconsistent benefit. Specialty-specific, physician-validated benchmarks may provide a reproducible assessment of LLMs' ability to make guideline-concordant clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【背景】医生越来越多地使用人工智能工具支持临床工作，但目前尚无公认标准来衡量大语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持方面的能力。我们开发了 EM-BENCH，这是一个经医生验证、采用确定性评分、用于评估模型能否可靠地将美国急诊医师学会（ACEP）指南应用于临床决策的基准。【方法】EM-BENCH 包含210个二元临床病例情景，覆盖25项 ACEP 临床政策中的所有70个关键问题。我们使用预设答案和确定性评分评估了代表79个基础模型的149种 LLM 配置。每个病例情景均基于一项 ACEP 推荐意见，对二元是/否问题设有一个预设正确答案。我们考察了准确性与模型访问层级（闭源访问模型 vs. 开放权重模型）、模型规模、发布日期、临床政策、推荐证据级别及推理设置之间的关联。【结果】没有任何配置达到完全符合指南。表现最佳的配置正确回答了210个病例情景中的207个（98.6%）。闭源访问模型优于开放权重模型（中位准确率，91% vs. 63%；Hodges-Lehmann 位置偏移，26个百分点；99% CI，20至33；校正 P<0.001）。在开放权重模型家族中，参数数量增加10倍与准确率提高14个百分点相关（99% CI，7.7至20；校正 P<0.001）。在所有模型中，准确率每发布年份增加8.9个百分点（99% CI，3.6至14；校正 P<0.001）。启用思考模式（伪中位数变化，0.95个百分点；99% CI，-2.6至3.1；校正 P=1.00）与高推理强度相对于低推理强度（0.91个百分点；99% CI，-0.69至3.1；校正 P=0.56）均未能持续提高准确率。【结论】当代 LLMs 在应用 ACEP 指南方面表现出不断提高但仍不完整的能力。不同模型之间的一致性差异显著，并与访问层级、规模和发布新近程度相关，而额外的推理时推理带来的益处不一致。专科特异性、经医生验证的基准可能为评估 LLMs 做出符合指南的临床决策的能力提供可重复的评估。

title: Large language models detect methodological errors that human peer review misses in clinical trials
zh_title: 大模型可检出临床试验方法学错误
summary: 预印本测试15个大模型，对植入方法学错误的临床试验报告检出率53%–96%，高于未训练人工审稿的27%。
key_points: 15个模型检出率53%–96%
人工审稿平均仅27%
对照组仍误报2%–29%错误类型
reason: 预印本，模型与人工审稿对照充分，证据仍有限，属5–6档
abstract: Peer review is the principal quality control of published research, but methodological errors can go undetected. In an earlier experiment with errors inserted into three reports of randomized clinical trials, untrained human reviewers achieved a mean major-error detection score of 27%. Here, we tested whether 15 large language models (LLMs), including four open-weight models, detect the same errors. Their major-error detection scores ranged from 53% to 96%. To reduce the risk of memorization, we repeated the test on three clinical trials published in 2026. Scores ranged from 51% to 99%, and from 66% to 87% for the open-weight models. Notably, LLMs still flagged 2% to 29% of the error types in control reports without inserted errors, most often conclusions not supported by the results and missing reasons why screened patients were not enrolled. Across the 12 models, mean review times ranged from 1.4 to 16.3 minutes. Opus 5.5 achieved the highest major-error detection score (99%), while GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna offered cost-effective alternatives with scores of 92% and 87%, respectively. Together, these tests provide a benchmark for specialized review models and suggest that relying on human peer review alone may leave avoidable methodological errors undetected.
zh_abstract: 同行评议是已发表研究的主要质量控制手段，但方法学错误可能未被发现。在此前一项向三篇随机临床试验报告中插入错误的实验中，未经训练的人类审稿人的重大错误检出平均评分为27%。在这里，我们测试了15个大语言模型（LLMs），包括四个开放权重模型，是否能检出同样的错误。它们的重大错误检出评分范围为53%至96%。为降低记忆风险，我们在2026年发表的三项临床试验上重复了测试。评分范围为51%至99%，开放权重模型的评分范围为66%至87%。值得注意的是，对于未插入错误的对照报告，LLMs仍标记了2%至29%的错误类型，最常见的是结论未得到结果支持以及缺少筛查患者未入组的原因。在12个模型中，平均审阅时间范围为1.4至16.3分钟。Opus 5.5取得了最高的重大错误检出评分（99%），而GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Luna提供了具成本效益的替代方案，评分分别为92%和87%。总之，这些测试为专门的审阅模型提供了基准，并表明仅依赖人类同行评议可能会使可避免的方法学错误未被发现。

title: Innovation and AI in Endourology: An Overview from EAU Endourology.
zh_title: 内镜泌尿外科创新与AI应用综述
summary: EAU内镜泌尿外科综述，总结AI在结石检测、术中自动化、预后预测及LLM患者教育中的应用。

abstract: [Current urology reports] Advancements in technology have been at the heart of endourology for decades. With the introduction of new and novel technologies, endourology is rapidly changing. This review aims to address the recent innovations and technological advances in endourology by addressing four different areas where tangible outcome improvements are being seen: (1) diagnostic and detection methods; (2) intraoperative optimisation and procedural automation; (3) prediction of treatment outcomes; and (4) the use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) for patients' education and monitoring. AI applications in endourology consistently demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy, with stone detection rates exceeding 95% across imaging modalities. Emerging tools include non-invasive analysis of stone composition and real-time intraoperative segmentation. Intraoperative improvements involve augmented reality-guided renal access, which has reduced puncture times, fluoroscopy exposure, and complications. New instruments, such as flexible, navigable suction devices (FANS) and intrarenal pressure (IRP) and temperature (IRT) monitoring systems, bring the field closer to achieving the endourological quadrifecta. Machine learning models trained on multicentre data can predict perioperative risks and personalise treatment, demonstrating similar effectiveness in managing stone disease. Additionally, generative AI and large language models are increasingly used for clinical documentation, patient communication, and outpatient workflows. However, concerns about hallucination, data privacy, and the need for human oversight remain significant in this growing area. Innovation, technology, and AI in endourology are advancing rapidly, introducing new ideas that are integrated into surgical procedures. These innovations offer numerous benefits to patients at various stages of treatment, leading to improved surgical results. Although combining these technologies can potentially maximise patient benefits, a careful and selective approach should be adopted, accompanied by thorough assessments before implementing these new innovations.
zh_abstract: [Current urology reports] 几十年来，技术进步一直是腔内泌尿外科（endourology）的核心。随着新的和新型技术的引入，腔内泌尿外科正在迅速变化。本综述旨在通过讨论四个已观察到切实结局改善的不同领域，来阐述腔内泌尿外科近期的创新和技术进步：（1）诊断与检测方法；（2）术中优化与操作自动化；（3）治疗结局预测；（4）使用生成式人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLMs）进行患者教育和监测。AI在腔内泌尿外科中的应用始终显示出高诊断准确性，在多种成像方式中结石检出率超过95%。新兴工具包括结石成分的无创分析和实时术中分割。术中改进涉及增强现实引导的肾脏入路，其缩短了穿刺时间、减少了透视暴露和并发症。新器械，如可弯曲、可导航的吸引装置（flexible, navigable suction devices, FANS）以及肾内压（intrarenal pressure, IRP）和温度（intrarenal temperature, IRT）监测系统，使该领域更接近实现腔内泌尿外科“四重目标”（endourological quadrifecta）。基于多中心数据训练的机器学习模型可预测围手术期风险并实现个体化治疗，在结石病管理中也显示出相似的有效性。此外，生成式AI和大语言模型越来越多地用于临床文档记录、患者沟通和门诊工作流程。然而，在这一不断发展的领域，幻觉、数据隐私以及需要人工监督等问题仍然突出。腔内泌尿外科中的创新、技术和AI正在迅速发展，引入新理念并整合到外科手术中。这些创新为处于治疗不同阶段的患者带来诸多益处，从而改善手术结果。尽管将这些技术结合起来可能最大化患者获益，但在实施这些新创新之前，应采取谨慎和选择性的方法，并辅以全面评估。

title: Building virtual cell dynamics that evolve with biological measurements
zh_title: CellCompass：随生物测量演化的虚拟细胞动力学智能体
summary: 预印本提出智能体系统CellCompass，可将单细胞时间序列测量转化为动力学模型，并发布DynBench100基准。
key_points: 科学智能体耦合可扩展动力学引擎
测量足够时复用已有方程，否则设计并精炼新方程
提出100个模拟单细胞时序场景的DynBench100基准

abstract: Virtual cell models built from single-cell measurements need to predict how cells change over time, but new biological measurements often reveal dynamical relationships that existing models cannot express. Translating such measurements into dynamics therefore requires deciding what biological relation should be modeled, where it should enter the formulation and how its recovery should be validated. Here we present CellCompass, an agentic AI system that couples a scientific agent with an extensible dynamical engine for modeling state transitions and population change, along with fate and molecular readout. CellCompass reuses existing formulations when sufficient and designs, implements and refines new ones when experimental measurements introduce additional constraints. To assess this capability, we developed DynBench100, a benchmark of 100 simulated single-cell time-course scenarios with hidden dynamical ground truth. CellCompass achieved the highest aggregate performance among the tested general-purpose and biomedical agents across six dynamical tasks. Across four real single-cell studies, it retained an existing velocity-growth model to reconstruct context-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition and developed three new dynamical formulations for distinct experimental measurements. In drug-response data, incorporating metabolic RNA labeling reduced pulse-control identifiability error by 31.1%, revealing staged response programs and generating testable predictions for perturbing a candidate adaptive program. In hematopoietic lineage tracing, incorporating clonal barcodes improved clone-fate agreement by 54% over the strongest dynamical baseline, identifying early lineage priming among transcriptionally similar progenitors. Finally, in time-resolved CITE-seq data, CellCompass reduced future surface-protein distribution error by 13.2% for RNA-initialized trajectories, uncovering lineage-specific temporal offsets between transcriptional and protein programs. Together, CellCompass provides a framework in which virtual-cell dynamics can expand with the biological measurements used to constrain them.
zh_abstract: 由单细胞测量构建的虚拟细胞模型需要预测细胞如何随时间变化，但新的生物学测量常常揭示现有模型无法表达的动力学关系。因此，将此类测量转化为动力学需要决定应建模何种生物学关系、该关系应在何处进入公式表述，以及应如何验证其恢复。在此，我们提出CellCompass，一种智能体式AI系统，它将科学智能体与可扩展的动力学引擎耦合，用于建模状态转变和群体变化，以及命运和分子读数。CellCompass在足够时复用现有公式表述，并在实验测量引入额外约束时设计、实现和细化新的公式表述。为评估这一能力，我们开发了DynBench100，这是一个包含100个模拟单细胞时间过程场景且隐藏动力学真实值的基准。在六项动力学任务中，CellCompass在受测的通用和生物医学智能体中取得了最高总体性能。在四项真实单细胞研究中，它保留了现有的速度-生长模型以重建情境依赖的上皮-间质转化，并针对不同的实验测量开发了三种新的动力学公式表述。在药物反应数据中，纳入代谢RNA标记将脉冲控制可识别性误差降低了31.1%，揭示了分阶段反应程序，并为扰动一个候选适应性程序生成了可检验的预测。在造血谱系追踪中，纳入克隆条形码使克隆命运一致性比最强的动力学基线提高了54%，识别出转录相似祖细胞之间的早期谱系启动。最后，在时间分辨CITE-seq数据中，CellCompass将RNA初始化轨迹的未来表面蛋白分布误差降低了13.2%，揭示了转录程序与蛋白程序之间谱系特异性的时间偏移。总之，CellCompass提供了一个框架，使虚拟细胞动力学能够随着用于约束它们的生物学测量而扩展。

title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching

abstract: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. The proposed benchmark integrates heterogeneous task formats, including multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended question answering (OpenQA), grounded in real-world user scenarios and paired with structured rubrics emphasizing safety compliance, scientific validity, and training logic. Through large-scale evaluation of 15 diverse LLMs on 809 questions with 5,012 rubric-level criteria, our results reveal substantial performance variability, particularly in safety awareness, structured program design, and personalization capability, highlighting a critical gap between knowing and doing. Our work establishes a foundational evaluation standard for sports and health LLM applications and provides a reproducible framework for advancing safe, reliable, and context-aware AI-driven coaching systems. Open resources are available at https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench.
zh_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）取得了快速进展，但由于缺乏领域特定的评估基准，其在体育与健康领域的部署仍具有高风险。现有的通用基准（例如MMLU和HELM）主要评估广泛的知识和推理能力，但未能捕捉关键领域要求，如运动安全性、生理适宜性、个性化以及可操作的指导质量。这一差距在健身和健康应用中尤其令人担忧，因为错误或不安全的建议可能导致身体伤害。为解决这一局限，我们推出MoveBench，这是首个专门用于评估LLMs在体育与健康指导中表现的综合基准框架。所提出的基准整合了异构任务格式，包括多项选择题（multiple-choice questions, MCQs）和开放式问答（open-ended question answering, OpenQA），以真实用户场景为基础，并配以强调安全合规性、科学有效性和训练逻辑的结构化评分细则。通过对15个多样化LLMs在809个问题及5,012条评分细则级标准上的大规模评估，我们的结果揭示了显著性能差异，尤其是在安全意识、结构化方案设计和个性化能力方面，凸显了“知”与“行”之间的关键差距。我们的工作为体育与健康LLM应用建立了基础评估标准，并为推进安全、可靠且情境感知的AI驱动指导系统提供了可复现框架。开放资源见https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Pulmonary Subsolid Nodules, Ground-Glass Nodules; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this prospective, non-interventional study is to evaluate the predictive performance and potential clinical utility of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based virtual follow-up framework for incidentally detected pulmonary subsolid nodules (SSNs), including pure ground-glass and part-solid nodules. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Can the AI model accurately predict future CT appearances, quantitative growth characteristics, and morphological progression of pulmonary SSNs at specified follow-up intervals? 2. Does AI-assisted virtual follow-up improve radiologists' assessment of nodule progression and simulated surveillance management decisions compared with assessment without AI assistance? Researchers will compare radiologists' assessments with and without access to AI-generated future CT images and quantitative predictions. An additional reader evaluation will examine whether generated future images provide incremental value beyond quantitative predictions alone. Participants will undergo clinically indicated CT examinations and receive routine care according to standard clinical practice. The research team will: * Collect previously acquired CT images and clinical information. * Generate and lock AI predictions before the corresponding follow-up CT examinations occur. * Obtain and lock radiologists' assessments and simulated management recommendations before actual follow-up outcomes become available. * Compare predicted nodule progression with observed follow-up CT findings. AI predictions and research-related reader assessments will not be disclosed to treating clinicians or used to alter patients' actual surveillance or treatment decisions.

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Purposes of Public Health: A Critical Look at Technology.
zh_title: 对公共卫生领域AI应用的批判性反思
summary: 评论文章批评以准确性、隐私与偏见为核心的评估框架，认为公共卫生采纳AI会重塑其专业目的并置换社区权力。

abstract: [The Hastings Center report] Within public health, the contemporary discourse surrounding AI in this field is dominated by what this paper terms the "standard approach." In this frame, AI appears as a neutral tool to be evaluated for accuracy, privacy protection, and bias mitigation. When direct benefits outweigh direct harms, AI is described as an opportunity to improve public health practice. But the standard approach does not consider how public health's adoption of AI discloses and reinforces different accounts of the underlying purpose of the profession. Drawing insights from the communitarian thinker Wendell Berry, we demonstrate how AI does not merely improve efficiency and add capabilities but tends to align public health practice with purposes and assumptions that, when actualized, increasingly displace community power and authentic human presence. This tendency is clear in three commonly proposed applications of AI in public health practice: health education, community health assessments, and data analysis. Because the advent of AI offers an opportunity for greater technological efficiency, it offers the public health community the opportunity to reflect on what ultimate ends those efficiencies should be directed toward.
zh_abstract: [The Hastings Center report] 在公共卫生领域，当代关于该领域 AI 的论述由本文所称的“标准路径”（standard approach）主导。在这一框架中，AI 表现为一种中性工具，需评估其准确性、隐私保护和偏倚缓解。当直接获益大于直接危害时，AI 被描述为改善公共卫生实践的机会。但标准路径未考虑公共卫生对 AI 的采用如何揭示并强化对该职业 underlying purpose 的不同理解。借鉴社群主义思想家 Wendell Berry 的洞见，我们展示 AI 如何不仅提高效率并增加能力，而且往往使公共卫生实践与某些目的和假设保持一致；这些目的和假设一旦实现，会日益取代社区权力和真实的人类在场。这一趋势在公共卫生实践中三种常见拟议 AI 应用中很明显：健康教育、社区健康评估和数据分析。由于 AI 的出现提供了提高技术效率的机会，它也为公共卫生界提供了反思这些效率应指向何种终极目的的机会。

title: The use of biological age and artificial intelligence in health care.
zh_title: 生物学年龄与人工智能在医疗中的应用
summary: 评论文章主张结合生物学年龄与AI，推动精准医学与长寿照护的临床转化。

abstract: [npj aging] This commentary highlights the age illusion and advocates integrating biological age and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance clinical precision in health care. By synthesizing geroscience and machine learning, practitioners and scientists can effectively bridge the gap between experimental biomarkers and personalized medicine and longevity care. This contribution is timely as the importance of biological age and predictive analytics offer transformative potential for diagnostics while necessitating a focus on modern medical systems. This article aims to elucidate how AI accelerates the clinical implementation of biological age rather than current chronological age in precision medicine.
zh_abstract: [npj aging] 本评论强调了年龄错觉，并倡导整合生物学年龄和人工智能（AI），以提升医疗保健中的临床精确性。通过综合老年科学与机器学习，从业者和科学家可以有效弥合实验性生物标志物与个性化医疗及长寿护理之间的差距。这一贡献具有及时性，因为生物学年龄和预测分析的重要性为诊断提供了变革性潜力，同时需要关注现代医疗系统。本文旨在阐明AI如何加速生物学年龄而非当前实际年龄在精准医学中的临床实施。

title: Artificial intelligence in digital implant dentistry: current applications, clinical translation, and future directions.
zh_title: 数字化种植牙中人工智能应用的现状与转化挑战

abstract: [Odontology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanded across digital implant dentistry, with applications ranging from diagnosis and treatment planning to surgical execution, prosthetic rehabilitation, outcome prediction, and biomechanical optimization. However, the clinical readiness and translational value of many proposed AI systems remain uncertain. This comprehensive state-of-the-art narrative review aims to provide an integrated overview of AI applications throughout the implant workflow while critically evaluating current evidence, methodological limitations, and challenges to clinical implementation. A comprehensive narrative literature search was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, supplemented by Google Scholar and manual reference screening. The review was prepared according to SANRA recommendations. AI has demonstrated promising performance in automated image analysis, implant planning, computer-assisted surgery, prosthetic workflows, implant identification, peri-implant disease detection, predictive modelling, and biomechanical optimization. Nevertheless, most available evidence is derived from retrospective studies, simulation-based investigations, or single-center datasets. Limited external validation, heterogeneity in study design, and insufficient prospective clinical evidence continue to restrict widespread clinical adoption. Furthermore, improvements in technical performance do not necessarily translate into superior patient-centered outcomes. AI has the potential to enhance efficiency, consistency, and clinical decision support throughout the implant workflow. However, current evidence supports its role primarily as an adjunctive tool rather than an autonomous clinical system. Future progress will depend on robust validation, standardized reporting, explainable AI frameworks, and prospective clinical studies demonstrating meaningful improvements in patient outcomes. Clinical Relevance Statement: Artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in the digital implant workflow, from radiographic analysis and virtual patient construction to computer-assisted surgery, prosthetic design, and outcome prediction. This review helps clinicians distinguish the AI-specific components of these technologies from conventional digital tools, identify which applications are supported by clinical evidence versus those that remain experimental, and understand the current limitations regarding validation, generali
zh_abstract: [口腔医学] 人工智能（AI）已在数字化种植牙领域迅速扩展，应用范围从诊断和治疗规划延伸到手术实施、修复重建、结局预测和生物力学优化。然而，许多已提出的AI系统的临床就绪度和转化价值仍不确定。这篇全面的最新叙述性综述旨在提供AI在整个种植工作流程中应用的整合概览，同时批判性评估当前证据、方法学局限性和临床实施面临的挑战。使用PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library进行了全面的叙述性文献检索，并以Google Scholar和手工参考文献筛查作为补充。本综述按照SANRA建议 prepared。AI在自动图像分析、种植规划、计算机辅助手术、修复工作流程、种植体识别、种植体周围疾病检测、预测建模和生物力学优化方面已表现出有前景的性能。然而，大多数现有证据来自回顾性研究、基于模拟的研究或单中心数据集。有限的外部验证、研究设计的异质性以及前瞻性临床证据不足继续限制其广泛的临床采用。此外，技术性能的改善并不必然转化为更优的以患者为中心的结局。AI有潜力在整个种植工作流程中提高效率、一致性和临床决策支持。然而，当前证据主要支持其作为辅助工具而非自主临床系统的作用。未来的进展将取决于稳健的验证、标准化报告、可解释AI框架，以及证明患者结局有有意义改善的前瞻性临床研究。临床相关性声明：人工智能正日益嵌入数字化种植工作流程，从影像分析和虚拟患者构建到计算机辅助手术、修复设计和结局预测。本综述帮助临床医生区分这些技术中AI特有的组成部分与传统数字化工具，识别哪些应用有临床证据支持、哪些仍处于实验阶段，并理解当前在验证、泛化性方面的局限性

title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Chronic Hepatitis B.
source: PubMed · Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology
zh_title: 人工智能在慢性乙型肝炎管理中的临床应用
summary: 同行评审综述，梳理AI在慢性乙肝筛查、诊断、抗病毒风险分层与肝癌监测中的潜在作用。
key_points: 主题为AI辅助慢性乙肝全流程管理

reason: 综述类文章上限档，无原始数据与新方法，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at-risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 《Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology》慢性乙型肝炎（CHB）给医疗系统带来负担，全球影响数百万个体，并可能进展为肝硬化、肝细胞癌（HCC）等并发症。世界卫生组织启动了慢性病毒性肝炎消除计划，旨在到2030年消除慢性乙型肝炎病毒，但鉴于从筛查策略和诊断到抗病毒治疗风险分层及HCC监测等一系列障碍，在剩余几年内该目标似乎遥不可及。为完善CHB管理，既往研究集中于使用传统统计方法识别高危人群和不良结局预测因素。随着人工智能（AI）作用日益显现，在筛查和管理的不同方面仍有进一步改进空间。例如，生成式AI，如大语言模型（LLMs），已被证明能够回答不同临床问题，协助患者和医生在各种临床情境下做出决策。不同机器学习和深度学习模型也已被开发用于评估肝纤维化，以及通过多种影像模态辅助肝脏结构分割和局灶性肝脏病变检测。尽管不同AI模型已显示出优于传统统计模型所开发模型的性能，但训练队列缺乏标准化数据集，以及LLMs中虚假信息幻觉问题尚未解决，给AI在当前CHB管理中的应用带来挑战，需要进一步研究将AI纳入日常临床实践。

title: PepPr: De Novo peptide sequencing with peptide priors
zh_title: PepPr：引入肽先验的从头肽段测序
summary: 预印本：将拟合参考蛋白质组的语言模型作为肽先验融入从头测序，提升参考肽段识别且未抑制变异肽段识别。
key_points: 以蛋白语言模型拟合参考蛋白质组作先验
参考肽段识别优于无先验从头测序
用近缘蛋白质组作先验可媲美同源库检索
reason: 有新方法且含基线对比的预印本，证据限于自建评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Mass spectrometry-based peptide sequencing underpins proteomics. Database search confines to predefined candidates, whereas de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) struggles with incomplete spectra. Existing hybrid methods use databases only for post hoc correction or retrieve previously identified spectra to guide decoding. We instead combine DNPS with a peptide prior: a language model fitted to a reference proteome, tolerating variants yet uncertain on strongly divergent sequences. Relative to prior-free DNPS, our implementation, PepPr, improved reference peptide identification and improved rather than suppressed variant identification. Using a related proteome as prior, it matched or outperformed homology-driven database search, and its gain over prior-free DNPS grew with relatedness. In antibody sequencing, it improved recovery of peptides spanning the variable-constant boundary, deamidation calls, and assembly, while preserving recall of hypervariable regions inaccessible to database search. Peptide priors thus bring reference knowledge into DNPS without limiting discovery.
zh_abstract: 基于质谱的肽段测序是蛋白质组学的基础。数据库搜索局限于预先定义的候选，而从头肽段测序（de novo peptide sequencing, DNPS）难以处理不完整的谱图。现有的混合方法仅将数据库用于事后校正，或检索先前鉴定的谱图来指导解码。我们则将DNPS与肽段先验结合：一个拟合到参考蛋白质组的语言模型，可容忍变异，但在高度分化的序列上不确定。相较于无先验的DNPS，我们的实现PepPr改善了参考肽段鉴定，并且改善而非抑制了变异鉴定。使用相关蛋白质组作为先验时，它匹配或优于同源性驱动的数据库搜索，并且其相对于无先验DNPS的增益随相关性增加而增大。在抗体测序中，它改善了跨越可变区-恒定区边界的肽段回收、脱酰胺判定和组装，同时保留了对数据库搜索无法触及的高变区的召回。因此，肽段先验将参考知识引入DNPS而不限制发现。

title: MRI of brain metastases in the era of immunotherapy, targeted agents, and artificial intelligence: from detection to treatment response assessment.
zh_title: 免疫与靶向治疗时代脑转移瘤 MRI 与 AI 综述
summary: 该综述讨论 MRI 在脑转移瘤检出与疗效评估中的演变，包括 AI 辅助检出与 AI 体积分析的潜在作用。
key_points: 讨论三维黑血成像、增强后 T2-FLAIR 等技术
指出 RANO-BM 标准的局限
提及 AI 体积定量分析的潜在价值

reason: 叙述性综述、无原始数据与验证，属增量档
abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to the detection, treatment planning, and response assessment of brain metastases (BM). However, advances in stereotactic radiosurgery, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy have substantially altered the imaging appearance and treatment response patterns of BM, which are not fully captured by conventional imaging and conventional size-based response criteria. This review discusses the evolving role of MRI in BM, from optimized lesion detection to treatment response assessment. We review advanced contrast-enhanced MRI techniques, including three-dimensional turbo spin echo black-blood imaging and post-contrast T2-weighted FLAIR, as well as recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted detection. We also examine limitations of RANO-BM and discuss the emerging role of AI-based volumetric analysis for quantitative longitudinal assessment. For differentiating radiation necrosis from tumor progression, we review diffusion and perfusion MRI, MR spectroscopy, and emerging approaches including chemical exchange saturation transfer imaging, radiomics, and tumor habitat analysis. Finally, we highlight how the integration of optimized MRI protocols, multi-parametric imaging, and validated AI-based quantitative tools may improve treatment response assessment and support more precise clinical decision-making for patients with BM.
zh_abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] 磁共振成像（MRI）对脑转移瘤（BM）的检出、治疗计划和疗效评估至关重要。然而，立体定向放射外科、免疫治疗和靶向治疗的进展已显著改变BM的影像学表现和治疗反应模式，而传统影像学和传统基于大小的疗效标准并不能完全反映这些变化。本综述讨论MRI在BM中不断演变的作用，从优化病灶检出到治疗反应评估。我们回顾先进的对比增强MRI技术，包括三维涡轮自旋回波黑血成像和对比增强后T2加权FLAIR，以及人工智能（AI）辅助检测的最新进展。我们还考察RANO-BM的局限性，并讨论基于AI的容积分析在定量纵向评估中的新兴作用。为鉴别放射性坏死与肿瘤进展，我们回顾扩散和灌注MRI、MR波谱，以及包括化学交换饱和转移成像、影像组学和肿瘤栖息地分析在内的新兴方法。最后，我们强调优化MRI方案、多参数成像和经过验证的基于AI的定量工具相结合，可能改善治疗反应评估，并支持对BM患者进行更精准的临床决策。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Therapeutic Peptide Discovery and Development.
zh_title: AI用于治疗性多肽发现与开发的综述
summary: 综述梳理AI在多类治疗性多肽识别、设计与优化中的应用，并比较序列、化学、图、结构与多模态表征及预测与生成方法。
key_points: 覆盖受体激动剂、蛋白互作抑制剂、抗菌肽等多类多肽
比较序列、化学、图、结构与多模态表征路线
指出疗效还取决于稳定性、递送、安全性与可制造性
reason: 覆盖面广的同行评审综述，但无原始数据，综述上限档
abstract: [Biomolecules] Therapeutic peptides combine biological specificity with chemical versatility, and artificial intelligence (AI) now contributes to their identification, design, and optimisation. Peptide discovery, however, cannot be reduced to generating amino-acid sequences: therapeutic performance also depends on chemistry, conformation, assay context, stability, delivery, safety, manufacturability, and in vivo exposure. This critical review examines AI use across the major peptide classes: receptor agonists, protein-protein interaction inhibitors, oncology and tumour-targeting peptides, antimicrobial and phenotype-driven peptides, delivery peptides, vaccine epitopes, self-assembling materials, and chemically constrained macrocycles. It compares sequence-based, chemical, graph, structure-aware, and multimodal representations across predictive, generative, and experimentally integrated workflows. Coverage spans recent general protein foundation, prediction, and design systems (ProtGPT2, ESM-2/ESM3, ProGen/ProGen2, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, and AlphaFold 3) and peptide-focused methods (RFpeptides, PepFlow, and PepGLAD). Particular attention is given to benchmark integrity, the limits of structure prediction for short and non-canonical molecules, and the gap between retrospective and prospective evidence. To make claims comparable, the review adapts established reporting, validation, and readiness concepts into a peptide-specific, two-dimensional Peptide-AI Evidence Grid that separates methodological rigour (M0-M3) from translational depth (T0-T3), applies it to representative studies, and provides a checklist extending DOME, TRIPOD + AI, and FAIR guidance with the chemistry- and assay-specific items peptide work requires.
zh_abstract: [Biomolecules] 治疗性肽将生物特异性与化学多样性结合起来，而人工智能（AI）现在在其识别、设计和优化中发挥作用。然而，肽发现不能简化为生成氨基酸序列：治疗性能还取决于化学性质、构象、测定背景、稳定性、递送、安全性、可制造性和体内暴露。这篇批判性综述考察了 AI 在主要肽类别中的应用：受体激动剂、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用抑制剂、肿瘤学及肿瘤靶向肽、抗菌肽和表型驱动肽、递送肽、疫苗表位、自组装材料以及化学受限大环化合物。它比较了基于序列、化学、图、结构感知和多模态的表示在预测性、生成性和实验整合工作流程中的应用。覆盖范围涵盖近期通用蛋白质基础模型、预测与设计系统（ProtGPT2、ESM-2/ESM3、ProGen/ProGen2、ProteinMPNN、RFdiffusion 和 AlphaFold 3）以及肽聚焦方法（RFpeptides、PepFlow 和 PepGLAD）。特别关注基准完整性、结构预测对短分子和非经典分子的局限性，以及回顾性与前瞻性证据之间的差距。为使主张具有可比性，本综述将既有报告、验证和成熟度概念改编为肽特异性的二维 Peptide-AI Evidence Grid，将方法学严谨性（M0-M3）与转化深度（T0-T3）分开，将其应用于代表性研究，并提供一份清单，在 DOME、TRIPOD + AI 和 FAIR 指南基础上扩展，加入肽工作所需的化学和测定特异性条目。

title: AI-Assisted Differentiation of Autoimmune Pancreatitis and Pancreatic Cancer Using EUS: A Multicenter Ambispective Study
zh_title: AI 辅助超声内镜鉴别自身免疫性胰腺炎与胰腺癌
summary: 瑞金医院牵头多中心观察性研究，拟入组 690 例，用 EUS 图像开发 AI 鉴别模型，尚未启动招募。
key_points: 多中心双向性观察设计，计划入组 690 例
目标为局灶性 AIP 与胰腺导管腺癌鉴别
基于既有数据库图像开发 AI，暂无结果
reason: 仅为临床试验注册信息，无结果数据，多中心设计为加分但证据尚未产生
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Autoimmune Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 690; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Focal autoimmune pancreatitis (f-AIP) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibit substantial overlap in clinical manifestations and imaging features, posing a major diagnostic challenge in pancreatic diseases. Given the marked differences in treatment strategies and prognosis, accurate differentiation is essential to avoid unnecessary surgery and ensure timely initiation of anticancer treatment. This study aims to collect endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) images from patients with confirmed f-AIP or PDAC across multiple centers, using a previously established multicenter database. Data collected before January 2026 will be used to develop an artificial intelligence (AI) model based on EUS radiomics for differential diagnosis. Subsequently, prospectively collected data from participating centers from 2026 onward will be used for model testing and validation. The diagnostic performance of the model will be evaluated and compared with that of endoscopists with different levels of experience. Furthermore, this study will investigate the clinical value of interpretable radiomic features, with particular emphasis on challenging diagnostic scenarios, including IgG4-negative AIP, AIP with elevated carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) levels, and PDAC with imaging features resembling those of AIP. The ultimate goal is to provide a reliable tool for accurate, noninvasive preoperative differential diagnosis while promoting the standardization of multicenter AIP databases and the sharing and utilization of imaging data resources.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：瑞金医院（Ruijin Hospital）；疾病：自身免疫性胰腺炎、胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：690；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 局灶性自身免疫性胰腺炎（focal autoimmune pancreatitis, f-AIP）与胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）在临床表现和影像学特征上存在显著重叠，给胰腺疾病诊断带来重大挑战。鉴于治疗策略和预后差异显著，准确鉴别对于避免不必要的手术并确保及时启动抗癌治疗至关重要。本研究旨在利用既往建立的多中心数据库，收集多个中心确诊f-AIP或PDAC患者的内镜超声（endoscopic ultrasound, EUS）图像。2026年1月前收集的数据将用于开发基于EUS影像组学的人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）鉴别诊断模型。随后，2026年起参与中心前瞻性收集的数据将用于模型测试和验证。将评估模型的诊断性能，并与不同经验水平的内镜医师进行比较。此外，本研究将探讨可解释影像组学特征的临床价值，尤其关注具有挑战性的诊断场景，包括IgG4阴性AIP、碳水化合物抗原19-9（carbohydrate antigen 19-9, CA19-9）水平升高的AIP，以及影像学特征类似AIP的PDAC。最终目标是提供一种可靠工具，用于准确、无创的术前鉴别诊断，同时促进多中心AIP数据库的标准化以及影像数据资源的共享与利用。

title: Effect of a Breastfeeding Chatbot on Mothers' Breastfeeding Attitudes, Behaviors, and Self-Efficacy

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Adiyaman University; conditions: Breastfeeding, Breastfeeding Attitudes; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 92; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This randomized controlled trial aims to evaluate the effects of an artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbot developed to address breastfeeding problems on mothers' breastfeeding attitudes, behaviors, and self-efficacy. The study will also assess exclusive breastfeeding rates, breastfeeding duration, and the technical performance and usability of the developed chatbot. The study is planned to include 92 primiparous mothers allocated to intervention and control groups. The intervention involves an AI-based breastfeeding counseling chatbot developed using natural language processing (NLP) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology. The chatbot will provide evidence-based breastfeeding education, information, and counseling support using an expert-reviewed breastfeeding knowledge base. The system is designed to support mothers in managing breastfeeding-related difficulties and will not provide medical diagnoses or replace healthcare professionals. Breastfeeding attitudes, self-efficacy, and behaviors will be evaluated during the postpartum follow-up period. Assessments will be conducted at baseline and at the first, third, and sixth postpartum months. Exclusive breastfeeding rates and breastfeeding duration will also be assessed. Additionally, the chatbot's technical performance, response reliability, medical safety, user satisfaction, and usability will be evaluated. The study aims to provide scientific evidence regarding the effectiveness and feasibility of an AI-supported, evidence-based breastfeeding counseling intervention.
