abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) has become integral to the detection, localization, risk stratification, and management of prostate cancer. Increasing utilization of prostate MRI in screening, active surveillance, targeted biopsy guidance, and treatment planning has amplified the demand for faster imaging protocols while maintaining high diagnostic quality. Conventional MRI acceleration strategies, including parallel imaging and compressed sensing, improve acquisition efficiency but remain limited by trade-offs involving signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), image sharpness, artifacts, and reconstruction complexity. Deep learning reconstruction (DLR) has emerged as a promising artificial intelligence-based approach for MRI acceleration and image enhancement. Unlike traditional reconstruction methods that rely primarily on predefined mathematical models, DLR uses neural networks to learn image priors and reconstruction features from MRI data. Published studies suggest that DLR may enable accelerated acquisitions while maintaining or, in some settings, improving image quality through denoising, artifact reduction, and improved spatial resolution and lesion conspicuity. However, these effects vary according to the reconstruction algorithm, sequence, acceleration factor, and clinical setting. Variational networks combine physics-based MRI constraints with learned regularization and represent an important framework for DLR. In prostate MRI, available studies have reported substantial reductions in acquisition time for T2-weighted and diffusion-weighted imaging while generally maintaining perceived image quality. Reported benefits include improved lesion conspicuity, reader confidence, and delineation of anatomic structures. Current evidence suggests that DLR generally preserves PI-RADS assessment and diagnostic performance rather than systematically altering lesion categorization; however, evidence demonstrating improvements in diagnostic accuracy or clinical outcomes remains limited. Important limitations include vendor and algorithm dependence, potential reconstruction artifacts, variability in quantitative imaging metrics, limited multicenter validation, and uncertain generalizability across scanners, protocols, and clinical settings. This review summarizes the technical principles underlying DLR, discusses current clinical applications in prostate MRI, highlights representative studies and workflow implications, reviews limitations, and outlines f
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）已成为前列腺癌检测、定位、风险分层和管理中不可或缺的一部分。前列腺 MRI 在筛查、主动监测、靶向活检引导和治疗计划中的使用日益增加，提高了对更快成像方案的需求，同时需保持高诊断质量。传统 MRI 加速策略，包括并行成像和压缩感知，可提高采集效率，但仍受限于信噪比（SNR）、图像锐度、伪影和重建复杂性之间的权衡。深度学习重建（DLR）已成为一种有前景的基于人工智能的 MRI 加速和图像增强方法。与主要依赖预定义数学模型的传统重建方法不同，DLR 使用神经网络从 MRI 数据中学习图像先验和重建特征。已发表的研究提示，DLR 可能实现加速采集，同时通过去噪、减少伪影以及改善空间分辨率和病灶显著性，维持或在某些情况下改善图像质量。然而，这些效果因重建算法、序列、加速因子和临床环境而异。变分网络将基于物理的 MRI 约束与学习到的正则化相结合，是 DLR 的一个重要框架。在前列腺 MRI 中，现有研究报告 T2 加权成像和扩散加权成像的采集时间显著缩短，同时总体维持感知图像质量。报告的获益包括改善病灶显著性、阅片者信心和解剖结构勾画。当前证据提示，DLR 通常能保持 PI-RADS 评估和诊断性能，而不是系统性地改变病灶分类；然而，证明诊断准确性或临床结局改善的证据仍然有限。重要局限包括厂商和算法依赖性、潜在重建伪影、定量成像指标的变异性、多中心验证有限，以及在不同扫描仪、方案和临床环境中的普遍适用性不确定。本综述总结了 DLR 的技术原理，讨论了其在前列腺 MRI 中的当前临床应用，重点介绍了代表性研究和对工作流程的影响，回顾了局限性，并概述 f

title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Multicenter Real-World Evidence to Advance Precision Dosing: A Critical Perspective Review.
zh_title: AI 与多中心真实世界证据推进精准给药
summary: 观点综述认为单中心数据不足，需隐私保护的多中心协作支撑精准给药的证据强度。
key_points: 单中心数据亚组小且存在本地实践偏倚
多中心系统可关联剂量、暴露、基因与结局
联邦学习与合成数据被视为可行路径
reason: 观点类综述，无原始数据与验证，按综述上限与增量档取4分
abstract: [Therapeutic drug monitoring] Precision dosing integrates patient-specific factors to optimize pharmacotherapy. However, current evidence often relies on limited single-center studies, restricting generalizability. A narrative review of literature on real-world evidence, pharmacogenetics, biomarkers, artificial intelligence (AI), and privacy-preserving data strategies relevant to precision dosing was conducted. Single-center data are insufficient for robust precision-dosing evidence because of small subgroups and local practice biases. Multicenter privacy-preserving systems enable richer, more generalizable datasets that link doses, exposures, genotypes, biomarkers, and outcomes. However, multicenter collaborations should remain aligned with the intended population and should not imply indiscriminate pooling of heterogeneous data. Secure pooled environments, federated learning, and synthetic data play distinct method-dependent roles. AI supports exposure estimation, phenotype extraction, and modeling of complex relationships but requires rigorous validation against conventional methods. Causal inference requires epidemiological rigor beyond predictive performance. Advancing precision dosing requires multicenter, purpose-specific, privacy-preserving, methodologically rigorous, and clinically validated data systems guided by clinical pharmacologists, with AI serving as a complementary tool rather than a default solution.
zh_abstract: [Therapeutic drug monitoring] 精准给药整合患者特异性因素以优化药物治疗。然而，当前证据常依赖有限的单中心研究，限制了普遍适用性。本文对与精准给药相关的真实世界证据、药物遗传学、生物标志物、人工智能（AI）以及隐私保护数据策略的文献进行了叙述性综述。单中心数据不足以形成稳健的精准给药证据，原因是亚组小和局部实践偏倚。多中心隐私保护系统能够产生更丰富、更具普遍适用性的数据集，将剂量、暴露、基因型、生物标志物和结局联系起来。然而，多中心合作应与目标人群保持一致，且不应意味着不加区分地汇总异质性数据。安全汇总环境、联邦学习和合成数据发挥各自不同的、依赖方法的作用。AI支持暴露估计、表型提取和复杂关系建模，但需要针对传统方法进行严格验证。因果推断需要超越预测性能的流行病学严谨性。推进精准给药需要由临床药理学家指导的多中心、目的特定、隐私保护、方法学严谨且经过临床验证的数据系统，AI应作为补充工具而非默认解决方案。

title: Reference Standards in Artificial Intelligence Detection of Apical Periodontitis: A Narrative Review of What Reported Accuracy Measures.
zh_title: AI检测根尖周炎的参考标准：准确性解读综述
summary: 叙述性综述指出AI检测根尖周炎的准确性多非对照疾病本身：44项研究中34项使用指标影像判读或不明确标签，仅少数采用独立参考标准。
key_points: 单视角根尖片仅检出16–27%的确诊病变
两名专家判读1717张片，22%牙齿意见不一致
44项研究中34项参考标准不独立或不可确定
reason: 方法学批评性综述、结论明确，但非系统meta分析，属值得一看
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] The accuracy reported for detecting apical periodontitis using artificial intelligence (AI) is generally interpreted as accuracy against the disease; however, this is usually not the case. Compared with histopathology, single-view periapical radiography detects 16 to 27% of confirmed lesions and 38% with parallax, with a pooled digital sensitivity of 61.0% and a negative predictive value of 41.6%. Two blinded specialists reading 1717 radiographs disagreed on 22% of teeth. Detection depended on lesion size and site: simulated cancellous-bone lesions were invisible below 1 mm in incisors and 3 mm in molars. Of the 44 primary studies identified, 34 (77%) used a label that was a reading of the index image or was unascertainable; eight (18%) used an independent reference-six (14%) suited to contemporaneous detection and two to later treatment outcomes. No cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) input study had a reference independent of its volume. One commercial platform reported 92.3% sensitivity against same-image consensus and 47.9% against blinded CBCT. The reported accuracy is thus in agreement with a noisy rater; recognising this changes what meta-analyses pool. A model that reproduces human labels would have a lower sensitivity against disease than reported; for real-world models, the direction depends on error dependence that the study design cannot identify.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 使用人工智能（AI）检测根尖周炎所报告的准确性通常被解读为针对该疾病的准确性；然而，实际情况通常并非如此。与组织病理学相比，单视角根尖周X线摄影可检出16%至27%的确诊病变，使用视差时可检出38%，汇总数字灵敏度为61.0%，阴性预测值为41.6%。两名盲法专家阅读1717张X线片时，对22%的牙齿存在分歧。检出取决于病变大小和部位：模拟松质骨病变在切牙中小于1 mm、在磨牙中小于3 mm时不可见。在识别出的44项原始研究中，34项（77%）使用的标签是指标图像的读片结果或无法确定；8项（18%）使用了独立参考——6项（14%）适用于同期检测，2项适用于后续治疗结局。没有任何以锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）作为输入的研究拥有独立于其容积的参考标准。一个商业平台报告，针对同一图像共识的灵敏度为92.3%，针对盲法CBCT的灵敏度为47.9%。因此，所报告的准确性与一个含有噪声的评分者一致；认识到这一点会改变荟萃分析所合并的内容。一个复现人类标签的模型，其针对疾病的灵敏度将低于所报告值；对于真实世界模型，其方向取决于研究设计无法识别的误差依赖性。

title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Access Reproductive Healthcare Information by U.S. States Following Sexual Assault.
zh_title: 用AI获取美国各州性侵后生殖健康信息
summary: 研究关注强奸后怀孕的女性使用ChatGPT等AI工具查询各州堕胎政策与豁免规定，因州法与程序差异而面临困惑。
key_points: 美国各州堕胎合法性及强奸等豁免条款差异大
受害者饮酒与是否承认强奸可能延迟就医
AI工具（含ChatGPT）被用于查询生殖健康信息
reason: 主题相关但描述有限，非临床验证研究，属增量档
abstract: [Archives of sexual behavior] There is currently wide variability across U.S. states regarding the legality of abortion with some states having relatively open access to abortion services and others with a total or near total ban on abortion access. Further complicating these state-by-state differences is the variability in policies and procedures with regard to exemptions (e.g., rape, incest) that may allow women access to abortion services that otherwise would be banned in that state. Factors such as a victim's alcohol use at the time of rape and victim's rape acknowledgment may delay or prevent women from seeking medical care post-assault. To help navigate potential confusion regarding state-level policies and requirements to access abortion services following a rape in which they became pregnant, women may use Artificial Intelligence tools, including ChatGPT, for reproductive health care information. Thus, we sought to qualitatively examine information provided by ChatGPT-4o to women seeking information on how to access abortions in each state depending on their alcohol use and rape acknowledgment after finding out they are pregnant following a rape. Using data collected between October 31 and November 11, 2024, we systematically analyzed ChatGPT-4o's responses to abortion access requests across all 50 U.S. states using four prompts that varied by alcohol use and rape acknowledgment, and qualitatively coded responses for accuracy, helpfulness, and inclusion of empathic statements. Results revealed no significant differences in ChatGPT-4o responses across prompt conditions and one difference based on U.S. state level abortion access restriction. Responses in states with more severe restrictions were more likely to include information on rape exemptions than states with less restrictions in abortion access. However, responses often failed to include helpful information and statements reflective of empathic tone, which may exacerbate pre-existing disparities across U.S. states.
zh_abstract: [Archives of sexual behavior] 目前美国各州在堕胎合法性方面存在很大差异，一些州对堕胎服务相对开放，而另一些州则完全或近乎完全禁止堕胎。使这些各州差异进一步复杂化的是，在豁免情形（如强奸、乱伦）方面的政策和程序存在差异，这些豁免可能使女性能够获得在该州原本会被禁止的堕胎服务。受害者在强奸时的酒精使用以及受害者对强奸的承认等因素，可能延迟或阻止女性在遭受性侵后寻求医疗照护。为帮助应对在因强奸而怀孕后获得堕胎服务的州级政策和要求方面可能存在的困惑，女性可能使用人工智能工具，包括ChatGPT，来获取生殖健康照护信息。因此，我们试图定性考察ChatGPT-4o向女性提供的信息，这些女性在因强奸而怀孕后，根据其酒精使用和强奸承认情况，寻求如何在各州获得堕胎的信息。使用2024年10月31日至11月11日期间收集的数据，我们使用四种根据酒精使用和强奸承认情况而变化的提示，系统分析了ChatGPT-4o对美国所有50个州堕胎获取请求的回应，并对回应进行定性编码，编码内容为准确性、有帮助性以及是否包含共情性陈述。结果显示，ChatGPT-4o的回应在不同提示条件之间没有显著差异，但基于美国州级堕胎获取限制存在一处差异。与堕胎获取限制较少的州相比，限制更严格的州的回应更可能包含关于强奸豁免的信息。然而，回应常常未能包含有帮助的信息和体现共情语气的陈述，这可能加剧美国各州之间先前存在的差异。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in gastroenterology for endoscopic detection and characterisation, disease-activity assessment, risk prediction, treatment-response estimation and workflow support. However, high retrospective accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable or beneficial clinical decision support. This structured narrative review examines the clinical development of artificial intelligence across gastrointestinal endoscopy, inflammatory bowel disease, hepatology and pancreaticobiliary diseases through three translational dimensions: explainability, generalisability and clinical actionability. Communication, human oversight and lifecycle governance are considered cross-cutting determinants of implementation. The evidence is most mature in gastrointestinal endoscopy, particularly for computer-aided polyp detection, although benefits vary across operators, indications and practice settings. Applications in inflammatory bowel disease, hepatology and pancreaticobiliary care remain predominantly retrospective, with limited prospective evidence that model outputs alter management or improve patient outcomes. Explainability is commonly represented by heatmaps or feature-attribution methods, but rarely evaluated in terms of clinician understanding, calibrated trust or patient communication. External validation is becoming more frequent, yet geographic and technological transportability, calibration and performance under dataset shift remain insufficiently assessed. Prospective implementation and health-economic studies are uncommon, and available economic evidence is largely model-based. Clinical artificial intelligence should therefore be evaluated as a sociotechnical intervention comprising the model, interface, users, workflow, communication process and associated care pathway. Translation requires clinically defined use cases, representative multicentre validation, human-centred evaluation, prospective assessment of benefits and harms, and continuous post-deployment surveillance. Clinical AI in gastroenterology should complement clinical expertise through transparent, contestable and continuously monitored decision support that preserves clinician accountability and supports informed, patient-centred decisions.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）在消化内科中越来越多地用于内镜检测与表征、疾病活动度评估、风险预测、治疗反应估计和工作流程支持。然而，高回顾性准确率并不一定转化为可靠或有益的临床决策支持。这篇结构化叙述性综述通过三个转化维度——可解释性、泛化性和临床可行动性——审视人工智能在胃肠内镜、炎症性肠病、肝病和胰胆疾病中的临床发展。沟通、人工监督和生命周期治理被视为实施的横跨各领域的决定因素。证据在胃肠内镜中最为成熟，尤其是计算机辅助息肉检测，尽管其获益因操作者、适应证和实践环境而异。在炎症性肠病、肝病和胰胆疾病照护中的应用仍以回顾性为主，有限的前瞻性证据表明模型输出可改变管理或改善患者结局。可解释性通常由热图或特征归因方法表示，但很少从临床医生理解、校准信任或患者沟通的角度进行评估。外部验证正变得更加频繁，但地理和技术可移植性、校准以及在数据集偏移下的性能仍评估不足。前瞻性实施和卫生经济学研究不常见，可获得的卫生经济学证据大多基于模型。因此，临床人工智能应作为一种社会技术干预来评估，包括模型、界面、用户、工作流程、沟通过程及相关照护路径。转化需要临床定义的使用场景、具有代表性的多中心验证、以人为本的评估、对获益与危害的前瞻性评估以及部署后持续监测。消化内科的临床AI应通过透明、可质疑且持续监测的决策支持来补充临床专业知识，该支持维护临床医生的问责制并支持知情的、以患者为中心的决策。

abstract: [Oral and maxillofacial surgery clinics of North America] Blepharoplasty and related periorbital procedures sit at the interface of functional reconstruction, esthetic surgery, ophthalmology, facial plastic surgery, and oral and maxillofacial surgery. Because eyelid and periorbital changes can be captured in photographs, videos, and 3-dimensional imaging, artificial intelligence has growing relevance for objective measurement, screening, planning, outcome assessment, and patient education. Current evidence is promising but heterogeneous. Image-based computer vision and deep learning appear closest to clinical use, whereas large language and generative image models require careful oversight. This review summarizes practical applications and proposes a cautious implementation pathway.

abstract: [Oral and maxillofacial surgery clinics of North America] Artificial intelligence (AI)-based facial analysis enables objective and quantitative evaluation of facial morphology. Recent advances in computer vision allow automated detection of facial landmarks and reproducible measurement of facial symmetry, movement, and emotional expression. Several AI systems, including Emotrics, MediaPipe Face Mesh, Real-Time Facial Asymmetry Analysis, FaceReader, and Affdex, have been applied to outcome assessment after facial reanimation procedures and facial nerve reconstruction. Similar computational approaches can also be applied to evaluate structural facial deformities, such as those observed after mandibular reconstruction. By reducing subjective bias and improving reproducibility, AI-based facial analysis may support more evidence-based evaluation of reconstructive surgical outcomes.

title: MOFI reveals dynamic multi-omics coordination during cell fate progression
zh_title: MOFI：重建细胞命运进程的多组学动态整合框架
summary: 预印本提出MOFI框架，联合建模多时间点配对多组学快照，重建连续细胞命运转变轨迹。

abstract: Cell fate decisions are shaped by dynamic coordination across transcriptomic, chromatin, and protein layers. Time-series single-cell multi-omics assays now enable these molecular layers to be profiled across developmental stages, yet each cell is still observed only once, and the continuous multi-omics trajectories connecting discrete snapshots remain unresolved. A central challenge is therefore to jointly integrate paired omics measurements while reconstructing their shared developmental progression. Here we present Multi-Omics Fate Inference (MOFI), a dynamically constrained multi-omics integration framework designed to reconstruct continuous cell fate transitions from paired multi-omics snapshots sampled across multiple time points. MOFI jointly models omics-specific state dynamics, cross-omics correspondence, and shared population growth within a unified framework, enabling cross-omics perturbation response analysis and identification of candidate cross-omics transformation programs. Across simulated benchmarks and paired RNA-ATAC/RNA-protein time-series datasets, MOFI reconstructed continuous fate transitions, population dynamics and cross-omics changes consistent with observed measurements. In kidney organoids, MOFI captured coordinated RNA-ATAC progression of nephron lineage specification. In hematopoietic progenitors, MOFI predicted perturbation-responsive lineage redistribution and nominated multi-omics transformation programs linking transcriptional modules with protein-level responses. In neural developmental systems, MOFI resolved gradual brain organoid maturation and interneuron lineage allocation during human cortical development. Together, MOFI provides a dynamics-grounded method for converting discrete paired multi-omics snapshots into interpretable models of cell fate progression, perturbation response, and cross-omics transformation analysis.
zh_abstract: 细胞命运决定是由转录组、染色质和蛋白质层面之间的动态协调所塑造的。时间序列单细胞多组学检测如今使得能够在发育阶段中对这些分子层面进行 profiling，但每个细胞仍仅被观测一次，而连接离散快照的连续多组学轨迹仍未得到解析。因此，一个核心挑战是在整合配对组学测量的同时重建其共同发育进程。在此，我们提出 Multi-Omics Fate Inference（MOFI），一种动态约束的多组学整合框架，旨在从多个时间点采样的配对多组学快照中重建连续的细胞命运转变。MOFI 在统一框架内联合建模组学特异性状态动态、跨组学对应关系以及共享群体增长，从而实现跨组学扰动响应分析并识别候选跨组学转化程序。在模拟基准和配对的 RNA-ATAC/RNA-蛋白质时间序列数据集中，MOFI 重建了与观测测量一致的连续命运转变、群体动态和跨组学变化。在肾脏类器官中，MOFI 捕捉了肾单位谱系特化的协调性 RNA-ATAC 进展。在造血祖细胞中，MOFI 预测了扰动响应性谱系重分布，并提名了将转录模块与蛋白质水平响应联系起来的多种组学转化程序。在神经发育系统中，MOFI 解析了脑类器官的逐渐成熟以及人类皮层发育过程中的中间神经元谱系分配。总之，MOFI 提供了一种以动态为基础的方法，将离散的配对多组学快照转化为细胞命运进展、扰动响应和跨组学转化分析的可解释模型。

title: BanglaDiaHallu: Hallucinations of large language models and the effect of guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation in Bangla diabetes question answering
zh_title: 孟加拉语糖尿病问答中的大模型幻觉与指南检索增强
summary: 预印本测评4个开源大模型在孟加拉语糖尿病问答中的幻觉，并用孟加拉国糖尿病指南检索增强以降低幻觉。
key_points: 4个可本地部署开源模型回答40个患者问题
BanglaDiaRAG加入密集与稀疏指南检索
两名医师对400条回答共同评审
reason: 低资源语言幻觉测评加RAG对照，预印本且规模有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for health advice, but they can produce fluent statements that are false or unsupported, known as hallucinations, and this risk is poorly characterised in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We measured hallucinations of locally deployable open-weight LLMs in Bangla diabetes question answering and tested whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounded in Bangladeshs National Guideline on Diabetes Mellitus reduces them. Forty patient questions spanning six clinical sub-domains were each answered twice, under zero-shot prompting, by Qwen3.5-9B, TigerLLM-9B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, and by BanglaDiaRAG, which adds hybrid dense (BGE-M3) and sparse (BM25) retrieval from a physician-reviewed Bangla guideline knowledge base to Qwen3.5-9B. Two physicians rated the 400 de-identified responses by consensus for medical accuracy, completeness, safety, readability and reliability on a 0-1 scale, and responses with accuracy below 0.70 were classified as hallucinated. Hallucination rates were 2.5% for Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3.8% for TigerLLM-9B, 22.5% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and 77.5% for Qwen3.5-9B. Guideline grounding lowered the rate of Qwen3.5-9B to 11.3% (difference -66.3 percentage points; 95% CI -76.3 to -55.0) and raised every criterion by 0.24 to 0.38 points (Holm-adjusted p < 0.001). BanglaDiaRAG outscored Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on all five criteria and matched or exceeded TigerLLM-9B, but it remained below Gemma-4-26B-A4B in safety, readability and reliability, and its residual errors were specific, confident and potentially harmful. Guideline grounding can turn a weak general-purpose model into a much safer Bangla diabetes assistant, but the choice of base model mattered as much as retrieval and no configuration was free of hallucination, so clinical oversight remains essential before patient-facing use.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于咨询健康建议，但它们可能生成流畅却虚假或无依据的陈述，即所谓幻觉（hallucinations），而这一风险在孟加拉语等低资源语言中特征描述不足。我们测量了可本地部署的开放权重LLMs在孟加拉语糖尿病问答中的幻觉，并检验了以孟加拉国《糖尿病国家指南》为依据的检索增强生成（RAG）是否能减少幻觉。来自六个临床子领域的40个患者问题，每个在零样本提示下被回答两次，分别由Qwen3.5-9B、TigerLLM-9B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B，以及BanglaDiaRAG回答；BanglaDiaRAG在Qwen3.5-9B基础上加入了来自经医师审阅的孟加拉语指南知识库的混合稠密（BGE-M3）与稀疏（BM25）检索。两名医师以共识方式对400份去标识化回答按0-1量表在医学准确性、完整性、安全性、可读性和可靠性方面进行评分，准确性低于0.70的回答被归类为幻觉。幻觉率为：Gemma-4-26B-A4B 2.5%、TigerLLM-9B 3.8%、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 22.5%、Qwen3.5-9B 77.5%。以指南为依据使Qwen3.5-9B的幻觉率降至11.3%（差异-66.3个百分点；95% CI -76.3至-55.0），并使每一项标准提高0.24至0.38分（Holm校正p < 0.001）。BanglaDiaRAG在所有五项标准上均优于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，并与TigerLLM-9B持平或超过，但在安全性、可读性和可靠性方面仍低于Gemma-4-26B-A4B，其残留错误具体、自信且可能有害。以指南为依据可以将一个较弱的通用模型转变为安全得多的孟加拉语糖尿病助手，但基础模型的选择与检索同样重要，且没有任何配置完全没有幻觉，因此在面向患者使用之前，临床监督仍必不可少。

title: Balanced Risk Integrity Index: a stratum-level metric for evaluating clinical prediction alerts under competing risks and censoring
zh_title: 平衡风险完整性指数：竞争风险与删失下评估临床预测警示的分层指标
summary: medRxiv预印本提出BRII分层指标，刻画被预警高风险患者中目标事件、竞争死亡与早期删失的构成，并用7个急性肾损伤预测模型评估。
key_points: 指出现有AUROC无法反映预警人群的结局构成
BRII定义为高风险层内目标事件所占比例
以7个急性肾损伤预测模型进行评估
reason: 预印本新方法，评估限于既有模型，证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Background: Conventional discrimination metrics, such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), do not characterize the composition of outcomes among patients flagged as high risk by clinical prediction models. This limitation is particularly relevant in critical care, where competing deaths and incomplete follow-up can complicate the interpretation of prediction alerts. We developed the Balanced Risk Integrity Index (BRII), a stratum-level metric defined as the proportion of target events among target events, competing deaths, and early-censored observations in a flagged high-risk stratum. BRII is algebraically related to positive predictive value (PPV) and is reported alongside its component decomposition to characterize the outcome composition of flagged patients. Methods: We evaluated BRII using seven acute kidney injury (AKI) prediction models developed in MIMIC-IV and externally validated in MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD (116,010 patients in total). Additional simulations examined the effects of competing deaths and early censoring on BRII and conventional model performance metrics. Results: For 48-hour AKI prediction in the top 10% risk stratum, BRII ranged from 0.90 to 0.96 in MIMIC-III, compared with less than 0.26 across all models in eICU-CRD, where 61.5% of evaluated patients were censored before the prediction horizon. In the eICU-CRD top 10% strata for the same target, 37.0% to 50.2% of patients were censored early, 12.2% to 15.5% had AKI, and 3.4% to 8.1% died before AKI. BRII and PPV ordered at least one model pair differently in 34 of 48 cohort-outcome-top-k groups. Under simulated random censoring for 48-hour AKI prediction, BRII declined by up to 0.80 while binary-label AUROC changed by less than 0.02. Conclusions: BRII provided complementary information on high-risk stratum composition, yielding different model rankings from PPV and revealing substantial differences across external validation cohorts. Interpreted alongside PPV and its component decomposition, BRII offers a standardized approach to evaluating clinical prediction alerts across models and observation environments.
zh_abstract: 【背景】传统区分度指标，如受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），并不能刻画被临床预测模型标记为高风险的患者的结局构成。这一局限在重症监护中尤为相关，因为竞争性死亡和不完整的随访会使预测警报的解读变得复杂。我们开发了平衡风险完整性指数（BRII），这是一个层级指标，定义为在被标记的高风险层中，目标事件占目标事件、竞争性死亡和早期删失观察之和的比例。BRII 在代数上与阳性预测值（PPV）相关，并与其次分分解一起报告，以刻画被标记患者的结局构成。【方法】我们使用在 MIMIC-IV 中开发、并在 MIMIC-III 和 eICU-CRD 中进行外部验证的七个急性肾损伤（AKI）预测模型来评估 BRII（共 116,010 例患者）。额外的模拟研究考察了竞争性死亡和早期删失对 BRII 及传统模型性能指标的影响。【结果】在 48 小时 AKI 预测的前 10% 风险层中，MIMIC-III 的 BRII 范围为 0.90 至 0.96，而 eICU-CRD 中所有模型均低于 0.26；在该队列中，61.5% 的被评估患者在预测时间窗之前被删失。在 eICU-CRD 中针对同一目标的前 10% 层中，37.0% 至 50.2% 的患者被早期删失，12.2% 至 15.5% 发生 AKI，3.4% 至 8.1% 在 AKI 之前死亡。在 48 个队列-结局-top-k 组中，有 34 组中 BRII 与 PPV 至少对一对模型的排序不同。在针对 48 小时 AKI 预测的模拟随机删失下，BRII 下降最多达 0.80，而二分类标签 AUROC 的变化小于 0.02。【结论】BRII 提供了关于高风险层构成的补充信息，产生了与 PPV 不同的模型排序，并揭示了不同外部验证队列之间的显著差异。与 PPV 及其组分分解结合解读时，BRII 提供了一种标准化方法，用于跨模型和观察环境评估临床预测警报。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Emergency Medical Call-Taking and Dispatch Operations: A Scoping Review.
zh_title: AI在急救呼叫与调度中的应用：范围综述

key_points: 纳入13国18项研究，44.4%来自欧洲

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Objective: This study aimed to systematically review worldwide research on artificial intelligence (AI) applications in emergency medical service (EMS) call-taking and dispatch operations and identify current research trends and research needs. Methods: This scoping review was reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, KoreaMed, IEEE Xplore, and the ACM Digital Library were searched for studies published from January 2021 to August 2026. Data were synthesized descriptively. Results: Eighteen studies from 13 countries and one multinational setting were included; eight (44.4%) were conducted in Europe. Patient Recognition and Classification was the predominant domain (11/18, 61.1%), followed by Dispatch Support and Operational Decision-Making (5/18, 27.8%) and Other Methodological Applications (2/18, 11.1%). Structured clinical or dispatch data were used in 11 studies, textual data in eight, and call audio in five; four applied multimodal integration. Deep learning (DL) was used as a primary model in 11 studies and classical machine learning (ML) in eight, including three using both; large language models (LLMs) were used in two. Eleven studies involved retrospective model development and internal validation, whereas only two were randomized controlled trials. None of the 11 model-development studies conducted independent external validation or calibration assessment, and the two randomized trials, one with high risk of bias and the other with some concerns, showed no consistent improvement across dispatch outcomes. Conclusions: AI applications span diverse clinical and operational tasks, with multimodal integration, speech technologies, and LLMs broadening their potential scope. Evidence remains dominated by retrospective model development and internal validation; prospective and real-world implementation studies are needed to establish safety and clinical utility before integration into EMS systems.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 【目的】本研究旨在系统综述全球范围内关于人工智能（AI）在紧急医疗服务（EMS）接警与调度操作中应用的研究，并识别当前的研究趋势与研究需求。【方法】本范围综述按照 PRISMA-ScR 进行报告。检索了 PubMed、Embase、Scopus、KoreaMed、IEEE Xplore 和 ACM Digital Library，纳入 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 8 月发表的研究。数据以描述性方式综合。【结果】共纳入来自 13 个国家和 1 个跨国环境的 18 项研究；其中 8 项（44.4%）在欧洲开展。患者识别与分类是主要领域（11/18，61.1%），其次是调度支持与运营决策（5/18，27.8%）以及其他方法学应用（2/18，11.1%）。11 项研究使用了结构化临床或调度数据，8 项使用文本数据，5 项使用通话音频；4 项应用了多模态整合。11 项研究将深度学习（DL）作为主要模型，8 项使用经典机器学习（ML），其中 3 项同时使用两者；2 项使用了大语言模型（LLM）。11 项研究涉及回顾性模型开发与内部验证，而仅 2 项为随机对照试验。11 项模型开发研究均未进行独立外部验证或校准评估；两项随机试验中，一项偏倚风险高、另一项存在一些关切，均未显示在调度结局上有一致改善。【结论】AI 应用涵盖多样的临床与运营任务，多模态整合、语音技术和 LLM 拓宽了其潜在范围。证据仍以回顾性模型开发和内部验证为主；在整合入 EMS 系统之前，需要前瞻性和真实世界实施研究来确立其安全性和临床效用。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Spirometry in Primary Healthcare: Opportunities for Early Detection of Small Airway Dysfunction.
zh_title: 基层医疗AI增强肺功能检查：早期识别小气道功能障碍
summary: 综述指出AI已在随机对照试验层面改善基层医生的肺功能判读，并探讨其能否助力MMEF与小气道功能障碍的早期识别。
key_points: 基层肺功能检查使用不足且判读质量受限
AI改善基层医生判读已有RCT级别证据
MMEF或有助于早期识别小气道功能障碍
reason: 综述提及RCT级证据，但本身为综述，最高6分
abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Spirometry underuse and persistent limitations in its technical quality and interpretation in primary healthcare (PHC) contribute to delayed and inaccurate diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma. Artificial intelligence (AI) has recently demonstrated, at the randomised controlled trial level, that it can improve spirometry interpretation by primary care clinicians. Maximal mid-expiratory flow (MMEF), a spirometric measure routinely derived from every forced expiratory manoeuvre, has been associated with subsequent airflow obstruction and lung function decline, particularly when conventional spirometric indices remain preserved, suggesting that it may contribute to earlier recognition of small airway dysfunction. However, no existing review has examined whether AI could specifically address the challenge of MMEF interpretation, and the incremental value of MMEF within AI-assisted spirometry models remains unestablished. This narrative review synthesises current evidence on AI-assisted spirometry in PHC across three evidence domains, diagnostic classification, quality control, and computational small airway assessment, and examines the potential for integrating MMEF with conventional spirometric indices, flow-volume curve morphology, technical quality, clinical characteristics, and longitudinal data to support its clinical interpretation. The available evidence supports the feasibility of the individual components underpinning this proposed framework, including AI-assisted spirometry interpretation, automated quality assessment, and computational extraction of small airway information from spirometric data. However, the contextual integration of MMEF within AI-assisted models has not yet been prospectively evaluated, and validation of its incremental predictive value and clinical utility is needed before implementation can be recommended.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 肺量计使用不足及其在初级医疗保健（PHC）中的技术质量和解读方面持续存在的局限，导致慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘诊断延迟且不准确。人工智能（AI）最近在随机对照试验层面已证明，它可以改善初级保健临床医生对肺量计的解读。最大呼气中期流量（MMEF）是一种通常从每次用力呼气动作中得出的肺量计指标，与随后的气流阻塞和肺功能下降相关，尤其是当常规肺量计指标仍保持正常时，提示它可能有助于更早识别小气道功能障碍。然而，现有综述均未考察 AI 能否专门应对 MMEF 解读的挑战，且 MMEF 在 AI 辅助肺量计模型中的增量价值仍未确立。本叙述性综述综合了关于 AI 辅助肺量计在 PHC 中应用的当前证据，涵盖三个证据领域：诊断分类、质量控制以及计算性小气道评估，并考察将 MMEF 与常规肺量计指标、流量-容积曲线形态、技术质量、临床特征和纵向数据相整合以支持其临床解读的潜力。现有证据支持支撑该拟议框架的各个组成部分的可行性，包括 AI 辅助肺量计解读、自动化质量评估以及从肺量计数据中计算提取小气道信息。然而，MMEF 在 AI 辅助模型中的情境化整合尚未经过前瞻性评估，在其推荐实施之前，需要对其增量预测价值和临床效用进行验证。

title: Safety, Feasibility, and Acceptability of the MINERVA Voice Conversational Agent for Emergency Department History-Taking
zh_title: MINERVA语音对话智能体用于急诊病史采集的安全性研究
summary: Beth Israel Deaconess 新注册一项250例观察性研究，评估语音对话智能体MINERVA在急诊采集与总结病史的安全性、可行性与准确性。
key_points: 新注册观察性研究，目前尚无结果公布
计划入组250名成人急诊患者
评估摘要准确性及危险征象独立识别能力

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; conditions: History Taking, Artificial Intelligence (AI); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 250; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] This study evaluates whether an artificial intelligence (AI) conversational agent called MINERVA (Medical Interface for Navigating the Emergency Room with Voice Assistance) can safely and feasibly gather medical histories from emergency department (ED) patients and produce accurate summaries. The main questions it aims to answer are: Can an AI conversational agent gather and summarize patient histories in the emergency department? Are the resulting summaries accurate? Do they capture essential clinical information? Can an AI agent overseeing these conversations independently identify red-flag symptoms that may need time-sensitive clinical interventions? Adult ED patients interact with MINERVA via either voice chat or typing on a keyboard. MINERVA asks them questions about their symptoms and generates a summary which the patients review for accuracy. MINERVA reviews the conversation for clinical red flags that suggest urgent evaluation is required. Participants fill out a survey providing feedback on their experience. The summary is not saved in the medical record and clinical care is not affected. Physician reviewers will evaluate the safety, accuracy, and clinical value of the MINERVA interview transcripts and summaries using standardized rubrics, including whether MINERVA was correct in identifying red-flag symptoms that may need time-sensitive clinical interventions.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心（Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center）；研究条件：病史采集、人工智能（AI）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：250；状态：通过邀请招募（ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION）] 本研究评估一种名为MINERVA（Medical Interface for Navigating the Emergency Room with Voice Assistance，用于通过语音辅助在急诊科进行导航的医疗界面）的人工智能（AI）对话代理，能否安全且可行地从急诊科（ED）患者处采集病史并生成准确的摘要。它旨在回答的主要问题是：AI对话代理能否在急诊科采集并总结患者病史？所得摘要是否准确？它们是否捕获了基本临床信息？监督这些对话的AI代理能否独立识别可能需要进行时间敏感性临床干预的危险信号症状？成年ED患者通过语音聊天或在键盘上打字与MINERVA互动。MINERVA向他们询问有关其症状的问题，并生成摘要，由患者审查其准确性。MINERVA审查对话，以发现提示需要紧急评估的临床危险信号。参与者填写调查问卷，就其体验提供反馈。该摘要不保存在病历中，且不影响临床护理。医师审查者将使用标准化评分表评估MINERVA访谈转录文本和摘要的安全性、准确性和临床价值，包括MINERVA在识别可能需要时间敏感性临床干预的危险信号症状方面是否正确。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models in Surgical Shared Decision-Making and Informed Consent: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI与大语言模型在手术共同决策与知情同意中的应用：叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI与大语言模型在手术共同决策与知情同意各环节的潜在作用及法律、伦理与治理问题。
key_points: 沿手术患者路径审视诊断、方案比较与知情同意环节
LLM可帮助解释已批准信息，但不能替代临床医生角色
为叙述性综述，未做meta分析与研究层偏倚评估
reason: 无系统检索与定量合成的叙述性综述，属增量档
abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) may make surgical information easier to access and understand. However, these tools cannot replace the clinician's role in shared decision-making or the requirements for valid informed consent. Methods: This narrative review follows the surgical patient pathway from diagnosis and explanation to option comparison, shared decision-making, and informed consent. It examines conventional digital tools, LLM-assisted communication, personalized prediction, direct consent studies, patient and professional perspectives and legal, ethical, and governance issues. A formal meta-analysis and study-level risk-of-bias assessment were not performed. Results: AI may support several stages of surgical care. Diagnostic and predictive systems can assist clinicians. LLMs can help explain approved information, prepare patients for consultation, and improve consent materials. Conventional interactive tools have the strongest evidence for better comprehension. Evidence for LLM-assisted consent is still based mainly on simulations and document analyses. Patient-facing use requires source control, privacy protection, and visible clinical oversight. AI cannot establish capacity, voluntariness, or final authorization. We propose a five-level framework in which safeguards increase with clinical influence. Conclusions: AI may support the patient's path from diagnosis to an informed surgical choice when it uses approved information, serves a defined task, and remains under clinical oversight. Current evidence does not support autonomous AI-mediated consent or AI-directed treatment choice. The aim should be a better-informed, preference-sensitive decision, not an automated signature.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare（Basel, Switzerland）] 【背景】人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLM）可能使外科信息更易获取和理解。然而，这些工具不能替代临床医生在共享决策中的作用，也不能替代有效知情同意的要求。【方法】本叙述性综述沿外科患者路径展开，从诊断和解释到方案比较、共享决策和知情同意。它考察传统数字工具、LLM辅助沟通、个性化预测、直接同意研究、患者与专业人员视角以及法律、伦理和治理问题。未进行正式荟萃分析和研究层面偏倚风险评估。【结果】AI可能支持外科护理的若干阶段。诊断和预测系统可辅助临床医生。LLM可帮助解释已批准的信息、让患者为咨询做好准备并改进同意材料。传统交互式工具在改善理解方面证据最强。LLM辅助同意的证据仍主要基于模拟和文档分析。面向患者的使用需要来源控制、隐私保护以及可见的临床监督。AI不能确立行为能力、自愿性或最终授权。我们提出一个五级框架，其中保障措施随临床影响力增加而增强。【结论】当AI使用已批准的信息、服务于明确任务并始终处于临床监督之下时，它可能支持患者从诊断走向知情的外科选择。当前证据不支持自主的AI介导同意或AI指导的治疗选择。目标应是更充分知情的、对偏好敏感的决定，而不是自动化签名。

title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence to Predict Dental Crowding in Modern Orthodontic Practice: A Comprehensive Review.
source: PubMed · The Kaohsiung journal of medical sciences
zh_title: 人工智能预测正畸牙列拥挤：综合综述
summary: 该叙述性综述梳理牙列拥挤评估从传统间隙分析、数字化测量到二维AI、三维点云学习与临床智能体的演进。
key_points: 拥挤定义与参考标准仍不统一
数字化提升效率与可重复性，未解决定义依赖
二维模型可基于常规影像进行预测
reason: 叙述性综述无原始数据，仅归纳现有方法，属增量档
abstract: [The Kaohsiung journal of medical sciences] Dental crowding is fundamental to orthodontic diagnosis and treatment planning, yet what constitutes "crowding" remains surprisingly heterogeneous. Space analysis quantifies tooth size-arch length discrepancy, irregularity indices characterize alignment displacement, and clinician-assigned severity reflects broader diagnostic interpretation. This narrative review examines the evolution of crowding assessment from conventional space analysis and digital measurement to two-dimensional artificial intelligence (AI), three-dimensional point-cloud learning, and clinician-aware agentic AI. Digitalization improves efficiency and reproducibility but does not resolve fundamental dependencies on how crowding is defined, anatomically represented, and established as a reference standard. Two-dimensional models enable prediction from readily available images but are constrained by projection and scale, whereas three-dimensional approaches directly learn from dental surface representations and can capture local geometric relationships. In a companion study of 495 arches from 284 patients, PointNet++ achieved an R2 of 0.718 and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.54 mm for prediction of crowding. In a separate retrospective demonstration, a bounded Gemini-based Agent incorporating matched record-derived verbal information reduced MAE from 1.951 to 1.437 mm, whereas mismatched information degraded performance. These findings also illustrate that the target construct-the specific clinical feature of crowding that a model is trained to predict-may differ across assessment methods. Together, these findings highlight a fundamental challenge: improving prediction does not resolve ambiguity in the target construct. Future crowding AI should therefore align the target construct, reference standard, and input representation; preserve provenance and uncertainty; integrate complementary clinical information transparently; and route uncertain cases for expert review.
zh_abstract: [The Kaohsiung journal of medical sciences] 牙列拥挤是正畸诊断和治疗计划的基础，然而“拥挤”的构成却出人意料地异质。间隙分析量化牙量与牙弓长度不调，不齐指数刻画排列位移，而临床医生判定的严重程度则反映了更广泛的诊断解读。本叙述性综述考察了拥挤评估的演变，从传统间隙分析和数字化测量，到二维人工智能（AI）、三维点云学习，以及具有临床医生感知能力的智能体式 AI。数字化提高了效率和可重复性，但并未解决对拥挤如何定义、如何解剖学表征以及如何确立参考标准的根本性依赖。二维模型能够基于易于获取的图像进行预测，但受限于投影和尺度；而三维方法直接从牙齿表面表征中学习，能够捕捉局部几何关系。在一项纳入 284 例患者 495 个牙弓的配套研究中，PointNet++ 预测拥挤度达到 R2 为 0.718、平均绝对误差（MAE）为 1.54 mm。在另一项回顾性演示中，一个整合了匹配病历来源言语信息的受限 Gemini 智能体将 MAE 从 1.951 mm 降至 1.437 mm，而不匹配的信息则使性能下降。这些发现还表明，目标构念——即模型被训练去预测的拥挤的特定临床特征——可能在不同评估方法之间有所不同。总体而言，这些发现凸显了一个根本性挑战：改进预测并不能解决目标构念的模糊性。因此，未来的拥挤 AI 应使目标构念、参考标准和输入表征相互对齐；保留来源信息与不确定性；透明地整合互补临床信息；并将不确定的病例转由专家复核。

title: Curriculum-Based Deep Learning for Automated Segmental Left Ventricular Hypertrophy Classification Using Short-Axis Echocardiography.
zh_title: 课程式深度学习自动分类节段性左心室肥厚
summary: 研究提出课程式深度学习框架，基于二维短轴超声对2000张图像进行节段性左心室肥厚分类，覆盖心尖、基底、中段、弥漫与正常。
key_points: 针对肋骨与混响伪影造成的心肌边界模糊
框架包含预处理与课程式学习算法
reason: 单中心回顾性、2000张图像、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Accurate detection and classification of segmental left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) are challenging due to rib and reverberation artifacts in two-dimensional short-axis (2D-SAX) echocardiography view. These artifacts lead to ambiguity in the boundaries of the myocardial region. Existing artificial intelligence techniques focus on global LVH detection compared to segmental LVH classification. Methodology: To solve the abovementioned problem, a curriculum-based left ventricular hypertrophy deep learning (LVH-DL) framework is proposed for segmental LVH classification. The proposed framework was tested with 2000 images of segmental LVH, which consists of (a) apical-423, (b) basal-382, (c) mid-ventricular-349, (d) diffuse-453, and (e) normal-393. The curriculum-based deep learning model consists of proposed algorithms such as (i) preprocessing of Mountaineering-Team-Based Optimization Deep Denoised Convolutional Neural Network (MTBO-DnCNN) for removing artifacts and enhancing the boundaries, (ii) segmentation of modified active contour segmentation (MACS) algorithm accurately extracting the myocardium region from the background, and (iii) classification of curriculum-based ConvNeXt-V2 model classifying segmental LVH using inter-channel features such as valvular structures and chamber size from the segmented myocardial region. Results: The proposed LVH-DL framework achieves a classification accuracy of about (a) 96.5% for apical, (b) 95% for basal, (c) 95.8% for mid-ventricular, (d) 97.2% for diffuse, and (e) 95% for normal. Conclusions: Thus, Thus, the proposed LVH-DL framework acts as a decision support tool for early identification of segmental LVH.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] 【背景】由于二维短轴（2D-SAX）超声心动图切面中存在肋骨和混响伪影，对节段性左心室肥厚（LVH）进行准确检测和分类具有挑战性。这些伪影导致心肌区域边界模糊。现有的人工智能技术侧重于整体 LVH 检测，而非节段性 LVH 分类。【方法】为解决上述问题，提出了一种基于课程学习的左心室肥厚深度学习（LVH-DL）框架，用于节段性 LVH 分类。所提出的框架使用 2000 张节段性 LVH 图像进行测试，包括 (a) 心尖部-423、(b) 基底部-382、(c) 中心室部-349、(d) 弥漫性-453 和 (e) 正常-393。基于课程学习的深度学习模型由以下所提出的算法组成：(i) 登山队优化深度去噪卷积神经网络（MTBO-DnCNN）预处理，用于去除伪影并增强边界；(ii) 改进活动轮廓分割（MACS）算法分割，从背景中准确提取心肌区域；(iii) 基于课程学习的 ConvNeXt-V2 模型分类，利用来自分割心肌区域的瓣膜结构和心腔大小等通道间特征对节段性 LVH 进行分类。【结果】所提出的 LVH-DL 框架获得的分类准确率约为 (a) 心尖部 96.5%、(b) 基底部 95%、(c) 中心室部 95.8%、(d) 弥漫性 97.2%、(e) 正常 95%。【结论】因此，因此，所提出的 LVH-DL 框架可作为早期识别节段性 LVH 的决策支持工具。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Sensing Technologies for Vascular Access in Hemodialysis: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: 血液透析血管通路的 AI 与传感技术综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理 AI 与传感技术在透析血管通路风险分层、预测与纵向监测中的应用。
key_points: 以血管通路为分析单元，分四阶段梳理证据
涵盖狭窄、血栓、穿刺困难与感染等并发症
涉及光学、声学、振动与热学等传感监测
reason: 叙述性综述，无原始数据与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Vascular access performance determines the adequacy, safety, and cost of hemodialysis. Stenosis, thrombosis, cannulation difficulty, infection, and access-related cardiac stress remain major sources of morbidity. This narrative review examines artificial intelligence and sensing technologies for vascular access care, based on PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov searches through 22 August 2026 with citation chaining. Existing reviews have examined artificial intelligence in dialysis broadly or prediction models in isolation. In this review, the vascular access itself is kept as the unit of analysis, and the evidence is followed across four connected stages: systemic risk stratification; prediction of maturation, dysfunction, and complications from clinical, ultrasound, and multimodal data; longitudinal monitoring with optical, acoustic, vibration, thermal, and pressure sensors; and procedural support with robotics and visualization technologies. Reported discrimination is high in retrospective, recording-level analyses, reaching areas under the curve of 0.99 and sample-level accuracy of 100%, but falls to approximately 0.71 in longitudinal designs that predict future events in the same patients; patient-level external validation and calibration are also rarely reported. No approach has yet been demonstrated to reduce thrombosis, prolong patency, avoid interventions, or lower cost relative to standard care in prospective multicenter studies. Deployment is further constrained by power budgets, duty cycling, and transmission bandwidth in wearable devices. Technical feasibility should not be read as clinical utility.
zh_abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] 血管通路性能决定血液透析的充分性、安全性和成本。狭窄、血栓形成、插管困难、感染以及通路相关心脏负荷仍是主要致病原因。本叙述性综述基于截至2026年8月22日的PubMed和ClinicalTrials.gov检索，并结合引文追溯，考察用于血管通路护理的人工智能和传感技术。现有综述已广泛考察透析中的人工智能或孤立地考察预测模型。在本综述中，血管通路本身被作为分析单元，并沿四个相互关联的阶段追踪证据：系统性风险分层；基于临床、超声和多模态数据预测成熟、功能障碍和并发症；使用光学、声学、振动、热和压力传感器进行纵向监测；以及使用机器人和可视化技术进行手术支持。在回顾性、记录层面的分析中，报告的区分度很高，曲线下面积达到0.99，样本层面准确率达到100%，但在预测同一患者未来事件的纵向设计中降至约0.71；患者层面的外部验证和校准也鲜有报告。尚无任何方法在前瞻性多中心研究中被证明相对于标准护理能够减少血栓形成、延长通畅期、避免干预或降低成本。可穿戴设备中的部署还进一步受到功率预算、占空比和传输带宽的限制。技术可行性不应被解读为临床效用。

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are increasingly used in periodontal assessment, image analysis, outcome prediction, and clinical decision support. However, evidence specifically addressing gingival recession (GR) and related periodontal soft-tissue parameters remains fragmented and predominantly technical. This scoping review aimed to map AI/ML applications for the detection, measurement, prediction, and treatment planning of GR and to identify methodological limitations and translational evidence gaps. Methods: This scoping review was conducted in accordance with the JBI methodology for scoping reviews and reported according to PRISMA-ScR. Eligibility was structured according to the Population-Concept-Context framework and included English-language original studies involving human participants or human-derived clinical data and evaluating AI/ML approaches directly related to GR or to periodontal soft-tissue or anatomical parameters relevant to its assessment or management. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Embase were utilized as the core bibliographic databases, while Google Scholar was used as an additional search source with screening restricted to the first 200 results ranked by relevance. No restrictions on publication year or start date were applied. Study characteristics, AI methods, clinical applications, validation strategies, and performance metrics were charted and descriptively synthesized. Results: Twelve studies were included across four main clinical domains: detection and segmentation of gingival recession and related soft-tissue features, measurement and anatomical landmark localization, prediction and risk assessment, and treatment planning or clinical decision support. abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping molecular oncology by making complex biological data tractable and by extending the reach of precision drug discovery. Its emerging value is particularly evident at the interface of immunoengineering and targeted therapy, where computational models can help prioritize tumor-selective antigens, predict neoantigen immunogenicity, optimize engineered receptors, support antibody and antibody-drug conjugate design, guide small-molecule discovery, refine genome-editing strategies, and anticipate treatment response. Across these applications, the central promise is not automation for its own sake, but a wider therapeutic window in which tumor control is increased while off-target toxicity is reduced. Yet the translational gap remains substantial. Many models are still preclinical, external validation is limited, and clinical implementation remains uncommon. This Commentary follows representative methods across a therapeutic continuum that now extends from target discovery and therapeutic engineering to imaging, liquid biopsy, resistance forecasting, combination selection, and drug repurposing. We argue that clinical value will depend on closed-loop workflows in which multimodal predictions are experimentally validated, externally tested, and longitudinally updated to guide the next therapeutic decision.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 人工智能（AI）正在重塑分子肿瘤学，使复杂的生物学数据变得可处理，并拓展精准药物发现的范围。其新兴价值在免疫工程与靶向治疗的交叉领域尤为明显，在该领域，计算模型可帮助优先选择肿瘤选择性抗原、预测新抗原免疫原性、优化工程化受体、支持抗体和抗体-药物偶联物设计、指导小分子发现、改进基因组编辑策略并预测治疗反应。在这些应用中，核心前景并非为自动化而自动化，而是拓宽治疗窗，使肿瘤控制增强的同时脱靶毒性降低。然而，转化差距仍然巨大。许多模型仍处于临床前阶段，外部验证有限，临床实施仍不常见。本评论沿治疗连续体追踪代表性方法，该连续体如今从靶点发现和治疗工程延伸至影像学、液体活检、耐药预测、联合方案选择和药物重定位。我们认为，临床价值将取决于闭环工作流程，在该流程中，多模态预测经过实验验证、外部测试并纵向更新，以指导下一项治疗决策。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Kastamonu University; conditions: Schizophrenia Caregiver, Caregiver Burden, Emotional Expressivity; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 88; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Schizophrenia is a chronic mental disorder that affects the diagnosed individual and the family members involved in the care process from a biopsychosocial perspective. The course of the illness, the recurrence of symptoms, and the high level of care required can increase the burden on caregivers and make it difficult for them to express their emotions. Structured psychoeducation and cognitive-behavioral interventions have been reported to be beneficial for caregivers in managing these challenges. The aim of this study is to develop an AI-supported psychoeducation program based on a cognitive-behavioral approach for caregivers of individuals diagnosed with schizophrenia and to evaluate the program's impact on caregiving burden and the level of emotional expression. The six-week program will cover topics such as the caregiver role and burden, schizophrenia, the thought-emotion-behavior cycle, recognizing and expressing emotions, effective communication, setting boundaries, seeking support, signs of relapse, and crisis planning. Content based on scientific literature will be evaluated by experts. Artificial intelligence will facilitate interaction with the content, participation in activities, the application of skills, and structured feedback. The system will not provide clinical assessments, diagnoses, or personalized treatment recommendations; participants will be referred to appropriate healthcare services in situations requiring professional evaluation. The study will be conducted using a quasi-experimental design with pre-test and post-test control groups. A total of 88 caregivers will be recruited, with 44 assigned to the experimental group and 44 to the control group. The program will be administered to the experimental group, while the control group will receive routine care. Data will be collected using the Caregiver Descriptive Information Form, the Zarit Caregiver Burden Scale, and the Emotional Expression Scale. A Program Evaluation Form will also be used for the experimental group. The program to be developed is expected to reduce the caregiving burden on caregivers and improve their ability to express emotions. It is anticipated that the findings will contribute to psychiatric nursing practice, the development of AI-supported psychoeducation programs, and the strengthening of psychosocial support provided to caregivers.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Kastamonu University；条件：精神分裂症照护者、照护者负担、情绪表达性；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：88；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 精神分裂症是一种慢性精神障碍，从生物心理社会视角来看，它不仅影响被诊断者，也影响参与照护过程的家庭成员。疾病的病程、症状的复发以及所需的高强度照护可增加照护者的负担，并使其难以表达情绪。据报道，结构化心理教育和认知行为干预有助于照护者应对这些挑战。本研究旨在为被诊断为精神分裂症个体的照护者开发一项基于认知行为方法的 AI 支持心理教育项目，并评估该项目对照护负担和情绪表达水平的影响。这个为期六周的项目将涵盖以下主题：照护者角色与负担、精神分裂症、思维-情绪-行为循环、识别与表达情绪、有效沟通、设定界限、寻求支持、复发迹象以及危机计划。基于科学文献的内容将由专家评估。人工智能将促进与内容的互动、活动的参与、技能的应用以及结构化反馈。该系统不会提供临床评估、诊断或个性化治疗建议；在需要专业评估的情况下，参与者将被转介至适当的医疗服务。本研究将采用带前测和后测对照组的准实验设计。共将招募88名照护者，其中44名分配至实验组，44名分配至对照组。该项目将施用于实验组，而对照组将接受常规照护。数据将使用照护者描述性信息表、Zarit 照护者负担量表和情绪表达量表收集。实验组还将使用项目评价表。所开发的项目预期可减轻照护者的照护负担并改善其表达情绪的能力。预期研究结果将有助于精神科护理实践、AI 支持心理教育项目的开发，以及加强为照护者提供的社会心理支持。

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Although artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being integrated into nursing practice, little is known about the association between nurses' AI literacy and their subjective workload. This study examines the associations between three dimensions of AI literacy-technical understanding, critical appraisal, and practical application-and overall and dimension-specific subjective workload among clinical nurses. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 305 clinical nurses recruited through convenience sampling from two hospitals in central Taiwan. AI literacy was assessed using the self-report Scale for the Assessment of Non-Experts' AI Literacy (SNAIL), with responses rated on a five-point Likert scale. Subjective workload was assessed using the self-report NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX). Pearson correlation and hierarchical multiple linear regression analyses were performed, adjusting for relevant demographic and work-related characteristics. Results: Higher technical understanding, critical appraisal, and practical application were each associated with lower temporal demand and frustration, and these associations remained statistically significant after correction for multiple testing. More limited associations were observed for physical demand and the overall NASA-TLX workload score, while no robust associations were found for mental demand, effort, or performance. Conclusions: The assessed dimensions of AI literacy are found to be associated with specific dimensions of nurses' subjective workload, rather than with workload uniformly, with the clearest relationships observed for temporal demand and frustration. Further longitudinal and intervention studies are needed to determine whether improvements in AI literacy are accompanied by meaningful changes in nurses' workload experiences.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 【背景】尽管人工智能（AI）日益融入护理实践，但关于护士的AI素养与其主观工作负荷之间的关联知之甚少。本研究考察临床护士AI素养的三个维度——技术理解、批判性评价和实际应用——与总体及特定维度主观工作负荷之间的关联。【方法】采用便利抽样从台湾中部两家医院招募305名临床护士进行横断面调查。AI素养使用自评量表《非专家AI素养评估量表》（Scale for the Assessment of Non-Experts' AI Literacy, SNAIL）评估，回答采用五点Likert量表评分。主观工作负荷使用自评NASA任务负荷指数（NASA-TLX）评估。进行Pearson相关和分层多元线性回归分析，并校正相关人口学和工作相关特征。【结果】较高的技术理解、批判性评价和实际应用分别与较低的时间需求和挫败感相关，且这些关联在多重检验校正后仍具有统计学显著性。对体力需求和总体NASA-TLX工作负荷评分的关联较为有限，而未发现脑力需求、努力程度或绩效有稳健关联。【结论】所评估的AI素养维度被发现与护士主观工作负荷的特定维度相关，而非与工作负荷普遍相关，其中时间需求和挫败感的关系最清晰。需要进一步的纵向和干预研究，以确定AI素养的提高是否伴随护士工作负荷体验的有意义变化。

zh_title: 成人胸片AI模型经持续学习适配新生儿：国际多中心研究
summary: 一项覆盖20个国家地区、30个新生儿ICU的国际回顾性研究，评估持续学习作为隐私保护方法，将成人气管插管评估模型适配至新生儿胸片。
key_points: 30个新生儿ICU、20个国家地区的国际回顾性研究
持续学习为不共享数据的模型适配方式
不足两成商用影像模型获准用于儿科
reason: 跨20国30个NICU的多中心外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Continual learning, a privacy-preserving approach, was shown to be effective in addressing a critical gap in paediatric AI by adapting a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care. Despite growing clinical adoption of artificial intelligence in radiology, fewer than one in five commercially available models are cleared for paediatric use. Existing systems are trained predominantly on adult data and generalize poorly to neonates, yet efficient strategies for repurposing them without data sharing or large-scale local data curation are lacking. Here we present an international retrospective study of neonatal chest radiographs from 30 neonatal intensive care units across 20 countries and territories, evaluating continual learning as a privacy-preserving approach to adapt a deep learning model for adult endotracheal tube assessment to neonatal care. Each hospital contributed 50 radiographs for sequential model retraining without centralized data pooling. Continual learning achieved lower anatomical landmark localization error (0.67 cm versus 1.29 cm for hospital-specific fine-tuning and 4.30 cm for adult-only models) at 29 of 30 sites, with improved detection of deep intubations at 27 of 30 sites. These findings demonstrate that privacy-preserving collaborative learning can address critical gaps in paediatric AI deployment.
zh_abstract: 持续学习（continual learning）是一种隐私保护方法，已被证明能有效弥补儿科人工智能（AI）中的关键空白，其做法是将用于成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型适配到新生儿护理。尽管人工智能在放射学中的临床采用日益增长，但只有不到五分之一的市售模型获准用于儿科。现有系统主要基于成人数据训练，对新生儿的泛化能力很差，而目前缺乏在不共享数据或不大规模本地数据整理的情况下将其再利用的高效策略。此处我们介绍一项国际回顾性研究，纳入来自20个国家和地区、30个新生儿重症监护病房的新生儿胸部X线片，评估持续学习作为一种隐私保护方法，将用于成人气管插管评估的深度学习模型适配到新生儿护理。每家医院贡献50张X线片用于序贯模型再训练，而不进行集中式数据汇集。持续学习在30个中心中的29个实现了更低的解剖标志定位误差（0.67 cm，对比医院特定微调的1.29 cm和仅成人模型的4.30 cm），并在30个中心中的27个改善了深部插管的检测。这些发现表明，隐私保护协作学习可以解决儿科AI部署中的关键空白。

title: An artificial intelligence framework for end-to-end rare disease phenotyping from clinical notes using large language models
zh_title: RARE-PHENIX：LLM端到端罕见病表型提取框架
summary: 整合大模型表型抽取、HPO标准化与监督排序的端到端框架，用11家UDN中心数据训练并在外部真实病历验证。
key_points: 融合LLM抽取、HPO标准化与监督排序
2671例、11家Undiagnosed Diseases Network中心训练
外部队列16,357份病历、143例验证
reason: 多中心训练并做独立机构外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Phenotyping is fundamental to rare disease diagnosis, but manually curating structured phenotypes from clinical notes is labor intensive and difficult to scale. Existing artificial intelligence (AI) approaches optimize individual components of phenotyping but generally do not operationalize the full workflow of extracting features from clinical text, standardizing them to Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms, and prioritizing rare disease-relevant HPO terms. We developed RARE-PHENIX, an end-to-end AI framework for rare disease phenotyping that integrates large language model-based phenotype extraction, ontology-grounded standardization to HPO terms, and supervised ranking of HPO terms. We trained RARE-PHENIX using data from 2671 patients across 11 Undiagnosed Diseases Network clinical sites, and externally validated it on 16,357 real-world clinical notes from 143 patients at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. Our findings suggest RARE-PHENIX generates structured, prioritized HPO terms highly concordant with clinician curation, demonstrates potential downstream disease-prioritization signal, and may support human-in-the-loop rare disease phenotyping in real-world settings.
zh_abstract: 表型分型是罕见病诊断的基础，但从临床笔记中人工整理结构化表型费力且难以扩展。现有的人工智能（AI）方法优化表型分型的各个组成部分，但通常未将完整工作流付诸实施，即从临床文本中提取特征、将其标准化为人类表型本体（HPO）术语，并对罕见病相关 HPO 术语进行优先级排序。我们开发了 RARE-PHENIX，一个用于罕见病表型分型的端到端 AI 框架，整合了基于大语言模型的表型提取、基于本体的 HPO 术语标准化以及对 HPO 术语的监督排序。我们使用来自 11 个未诊断疾病网络（Undiagnosed Diseases Network）临床中心的 2671 名患者数据训练 RARE-PHENIX，并在范德堡大学医学中心（Vanderbilt University Medical Center）143 名患者的 16,357 份真实世界临床笔记上进行外部验证。我们的发现表明，RARE-PHENIX 生成的结构化、优先排序的 HPO 术语与临床医生整理高度一致，展示出潜在的下游疾病优先级排序信号，并可能支持真实世界环境中人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的罕见病表型分型。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical phenotyping of human brown fat.
zh_title: 人工智能实现人棕色脂肪临床表型分析
summary: Nature研究用大数据与机器学习在101,243例患者中量化棕色脂肪活性，发现其与心血管及精神疾病患病率较低相关。
key_points: 基于大型癌症中心101,243例患者队列
机器学习半自动量化约8,700例患者的棕色脂肪活性
分析显示有棕色脂肪者心血管与精神疾病患病率更低
reason: 同行评审、十万例级大队列并有客观量化表型，属重要档
abstract: [Nature] Adipose tissue has a central role in systemic energy balance and the pathogenesis of obesity and its sequelae1,2. In contrast to white adipose tissue, brown adipose tissue (BAT) uses energy to produce heat3. Detectable BAT in humans is associated with decreased prevalence of cardiometabolic diseases4. However, the complete spectrum of health conditions associated with BAT remains unknown, and high-throughput methods to quantify BAT activity in humans are lacking5,6. Here we leveraged big data and artificial intelligence to systematically define the clinical impact of BAT in a cohort of 101,243 patients from a large cancer centre. Our unbiased analyses revealed that, across all diagnoses, cardiovascular and psychiatric diseases were less prevalent in people with BAT. Using a machine learning approach, we semi-automatically quantified BAT activity in approximately 8,700 patients and demonstrated that higher BAT activity, especially in the axillary depot, is associated with lower odds of cardiometabolic diseases and healthier white fat distribution. People with BAT also exhibited more favourable glycaemic parameters, lipid profiles, inflammatory markers and echocardiographic indices. Analysis of medication usage demonstrated that angiotensin receptor blocker use was positively associated with BAT presence. As proof of concept, we showed that the angiotensin receptor blocker losartan increased brown adipocyte activity and whole-body energy expenditure. Altogether, our studies harnessing artificial intelligence and big data identify new clinical phenotypes linked to BAT and serve as a platform for drug repurposing to activate this tissue in humans.
zh_abstract: 《自然》脂肪组织在全身能量平衡以及肥胖及其后遗症的发病机制中具有核心作用1,2。与白色脂肪组织相比，棕色脂肪组织（BAT）利用能量产热3。在人类中可检测到的 BAT 与心血管代谢疾病患病率降低相关4。然而，与 BAT 相关的完整健康状况谱仍未知，且缺乏高通量方法量化人类 BAT 活性5,6。在此，我们利用大数据和人工智能，在一个来自大型癌症中心的 101,243 名患者队列中系统定义 BAT 的临床影响。我们的无偏分析显示，在所有诊断中，心血管和精神疾病在具有 BAT 的人群中患病率较低。使用机器学习方法，我们半自动量化了约 8,700 名患者的 BAT 活性，并证明较高的 BAT 活性，尤其是在腋窝脂肪库，与心脏代谢疾病几率降低和更健康的白色脂肪分布相关。具有 BAT 的人也表现出更有利的血糖参数、血脂谱、炎症标志物和超声心动图指标。对药物使用的分析表明，血管紧张素受体阻滞剂使用与 BAT 存在正相关。作为概念验证，我们显示血管紧张素受体阻滞剂氯沙坦（losartan）增加了棕色脂肪细胞活性和全身能量消耗。总之，我们利用人工智能和大数据的研究识别了与 BAT 相关的新临床表型，并作为药物重定位平台，以在人类中激活该组织。

title: An all-in-one foundation model for multimodal medical image restoration and enhancement
zh_title: 全能医学图像恢复与增强基础模型AMIFound
summary: 研究提出AMIFound基础模型，覆盖CT、MRI、PET、内镜、超声、眼底与X线7种模态，在376万对图像上训练评估，性能超越38个基线。
key_points: 覆盖7种模态、7类退化模式
训练评估使用376万对高低质量图像
在图像质量指标上超越38个基线
reason: 多模态基础模型且训练数据规模大，属重要档
abstract: Medical image quality is essential for reliable clinical diagnosis and downstream artificial intelligence analysis, yet routine images are often degraded by noise, motion artefacts, low contrast, low-dose acquisition or modality-specific artefacts. Here we present AMIFound, an all-in-one foundation model for medical image enhancement and restoration across computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography, endoscopy, ultrasound, fundus imaging and X-ray. AMIFound is trained and evaluated on 3.76 million paired high-quality and degraded images spanning 7 representative degradation patterns. A shared encoder captures modality and degradation cues, while a dynamically routed expert restoration pool adapts the enhancement pathway for each input. Across 7 modalities, AMIFound outperforms 38 task-specific and generalist baselines on full-reference image quality metrics, clinician assessment and robustness tests under combined degradations as well as on naturally degraded clinical images. Enhanced images further improve 44 disease detection tasks, tumour stage prediction and survival risk stratification in non-small-cell lung cancer, including improved individual-level prognostic ranking. These results support AMIFound as a domain-specific foundation model for improving low-quality clinical images and strengthening downstream medical artificial intelligence workflows while preserving clinically relevant information. Cao et al. present AMIFound, a foundation model that unifies medical image restoration across seven imaging modalities, delivering robust enhancement across diverse degradations and preserving clinically relevant information for diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 医学图像质量对于可靠的临床诊断和下游人工智能分析至关重要，然而常规图像常因噪声、运动伪影、低对比度、低剂量采集或模态特异性伪影而质量下降。此处我们介绍AMIFound，一种一体化基础模型，用于跨计算机断层扫描（CT）、磁共振成像（MRI）、正电子发射断层扫描（PET）、内窥镜、超声、眼底成像和X线的医学图像增强与恢复。AMIFound在376万对高质量与退化图像上进行训练和评估，涵盖7种代表性退化模式。共享编码器捕捉模态和退化线索，而动态路由的专家恢复池为每个输入调整增强路径。在7种模态中，AMIFound在全参考图像质量指标、临床医生评估以及组合退化下的鲁棒性测试中，以及在自然退化的临床图像上，均优于38个任务特定和通用基线。增强后的图像进一步改善了44项疾病检测任务、肿瘤分期预测和非小细胞肺癌的生存风险分层，包括改善了个体水平的预后排序。这些结果支持AMIFound作为一种领域特定基础模型，可改善低质量临床图像并加强下游医学人工智能工作流程，同时保留临床相关信息。Cao等人提出了AMIFound，一种统一了七种成像模态的医学图像恢复的基础模型，能在多种退化下提供稳健增强，并保留用于诊断的临床相关信息。

title: Interpretable AI model reveals spatial codes of cell recruitment in tissues
zh_title: 可解释 AI 模型 SPACER 解析组织细胞募集空间编码
summary: 可解释多实例学习框架 SPACER 直接从空间转录组数据解码基因水平细胞募集规则，在 37 个数据集上较现有方法提升 4–21 倍。
key_points: 多实例学习框架，可解释地解码基因级募集规则
覆盖 37 个空间转录组数据集与多种肿瘤
揭示黏蛋白屏障与免疫检查点抑制剂耐药相关
reason: 同行评审，37 个多来源数据集验证并给出预后相关生物学发现，属重要档
abstract: Understanding which molecular signals recruit specific cells to precise tissue locations is fundamental to tissue biology, immunity and disease. Existing computational tools for spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) describe where cells reside but cannot explain why. Here we introduce SPACER, a fully interpretable multi-instance learning framework that decodes gene-level recruitment rules directly from SRT data. Applied to 37 SRT datasets spanning multiple human tumour types and mouse heart, SPACER achieved 4–21-fold improvement over existing methods in various tasks of recovering biologically meaningful recruitment signals. SPACER revealed (1) that tumour-expressed mucins are associated with physical barriers to T cell engagement, which predicts resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors and patient prognosis, (2) that local antigen presentation is the dominant correlate of T cell engagement across cancer types and (3) that Cd4^+ T cells are the dominant functional effectors in severe immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced myocarditis. These findings establish SPACER as a discovery engine for cellular recruitment biology with direct translational applications. A fully interpretable multi-instance learning framework, SPACER, helps elucidate which molecular signals recruit specific cells to their precise locations by decoding gene-level recruitment rules from spatially resolved transcriptomics data.
zh_abstract: 理解哪些分子信号将特定细胞募集到精确的组织位置，是组织生物学、免疫学和疾病的基础。现有的空间分辨转录组学（SRT）计算工具描述了细胞驻留在何处，但无法解释原因。在此，我们介绍SPACER，一种完全可解释的多实例学习框架，可直接从SRT数据中解码基因水平的募集规则。应用于涵盖多种人类肿瘤类型和小鼠心脏的37个SRT数据集，SPACER在恢复具有生物学意义的募集信号的各种任务中，相比现有方法实现了4–21倍的提升。SPACER揭示：(1) 肿瘤表达的黏蛋白与T细胞接合的物理屏障相关，这预测了对免疫检查点抑制剂的耐药性和患者预后；(2) 局部抗原呈递是跨癌种T细胞接合的主要相关因素；(3) Cd4^+ T细胞是严重免疫检查点抑制剂诱导的心肌炎中的主要功能性效应细胞。这些发现确立了SPACER作为细胞募集生物学的发现引擎，具有直接的转化应用。一个完全可解释的多实例学习框架SPACER，通过从空间分辨转录组学数据中解码基因水平募集规则，帮助阐明哪些分子信号将特定细胞募集到其精确位置。

title: A language model framework for sequence modeling of audit logs to characterize clinician-electronic health record interactions.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 用语言模型对EHR审计日志做序列建模
summary: JAMIA研究用超2.95亿条住院EHR审计日志微调Llama-3-8B，以动作预测检验临床医生工作流序列建模。
key_points: 使用2019–2024年超2.95亿条住院EHR审计日志
Llama-3-8B按符号与语义两种编码微调
以首序马尔可夫模型为基线，含时序外部测试集
reason: 超大规模日志加时序外部测试集评估，属重要档，但未报告临床结局
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Electronic health record (EHR) audit logs capture clinician-EHR interaction patterns, but most audit log research relies on aggregated measures (eg, total time). We investigated how audit logs could be modeled using large language model (LLM) architectures to learn underlying workflow sequences during clinician-EHR interactions. Using >295 million EHR-based audit log actions from inpatient settings spanning 2019 to 2024, we fine-tuned Llama-3-8B under 2 encodings: (1) symbolic (field-based) tokens and (2) semantic (word-based) natural language-based audit log action descriptions. A first-order Markov model, using only the immediate prior action, served as a baseline minimal context comparator. Model representation was assessed using next-action prediction accuracy in an early-period test set and 2 temporally distinct out-of-sample (OOS) periods. In the early-period test set, the word-based LLM achieved the highest accuracy (0.7473; 95% CI, 0.7468-0.7478) compared to the field-based LLM (0.3464; 95% CI, 0.3456-0.3472) and Markov baseline (0.4230; 95% CI, 0.4223-0.4236). The word-based approach retained a substantial performance advantage over the Markov baseline across the OOS periods, although accuracy declined over time (word-based LLM vs Markov accuracy, OOS-1: 0.6555 vs 0.3139, OOS-2: 0.6286 vs 0.2720). Word-based LLM relying on audit log action descriptions yielded the highest next-action prediction accuracy and demonstrated relative robustness to temporal drift, suggesting that longer sequential context and word-based action descriptions may improve audit log-based sequence modeling. These findings support the development of natural language-based LLM models for audit log research for task identification, workflow characterization, and safety-focused analyses of clinician-EHR interaction patterns.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 电子健康记录（EHR）审计日志捕获临床医生与EHR的交互模式，但大多数审计日志研究依赖聚合指标（例如总时间）。我们研究了如何使用大型语言模型（LLM）架构对审计日志建模，以学习临床医生与EHR交互期间的潜在工作流程序列。使用来自住院环境、横跨2019年至2024年的超过2.95亿条基于EHR的审计日志操作，我们在2种编码下微调Llama-3-8B：（1）符号（基于字段）标记和（2）语义（基于词）的自然语言审计日志操作描述。一个仅使用紧邻前一动作的一阶马尔可夫模型作为基线最小上下文比较器。模型表征使用早期测试集和2个时间上不同的样本外（OOS）时期中的下一动作预测准确率进行评估。在早期测试集中，基于词的LLM取得了最高准确率（0.7473；95% CI，0.7468-0.7478），相比之下基于字段的LLM（0.3464；95% CI，0.3456-0.3472）和马尔可夫基线（0.4230；95% CI，0.4223-0.4236）。基于词的方法在各个OOS时期均较马尔可夫基线保持显著性能优势，尽管准确率随时间下降（基于词的LLM vs 马尔可夫准确率，OOS-1：0.6555 vs 0.3139，OOS-2：0.6286 vs 0.2720）。依赖审计日志操作描述的基于词LLM产生最高的下一动作预测准确率，并表现出对时间漂移的相对稳健性，表明更长的序列上下文和基于词的动作描述可能改善基于审计日志的序列建模。这些发现支持开发基于自然语言的LLM模型，用于审计日志研究，以进行任务识别、工作流程表征以及针对临床医生-EHR交互模式的安全导向分析。

title: [Articles] Generalisability of an adult-trained AI model to paediatric coeliac disease diagnosis: a multicentre external validation study
zh_title: 成人训练AI模型用于儿童乳糜泻诊断的多中心外部验证
summary: 多中心外部验证显示，基于成人活检训练的AI模型可跨中心与扫描平台泛化至儿童乳糜泻诊断，校准良好的概率输出具临床可解释性。
key_points: 成人活检训练模型接受跨中心外部验证
覆盖不同中心与扫描平台
概率输出校准良好，可提示诊断信心
reason: 多中心外部验证并报告校准与临床可解释输出，属重要档
abstract: Our AI model, trained on adult biopsies, generalises to paediatric coeliac disease diagnosis across centres and scanner platforms. Well calibrated probability outputs provide clinically interpretable measures of diagnostic confidence and could support safe identification of coeliac disease-negative biopsies within defined thresholds. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of applying adult-derived AI models in paediatric populations and reinforce the importance of multi-site (D1 & D2) biopsy sampling.
zh_abstract: 我们的人工智能模型基于成人活检训练，可泛化至跨中心、跨扫描仪平台的儿童乳糜泻诊断。校准良好的概率输出提供了临床可解释的诊断置信度指标，并可在既定阈值内支持安全识别乳糜泻阴性活检。这些发现证明了将成人来源的人工智能模型应用于儿童人群的可行性，并强调了多部位（D1 和 D2）活检采样的重要性。

title: TrajOnco: a multi-agent framework for temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHR for multi-cancer early detection
_abs_err: page: no abstract in meta (3036 bytes, best 199 chars)
zh_title: TrajOnco：多智能体框架用于EHR多癌早筛
summary: 基于Truveta纵向电子病历，无需训练的多智能体大模型框架在15种癌症上预测1年诊断风险，AUROC 0.64–0.80。
key_points: 无需训练的多智能体链式架构，含长期记忆
15种癌症、匹配病例对照，预测1年风险
零样本AUROC 0.64–0.80，肺癌基准接近监督模型
reason: 大规模EHR多癌评估但无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Accurate estimation of cancer risk from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) could support earlier detection and improved care, but modeling such complex patient trajectories remains challenging. We present TrajOnco, a training-free, multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework designed for scalable multi-cancer early detection. Using a chain-of-agents architecture with long-term memory, TrajOnco performs temporal reasoning over sequential clinical events to generate patient-level summaries, evidence-linked rationales, and predicted risk scores. We evaluated TrajOnco on de-identified Truveta EHR data across 15 cancer types using matched case-control cohorts, predicting risk of cancer diagnosis at 1 year. In zero-shot evaluation, TrajOnco achieved AUROCs of 0.64–0.80, performing comparably to supervised machine learning in a lung cancer benchmark while demonstrating better temporal reasoning than single-agent LLMs. The multi-agent design also enabled effective temporal reasoning with smaller-capacity models such as GPT-4.1-mini. The groundedness of TrajOnco’s output was supported by human evaluation. Furthermore, TrajOnco’s interpretable reasoning outputs can be aggregated to reveal population-level risk patterns that align with established clinical knowledge. These findings highlight the potential of multi-agent LLMs to execute interpretable temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHRs, advancing both scalable multi-cancer early detection and clinical insight generation.
zh_abstract: 从纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）中准确估计癌症风险可支持更早发现和改善照护，但对这种复杂患者轨迹进行建模仍具挑战性。我们提出了 TrajOnco，一个免训练、多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架，旨在实现可扩展的多癌种早期检测。采用具有长期记忆的智能体链（chain-of-agents）架构，TrajOnco 对序贯临床事件进行时间推理，以生成患者层面的摘要、与证据关联的推理依据以及预测风险评分。我们在去标识化的 Truveta EHR 数据上，使用匹配病例-对照队列，跨 15 种癌症类型评估 TrajOnco，预测 1 年时癌症诊断的风险。在零样本评估中，TrajOnco 达到 0.64–0.80 的 AUROC，在肺癌基准中与监督机器学习表现相当，同时展现出优于单智能体 LLM 的时间推理能力。多智能体设计还使较小容量模型（如 GPT-4.1-mini）能够进行有效的时间推理。人工评估支持了 TrajOnco 输出的有据性。此外，TrajOnco 的可解释推理输出可被汇总，以揭示与既有临床知识一致的人群层面风险模式。这些发现凸显了多智能体 LLM 对纵向 EHRs 执行可解释时间推理的潜力，从而推进可扩展的多癌种早期检测和临床洞见生成。

title: Transparency features alone are insufficient for trust calibration in artificial intelligence diagnostic support.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 透明度功能不足以校准临床医生对AI诊断的信任
summary: 220名临床医生的随机对照实验显示，数字置信度分数或带引用的叙述性解释均未影响工具信任、整体信任或信息可信度评价，但任何AI辅助后信心均上升。
key_points: 随机对照实验，220名临床医生分三组
透明性对工具信任、整体信任均无显著影响

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Clinician trust in artificial intelligence (AI) is a frequently cited barrier to adoption, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how transparency features influence trust. This study aimed to address this evidence gap. We conducted a randomized controlled experiment in which 220 clinicians were randomized to 1 of 3 conditions: no transparency (control), numeric confidence scores, or narrative explanations with citations, using simulated AI diagnostic assistance across clinical case vignettes. Transparency did not influence tool-specific trust [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68], global trust [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88], or perceived information credibility [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]. Confidence increased following any AI assistance (+6.7%), but narrative explanations were associated with greater change in confidence compared with both control (P = .024) and numeric confidence (P = .0051). Participants changed or refined diagnoses after reviewing AI output 45.8% (SD 23.4%) of the time, with participants in the control group demonstrating higher levels of behavioral influence than transparency conditions (P = .0006). Trust, confidence, and behavioral influence represent distinct constructs and are impacted differently by transparency methods. The difference in these contributions to clinician-AI partnerships should be considered when designing for safe trust calibration, with particular consideration for the dissociation between trust and confidence. These findings suggest common interface transparency features alone failed to produce a detectable, meaningful shift in clinician trust in AI assistance and that changes may instead alter behavioral influence and confidence without a corresponding change in trust.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 临床医生对人工智能（AI）的信任是常被提及的采用障碍，但关于透明度特征如何影响信任的实证证据有限。本研究旨在填补这一证据空白。我们进行了一项随机对照实验，其中 220 名临床医生被随机分配到 3 种条件中的 1 种：无透明度（对照）、数字置信分数、或带引用的叙述性解释，在临床病例情景中使用模拟 AI 诊断辅助。透明度未影响工具特定信任 [F(2, 214) = 0.38, P = .68]、总体信任 [F(2, 217) = 0.13, P = .88] 或感知信息可信度 [F(2, 210) = 0.42, P = .66]。在任何 AI 辅助后置信度增加（+6.7%），但与对照（P = .024）和数字置信（P = .0051）相比，叙述性解释与更大的置信度变化相关。参与者在查看 AI 输出后 45.8%（SD 23.4%）的时间里改变或细化了诊断，其中对照组参与者表现出比透明度条件更高的行为影响水平（P = .0006）。信任、置信度和行为影响代表不同的构念，并受到透明度方法的不同影响。在设计安全信任校准时应考虑这些对临床医生-AI 伙伴关系的贡献差异，尤其要考虑信任与置信度之间的分离。这些发现表明，仅常见的界面透明度特征未能对临床医生对 AI 辅助的信任产生可检测的、有意义的转变，并且变化可能反而改变行为影响和置信度，而没有相应的信任变化。

source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging

summary: IEEE TMI论文提出含知识图谱推理的眼科视觉语言基础模型EyeGraph，并发布多粒度眼科VQA数据集IT-Retinal。

abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The exponential growth of large vision-language models (VLMs) has created significant opportunities for advancing multimodal artificial intelligence in specialized domains such as ophthalmology. However, progress in ophthalmic VLMs remains limited, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, high-quality image-text pairs. Moreover, existing VLMs frequently generate hallucinations, leading to uncertainty and unreliability that are unacceptable in clinical practice. To address the data scarcity issue, we introduce IT-Retinal, a dedicated ophthalmic Vision Question Answering (VQA) dataset that providesmultigranularity tasks and high-quality long-form textual content in image-text pairs. To mitigate hallucinations, we propose EyeGraph, a framework for ophthalmic VLMs that consists of two training stages, targeted pre-training and fine-tuning, and one inference stage that integrates Graph of Thought (GoT) and Think on Graph (ToG) reasoning, referred to as G2T. This design enables EyeGraph to incorporate structured external knowledge, constrain the output space, and produce more clinically consistent results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EyeGraph achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven clinically relevant benchmarks, spanning disease diagnosis, structural detection and localization, and report generation. Notably, the proposed G2T reasoning module consistently improves the factual consistency and reliability of ophthalmic report generation. All source code, along with an interactive demo, is publicly available at: https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）的指数级增长为在眼科等专业领域推进多模态人工智能创造了重大机遇。然而，眼科VLM的进展仍然有限，主要原因是缺乏大规模、高质量的图文对。此外，现有VLM经常产生幻觉，导致临床实践中不可接受的不确定性和不可靠性。为解决数据稀缺问题，我们引入IT-Retinal，一个专门的眼科视觉问答（VQA）数据集，在图文对中提供多粒度任务和高质量长文本内容。为减轻幻觉，我们提出EyeGraph，一个用于眼科VLM的框架，由两个训练阶段（定向预训练和微调）和一个推理阶段组成，该推理阶段整合思维图（Graph of Thought，GoT）和图上思考（Think on Graph，ToG）推理，称为G2T。该设计使EyeGraph能够纳入结构化外部知识、约束输出空间并产生更临床一致的结果。大量实验表明，EyeGraph在七个临床相关基准上达到最先进性能，涵盖疾病诊断、结构检测与定位以及报告生成。值得注意的是，所提出的G2T推理模块持续改善眼科报告生成的事实一致性和可靠性。所有源代码以及交互式演示已公开提供：https://github.com/ZardCAI/EyeGraph。

key_points: 训练数据为800034对心电图与报告

reason: 大样本(80万对)且含外部验证，属重要档
abstract: [Health information science and systems] Most artificial intelligence models for electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation rely on task-specific supervised learning, requiring dedicated labeled datasets for each diagnostic task and limiting scalability across diverse cardiac conditions. This study investigated whether vision-language learning from paired ECG recordings and summary reports could enable transferable ECG representations without task-specific supervised training. We developed ECG-VLM, a contrastive vision-language model consisting of a Transformer-based image encoder and a text encoder, trained on 800,034 paired 10-s ECG recordings and summary reports from the MIMIC-IV-ECG database. Cardiac condition detection was performed using natural-language prompts without condition-specific retraining or fine-tuning. Performance was evaluated on an internal test set and externally validated using the LSAS-ECG dataset (45,151 recordings) across 14 cardiac conditions, together with retrieval and subgroup analysis. ECG-VLM achieved diagnostic performance across 14 cardiac conditions, with AUROC ranging from 0.679 to 0.981 on the internal test set and from 0.691 to 0.991 on external validation. Performance was strongest for rhythm abnormalities (mean AUROC 0.948 internally and 0.921 externally) and lower for morphological conditions. Compared with the previously reported signal-based ECG-CLIP framework, ECG-VLM achieved comparable performance for rhythm abnormalities while improving AUPRC for several morphological conditions. Performance remained broadly consistent across external validation and demographic and clinical subgroups. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of vision-language supervision from paired ECG recordings and summary reports for learning transferable ECG representations without task-specific supervised training. This framework provides a basis for future extension of vision-language learning to ECG images encountered in routine clinical practice. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13755-026-00482-7.
zh_abstract: [Health information science and systems] 大多数用于心电图（ECG）解读的人工智能模型依赖于任务特定的监督学习，需要为每个诊断任务专门准备标注数据集，并限制了其在不同心脏状况中的可扩展性。本研究探讨了从配对的 ECG 记录和摘要报告中进行的视觉-语言学习是否能在没有任务特定监督训练的情况下实现可迁移的 ECG 表示。我们开发了 ECG-VLM，一种对比视觉-语言模型，由基于 Transformer 的图像编码器和文本编码器组成，在来自 MIMIC-IV-ECG 数据库的 800,034 对 10 秒 ECG 记录和摘要报告上进行训练。心脏状况检测使用自然语言提示进行，无需状况特定的重新训练或微调。性能在内部测试集上评估，并使用 LSAS-ECG 数据集（45,151 条记录）在 14 种心脏状况中进行外部验证，同时进行检索和亚组分析。ECG-VLM 在 14 种心脏状况中取得了诊断性能，内部测试集上 AUROC 范围为 0.679 至 0.981，外部验证上为 0.691 至 0.991。性能在节律异常方面最强（内部平均 AUROC 0.948，外部 0.921），在形态学状况方面较低。与先前报道的基于信号的 ECG-CLIP 框架相比，ECG-VLM 在节律异常方面取得相当的性能，同时改善了几种形态学状况的 AUPRC。性能在外部验证以及人口学和临床亚组中保持大致一致。这些发现证明了从配对的 ECG 记录和摘要报告中进行视觉-语言监督，以在没有任务特定监督训练的情况下学习可迁移 ECG 表示的可行性。该框架为未来将视觉-语言学习扩展到常规临床实践中遇到的 ECG 图像提供了基础。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13755-026-00482-7 获取。

summary: 基于LLM多智能体迭代生成与优化排程代码，在10个模型、35个场景中可行排程率82.91%，优于基线。
key_points: 迭代多智能体协作生成并优化排程代码
10个LLM、35场景，可行排程率82.91%
