abstract: [Magnetic resonance letters] In the era of AI-driven protein structure prediction, there is an urgent demand for rapid, accessible experimental approaches to validate computationally predicted structural models or to improve the accuracy of AI-based structure determination. As a key experimental technique for determining protein structures in solution, conventional biomolecular NMR spectroscopy relies heavily on proteins labeled with 13C and 15N isotopes, a requirement that entails high experimental costs, lengthy sample preparation times, and steep technical barriers, thereby limiting its broader application. Building on our previous work, we have developed a pseudo-labeling strategy for the automated resonance assignment of unlabeled proteins. Using high-field NMR spectrometers equipped with cryoprobes, we acquired natural-abundance 1H-13C and 1H-15N heteronuclear correlation spectra directly from unlabeled samples. By integrating predicted chemical shifts of HN, Hα, 13Cα, and 15N from three complementary AI tools into an iterative simulated annealing framework with an alternating scoring scheme, our method effectively resolves severe cross-peak overlap during the automated assignment process by introducing heteronuclear dimensional constraints. This approach enables reliable automated backbone resonance assignment for unlabeled proteins exceeding 100 amino acid residues. We anticipate that this labeling-free strategy will lower the technical barrier to biomolecular NMR, enabling researchers without specialized NMR expertise to employ NMR spectroscopy in fundamental life science research and drug development.

abstract: Background: Patient Decision aids (PtDAs) are important tools that support shared decision-making (SDM) between clinicians and patients, enabling patients to be more informed and engaged in decisions regarding their care. The use of PtDAs can increase patient knowledge, reduce decisional regret, and engage the clinician and patient in meaningful dialogue. Shared decision-making relies on decision aids, but how patients receive the PtDA can vary. This qualitative study elucidated patient familiarity with PtDAs and the barriers, needs, and requirements of patients to access and confidently use DAs, including when received via a clinician-facing EHR-integrated Decision Aid Navigator System (DEANS). Methods: We conducted six focus groups (FG) with participants who were recruited from two academic medical centers. Focus groups included an introduction to what a PtDA is and an exploration of how patients or family members, i.e., people who had not made a medical decision for themselves using a PtDA, but who have helped a family member, had previously used PtDAs in their healthcare. The FGs focused on PtDA-users, affordances and barriers to using PtDAs, and PtDA-user needs and requirements of a proposed DEAN patient portal. We applied Rapid Qualitative Analysis (RQA) to summarize the data, using a consensus making approach to identify emerging themes. Results: We identified three overarching themes: 1) Patients had varied familiarity with PtDAs and often confused them with general health tools, but found value in SDM, 2) Patients perceived technology accessibility, PtDA credibility, and time as barriers potentially impeding PtDA use, and 3) Patients valued flexible, user-friendly, and accessible PtDAs that support patient-led decisions, particularly when introduced by clinicians and delivered via a patient portal. Conclusion: This study provides patient-derived insights into factors that influence PtDA uptake, highlighting common misconceptions about PtDAs and identifying key patient priorities such as accessibility, flexibility, clear content, and clinician-guided usage. Patient also expected clinicians to be familiar with PtDAs, especially when the PtDA covers a complex decision. These findings can inform the development of more patient-centered SDM infrastructure and strategies to support PtDA use in clinical practice, including clinician-supported delivery, accessibility, and integration into routine care to strengthen shared decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【背景】患者决策辅助工具（Patient Decision aids, PtDAs）是支持临床医生与患者之间共享决策（shared decision-making, SDM）的重要工具，使患者能够更知情并参与有关其照护的决策。使用 PtDAs 可以增加患者知识、减少决策后悔，并使临床医生和患者进行有意义的对话。共享决策依赖决策辅助工具，但患者获得 PtDA 的方式可能各不相同。这项定性研究阐明了患者对 PtDAs 的熟悉程度，以及患者获取并自信使用 DAs 的障碍、需求和要求，包括当通过面向临床医生的、与 EHR 集成的决策辅助导航系统（Decision Aid Navigator System, DEANS）获得时。【方法】我们开展了六个焦点小组（focus group, FG），参与者从两个学术医疗中心招募。焦点小组包括介绍什么是 PtDA，并探讨患者或家庭成员（即未曾自己使用 PtDA 做出医疗决定、但曾帮助过家庭成员的人）此前在其医疗保健中如何使用 PtDAs。焦点小组聚焦于 PtDA 使用者、使用 PtDAs 的可供性与障碍，以及拟议的 DEAN 患者门户的 PtDA 使用者需求和要求。我们应用快速定性分析（Rapid Qualitative Analysis, RQA）来总结数据，使用共识制定方法识别新出现的主题。【结果】我们确定了三个总体主题：1）患者对 PtDAs 的熟悉程度各异，常将其与一般健康工具混淆，但认为 SDM 有价值；2）患者认为技术可及性、PtDA 可信度和时间是可能阻碍 PtDA 使用的障碍；3）患者重视灵活、用户友好且可及的 PtDAs，这些工具支持患者主导的决策，尤其是当由临床医生介绍并通过患者门户提供时。【结论】本研究提供了来自患者的洞见，揭示影响 PtDA 采用的因素，强调了关于 PtDAs 的常见误解，并确定了患者的关键优先事项，如可及性、灵活性、清晰内容和临床医生指导的使用。患者还期望临床医生熟悉 PtDAs，尤其是当 PtDA 涉及复杂决策时。这些发现可为开发更以患者为中心的 SDM 基础设施和策略提供信息，以支持临床实践中 PtDA 的使用，包括临床医生支持的提供、可及性以及整合到常规照护中，以加强共享决策。

title: Population-scale reconstruction of menopause dynamics reveals a physiological cliff at the final menstrual period
zh_title: 人群尺度重建绝经动态：末次月经的生理断崖
summary: 受天文学启发的计算框架从横断面数据重建末次月经锚定轨迹，在两个队列3亿项检验中发现多系统生理断崖。
key_points: 框架去除个体末次月经年龄差异造成的模糊

abstract: Menopause reshapes female physiology, yet current understanding is limited by small longitudinal cohorts that characterize it as a gradual transition. Large-scale biomedical datasets remain underutilized because the final menstrual period (FMP) age is rarely recorded. Here we present a computational framework, inspired by astronomy, that reconstructs FMP-anchored trajectories from cross-sectional data by removing the blurring caused by variation in FMP age across individuals. Applying this to two independent cohorts totaling 300 million laboratory tests revealed a step-like physiological cliff at the FMP including endocrine, skeletal, hepatic, renal and lipid systems. These discontinuities are absent in male individuals, are concordant across populations and appear markedly attenuated by menopausal hormone therapy. Dysregulation began more than a decade before FMP. These findings support a systemic, quantifiable view of menopause and provide a generalizable strategy for recovering hidden biological trajectories applicable to other transitions such as puberty or disease progression. By using a novel computational framework, a cross-sectional analysis on laboratory data from two independent cohorts reveals that the final menstrual period marks an abrupt, multisystem physiological shift, with sex hormone changes beginning more than 10 years before menopause onset.
reason: 两独立队列、3亿项检测并跨人群一致，属重要档
zh_abstract: 绝经重塑女性生理，但当前理解受到小型纵向队列的限制，这些队列将其描述为一种逐渐过渡。大规模生物医学数据集仍未得到充分利用，因为末次月经（final menstrual period, FMP）年龄很少被记录。在此，我们提出一个受天文学启发的计算框架，通过去除个体间 FMP 年龄差异所造成的模糊，从横断面数据中重建以 FMP 为锚点的轨迹。将其应用于两个独立队列、总计 3 亿次实验室检测，揭示了在 FMP 处存在阶梯式生理断崖，包括内分泌、骨骼、肝脏、肾脏和脂质系统。这些不连续性在男性个体中不存在，在不同人群中一致，并且似乎被绝经激素治疗显著减弱。失调在 FMP 前十余年就开始。这些发现支持一种系统性、可量化的绝经观，并提供了一种可推广的策略，用于恢复隐藏的生物学轨迹，适用于其他转变，如青春期或疾病进展。通过使用一种新颖的计算框架，对来自两个独立队列的实验室数据进行横断面分析，揭示末次月经标志着一种突然的多系统生理转变，性激素变化在绝经开始前超过 10 年就已出现。

abstract: Abstract We created an interpretable end-to-end neural network (ScoreNet) which can be used to develop an easy-to-implement scoring system for risk stratification. We applied it to data from 2711 patients with advanced melanoma across 5 trials that supported new drug approvals and developed a scoring system for overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS). The scoring system was then validated in two separate trials. This score is a weighted summation based on eight baseline features (sum of longest diameter for all target lesions, lactate dehydrogenase, systemic immune inflammation index, hemoglobin, ECOG performance status, liver metastasis, pulse rate, and PD-L1 immunohistochemistry status). Using the score, patients can be classified into low, moderate, or high-risk categories of reduced OS and PFS. Risk stratification was demonstrated for patients treated with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, chemotherapy, CTLA-4 inhibitors, BRAF or MEK inhibitors, and their combinations. ScoreNet-based risk stratification can be a new tool for clinical research/practice.

zh_abstract: 摘要 我们创建了一个可解释的端到端神经网络（ScoreNet），可用于开发易于实施的评分系统以进行风险分层。我们将其应用于来自 5 项支持新药获批的试验中的 2711 例晚期黑色素瘤患者的数据，并开发了一个用于总生存期（OS）和无进展生存期（PFS）的评分系统。随后，该评分系统在两个独立试验中得到验证。该评分是基于八个基线特征的加权求和（所有靶病灶最长径之和、乳酸脱氢酶、全身免疫炎症指数、血红蛋白、ECOG 体能状态、肝转移、脉率以及 PD-L1 免疫组织化学状态）。使用该评分，患者可被分为 OS 和 PFS 降低的低、中或高风险类别。风险分层已在接受 PD-1/PD-L1 抑制剂、化疗、CTLA-4 抑制剂、BRAF 或 MEK 抑制剂及其联合治疗的患者中得到证明。基于 ScoreNet 的风险分层可成为临床研究/实践的新工具。

title: AI-assisted scoping review of code sharing in clinical prediction model research
zh_title: AI辅助范围综述：临床预测模型研究的代码共享
summary: 用大模型流水线筛查3967篇文献，发现12.2%报告代码共享，为TRIPOD-Code报告规范提供依据。
key_points: 筛查3967篇引用TRIPOD的文献
482篇（12.2%）含代码共享声明
共享率因期刊与国别差异明显
abstract: Clinical prediction models are increasingly deployed to support diagnostic and prognostic decisions, making reproducibility essential for assessing their reliability and generalizability. Analytical code supports independent assessment of these processes, yet its availability in the literature remains limited. This scoping review quantifies current practices in sharing analytical code to inform the development of TRIPOD-Code, a reporting guideline for code availability and reproducibility. Here a large-language-model-assisted pipeline was developed to screen articles citing TRIPOD or TRIPOD+AI, extract repository links and assess retrieved repositories against 14 predefined reproducibility-related features. Among 3,967 articles, 482 (12.2%) included code-sharing statements. Sharing prevalence varied widely by journal and country. Repository assessment showed substantial heterogeneity in reproducibility features. These findings underscore the need for clearer expectations beyond code availability, including documentation, dependency specification and executable structure. Strengthening these practices may improve the usability of clinical prediction model studies and support their deployment in real-world clinical settings.
reason: 纳入近4000篇文献的大规模范围综述并支撑报告规范制定，属重要档。
zh_abstract: 临床预测模型越来越多地被部署用于支持诊断和预后决策，这使得可重复性对于评估其可靠性和可推广性至关重要。分析代码支持对这些过程进行独立评估，但其在文献中的可用性仍然有限。本范围综述量化了当前共享分析代码的实践，为制定 TRIPOD-Code 提供信息，TRIPOD-Code 是一个关于代码可用性和可重复性的报告指南。在此，开发了一个大语言模型辅助流程，用于筛选引用 TRIPOD 或 TRIPOD+AI 的文章、提取仓库链接，并根据 14 个预定义的可重复性相关特征评估检索到的仓库。在 3,967 篇文章中，482 篇（12.2%）包含代码共享声明。共享流行率因期刊和国家/地区差异很大。仓库评估显示可重复性特征存在显著异质性。这些发现强调，需要超越代码可用性的更明确期望，包括文档、依赖项说明和可执行结构。加强这些实践可能会提高临床预测模型研究的可用性，并支持其在真实世界临床环境中的部署。

title: Human–artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time
zh_title: 人机协作实时共管癫痫
summary: 住院原型将头皮与颅内脑电接入基于大语言模型的AI，经手机应用与患者双向沟通，辅助癫痫实时管理。
key_points: 原型连接脑电与LLM驱动AI
经手机应用实现双向沟通
处理睡眠、用药、认知与发作概率标志物
reason: LLM与器械结合的住院原型，有新意但验证与样本有限，属值得一看
abstract: One-third of the world’s 70 million people with epilepsy have seizures uncontrolled by medication, and implantable devices are a promising treatment. These devices can detect impending seizures, missed medication and impaired cognition, but, like most medical devices, they cannot share this information with patients in real time. This is a missed opportunity for devices to learn from clinical events and teach patients how their behaviors affect their health. Here we present a device platform that converses with patients to help them manage their epilepsy. The inpatient prototype links scalp and intracranial electroencephalography (EEG) to a secure, large language model-based artificial intelligence (AI) that communicates bidirectionally through a smartphone app. The AI processes biomarkers of sleep, medication, cognition and seizure probability, notifies patients of clinical events and trends, records symptoms and responses, and uses their feedback to retrain its seizure detector, reducing false alarms. We validated this platform in 13 patients who are undergoing video-EEG monitoring for epilepsy (scalp, n = 11; intracranial, n = 2). In a pseudoprospective simulation, seizure detectors improved precision from patient feedback alone, without expert intervention. We propose this system as a scalable, safeguarded platform for medical devices that can rapidly adapt to patient and provider needs across epilepsy and other medical conditions.
zh_abstract: 全球 7000 万癫痫患者中有三分之一存在药物无法控制的癫痫发作，而植入式设备是一种有前景的治疗方法。这些设备可以检测即将发生的癫痫发作、漏服药物和认知受损，但与大多数医疗设备一样，它们无法实时与患者分享这些信息。这错失了让设备从临床事件中学习并让患者了解其行为如何影响自身健康的机会。在此，我们提出一个可与患者对话以帮助其管理癫痫的设备平台。该住院原型将头皮和颅内脑电图（EEG）连接到一个安全的、基于大语言模型的人工智能（AI），后者通过智能手机应用程序进行双向交流。该 AI 处理睡眠、用药、认知和癫痫发作概率的生物标志物，向患者通知临床事件和趋势，记录症状和反应，并利用其反馈重新训练其癫痫发作检测器，从而减少误报。我们在 13 例因癫痫接受视频脑电图监测的患者中验证了该平台（头皮，n = 11；颅内，n = 2）。在一项伪前瞻性模拟中，仅凭患者反馈，无需专家干预，癫痫发作检测器的精确度即得到改善。我们提出该系统作为一个可扩展、受保护保障的医疗设备平台，可在癫痫和其他医疗状况中快速适应患者和提供者的需求。

abstract: We evaluated electronic health record developer compliance with federal transparency requirements for AI-enabled predictive decision support interventions. Developers are required to publicly report on risk analysis, mitigation, governance, and on eight other attributes. Across 35 developers, reporting was inconsistent and often incomplete, with substantial variation in structure and detail, yet all developers were certified as meeting the requirements. Results suggest a need for standardized reporting and more rigorous certification review.

title: Model-dependent prompt effects challenge reliable deployment of medical LLMs in traditional Chinese medicine
zh_title: 模型依赖的提示效应挑战中医医疗大模型可靠部署
summary: 在2025年台湾中医师执照考试475题上评测16个LLM与7种提示策略，无提示工程时准确率35.4%–85.9%，约半数通过。
key_points: 评测16个LLM、7种提示策略
475题来自2025台湾中医师执照考试
无提示工程准确率35.4%–85.9%，约半数通过
abstract: Although contemporary large language models (LLMs) have achieved satisfactory results in Western medical knowledge, their performance on traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains underexplored, and the determinants of performance variation are poorly understood. We evaluated 16 LLMs under seven prompt strategies on 475 questions from the 2025 Taiwan national TCM licensing examination, a public benchmark of TCM knowledge. Without prompt engineering, accuracy ranged from 35.4% to 85.9%, with approximately half passing. Among the evaluated model versions, adjusted accuracy differed substantially when models were grouped by family (for example, Claude-family models, 84% vs. GPT-4, 43%); these family-grouped comparisons were descriptive because only 16 individual models were evaluated. Paired prompt analyses showed modest average absolute effects, ranging from a 2.03-percentage-point decrease with implicit CoT to a 3.04-percentage-point increase with explicit CoT. However, prompt–model interactions produced substantial model-level divergence: prompt optimization reversed failing performance in one model (87.4% vs. 49.7%) while reducing accuracy in others. No single prompt strategy yielded consistent benefits across the evaluated models. Among five selected lower-performing models evaluated under explicit CoT prompting, misunderstanding of foundational TCM concepts was the most frequent error. These findings indicate that reliable LLM deployment in TCM requires empirical validation of both model choice and prompt strategy: model selection strongly shapes baseline capability, while prompt-model interactions can materially alter performance.
reason: 同行评审基准评测，公开题库475题、16模型对比，但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档。
zh_abstract: 尽管当代大型语言模型（LLMs）在西方医学知识方面已取得令人满意的结果，但其在中医（TCM）方面的表现仍未被充分探索，且对表现差异的决定因素了解甚少。我们在2025年台湾全国中医师执照考试的475道题（中医知识的公共基准）上，使用七种提示策略评估了16个LLM。在没有提示工程的情况下，准确率范围为35.4%至85.9%，约有一半通过。在所评估的模型版本中，当按模型家族分组时，调整后准确率差异很大（例如，Claude家族模型为84%，而GPT-4为43%）；这些按家族分组的比较是描述性的，因为仅评估了16个单独模型。配对提示分析显示平均绝对效应不大，范围从使用隐式CoT时下降2.03个百分点到使用显式CoT时提高3.04个百分点。然而，提示-模型交互产生了显著的模型层面差异：提示优化在一个模型中逆转了不及格表现（87.4% vs. 49.7%），而在其他模型中降低了准确率。在所评估的模型中，没有单一提示策略产生一致的益处。在显式CoT提示下评估的五个选定的表现较低模型中，对中医基础概念的误解是最常见的错误。这些发现表明，在中医中可靠部署LLM需要对模型选择和提示策略二者进行实证验证：模型选择强烈影响基线能力，而提示-模型交互可以实质性改变表现。

title: AEGIS: an operational infrastructure for post-market governance of adaptive medical AI under US and EU regulatory frameworks
zh_title: AEGIS：美欧监管框架下自适应医疗AI上市后治理基础设施
summary: 提出AEGIS治理与上市后监测基础设施，对齐FDA PCCP与欧盟MDR，含再训练、监测与条件决策模块。
key_points: 四类决策分类：批准、条件批准、临床复审、拒绝
独立ALARM信号，失败模型被路由至拒绝加告警
在脓毒症预测与BraTS肿瘤分割上覆盖全部分支
abstract: Abstract Medical AI requires governance preserving safety during continuous improvement. FDA Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP) and EU post-market surveillance address iterative updates but lack operational tooling. We present AEGIS, an internal governance and post-market-monitoring infrastructure designed to support the documentation of predetermined governance pathways for PCCP and Medical Devices Regulation alignment. AEGIS comprises dataset assimilation and retraining, model monitoring, and conditional decision-making modules. It utilizes a four-category taxonomy (APPROVE, CONDITIONAL APPROVAL, CLINICAL REVIEW, REJECT) and an independent ALARM signal. Instantiating AEGIS for sepsis prediction (PhysioNet) and brain-tumor segmentation (BraTS) exercised all decision categories, successfully routing failures to the critical REJECT + ALARM state (no deployable model; released model at risk). On real cross-site data, drift detection ROC-AUC rose from 0.82 to 1.00, reliably triggering near 500-patient batches with zero false alarms. This proof-of-concept utilizes illustrative clinical models; drift scoring quantifies covariate shift only, leaving concept drift for future work.
reason: 治理工具演示性研究，未验证临床结局，取值得一看档
zh_abstract: 摘要 医学人工智能需要治理，以在持续改进过程中保障安全性。FDA 预定变更控制计划（PCCP）和欧盟上市后监督应对迭代更新，但缺乏可操作工具。我们提出 AEGIS，一种内部治理与上市后监测基础设施，旨在支持为 PCCP 和医疗器械法规（Medical Devices Regulation）对齐记录预定治理路径。AEGIS 包括数据集同化与再训练、模型监测和条件决策模块。它采用四类分类法（APPROVE、CONDITIONAL APPROVAL、CLINICAL REVIEW、REJECT）和一个独立的 ALARM 信号。将 AEGIS 实例化用于脓毒症预测（PhysioNet）和脑肿瘤分割（BraTS）时，实践了所有决策类别，成功将失败路由至关键的 REJECT + ALARM 状态（无可部署模型；已发布模型处于风险中）。在真实跨站点数据上，漂移检测 ROC-AUC 从 0.82 上升至 1.00，可可靠地在接近 500 例患者批次时触发，且零误报。该概念验证使用了示例性临床模型；漂移评分仅量化协变量偏移，概念漂移留待未来工作。

title: Multidimensional continuous glucose monitoring metrics enable digital risk stratification across the diabetes spectrum
zh_title: 多维连续血糖监测指标实现糖尿病谱系数字风险分层
summary: 在90,757人的iCanNet队列中分析48项CGM指标，构建数字血糖风险评分DGRS并识别四种血糖表型。
key_points: 48项CGM指标与糖尿病前期、T2D、T1D相关
高斯混合模型识别出四种T2D血糖表型
DGRS量化T2D并发症风险，校准结果一致
abstract: Abstract Although continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides high-dimensional data, the usefulness of multimodal and diurnal glycemic profiles for disease characterization and risk stratification remains unknown. Here, in the iCanNet cohort of 90,757 participants, we examined the associations of 48 CGM-derived metrics with prediabetes, T2D, and T1D, compared to normoglycemia. We further employed Gaussian Mixture Model to define glycemic phenotypes and established digital glycemic risk score (DGRS) to quantify complication risks in T2D. Participants with prediabetes, T2D, or T1D exhibited distinct CGM signatures compared to normoglycemic individuals (all P < 0.001). Integration of top five metrics significantly improved diabetes classification, and calibration analyses showed agreement between predicted and observed risks. Four glycemic phenotypes were identified in T2D, with sustained hyperglycemia associated with a 59% increased risk of acute complications, and high glycemic variability associated with 75% and 41% higher risks of acute and chronic complications, respectively. The DGRS identified residual risk among patients achieving time in range ≥70%, reclassifying 25.0% and 22.3% of these individuals to high-risk groups for acute and chronic complications, respectively. In summary, this study revealed distinct CGM-derived signatures across diabetes statuses and established a multimodal framework for identifying high-risk individuals with T2D who may be overlooked by conventional biomarkers.
reason: 大样本单队列研究，仅内部验证，属值得一看档
zh_abstract: 摘要 尽管连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）提供高维数据，但多模态和昼夜血糖谱用于疾病表征和风险分层的实用性仍属未知。在此，我们在 90,757 名参与者的 iCanNet 队列中，检查了 48 项 CGM 衍生指标与糖尿病前期、T2D 和 T1D 的关联，并与血糖正常进行比较。我们进一步采用高斯混合模型（Gaussian Mixture Model）定义血糖表型，并建立数字血糖风险评分（DGRS）以量化 T2D 中的并发症风险。与血糖正常个体相比，糖尿病前期、T2D 或 T1D 参与者表现出不同的 CGM 特征（所有 P < 0.001）。整合排名前五的指标显著改善了糖尿病分类，校准分析显示预测风险与观察风险之间一致。在 T2D 中识别出四种血糖表型，其中持续性高血糖与急性并发症风险增加 59% 相关，高血糖变异性分别与急性和慢性并发症风险增加 75% 和 41% 相关。DGRS 识别出达到目标范围内时间 ≥70% 的患者中的残余风险，并将这些个体中的 25.0% 和 22.3% 分别重新分类为急性和慢性并发症高风险组。总之，本研究揭示了不同糖尿病状态下不同的 CGM 衍生特征，并建立了一个多模态框架，用于识别可能被传统生物标志物忽视的 T2D 高风险个体。

title: Exploring PET and MRI brain networks across healthy controls, mild cognitive impairment, and Alzheimer’s disease
zh_title: PET与MRI脑网络在健康、轻度认知障碍与阿尔茨海默病中的研究
summary: 回顾性纳入651名受试者的FDG PET与MRI，构建群体与个体化脑网络，并用45人外部队列验证预测能力。
key_points: 回顾性纳入651例，含PET与MRI
以32个AD相关脑区为节点构建SUVR与影像组学网络
45人外部队列验证网络特征的预测表现
abstract: This study aimed to characterize population-level and individual-level metabolic and radiomics-derived structural brain networks across healthy controls (HC), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) using multimodal PET and MRI. A total of 651 participants with both [ 18 F]FDG PET and MRI were retrospectively included, with an external cohort of 45 participants used for validation. Thirty-two AD-relevant regions of interest were retained as network nodes and characterized using PET standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs) and a selected MRI radiomics descriptor. Population-level networks were constructed using probability density function-based similarity with Jensen–Shannon divergence, and individualized perturbation networks were derived relative to an HC reference. Network-derived features were evaluated for prediction. Both SUVR-based and radiomics-based networks showed distinct patterns in MCI and AD compared with HC. Fused network features improved discrimination compared with either modality alone, achieving one-vs-rest AUCs of 0.894 [0.868–0.917] for HC, 0.888 [0.862–0.912] for AD, and 0.814 [0.783–0.844] for MCI. These findings indicate graded network disorganization across the HC–MCI–AD spectrum and support multimodal prediction.
reason: 回顾性多模态影像研究，651例样本可观并有小规模外部验证，但外部队列仅45人。
zh_abstract: 本研究旨在利用多模态PET和MRI，刻画健康对照（HC）、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）中群体水平和个体水平的代谢及放射组学衍生的结构性脑网络。回顾性纳入651名同时具有[18F]FDG PET和MRI的参与者，并使用一个45名参与者的外部队列进行验证。保留32个AD相关感兴趣区作为网络节点，并使用PET标准化摄取值比（SUVR）和一个选定的MRI放射组学描述符进行表征。使用基于概率密度函数的相似性及Jensen–Shannon散度构建群体水平网络，并相对于HC参考推导个体化扰动网络。评估网络衍生特征用于预测。基于SUVR和基于放射组学的网络在MCI和AD中与HC相比均显示出不同模式。融合网络特征相比单独任一模态改善了区分能力，达到one-vs-rest AUC：HC为0.894 [0.868–0.917]，AD为0.888 [0.862–0.912]，MCI为0.814 [0.783–0.844]。这些发现表明沿HC–MCI–AD谱存在分级网络失组织，并支持多模态预测。

title: A health-system-scale, episode-resolved multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia
zh_title: 健康系统级癌症恶病质多模态图谱
summary: 利用MSK-IMPACT中52,236例肿瘤患者纵向临床基因组数据，构建按发作解析的癌症恶病质轨迹并关联结局与基因型。
key_points: MSK-IMPACT 2010–2024年52,236例患者
恶病质体重下降发作多聚集于疾病进展期
各癌种见白蛋白、血红蛋白偏低等血清学特征
reason: 大规模多模态临床基因组资源，但未涉及AI建模方法，属值得一看
abstract: Cancer cachexia is a wasting syndrome with outsized impact on morbidity and mortality, yet its drivers and systemic consequences remain poorly defined. In this study, we repurposed longitudinal clinicogenomic data from 52,236 patients with cancer profiled by MSK-IMPACT (2010–2024) at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center to define episode-resolved trajectories of consensus-defined cachectic weight loss and linked these events to outcomes, serology and tumor genotypes. Cachectic episodes clustered near periods of disease progression and were associated with inferior outcomes in nearly all cancer types. Across diverse malignancies, cachectic weight loss episodes exhibited a consistent serologic signature characterized by lower albumin and hemoglobin and higher levels of liver enzymes. Numerous somatic tumor genotypes, including TP53 mutation across several diseases, were also associated with more frequent onset of cachectic episodes. Motivated by these observations, we developed a multivariate model to predict impending risk of cachectic weight loss in patients with lung, colorectal and prostate cancer, validated in an independent, external cohort from Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (n = 5,785). Routine clinicogenomic data are, therefore, a scalable resource for discovery in cancer cachexia. Using longitudinal data from 52,236 patients with cancer, this study created a multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia, demonstrating that weight loss episodes are linked to systemic serologic signatures and specific tumor genotypes and can be predicted using integrated clinical and molecular data, enabling earlier identification.
zh_abstract: 癌症恶病质是一种消耗综合征，对发病率和死亡率有不成比例的重大影响，但其驱动因素和全身性后果仍定义不清。在本研究中，我们重新利用来自 Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center 的 52,236 例癌症患者的纵向临床基因组数据（由 MSK-IMPACT 分析，2010–2024 年），以定义共识定义的恶病质性体重减轻的按发作解析的轨迹，并将这些事件与结局、血清学和肿瘤基因型相关联。恶病质发作聚集在疾病进展期附近，并且几乎在所有癌症类型中都与较差结局相关。在不同恶性肿瘤中，恶病质性体重减轻发作表现出一致的血清学特征，以白蛋白和血红蛋白较低以及肝酶水平较高为特征。许多体细胞肿瘤基因型，包括多种疾病中的 TP53 突变，也与恶病质发作更频繁发生相关。受这些观察结果启发，我们开发了一个多变量模型，用于预测肺癌、结直肠癌和前列腺癌患者即将发生的恶病质性体重减轻风险，并在来自 Dana-Farber Cancer Institute 的独立外部队列（n = 5,785）中进行了验证。因此，常规临床基因组数据是癌症恶病质发现的一个可扩展资源。利用来自 52,236 例癌症患者的纵向数据，本研究创建了癌症恶病质的多模态图谱，表明体重减轻发作与全身性血清学特征和特定肿瘤基因型相关，并且可利用整合的临床和分子数据进行预测，从而实现更早识别。

title: Improved Efficiency and Lesion Detection in Small Bowel Capsule Endoscopy Using the Open-Source Artificial Intelligence Model SEE-AI.
zh_title: 开源 SEE-AI 提升小肠胶囊内镜检出与效率
summary: 六家医院 249 例胶囊内镜回顾性交叉设计，评估开源模型 SEE-AI 辅助阅片的病灶灵敏度、准确率与阅片时间。
key_points: 249 例 PillCam SB3 检查，双读者交叉设计
对八类病灶生成带框标注视频
主要终点为病灶与患者层面灵敏度
abstract: [DEN open] Small bowel capsule endoscopy (CE) produces lengthy videos that are time-consuming to review and susceptible to missed lesions. We evaluated whether an open-source, pretrained artificial intelligence (AI) model (SEE-AI) could improve diagnostic performance and interpretation efficiency compared with conventional reading. We retrospectively analyzed 249 PillCam SB3 examinations performed between 2007 and 2022 at six hospitals, using a two-reader crossover design. SEE-AI (confidence threshold 0.1) generated annotated videos with bounding boxes for eight lesion categories. The primary endpoints were sensitivity for lesion detection on a per-lesion and per-patient basis. Secondary endpoints included specificity, predictive values, overall accuracy, and reading time. A prespecified subgroup analysis evaluated cases of suspected small-bowel bleeding (SSBB), focusing on Saurin P1+P2 hemorrhagic lesions. Across 1550 adjudicated lesions, AI-assisted reading demonstrated higher sensitivity than conventional reading (per-lesion: 98.8% [1532/1550] vs. 86.4% [1339/1550]; per-patient: 99.1% [464/468] vs. 80.3% [376/468]; both p < 0.0001). The mean reading time decreased from 17.9 to 13.7 min (p < 0.0001). In SSBB cases (n = 131), sensitivity for P1+P2 lesions improved on both a per-lesion basis (98.2% [439/447] vs. 82.8% [370/447]) and per-patient basis (98.6% [145/147] vs. 73.5% [108/147]), with a shorter reading time (14.1 vs. 18.0 min; all p < 0.0001). In this multicenter evaluation, SEE-AI significantly improved lesion detection and reduced reading time for CE interpretation, including SSBB cases, while maintaining openness and reproducibility. AI-assisted reading may reduce clinicians' workload and support the adoption of SEE-AI as a practical tool - and a potential future standard of care - for small bowel CE. N/A.
reason: 六中心、双读者交叉、开源模型，但为回顾性研究，属值得一看档。
zh_abstract: [DEN open] 小肠胶囊内镜（capsule endoscopy, CE）产生冗长的视频，审查耗时且容易漏诊病变。我们评估了一个开源、预训练的人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）模型（SEE-AI）与传统阅片相比，是否能提高诊断性能和解读效率。我们采用双读者交叉设计，回顾性分析了2007年至2022年间在六家医院进行的249次PillCam SB3检查。SEE-AI（置信度阈值0.1）生成了带边界框的注释视频，涵盖八种病变类别。主要终点是基于每病灶和每患者的病变检测灵敏度。次要终点包括特异度、预测值、总体准确率和阅读时间。一项预先设定的亚组分析评估了疑似小肠出血（suspected small-bowel bleeding, SSBB）病例，重点关注Saurin P1+P2出血性病变。在1550个经裁定的病变中，AI辅助阅片显示出比传统阅片更高的灵敏度（每病灶：98.8% [1532/1550] vs. 86.4% [1339/1550]；每患者：99.1% [464/468] vs. 80.3% [376/468]；两者 p < 0.0001）。平均阅读时间从17.9分钟降至13.7分钟（p < 0.0001）。在SSBB病例（n = 131）中，P1+P2病变的灵敏度在每病灶基础上（98.2% [439/447] vs. 82.8% [370/447]）和每患者基础上（98.6% [145/147] vs. 73.5% [108/147]）均得到改善，且阅读时间更短（14.1 vs. 18.0分钟；所有 p < 0.0001）。在这项多中心评估中，SEE-AI显著改善了病变检测并减少了CE解读的阅读时间，包括SSBB病例，同时保持了开放性和可重复性。AI辅助阅片可能减轻临床医生的工作量，并支持将SEE-AI采纳为小肠CE的实用工具——以及未来潜在的标准诊疗。N/A。

title: Stage-aware deep learning with adversarial data synthesis enables prospective season-scale A/H1N1 influenza forecasting in China.
zh_title: 阶段感知模型实现中国甲型 H1N1 流感季前预测
summary: 基于中国 13 年 A/H1N1 监测数据提出 SAMNN 多模态模型，用对抗合成协变量做 1–4 周及季前情景预测。
key_points: 使用 2011–2024 年国家级监测数据
跨三个流行强度差异约 20 倍的季节评估
1/2/4 周预测 R² 最高达 0.97
abstract: [Infectious Disease Modelling] Accurate influenza forecasting is essential for public health preparedness, yet many models require future covariates, provide limited interpretability, and degrade under post-pandemic regime shifts. We propose a Stage-Aware Multimodal Neural Network (SAMNN) that integrates multimodal temporal features using configurations adapted to heterogeneous transmission regimes and supports season-ahead scenario forecasting using adversarially synthesized covariates. Using 13 years of national A/H1N1 surveillance data from mainland China (2011∼2024), SAMNN was evaluated across three epidemiologically distinct seasons spanning ∼20-fold differences in peak intensity. SAMNN achieved R 2 values of 0.82-0.95, 0.82-0.97, and 0.55-0.97 for 1-week-, 2-week-, and 4-week-ahead forecasting, respectively, and generally maintained competitive performance relative to five baseline models across forecast horizons. SHAP attribution showed that epidemiological signals dominated predictions, with context-dependent contributions from climatic and social-context features. To support prospective scenario forecasting, we used an adversarial synthetic covariate-generation pipeline to produce season-ahead forecasts for 2024/25 using information available at the prespecified forecast origin.
reason: 国家级长序列与五个基线对比，但评估为回顾性，属值得一看档。
zh_abstract: [Infectious Disease Modelling] 准确的流感预测对于公共卫生防范至关重要，然而许多模型需要未来协变量，可解释性有限，并且在大流行后制度转变下性能下降。我们提出一种阶段感知多模态神经网络（Stage-Aware Multimodal Neural Network, SAMNN），它使用适应异质性传播机制的配置整合多模态时间特征，并支持使用对抗性合成协变量进行提前一季的情景预测。利用中国大陆13年全国A/H1N1监测数据（2011∼2024），在三个流行病学上不同的季节中评估了SAMNN，这些季节的峰值强度相差约20倍。SAMNN在提前1周、2周和4周预测中分别达到R 2值 0.82-0.95、0.82-0.97和0.55-0.97，并在各预测时间范围内总体保持相对于五个基线模型具有竞争力的性能。SHAP归因显示，流行病学信号主导了预测，气候和社会背景特征则具有情境依赖性贡献。为支持前瞻性情景预测，我们使用对抗性合成协变量生成流程，利用预先设定的预测起点时可得的信息，生成2024/25年提前一季预测。

title: Establishment and validation of intelligent review rules for blood cell analysis based on the gradient boosting decision tree algorithm.
zh_title: 梯度提升决策树建立血细胞分析智能复检规则
summary: 基于4家医院10212例样本建立并外部验证血细胞分析AI复检规则，与实验室现有41条规则比较。
key_points: 10212例EDTA-K2静脉血样本，来自4家医院
9000例建模，1212例独立医院外部验证
与实验室设定的41条复检规则对比
abstract: [Clinica chimica acta; international journal of clinical chemistry] To develop artificial intelligence (AI)-based intelligent review rules to accurately screen samples that require retests or blood smear microscopy examinations, thereby reducing the review rate, improving the work efficiency of haematology laboratories, and ensuring the quality of whole blood analysis. A total of 10,212 EDTA-K2 venous blood samples from the clinical laboratories of 4 hospitals from May 2022 to April 2025 were collected. Among them, 9000 samples from the First People's Hospital of Foshan, the Zhongda Hospital affiliated to Southeast University, and the First Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University were used to establish the rules, and 1212 samples from the Zhongshan Hospital affiliated to Fudan University were used for rule validation. The obtained rules were compared with the 41 review rules set by the International Consensus Group for Haematology Review (ICGHR). All samples were tested using a haematology analyser under the customized dilution ratio (CDR) mode and smear microscopy, if the microscopic examination results trigger the 10 microscopic anomalous rules established by the ICGHR, then the sample is deemed to be an anomalous sample. Intelligent review rules were established using the gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT) algorithm. Moreover, the false negative rate, false positive rate, and review rate of the validation set were statistically analysed. (1) Among the 9000 samples in the establishment set, 4493 anomalous samples were identified by microscopic examination, and 26 intelligent review rules were established using the GBDT algorithm. (2) For the external validation set, 180 anomalous samples were identified by microscopic examination. Compared with those of the 41 international review rules, the false positive rate (14.60%) and review rate (27.55%) of the intelligent review rules were significantly lower (false positive rate: 30.19%, review rate: 44.14%). The false negative rate of the intelligent review rules (1.89%) was comparable to that of the 41 international review rules (0.90%) and met the ICGHR requirement of a false negative rate < 5%, with no critical hematologic cells missed. Intelligent review rules generated using AI techniques effectively reduce the false positive rate and review rate and prevent missed diagnoses of hematologic cells while ensuring test quality. The review rules generated by AI methods significantly increase laboratory efficiency and are especially suitable for medical institutions.
reason: 同行评审、样本过万且含独立医院外部验证，但为回顾性设计，属值得一看上限
zh_abstract: [Clinica chimica acta; international journal of clinical chemistry] 建立基于人工智能（AI）的智能复检规则，以准确筛查需要复检或血涂片显微镜检查的样本，从而降低复检率、提高血液学实验室的工作效率并确保全血分析质量。共收集2022年5月至2025年4月4家医院临床实验室的10212例EDTA-K2静脉血样本。其中，来自佛山市第一人民医院、东南大学附属中大医院和中山大学附属第一医院的9000例样本用于建立规则，来自复旦大学附属中山医院的1212例样本用于规则验证。将所获得的规则与国际血液学复检共识组（ICGHR）设定的41条复检规则进行比较。所有样本均在定制稀释比例（CDR）模式下使用血液分析仪检测并进行涂片显微镜检查，若显微镜检查结果触发ICGHR建立的10条镜检异常规则，则该样本被判定为异常样本。采用梯度提升决策树（GBDT）算法建立智能复检规则。此外，对验证集的假阴性率、假阳性率和复检率进行统计分析。（1）在建立集的9000例样本中，经显微镜检查识别出4493例异常样本，并采用GBDT算法建立了26条智能复检规则。（2）对于外部验证集，经显微镜检查识别出180例异常样本。与41条国际复检规则相比，智能复检规则的假阳性率（14.60%）和复检率（27.55%）显著更低（假阳性率：30.19%，复检率：44.14%）。智能复检规则的假阴性率（1.89%）与41条国际复检规则（0.90%）相当，并满足ICGHR假阴性率<5%的要求，且未漏检关键血液学细胞。使用AI技术生成的智能复检规则在确保检测质量的同时，有效降低了假阳性率和复检率，并防止血液学细胞漏诊。通过AI方法生成的复检规则显著提高了实验室效率，尤其适用于医疗机构。

title: AI-based hourly prediction of emergency department demand integrating social determinants of health
zh_title: 融合健康社会决定因素的急诊需求逐小时AI预测
summary: 基于武汉某三甲医院213,138次就诊数据，XGBoost模型显示纳入动态SDoH特征优于仅用天气因素预测急诊需求。
key_points: 单中心213,138次就诊，聚合为22,883条小时观测
纳入动态SDoH特征的模型持续优于天气变量模型
构建可解释模型以辅助资源配置
abstract: Emergency department (ED) crowding is associated with delayed treatment and increased mortality, and proactive staffing requires reliable short-term demand forecasts. Most operational models rely on temporal or weather patterns but may insufficiently capture underlying population vulnerability. We evaluated whether community-level social determinants of health (SDoH) improve the prediction of near-term ED demand compared with weather factors using XGBOOST, and developed an interpretable model to inform resource allocation. The study included 213,138 encounters aggregated into 22,883 hourly observations at a tertiary teaching hospital in Wuhan, China. Neighbourhoods differed markedly in age structure and diagnostic profiles, indicating heterogeneous healthcare needs across the catchment area. Models incorporating dynamic SDoH features consistently outperformed those using weather variables alone. Overall, the composite model achieved the best performance with an RMSE of 3.48 visits per hour, an MAE of 2.62 visits per hour, and an R ² of 0.68. Mean absolute prediction errors were approximately 2 to 3 patients per hour across scenarios, suggesting practical utility for short-term staffing and capacity planning. The study indicates that community-level social vulnerability may provide more informative signals than weather conditions for anticipating short-term ED demand. Integrating SDoH-informed forecasts into hospital operations may enable earlier staffing adjustments and help mitigate crowding-related risks.

title: Label-free, low-cost AI ranking for systematic review screening
zh_title: 无标注低成本AI排序用于系统综述筛选
summary: 预印本：无标注决策模型Jev在169982条记录、128篇综述上评测，23篇留出综述平均AUC 0.966，成本约为主流大模型1/700。
key_points: 评测169982条记录、128篇综述
23篇留出综述AUC 0.966 vs 0.831
结合主动学习省力0.659→0.806
abstract: Title and abstract screening is among the most labor-intensive steps of systematic reviews. Jev, a low-cost AI decision model, scores records against eligibility criteria without screening labels. We scored 169,982 records from 128 reviews and, after tuning on development reviews, evaluated 23 held-out reviews once and 31 Cochrane reviews post hoc. Jev outranked the best free ranker in all 23 held-out reviews (mean AUC 0.966 vs 0.831) and came within 0.011 AUC of Claude Opus 5.5 on 1999 records at about 1/700 of its list-price cost (US$0.02/1000 records). Combined with active learning, it raised work saved at 95% recall from 0.659 to 0.806. A fixed score threshold fell below 95% recall in 3 of 28 Cochrane reviews, whereas Jev ranking with statistical stopping (post hoc) reached 95% recall in all 51 reviews, reading 86-88% of records. Label-free ranking with Jev was accurate and inexpensive, but stopping safely required screening decisions.

title: Artificial Intelligence in suicide prevention: promise, peril, and clinical implications for clinical practice.
zh_title: AI在自杀预防中的前景、风险与临床意义
summary: 综述探讨AI在自杀预防连续谱中的应用，包括自杀意念识别、临床医生培训与患者心理支持。

AI虚拟患者提升医生风险评估信心

abstract: [Dialogues in clinical neuroscience] The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into psychiatry is progressing rapidly, with promising yet underexplored applications in suicide prevention. While most existing studies have focused on suicide risk prediction, AI could be applied more broadly across the suicide prevention continuum. This review explores AI's potential in improving the detection of suicidal ideation (SI), enhancing clinician training, and expanding patient access to psychotherapeutic support. Studies suggest that AI models may identify SI more sensitively than clinicians by detecting subtle linguistic or semantic cues. Furthermore, AI-based virtual patients have been shown to improve clinicians' confidence and accuracy in suicide risk assessments, particularly when used alongside traditional training methods. On the patient side, CBT-inspired AI tools offer scalable, on-demand support, but most remain unregulated and clinically unvalidated. Despite their perceived empathy and availability, such tools pose ethical and clinical risks. Many patients use AI tools without professional guidance, a trend clinicians often underestimate. This disconnect calls for urgent regulatory oversight and professional engagement. Without clear clinical validation, AI-based tools may evolve outside medical frameworks, exposing vulnerable individuals to preventable harm. Psychiatry must not only adapt but also lead, ensuring that innovation is harnessed responsibly to serve patients with empathy, safety, and scientific rigor.

title: Evaluation of Computer-aided Detection for Identifying Missed Gastric Cancer After Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection.

summary: 用 2324 张内镜图像比较深度学习 CADe 与 10 名内镜医师对 ESD 后漏诊胃癌的检出，病灶灵敏度无显著差异。

CADe 病灶灵敏度 15.0%，医师 13.8%

abstract: [DEN open] Computer-aided detection (CADe) using deep learning is promising for reducing missed gastric cancers (MGCs) and supporting physicians in double-checking endoscopic images. We aimed to evaluate the CADe efficacy for MGCs after endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD). We collected 2324 endoscopic images, including 60 of MGCs detected during surveillance esophagogastroduodenoscopy within 18 months after initial ESD. The performance of the CADe system, developed for early GC detection using deep learning, was compared with that of 10 endoscopists in a detection study using collected images. Per-lesion sensitivity, per-image detection performance, and diagnostic time were compared. The per-lesion sensitivity for MGCs was 15.0% (9/60) and 13.8% (83/600) for CADe and endoscopist detection, respectively (p = 0.538). The respective per-image computer-aided and endoscopist performance sensitivity was 11.3% and 10.6% (p = 0.548), specificity 88.5% and 94.8% (p < 0.001), positive predictive value 4.4% and 8.3%, and negative predictive value 95.7% and 96.0%. The per-image CADe time was significantly shorter (0.03 s vs. 2.86 s, p < 0.001). CADe showed higher sensitivity in certain subgroups, although these findings should be interpreted cautiously given the small sample size. No significant difference in sensitivity was observed between CADe and endoscopist detection for MGCs after ESD, and the absolute sensitivity remained low. Further improvements are needed before clinical implementation of CADe as a double-checking tool. The authors have confirmed clinical trial registration is not needed for this submission.

title: Evaluation of Large Language Models in the Clinical Management of Patients With Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding: Insights From Real-World Patient Data.

summary: 多中心回顾性研究用 384 例上消化道出血患者，比较五种大模型与临床评分、机器学习模型的入院前风险分层表现。

abstract: [DEN open] To evaluate large language models (LLMs) for pre-endoscopy (PE) risk stratification and prediction of endoscopic findings in upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB), and compare their performance with clinical risk scores, conventional machine learning (ML) models, and hybrid approaches. This multicenter retrospective study included 384 patients with UGIB who underwent endoscopy. Five LLMs (GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Llama 4, Grok, and DeepSeek R1) were tested using structured zero-shot prompts based on PE clinical and laboratory data. Their performance in identifying high-risk patients was compared with the Glasgow-Blatchford Score (GBS), AIMS65, PE Rockall score, and ML models. Hybrid LLM-score models were also assessed. Two gastroenterologists evaluated the quality of LLM-generated justifications. GBS showed the best discriminative performance among clinical scores (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.73). Among LLMs, GPT-5 achieved the highest accuracy (0.66), while Grok showed the best-balanced performance (0.59; F1 0.47). Gemini-2.5-Flash had the highest sensitivity (0.89) but low specificity (0.21). Endoscopic prediction performance was modest, with Gemini-2.5-Flash achieving the highest exact-match accuracy (0.34) and micro-F1 (0.38). Hybrid models improved performance over standalone LLMs but did not outperform GBS alone (best: GBS+GPT-5, AUROC 0.670. LLMs showed higher numerical performance than conventional ML models, but a statistical comparison was not possible due to unavailable instance-level data. Grok received the highest human evaluation score for explanation quality. LLMs showed moderate performance in UGIB risk stratification and endoscopic prediction but were inferior to clinical scores, especially GBS. Hybrid models modestly improved over standalone LLMs but not GBS, supporting their use as adjunct tools rather than clinical decision-support systems. N/A.

title: Dynamic Risk Stratification for Short-Term Deterioration After Acute Stroke: Incremental Value of Radiology-Report-Derived Neuroimaging Phenotypes Beyond Dynamic ICU States, a retrospective cohort study with temporal validation
zh_title: 卒中后短期恶化动态风险分层：影像报告表型的增量价值
summary: MIMIC-IV中4827例急性卒中患者，语言模型从影像报告提取表型，在ICU动态生理状态之上提升24小时恶化预测，含时间验证。
key_points: MIMIC-IV 4827例急性卒中回顾性队列
6–48小时八个节点预测24小时内恶化或死亡

abstract: BackgroundPrediction models after stroke increasingly add neuroimaging information to bedside data. Whether findings documented in radiology reports improve short-term risk stratification beyond a patients evolving physiological state is unknown. MethodsWe studied 4,827 adults with acute ischaemic stroke, intracerebral haemorrhage or subarachnoid haemorrhage in MIMIC-IV (2008-2019). At eight landmarks from 6 to 48 hours after ICU admission, models ranked patients by their risk of deterioration or death within 24 hours. The baseline model combined demographic and clinical characteristics, a previously validated dynamic ICU state representation, and the physiology, treatment and imaging status at each landmark. A locally run language model extracted imaging phenotypes from 6,992 head CT and MRI reports; three phenotypes and four location categories met a pre-specified reliability criterion for automated extraction in independent validation and entered the model. The primary outcome was the difference in the proportion of events captured among the 10% of patients ranked highest at each landmark, in temporal validation (2017-2019; 8,923 patient-landmarks, 666 events). ResultsAmong the highest-ranked 10%, adding imaging phenotypes captured no additional event (348 of 666 with and without them): a difference of 0.00 percentage points (95% CI -2.20 to +2.01). Discrimination (AUROC 0.855 vs 0.849), calibration and net benefit were similar. No prespecified sensitivity analysis, stroke subtype or availability-adjusted analysis showed statistically supported incremental capture. In a post hoc redundancy analysis, imaging phenotypes improved capture when added to demographic and clinical characteristics alone (+12.91 points, 7.54 to 17.81), but this gain was no longer evident once the dynamic state representation was included. ConclusionsNeuroimaging phenotypes derived from routine radiology reports were associated with short-term deterioration, but we found no evidence that they added risk stratification value beyond the dynamic ICU state and contemporaneous physiology.

title: Realizing the value of the divergence event in clinical human-AI interaction
zh_title: 临床人机交互中「分歧事件」的价值实现

abstract: When a clinical AI system’s output differs from a human clinician’s judgment, what follows is consequential and underspecified. Current AI interfaces offer only a narrow lane for what happens next: they present the AI output (and its associated potential divergence) as an adjudicative choice for a human to accept, override, or modify. In practice, collapsing this human-AI interaction into a single output inadvertently obscures what happens in a potential divergence event (Fig. 1 ) which can be characterized along three axes: What the workflow and interface allow the clinician to see and do ( structural axis), what information each side brought to the interaction ( informational axis), and how the clinician engaged with the AI’s reasoning rather than only its output ( behavioral axis). When clinical judgment and AI output diverge, clinicians must ultimately decide what to recommend and how to explain their recommendation to the patient, consider their autonomy, accountability, and liability, and bear moral responsibility 1 . A recent systematic review of AI ethics in nursing and midwifery found that AI challenges the role of health professionals not through replacement, but through subtle reconfiguration of the activities that count as care and that emphasis on AI efficiency may risk certain relational aspects of care less visible and valued 2 . Because clinicians often cannot see how an AI system reached its output, they are left to choose between that AI output and their own judgment. Clinicians are told to be the “human in the loop” but are typically given no method for doing so beyond “exercising their judgment” 3 . Efforts to make AI output both more technically explainable and human interpretable - have not directly correlated with improved clinical decisions and have sometimes created false confidence in incorrect AI output 4 .

zh_abstract: 当临床 AI 系统的输出与人类临床医生的判断不同时，随之而来的后果重大且规定不足。当前的 AI 界面仅为接下来发生的事情提供了一条狭窄通道：它们将 AI 输出（及其相关的潜在分歧）呈现为一种裁决性选择，供人接受、推翻或修改。在实践中，将这种人-AI 交互压缩为单一输出，会无意中掩盖潜在分歧事件（图 1）中发生的情况；该事件可沿三个轴线刻画：工作流程和界面允许临床医生看到和做什么（结构轴线），每一方为交互带来了什么信息（信息轴线），以及临床医生如何参与 AI 的推理而不仅仅是其输出（行为轴线）。当临床判断与 AI 输出出现分歧时，临床医生最终必须决定推荐什么以及如何向患者解释其推荐，考虑其自主权、问责和法律责任，并承担道德责任 1。最近一项关于护理和助产领域 AI 伦理的系统综述发现，AI 对卫生专业人员角色的挑战并非通过替代，而是通过对被视为照护的活动的微妙重构；并且强调 AI 效率可能使照护的某些关系性方面更不显眼且更不受重视 2。由于临床医生往往无法看到 AI 系统如何得出其输出，他们只能在 AI 输出和自己的判断之间做选择。临床医生被告知要成为“human in the loop（人在回路中）”，但通常除了“运用其判断”3 之外，并没有得到这样做的方法。使 AI 输出在技术上更可解释且对人类更可解释的努力——并未与临床决策改善直接相关，有时还会对不正确的 AI 输出产生虚假信心 4。

title: Subversion of clinical judgment by conversational artificial intelligence
zh_title: 对话式AI对临床判断的隐性颠覆
summary: 参与者盲法随机实验中，225名多国医师使用被设定为对抗性的对话AI，多数被引导偏离正确诊疗。
key_points: 225名医师、42国、8个临床专科参与
同一模型设对抗与对齐两种条件
对抗条件下190名医师被误导
abstract: In medicine, artificial intelligence (AI) safety has focused on discrete flaws such as hallucination, bias and miscalibration. Conversational systems pose a distinct hazard: in dialogue, a model can covertly advance a misaligned objective by redirecting the clinical judgment it should support. Whether clinical expertise equips physicians to detect and resist such subversion is unknown. In a participant-blinded, randomized experiment, 225 physicians from 42 countries and eight clinical disciplines made sequential diagnostic and treatment decisions with AI assistance on anonymized cases from neurocritical care, their shared field of expertise. Unknown to them, each physician used the same model under two conditions: instructed to steer them towards harmful targets (adversarial) or correct clinical options (aligned), each established by expert consensus. With adversarial AI, 190 physicians made at least one harmful decision, compared to 21 with aligned AI. Across 2,485 targeted decision points, adversarial AI raised the harmful-decision rate from 2% with aligned AI to 49% (adjusted difference 47 percentage points, 95% CI, 43-51) and reduced the correct-decision rate from 83% to 25%, with no clear protection associated with clinical experience. Of the 190 physicians who made harmful decisions with adversarial AI, 141 did not report anything unusual about that AI. Two physicians reported suspecting systematic steering or manipulation. Physicians cannot safeguard the clinical use of conversational AI through expertise and decision-making authority alone.

zh_abstract: 在医学中，人工智能（AI）安全性一直聚焦于离散缺陷，如幻觉、偏倚和校准不良。对话系统带来一种独特危险：在对话中，模型可以通过重新引导它本应支持的临床判断，暗中推进一个不一致的目标。临床专业知识是否能使医生识别并抵制这种颠覆尚不清楚。在一项参与者设盲的随机实验中，来自 42 个国家、八个临床学科的 225 名医生，在其共同专业领域——神经重症监护的匿名病例上，借助 AI 做出了连续的诊断和治疗决策。他们不知道的是，每位医生在两种条件下使用了同一个模型：被指示将他们引向有害目标（对抗性）或正确临床选项（对齐），每种条件均由专家共识确定。在使用对抗性 AI 时，190 名医生至少做出了一项有害决策，而使用对齐 AI 时为 21 名。在 2,485 个目标决策点上，对抗性 AI 将有有害决策率从使用对齐 AI 时的 2% 提高到 49%（校正差异 47 个百分点，95% CI，43-51），并将正确决策率从 83% 降低到 25%，未发现临床经验具有明确的保护作用。在使用对抗性 AI 做出有害决策的 190 名医生中，141 名未报告该 AI 有任何异常。两名医生报告怀疑存在系统性引导或操纵。医生仅凭专业知识和决策权无法保障对话式 AI 的临床使用安全。

title: Pan-cancer estimation of prognostic immune biomarkers from histopathology using artificial intelligence
zh_title: AI从病理H&E图像估计泛癌预后免疫标志物
summary: 预印本：弱监督模型HistoProfile从常规H&E切片估计CD8、FOXP3、PD-1、PD-L1密度及PD-L1 TPS，AUROC为0.78–0.89。
key_points: 从H&E图像估计多种免疫标志物密度
AUROC 0.78–0.89区分高/低表达
估计值在生存分析中保留预后分层
abstract: Multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) assays such as ImmunoProfile provide standardized quantification of prognostic immune markers but are costly and not routinely used in clinical settings. We developed a weakly-supervised AI model, HistoProfile, to estimate intratumoral cell densities of key immune biomarkers (CD8, FOXP3, PD-1, and PD-L1) and the PD-L1 tumor proportion score from routine H&E-stained whole-slide images. Trained on a large pan-cancer cohort with paired H&E and mIF data, HistoProfile discriminated biomarker-high from biomarker-low tumors in held-out samples and tumor-specific subgroups (AUROCs of 0.78-0.89 across biomarkers). Critically, the estimated biomarkers preserved prognostic stratification in downstream survival analyses, and showed cancer-specific survival associations across TCGA cohorts where mIF is unavailable. These findings support scalable H&E-based estimation of key immune biomarker measurements for large-scale immune profiling and risk stratification.

zh_abstract: 多重免疫荧光（mIF）检测，如 ImmunoProfile，可对预后免疫标志物进行标准化定量，但成本高昂且未在临床环境中常规使用。我们开发了一种弱监督人工智能模型 HistoProfile，用于从常规 H&E 染色的全切片图像中估计关键免疫生物标志物（CD8、FOXP3、PD-1 和 PD-L1）的瘤内细胞密度以及 PD-L1 肿瘤比例评分。在具有配对 H&E 和 mIF 数据的大型泛癌队列上训练后，HistoProfile 在留出样本和肿瘤特异性亚组中能够区分生物标志物高表达与低表达肿瘤（各生物标志物的 AUROC 为 0.78–0.89）。关键的是，所估计的生物标志物在下游生存分析中保留了预后分层，并在无法获得 mIF 的 TCGA 各队列中显示出癌症特异性的生存关联。这些发现支持基于 H&E 的可扩展估计关键免疫生物标志物测量值，用于大规模免疫谱分析和风险分层。

title: VirtualSkin integrates skin-cell identity with intervention-response prediction
zh_title: VirtualSkin：整合皮肤细胞身份与干预反应预测
summary: 预印本提出细胞语言模型 VirtualSkin，对齐皮肤转录组与生物学描述，支持干预条件下的反应预测。
key_points: 在独立图谱、疾病、解剖与扰动队列评估
炎症皮肤注释 macro F1 提升 0.056
细胞文本检索 Recall@10 提升 0.12
abstract: Human skin atlases resolve a diverse set of cellular states, yet connecting these states to their responses to intervention remains difficult across independently sampled tissues. Here we present VirtualSkin, a cell language model that aligns skin transcriptomes with biological descriptions and supports intervention conditioned response prediction. We evaluated the model across independent atlas, disease, anatomical and perturbation cohorts, with donors, studies and perturbations withheld according to the experimental design. VirtualSkin improved inflammatory skin annotation by 0.056 macro F1 points and cell text retrieval by 0.12 Recall@10 points relative to the strongest corresponding comparators. The representation retained cell identity during study integration and transferred across ageing, systemic sclerosis, lymphoma and anatomical sites. Across five intervention cohorts, response prediction improved by 0.03 0.09 response-score points, with agreement at the levels of gene expression change, gene recovery and transcriptional programs. Paired tissue trajectories provided a complementary assessment in two donors per intervention. Component ablations and pairing controls localized the predictive contributions, while uncertainty estimates supported selective prediction under distribution shift. These results connect skin-cell recognition to intervention response prediction within a common evaluation framework and define the conditions under which predictions can inform experimental prioritization.
reason: 预印本，跨独立队列评估并有基线对比，属值得一看档。
zh_abstract: 人类皮肤图谱解析了多样的细胞状态，但将独立采样组织中的这些状态与其对干预的响应联系起来仍然困难。此处我们提出 VirtualSkin，一种细胞语言模型，可将皮肤转录组与生物学描述对齐，并支持干预条件化响应预测。我们在独立的图谱、疾病、解剖和扰动队列中评估了该模型，并按照实验设计保留供体、研究和扰动不参与。相较于最强对应比较器，VirtualSkin 将炎症性皮肤注释提高了 0.056 个 macro F1 点，将细胞文本检索提高了 0.12 个 Recall@10 点。该表征在研究整合过程中保留了细胞身份，并可跨衰老、系统性硬化症、淋巴瘤和解剖部位迁移。在五个干预队列中，响应预测提高了 0.03 0.09 个响应评分点，并在基因表达变化、基因恢复和转录程序水平上一致。配对组织轨迹在每种干预的两名供体中提供了补充评估。组件消融和配对对照定位了预测贡献，而不确定性估计支持分布偏移下的选择性预测。这些结果在共同评估框架内将皮肤细胞识别与干预响应预测联系起来，并界定了预测可用于指导实验优先排序的条件。

title: BioMod: Biological Module Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Modeling
zh_title: BioMod：单细胞基础建模的生物模块分词
summary: 提出5000万参数单细胞基础模型，以660个生物模块作为基因与细胞之间的表征单元。
key_points: 用通路与数据驱动基因程序构建660个模块
以模块级掩码在约7300万人细胞上预训练
以模块替代成千上万基因级输入
abstract: Single-cell foundation models typically represent cells as flat sequences of individual genes, requiring higher-order biological organization to be inferred implicitly from sparse expression profiles. Similar to the evolution from character-level to semantic tokenization in natural language processing,we hypothesize that cellular states can be more efficiently represented using biologically meaningful intermediate units. Here we present BioMod, a 50-million-parameter single-cell foundation model that introduces biological modules as representation units between genes and cells. BioMod constructs an overlapping vocabulary of 660 biological modules derived from curated pathways and data-driven gene programs, replacing thousands of gene-level inputs with compact module representations. Pretrained on approximately 73 million human cells using high-ratio module masking with an asymmetric decoder, BioMod achieves state-of-the-art performance across cell-type annotation, zero-shot batch integration, perturbation-response prediction and drug-response forecasting while maintaining a compact architecture that enables efficient inference on a single GPU. Module-level analyses further demonstrate that BioMod captures biologically meaningful cellular programs and preserves pathway-level organization.
reason: 新颖模块化单细胞基础模型、预训练规模大，但为预印本证据有限
zh_abstract: 单细胞基础模型通常将细胞表示为单个基因的扁平序列，需要从稀疏表达谱中隐式推断更高阶的生物组织。类似于自然语言处理中从字符级到语义标记化的演变，我们假设细胞状态可以使用具有生物学意义的中间单元更高效地表示。在此，我们提出 BioMod，一个 5000 万参数的单细胞基础模型，它引入生物模块作为基因与细胞之间的表示单元。BioMod 构建了一个由 660 个生物模块组成的重叠词汇表，这些模块源自精选通路和数据驱动的基因程序，用紧凑的模块表示替代了数千个基因级输入。BioMod 在约 7300 万个人类细胞上预训练，采用高比例模块掩码与非对称解码器，在细胞类型注释、零样本批次整合、扰动响应预测和药物响应预测方面达到最先进性能，同时保持紧凑架构，从而能够在单个 GPU 上高效推理。模块级分析进一步表明，BioMod 捕获了具有生物学意义的细胞程序，并保留了通路级组织。

title: Effects of Dish Name, Visible Amount, Persona, and Explicit Instruction on Energy Estimates From Food Photographs by 26 Vision-Language Models: Comparative Evaluation Study
zh_title: 26个视觉语言模型从食物照片估算能量的对比评估
summary: 预印本：在两个日美食物照片数据集上比较26个视觉语言模型，检验菜名、份量、人设与指令对能量估算的影响。

考察菜名、可见份量与人物设定的作用
abstract: Background: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being considered for estimating energy intake from meal photographs. Prompt descriptions such as a Japanese-dietitian persona shift the estimates, suggesting their use for calibration; what the estimates rest on was unknown. Objective: We examined whether prompt descriptions can serve as calibration, at which training stage responses to a nationality persona and to an amount instruction arise, and whether estimates follow the visible amount or one associated with the identified dish. Methods: Eleven commercial and 15 open-weight models were evaluated on NutriImage (887 Japanese single-dish photographs) and SNAPMe (1,134 US meal photographs) under eight prompt conditions (no description, five personas, and smaller- or larger-portion instructions). With one model, images were cropped or replaced by the dish name. Before- and after-meal photographs of 804 meals (ACETADA) were estimated. Pre-trained and post-trained weights of Gemma 3 and InternVL3.5 8B were compared by likelihood scoring. Prompts were compared with numerical calibration. Results: Where the dish was named as in the full image, a 25% crop changed neither the median absolute percentage error (MedAPE; 33.8% vs 34.4%) nor the persona shift (-20 vs -20 kcal); dish names alone gave similar accuracy (MedAPE 31.7%); nearly empty trays still received 39%-75% of the before-meal estimate, often described as already eaten. Between models, the persona shift was related to baseline bias (r = -0.77) and less to instruction following (r = -0.36); the instruction shift showed the reverse (r = -0.14 and -0.95). In Gemma 3, the Japan-US contrast was 2-4 times larger before post-training, and the instruction response 2-4 times larger after it (InternVL3.5 8B: 3 and 1.4 times). Across images, the Japan-US contrast was uniform on US meals and, for Japanese dishes in the commercial models, Gemma 3, and Qwen3-VL 32B, larger where overestimated. In these models, the persona lowered MedAPE for Japanese dishes as much as, or slightly more than, subtracting the mean bias, and no more than dividing by a ratio; on US meals it did not; in open-weight families that responded little, only numerical calibration lowered error. The smaller-portion instruction raised MedAPE in models with little bias (eg, 30.0% to 50.2%). Although routine coagulation markers are clinically relevant, their incremental value for mortality prediction beyond neurologic and physiologic information is uncertain. We developed and externally validated models using first-24-hour ICU data and evaluated the added predictive value of routine coagulation measurements. Methods: We used MIMIC-IV for model development and eICU-CRD for external validation. The development cohort included 2,669 adults with non-traumatic ICH and 388 ICU deaths. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were evaluated using a patient-level 70:30 holdout split and 5-fold stratified cross-validation. External validation used a high-specificity primary eICU cohort (396 patients; 39 deaths) and a broader secondary hemorrhagic-stroke/likely-ICH cohort (1,555 patients; 168 deaths). Performance was assessed using AUROC, AUPRC, Brier score, calibration, and paired bootstrap comparisons. GCS-only and age-plus-GCS models served as clinical benchmarks. Coagulation-only, clinical-only, and combined XGBoost models were compared to assess incremental value. Results: In the internal holdout cohort, AUROCs were 0.870 for logistic regression, 0.859 for random forest, and 0.867 for XGBoost. In the primary external cohort, corresponding AUROCs were 0.804, 0.839, and 0.817; AUPRCs were 0.342, 0.419, and 0.406; and Brier scores were 0.080, 0.072, and 0.074. In the broader cohort, AUROCs were 0.826, 0.848, and 0.838. Random forest showed the numerically strongest external performance, but pairwise AUROC differences among multivariable models were not clearly supported. GCS-only achieved AUROCs of 0.780 and 0.813 in the primary and broader cohorts. Coagulation-only XGBoost showed weak discrimination (AUROC 0.598 internally, 0.598 primary external, and 0.566 broader external). Adding coagulation variables to the clinical model produced AUROC differences of 0.014 (95% CI -0.009 to 0.037) and 0.003 (95% CI -0.007 to 0.013) in the two external cohorts. Conclusions: Multivariable models based on first-24-hour ICU data retained useful discrimination across external cohorts and provided modest gains over simple GCS-based benchmarks. Routine coagulation markers alone were weak predictors and did not provide clearly supported incremental discrimination beyond broader clinical information. title: Decision models can offload structured clinical tasks from large language models

abstract: Decision models like Jev read text and return probabilities, categories, or ordinal levels, with confidence scores for the latter two, at a fraction of large language models' (LLMs) cost. We explored how Jev could be integrated into clinical workflows for all these output types: mortality risk estimation, categorical Choosing-Wisely decisions for patient questions, and ordinal colon cancer staging. With standard LLM-style inputs, Jev trailed five flagship LLMs: mortality AUROC was 0.822 versus 0.837-0.846; Choosing-Wisely accuracy, 87.7% versus 98.4-100%; and staging accuracy, 45.4% versus 94.2-100%. Developer-recommended input alterations improved staging accuracy to 75.8% with medical context, 82.1% with task decomposition, and 85.8% with both. None of Jev's staging errors had full confidence. Using Jev for fully confident staging decisions and LLMs for the rest was non-inferior to each LLM alone and cut flagship LLM costs by 33-44%. Prompted as designed, decision models may efficiently share structured clinical tasks with LLMs.

abstract: [DEN open] Artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted endoscopy represents a promising approach for lesion detection, yet frequent false-positive detections impair clinical utility by disrupting examinations and diminishing physician confidence. Linked-color imaging (LCI), an image-enhanced endoscopy technique that amplifies mucosal and vascular contrast, may address this limitation. This investigation evaluated whether LCI reduces false-positive AI detections compared with white-light imaging (WLI). This retrospective study analyzed consecutive AI-assisted upper endoscopies performed between March 2024 and June 2025. WLI and LCI were performed sequentially within the same endoscopic session in each patient. False-positive AI detections were compared between modalities using two computer-aided detection (CAD) versions. Propensity score adjustment was used as a sensitivity analysis for baseline differences between CAD Versions I and II. Of 66 initially screened cases, 63 remained after excluding patients with prior gastric surgery. LCI reduced false-positive AI detections compared with WLI (median 2 vs. 5; p < 0.001). In CAD version-stratified sensitivity analyses, LCI reduced false-positive AI detections in both Version I (5 to 2; p = 0.01) and Version II (2 to 0; p = 0.03). This reduction remained consistent across atrophic grades. Both imaging modalities identified all gastric lesions, achieving 100% detection sensitivity. LCI assessment performed after WLI observation yielded fewer false-positive CAD-EYE detections while maintaining lesion detection sensitivity. However, because the observation sequence was fixed, these findings should be interpreted cautiously and require confirmation in prospective or counterbalanced studies. Trial Registration: N/A (retrospective study).

title: Deep learning-driven de novo design of ribosome binding sites in Paracoccus denitrificans.
zh_title: 深度学习从头设计脱氮副球菌核糖体结合位点
summary: 研究系统解析1335条天然RBS序列并结合转录组与蛋白组分析，进而用深度学习从头设计功能RBS。

abstract: [Synthetic and systems biotechnology] Paracoccus denitrificans is a heterotrophic nitrifying-aerobic denitrifying bacterium widely used in wastewater treatment and as a model system for studying electron transport chains, making it a promising chassis for environmental synthetic biology. Precise translational control of gene expression is essential for engineering desired traits in this organism, yet the design of functional ribosome binding sites (RBS) in P. denitrificans remains hindered by limited understanding of their sequence-activity relationships. To address this gap, we systematically profiled 1335 native RBS sequences via integrated transcriptomic and proteomic analyses. We found that RBS strength is predominantly governed by a purine-rich Shine-Dalgarno motif located 5-8 bp upstream of the start codon, with specific A/G patterns in this region serving as key determinants. Building on this dataset, we developed and compared CNN, BiLSTM, and Transformer models for RBS strength prediction; among them, the CNN achieved the highest predictive correlation (Pearson r = 0.68). Additionally, a WGAN-GP framework was implemented to generate novel RBS sequences, which were subsequently filtered and evaluated by the prediction framework to enable the design of RBSs with user-specified strengths. Experimental validation showed a relatively strong correlation between predicted and measured strengths (Pearson r = 0.75). This work establishes the first deep learning-enabled RBS design platform for P. denitrificans, offering a robust tool for precise translational regulation and advancing synthetic biology applications in environmental biotechnology.

abstract: [Clinica chimica acta; international journal of clinical chemistry] For much of its history, forensic toxicology was built on a core analytical question: what poison or drug is present, and at what concentration? That question still matters, but modern casework increasingly shows that it is no longer sufficient on its own. The field grew from the nineteenth-century chemical toxicology of Mathieu Orfila and the arsenic-detecting Marsh test into a discipline central to medicolegal death investigation, overdose certification, and exposure reconstruction. Yet contemporary practice must now contend with novel psychoactive substances, highly potent synthetic opioids, complex polysubstance deaths, delayed reporting, postmortem redistribution, matrix degradation, and incomplete toxicological context. These pressures are pushing forensic toxicology beyond simple compound detection toward mechanism-aware, data-rich interpretation. This review develops the idea of precision forensic toxicology as a proposed, forward-looking conceptual framework for that transition rather than a description of established or routinely implemented forensic practice. In this model, classical analytical chemistry remains essential, but it is connected to toxicogenomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, metabolomics, exposomics, microbiomics, and spatial multi-omics, then integrated through systems toxicology and artificial intelligence. Recent literature shows that toxicogenomics can reveal early molecular perturbations before overt phenotype, that postmortem metabolomics can assist cause-of-death screening, that RNA- and miRNA-based markers may improve postmortem interval estimation, and that machine learning can strengthen high-resolution mass-spectrometry workflows and multi-omics interpretation. At the same time, routine implementation remains constrained by standardization, validation, explainability, privacy governance, and regulatory uncertainty. None of these components is yet part of routine forensic casework; each remains at a research or early-validation stage, and their translation into daily practice will require dedicated feasibility, validation, and regulatory work, which this review discusses explicitly. title: Artificial intelligence-guided nanozyme engineering for chronic wound healing: from rational design to precision therapeutics.

summary: 同行评审综述提出病理知情设计框架，将慢性伤口治疗需求与AI辅助的纳米酶筛选、功能优化和迭代改进相衔接。

abstract: [Bioactive materials] Chronic non-healing wounds remain a major clinical challenge, with limited therapeutic efficacy and a huge burden on patients. Nanozymes have emerged as promising bioactive platforms for wound repair by modulating reactive oxygen species, immune responses, angiogenesis, and antimicrobial defense. However, traditional nanozyme development primarily relies on empirical approaches, resulting in limited functional specificity and suboptimal therapeutic outcomes. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have provided promising alternatives to overcome these limitations and accelerate the rational engineering of nanozymes. This review proposes a pathology-informed design framework that links wound-specific therapeutic needs to nanozyme screening, function optimization, and iterative refinement. We synthesize current progress in AI-enabled material discovery and structure-activity prediction, function-oriented and multiobjective optimization, development of stimuli-responsive systems, and elucidation of biological mechanisms. We further examine how these approaches support pathology-guided functional matching, coordination of multifunctional interventions, treatment monitoring, and closed-loop feedback optimization. Key challenges include heterogeneous and biased datasets, limited model generalizability, weak correlation between in vitro catalytic metrics and in vivo efficacy, insufficient wound-relevant endpoints, and incomplete long-term safety assessments. Future work should strengthen the links among material properties, catalytic behavior, and tissue-repair outcomes, while incorporating pathological conditions, delivery systems, and therapeutic feedback into model optimization.

title: Organoid Intelligent Morphomics: Decoding the organoid morphome through artificial intelligence from phenotypic quantification to mechanistic insight.
zh_title: 类器官智能形态组学：AI解码形态-功能-机制
summary: 综述提出结合成像与人工智能的类器官智能形态组学框架，实现从形态量化到机制推断的映射。
key_points: 提出OIM整合分析框架

abstract: [Bioactive materials] Organoids, as three-dimensional bioactive microtissues capable of recapitulating native organ architecture and function, have become valuable models in biomedical research. However, their broad adoption is constrained by subjective morphological assessment and endpoint assays that compromise standardization and scalability. This review introduces Organoid Intelligent Morphomics (OIM), an integrative analytical framework that synergizes imaging technologies with artificial intelligence to establish a "morphology-function-mechanism" mapping. OIM enables a paradigm shift from qualitative to quantitative analysis, from static to dynamic monitoring, and from superficial observation to deep molecular inference. The applications of OIM are critically examined across three interconnected domains: (1) quality control, encompassing real-time assessment through non-invasive viability quantification and morphological evaluation, as well as predictive quality control for early differentiation outcome forecasting; (2) disease deconstruction, enabling quantitative, multiscale phenotyping of disease morphology and establishing morphology-mechanism association analyses; (3) drug development, facilitating high-throughput efficacy screening, toxicity assessment, and personalized therapeutic guidance. Furthermore, we critically analyze the current data, algorithmic, and translational challenges facing OIM, propose corresponding solutions, and provide a roadmap toward artificial intelligence virtual organoids. Ultimately, OIM holds promise for establishing the critical technological infrastructure for the scalable manufacturing and clinical translation of organoid-based therapeutics.

title: High-throughput pharmaceutical classification via short-range interferometric hyperspectral imaging.

abstract: Short-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging (SWIR-HSI) enables rapid, non-destructive material characterization with high potential for process analytical technology and pharmaceutical screening. Here, we demonstrate high-throughput, full-field SWIR-HSI using Fourier transform spectroscopy (FTS) coupled with deep learning. Conventional FTS typically requires thousands of sampling points over a wide optical path difference (OPD) range to resolve spectral features. By directly processing raw interferograms with deep learning, bypassing conventional Fourier transformation, we achieved 98.9% pixel-level and 100% whole-tablet classification accuracy across 11 over-the-counter pharmaceutical products using only 200 data points acquired over a 10 μm mirror displacement (20 μm OPD). Under challenging independent-lot, multi-day testing conditions, the framework maintained 96.7% pixel-level and 100% whole-tablet accuracy. Latent-space visualizations confirmed that short-range interferograms retain sufficient chemical and physical information for rapid, robust pharmaceutical classification. These findings indicate that deep-learned short-range interferometry offers a promising, vibration-resilient approach for high-throughput, non-destructive quality control of solid dosage pharmaceuticals.

title: Data-efficient machine learning for the detection of duodenal neoplasia: a multi-centre study
zh_title: 多中心数据高效机器学习检测十二指肠上皮肿瘤
summary: 五家医院8027例正常与401例肿瘤全切片，基于Hibou-B基础模型实现数据高效检测。

abstract: BackgroundMachine Learning (ML) has shown promise in histopathological diagnosis, but rare tumours, like duodenal epithelial neoplasms, are challenging because large, labelled datasets are difficult to assemble. We propose a data-efficient ML pipeline for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia in whole-slide images. MethodsWe assembled a five-hospital dataset of haematoxylin and eosin-stained duodenal biopsy whole slide images (WSIs) at 10x magnification, comprising 8,027 normal and 401 neoplastic biopsies, including adenomas, carcinomas and neuroendocrine tumours. WSIs were divided into patches and encoded using the Hibou-B foundation model. We compared global standardisation with unsupervised site-specific standardisation of patch embeddings. Our pipeline combined principal component analysis, a Gaussian mixture model and a Random Forest classifier. We assessed generalisability using leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation across four hospitals and on an independent test set from a fifth hospital. ResultsIn leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation, the pipeline achieved a mean accuracy of 90%, sensitivity of 96%, specificity of 83% and an AUC of 0.96. On the external test hospital, it achieved 94% accuracy, 93% sensitivity, 95% specificity, and AUC of 0.97. Site-specific standardisation improved mean cross-validation accuracy by 20 percentage points compared with global standardisation, while the Gaussian mixture pipeline improved accuracy by 12 percentage points compared with mean pooling of patch embeddings. ConclusionsWe present a data-efficient ML approach for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia from WSIs. Strong performance was maintained across hospitals and on an independent external test cohort despite the limited number of neoplastic training cases, supporting the feasibility of foundation-model-based approaches for rare histopathological diagnoses.

abstract: Social media language and digital lifestyle behaviours are promoted as scalable signals of population mental health, but predictive models are often evaluated in ways that overstate accuracy. We analysed 20,000 tweets from 72 users, labelled by whether the account belonged to a user identified as depressed, and two synthetic datasets (100,000 and 30,000 records) linking screen time, sleep and social media use with self-reported stress. Under a conventional tweet-level split, a term-weighted logistic regression appeared accurate (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.835), but when whole users were held out its performance fell to near chance (0.595; 95% confidence interval 0.505-0.686), because the model largely recognised users and their topics. Depression-associated tweets were more often negative (31.7% versus 24.2%), yet sentiment alone could not identify unseen users (0.539). The two behavioural datasets gave opposite answers: strong discrimination in one (0.926), driven by short sleep, and chance in the other (0.506), so synthetic results reflect how the data were generated. Digital distress signals should be validated across individuals, on real linked data and at realistic prevalence before informing public health surveillance or prevention.

Methods: We analyzed a program feedback web survey completed between 11 July and 29 July, 2025 by hub clinicians and spoke providers. abstract: Objectives: To assess the feasibility and early performance of an AI-assisted screening workflow that reviews inpatient discharge summaries to identify potential treatment injuries for clinician review and, where appropriate, Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC) treatment injury claim consideration in New Zealand. Design: Single-site, six-month pilot reported as a quality-improvement/service-evaluation activity. A large language model (LLM)-enabled system acted as an index screening test over discharge summaries to generate candidate treatment injury signals for structured clinician adjudication and escalation. Setting: A New Zealand district hospital (Wairarapa). Screening operated on routinely produced inpatient discharge summaries. Participants: All inpatient discharge summaries produced during the pilot period were screened (n = 2,642). The unit of analysis was one discharge summary per inpatient episode. Intervention: An LLM-based screening workflow that outputs structured candidate harm signals with supporting excerpts and a certainty label. Outputs were reviewed by clinicians using a structured adjudication template. Suitable cases could be escalated to senior clinicians and followed through the local ACC treatment injury process. Main outcome measures: Primary outcomes were yield, positive predictive value (PPV) of AI- flagged signals for clinician-adjudicated iatrogenic harm, and the rate of unsupported/hallucinated outputs. Secondary outcomes included overlap with incident reporting and administrative coding, downstream ACC claim outcomes, and clinician review workload. Results: Across 2,642 inpatient discharge summaries screened, the AI-assisted workflow generated 237 candidate signals (yield 9.0%; 95% CI 7.9% to 10.1%). Clinician adjudication classified 102 as confirmed iatrogenic harm, 43 as possible harm requiring additional context, 81 as no harm, and 11 as unsupported/hallucinated outputs. PPV for confirmed harm was 43.0% (95% CI 36.8% to 49.4%). PPV for confirmed-or-possible harm was 61.2% (95% CI 54.9% to 67.1%). Seven ACC treatment injury claims were lodged as a direct result of AI-assisted surfacing; three were accepted, two declined, and two were held/pending at analysis. Organisational ACC data identified 68 treatment injury claims lodged during the same period, of which 17 overlapped with AI-identified cases.
